name: Tinder
description: #(Tag:fire)Produce and control weak little flames, never stronger than matchsticks and candle flames.

name: Ember
description: #(Tag:fire)Produce and control moderate flames that can be shaped into attacks like fireballs and fire arrows.

name: Blaze
description: #(Tag:fire)Produce and control flames to unleash streams, arrows, whips, walls of fire, and similar attacks.

name: Pyrokinesis
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:kinesis)Produce and control your own or natural flames with fine control, shaping them into arrows, blades, walls, projectiles, and similar forms.

name: Hellflames
description: #(Tag:fire)Emit and control powerful flames on a large scale, unleashing giant flamethrowers or compressing flames into laser-like points, with extreme flame resistance. Overuse causes overheating, lowering your maximum energy output.

name: Micro Pyrokinesis
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:kinesis)Control heat and flames on a small scale with atomic precision, though weak in power and temperature.

name: Disaster Flames
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:fire)Embody humanity's fear of wildfires, eruptions, and flames, granting very potent pyrokinesis plus lava generation and manipulation. Your conceptual flames are far less restrained by ordinary limitations.

name: Amaterasu
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:ocular)Ignite an object in your line of sight with Amaterasu flames that can burn anything and cannot be extinguished by normal means. Repeated use strains your eye, causing bleeding or blindness.

name: Frenzied Flame
description: #(Tag:fire)Wield and manipulate the Frenzied Flame, a cosmic fire that can burn minds, souls, and space. Increased use causes mental instability and obsession with destruction.

name: Ignite
description: #(Tag:fire)Instantly set any object you touch aflame; stronger targets are harder to ignite. With training, you can ignite adjacent objects.

name: Conflagration
description: #(Tag:fire)Instantly set any target or area you touch aflame; stronger targets are harder to ignite. One touch can burn entire buildings, and with training, entire cities.

name: Mystic Eyes of Flame
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:ocular)Raise the temperature of and spontaneously combust any target in your line of sight; stronger targets cost more energy. While active, your eye turns red with three overlapping triangles.

name: Fire Cloak
description: #(Tag:buff)(Tag:fire)Cloak yourself and your surroundings in flame that ignites nearby non-friendly targets, though it may fail on stronger opponents. While active, all fire-based abilities are slightly more potent.

name: Fireball
description: #(Tag:fire)Form and launch fireballs from your hands or other appendages; size and potency depend on energy expended.

name: Flame Weaponry
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:martial)Emit fire shaped into any cold weaponry such as swords, axes, hammers, bows, and crossbows. The flames mimic the weapon's properties, staying sharp as a sword or heavy as a hammer.

name: Frostflare
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:ice)Emit and control incredibly powerful Frostflare, flames that freeze instead of burning. While using it, you gain incredible ice and cold resistance in exchange for vulnerability to flame.

name: Fire Absorption
description: #(Tag:fire)Absorb fire into your body to release later as your own flames or convert into energy. Strong flames may be impossible or painful to absorb, and absorbing too much without releasing causes internal burning.

name: Pyromaster
description: #(Tag:fire)Control flames and ignition on the level of a Level 5 Esper from Toaru, with unmatched precision, range, and control.

name: Unholy Flames
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:infernal)Wield Hell flames so potent even you are not fully immune, suffering burns from overuse. They deal severe damage to Holy and Light-based beings.

name: Profaned Flames
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:holy)(Tag:infernal)Channel and control Providence's Profaned Flames, which are incomparably hot, turn all to impartial ash, and ignore all fire resistance.

name: Profaned Guardian Transformation
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:holy)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:transformation)Temporarily take the form of one of Providence's guardians, massively boosting physical stats and granting flame wings and Profaned Flame manipulation. Maintaining it slowly burns you from the inside until released, mitigated only by fire resistance.

name: Shadowflames
description: #(Tag:fire)Emit and control Shadowflame, soundless flames with no energy signature that burn away light, making them extremely hard to perceive. An experienced user can hide them from all senses.

name: Fire Fist
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:martial)Coat your fists in flames that enhance strike power while burning the target. You can release the fire while punching to launch a burning fist projectile.

name: Fire Logia
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:transformation)Emit, create, shape, control, and turn into fire and flame at will, becoming living fire.

name: Coat Flames
description: #(Tag:buff)(Tag:fire)Coat any object you touch in a layer of flames that does not harm the object's integrity.

name: Enflame
description: #(Tag:buff)(Tag:fire)(Tag:martial)Coat a held object or your own body in flames that reinforce it and mimic its properties. Coated fists gain blunt force, while coated blades gain cutting ability plus flames.

name: Heat Object
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:fire)Heat any object by touching it; more energy makes it hotter and faster.

name: Heat Metal
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:fire)Raise the temperature of any metal in sensory range; more energy makes it hotter and faster.

name: Heatwave
description: #(Tag:fire)Unleash waves of pure heat from your body as directed waves or omnidirectional heat.

name: Sunny Day
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:buff)(Tag:debuff)(Tag:fire)Change the weather to harsh sunlight, weakening nearby water-based abilities while boosting fire-based abilities.

name: Desolate Land
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:buff)(Tag:debuff)(Tag:earth)(Tag:fire)Transform weather and land into Desolate Land, with burning sunlight, scorched land, lava rivers, raised temperature, and no moisture. It largely amplifies Fire and Earth abilities, nullifies Water abilities below Epic rank, and weakens those above.

name: Kamino
description: #Chant "Kamino" to manifest an immensely powerful, hot fire arrow. Its wind-up is slow, but its destructive power compensates.

name: Blazing Courage
description: #Coat an object in flames that imitate its aspects, such as sharp or blunt flames.

name: Dark Flames
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:fire)Emit and control humanity's Black Flames, which do not burn or emit heat but have mass greater than most metals, shredding what they touch instead of burning it.

name: Extinguish Flames
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:fire)Remotely extinguish any fire or flame in sensory range; stronger flames cost more energy.

name: Godslayer Apostle Flames
description: #(Tag:anti-divine)(Tag:fire)Wield and control the Godskin Apostles' Godslayer Flames, already strong but significantly hotter and more potent against the divine. The more divine the enemy, the more potent the flames.

name: Blood Flames
description: #(Tag:blood)(Tag:fire)Wield and control Blood Flames, which cost vitality and health instead of energy. They are much more potent than regular flames, lacerate on contact, and are extremely hard to heal.

name: Bloodflame Talons
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:life)Conjure talons of bloodflame that burn and lacerate. They cost health and vitality instead of energy, with more vitality producing stronger claws.

name: Heat Vision
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:ocular)Emit laser beams of extreme heat from your eyes, concentrating them for more power over less area or spreading them for less power over more area. Beams weaken over distance.

name: Flame Burst
description: #(Tag:fire)Unleash a concentrated burst of flame like a beam from your hands, or a continuous but less powerful beam of fire.

name: Fire Claws
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:fire)Grow very durable, sharp fingernail claws that can be covered in very hot flames. They can carve apart and melt metal.

name: Flamethrower
description: #(Tag:fire)Unleash a constant stream of fire from anywhere on your body; more energy makes it hotter and more potent.

name: Combustion
description: #(Tag:fire)Create explosions of flame from anywhere on your body.

name: Fire Breath
description: #(Tag:fire)Unleash a dragon-like breath attack of very powerful flame; charging longer and expending more energy increases power.

name: Explosive Sweat
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:fire)Sweat a highly explosive compound on demand and detonate it at any time to unleash powerful explosions.

name: Explosion
description: #(Tag:fire)Create and project flame explosions at will as condensed glowing-bullet projectiles that explode on contact. With mastery, you can send streams of explosive energy from fingers and palms.

name: Detonation
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:fire)Charge any held item with explosive energy to detonate at any time like a time bomb; the energy fades over time. More energy means a stronger explosion.

name: Explosion!
description: #(Tag:fire)Call down an incredibly powerful sky explosion like divine wrath or a thermonuclear warhead. Longer charging and more energy make it stronger.

name: Heat Palm
description: #(Tag:fire)Heat your palms to red-hot levels, palms only.

name: Magma Logia
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:fire)(Tag:transformation)Create, control, and transform into lava and magma at will, becoming a living eruption.

name: Eruption
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:fire)Slam the ground to make magma/lava erupt like a volcano. With training, you can unleash it from any sufficiently large surface.

name: Lava
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:fire)Create and control magma/lava at will, such as volcanic rocks, lava whips, lava lakes, magma bullets, and similar forms.

name: Match
description: #(Tag:fire)Light a small flame on your fingers, barely qualifying as a lighter.

name: Droplet
description: #(Tag:water)Conjure small streams of water dripping from your fingers, barely enough to wash your hands.

name: Spray Water
description: #(Tag:water)Unleash a spray of water from your hands like a showerhead or hose, useful for dousing people and putting out fires.

name: Sprinkle
description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:water)Telekinetically control water to a minor degree, too weak to injure but able to douse targets or remove moisture from inanimate objects.

name: Create Water
description: #(Tag:water)Create large volumes of fresh water from your hands without controlling it; the stream is strong enough to seriously hurt someone.

name: Flood
description: #(Tag:water)Create and release extreme volumes of water from your body without controlling it, enough to flood a building at base level and streets or towns with training.

name: Geyser
description: #(Tag:water)Create geysers of water erupting from the ground around you; more energy makes them more powerful.

name: Mist
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:ice)(Tag:water)Create and control mist to obscure, hinder, and smother flames. With training, you can make freezing ice mist or condense mist into physical obstacles and attacks.

name: Lesser Hydrokinesis
description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:kinesis)(Tag:water)Telekinetically create and control water around yourself; not particularly powerful but versatile and precise.

name: Hydrosmith
description: #(Tag:water)Control and shape any water you physically touch, with no control once untouched. While maintaining contact you can freely morph and move it; more energy controls larger quantities with more power.

name: Micro Hydrokinesis
description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:kinesis)(Tag:water)Control water on a small scale with atomic precision, though power and range are negligible.

name: Hydro Pump
description: #(Tag:water)Create and emit high-volume, high-pressure water streams from your body strong enough to tear through concrete like paper.

name: Sponge
description: #(Tag:water)Absorb and store vast quantities of water in your body by touch, releasing it at any time.

name: Dehydration
description: #(Tag:water)Evaporate moisture inside an object or target through contact, turning trees to dust and crumbling most rocks. Living targets resist more strongly and are much harder to affect.

name: Drought
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:water)Remotely evaporate water in sensory range by expending energy; larger quantities cost more. With training, you can evaporate water inside objects in range, though magical waters and water in more powerful objects cost more energy.

name: Water Manipulation
description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:water)Create and control water; more energy controls larger quantities with more force.

name: Hydrokinesis
description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:kinesis)(Tag:water)Telekinetically control Water (H2O), freely controlling, moving, shaping it and other water-based targets.

name: Razorblade Typhoon
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:water)Create miniature typhoons like disks of whirling water razor-saw blades to deal devastating damage. They can lock onto and home in on targets.

name: Whirlpool
description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:water)Create and control water whirlpools for use as barriers, projectiles, or hindrances.

name: Rain
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:buff)(Tag:debuff)(Tag:water)Make it rain from the sky; more energy increases scale. It slightly boosts water-based abilities and slightly weakens fire-based ones.

name: Torrent
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:buff)(Tag:debuff)(Tag:water)Change local weather to heavy rain, boosting water-based abilities while weakening fire-based abilities.

name: Primordial Sea
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:buff)(Tag:debuff)(Tag:water)Call down the primordial sea as torrential downpour and mighty land-swallowing waves. It greatly boosts water-based abilities, snuffs out fire-based abilities below Epic rank, and greatly weakens those above.

name: Dampen
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:water)Dampen any touched object by making it more moist.

name: Dry
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:water)Dry any touched object, removing only abnormal moisture rather than all internal water particles.

name: Aquamaster
description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:water)Create and control Water (H2O) on the scale of a Level 5 Esper from Toaru, with incredible range, power, and unmatched precision.

name: Holy Water Tap
description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:water)Create and control holy water, very effective against unholy beings. More energy creates more water or more potent holy water.

name: Hydrofreeze
description: #(Tag:ice)(Tag:transformation)(Tag:water)Create, control, and turn into water and ice, allowing water-form escapes, dodges, icicles, freezing, and similar tricks. Water or ice form shares water's vulnerabilities.

name: Water Bubbles
description: #(Tag:water)Blow harmless water bubbles from your body.

name: Hydrification
description: #(Tag:transformation)(Tag:water)Turn your body into water at will to slip away, ignore physical attacks, and gain mobility. Water form shares water's vulnerabilities.

name: Aquatic
description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:movement)(Tag:water)Breathe underwater as on land and move through water as on land.

name: Steam Emission
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:water)Conjure, control, and emit blasts of hot steam from your body.

name: Ink Manipulation
description: #(Tag:summon)(Tag:water)Create and telekinetically control ink. With training, you can condense ink into hardened constructs.

name: Cool
description: #(Tag:ice)Lower an object's temperature through touch, slowly and insufficiently to freeze. It can keep drinks or ice cream cool.

name: Chill
description: #(Tag:ice)Create and control ice to a minor degree, better for ice cubes or ice knives than icicle attacks.

name: Frostbite
description: #(Tag:ice)Rapidly freeze touched targets, expanding with training to freeze a whole body from a hand grab or an entire street floor.

name: Ice Spike
description: #(Tag:ice)Conjure and launch ice spikes or erupt them from the ground. More energy makes larger, stronger icicles.

name: Ice Creation
description: #(Tag:ice)Create but not control ice, still able to conjure walls, spikes, weapons, and similar forms without telekinetic control afterward.

name: Iceberg
description: #(Tag:ice)Freeze objects and create massive ice volumes, freezing streets, encasing buildings, and with training turning city blocks into icebergs.

name: Ice Age
description: #(Tag:ice)Freeze objects and create incredible ice volumes at will, freezing cities and buildings, launching thousand-ton ice boulders, and impaling with ice pillars. With training, entire cities can become mountains of ice.

name: Frost
description: #(Tag:ice)Create and control ice you created, with no control over ice you did not create.

name: Ice Manipulation
description: #(Tag:ice)Sense and telekinetically control all ice in range with very potent control, but without creating ice yourself.

name: Half Hot Half Cold
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:ice)Create and emit both ice and fire from either side of your body, with resistance to both elements. With training, both aspects can combine to unleash Frostflare.

name: Frozen Heart
description: #(Tag:buff)(Tag:ice)(Tag:mental)Heavily boost ice-ability power while keeping your mind calm, sharp, and resistant to mental influences. You are also immune to all frost effects below Epic rank.

name: Cryokinesis
description: #(Tag:ice)(Tag:kinesis)Telekinetically create and control ice and cold, making ice constructs, remotely freezing objects, and similar effects.

name: White Album
description: #(Tag:ice)Freeze objects with extreme temperatures and form a dispellable cold-ice armor around yourself. With training, you can plunge objects to near sub-zero temperatures.

name: Cold Wave
description: #(Tag:buff)(Tag:debuff)(Tag:ice)Unleash debilitating cold waves from your body that boost Ice-based abilities and spells while active. Those exposed slowly lose stamina in the harsh cold.

name: Frigid Winds
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:ice)Create and control icy winds for freezing wind blades, ice tornadoes, and other wind-manipulation effects with an icy twist.

name: Cryomaster
description: #(Tag:ice)Control cold and ice on the level of a Level 5 Esper from Toaru, with unmatched range, power, and control.

name: Snow Warning
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:buff)(Tag:debuff)(Tag:ice)Summon a snowstorm on your location that slightly boosts ice-based abilities.

name: Blizzard
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:buff)(Tag:debuff)(Tag:ice)Summon a fierce blizzard that boosts ice-based ability power.

name: Snow Manipulation
description: #(Tag:ice)Create and control snow, with amount and power equal to energy expended.

name: Snow Logia
description: #(Tag:ice)(Tag:transformation)Create, control, and turn into snow, becoming a living entity of snow.

name: Ice Logia
description: #(Tag:ice)(Tag:transformation)Create, control, and turn into ice, becoming a living entity of ice.

name: Freezing Breath
description: #(Tag:ice)Charge and unleash a freezing breath of frigid winds that freezes what it hits. Longer charging and more energy increase power.

name: Ice Sprout
description: #(Tag:ice)Sprout ice constructs like walls and pillars from the ground and other surfaces to barrier, hinder, crush, or block enemies.

name: Black Ice
description: #(Tag:ice)Create and control black ice, an incredibly durable ice highly resistant to heat and fire.

name: Ice Formation
description: #(Tag:ice)Manifest extreme cold and ice at will under telekinetic control.

name: Absolute Zero
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:ice)Drop temperatures to absolute zero on a touched target or in an area, though not instantly. More energy reaches Absolute Zero faster.

name: Divinity Water & Ice
description: #(Tag:ice)(Tag:water)You are a god of water and ice, holding domain over both with all that entails.

name: Typhoon
description: #(Tag:air)Manifest and control typhoons at will, from miniature direct attacks to area-wide devastation.

name: Breeze
description: #(Tag:air)Conjure a light breeze from your body, far too weak to knock a grown person down.

name: Gust
description: #(Tag:air)Conjure and control winds strong enough to injure people and knock grown people off their feet.

name: Wind
description: #(Tag:air)Conjure and control winds and air with decent power and precision, strong enough to kill with wind lashes or throw people with gusts.

name: Gale
description: #(Tag:air)Conjure, shape and control powerful gales of wind and air.

name: Hurricane
description: #(Tag:air)Conjure and command mighty winds and hurricanes with great power. With training, you can devastate several cities with hurricanes and storms.

name: Tempest
description: #(Tag:air)Upgrade of Hurricane. Create mighty storms and hurricanes for massive devastation. With training, you can unleash grand tempests that devastate cities.

name: Aerokinesis
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:kinesis)Sense and telekinetically control wind, granting precise and powerful control over surrounding air.

name: Wind Blade
description: #(Tag:air)Conjure and launch razor-sharp crescent-shaped slashes of wind.

name: Wind Edge
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:buff)(Tag:martial)Cloak a held item in razor-sharp winds to boost its cutting ability. You can launch the cloak as a projectile to extend the effect.

name: Delta Stream
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:alter)(Tag:buff)Call forth winds that make the surrounding area very windy, enhancing the power and efficiency of all wind-based abilities.

name: Floating
description: #(Tag:gravity)Cloak yourself in winds that carry you, allowing you to fly.

name: Wind Flight
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:movement)Push off the surrounding air to fly with precision and power.

name: Air Jet
description: #(Tag:air)Create air jets of powerful air currents.

name: Wind Cloak
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:buff)(Tag:movement)Cloak yourself in powerful winds that assist movement, letting you move faster, dash and float.

name: Whirlwind
description: #(Tag:air)Create and control powerful whirlwinds and air currents, though control is imprecise.

name: Vacuum
description: #(Tag:air)Create and control vacuums in your sensory range to pull things in and cause implosions. Stronger vacuums expend more energy.

name: Louden
description: #(Tag:sound)Increase noises to obnoxiously loud but non-destructive levels that cause no damage.

name: Megaphone
description: #(Tag:sound)Amplify noises you create loudly enough to disorient and temporarily deafen opponents.

name: Sonic Blast
description: #(Tag:sound)Amplify noises you create loudly enough to crack objects, rupture eardrums and deafen opponents.

name: View Air
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:divination)(Tag:sense)Share your senses with surrounding air to map the world through wind. Base range is 1km, improvable with training and base stats.

name: Boomburst
description: #(Tag:sound)Amplify noises you create to cause physical destruction, internal damage and deafness.

name: Airlock
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:alter)Increase air resistance in an area to feel like wading through mud and make flight near impossible. With training, you can increase it until movement causes things to burst into flame from friction.

name: Storm Blade
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:martial)Conjure a blade of compressed air, most commonly a sword, whose size and shape you can manipulate. You can release wind slash projectiles from it.

name: Wind Barrier
description: #(Tag:air)Conjure a barrier of violent air streams around yourself that excels at deflecting projectiles and elements, but less so physical force.

name: Heavy Wind
description: #(Tag:air)Create and control winds whose virtual density you can manipulate, affecting how they impact the world without changing how they move. You can unleash tungsten-dense wind blades, iron-weight storms, mountain-weight wind whips and more. Denser winds exhaust more energy.

name: Weather Manipulation
description: #(Tag:alter)Manipulate weather conditions over an area. Despite massive range it consumes very little energy, but is weak offensively.

name: Wind Alteration
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:alter)Alter air's chemical composition and properties, such as raising oxygen concentration to make it more flammable and poisonous, or making it dense enough to feel like steel.

name: Oxidiser
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:fire)Create and control clouds of pure oxygen to intensify flames, trigger detonations with slight sparks, suffocate or poison targets, or use them as compressed wind attacks.

name: Aeromaster
description: #(Tag:air)Control wind, air and its composition at the level of a Level 5 Esper from Toaru, with unmatched range, power and control.

name: Atmospheric Pressure Manipulation
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:alter)Control atmospheric pressure in zones you can raise or lower.

name: Air Whips
description: #(Tag:air)Create and control whips of compressed air to lash out or grab with. Longer, stronger whips expend more energy.

name: Spark
description: #(Tag:electric)Create small sparks of electricity from your body, too weak to work as a taser.

name: Taser
description: #(Tag:electric)Channel electricity through your body and discharge it, strong enough to seriously hurt someone.

name: Arc
description: #(Tag:electric)Channel electricity through your body and discharge it. With training, you can direct where it goes to aim more precisely.

name: Electric Discharge
description: #(Tag:electric)Channel potent electricity through your body and discharge it. With training, you can direct where it goes to aim more precisely.

name: Lightning Channel
description: #(Tag:electric)Channel lightning through a held object to reinforce and empower it. The lightning imitates the object, becoming sharp with a sword and heavy with a hammer.

name: Lightning Absorption
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:electric)Absorb electricity and lightning into your body for storage. You can convert it into energy to refill reserves, boost your power, or fire it as an attack.

name: Call Lightning
description: #(Tag:electric)Call down lightning from the sky onto any location in sensory range. Not very effective indoors.

name: Call Thunder
description: #(Tag:electric)Call down powerful thunder from the sky onto any location in sensory range. Not very effective indoors.

name: Call Greater Thunder
description: #(Tag:electric)Call down very powerful thunder from the sky onto any location in sensory range. Not very effective indoors. With training, you can call multiple at once or charge it into a concentrated spear of thunder.

name: Storm Call
description: #(Tag:electric)Freely call thunder and lightning from the skies to strike the ground with little energy consumption. You can charge it to smite with concentrated lightning.

name: Lightning Form
description: #(Tag:electric)(Tag:movement)(Tag:transformation)Turn into a living bolt of lightning to travel extremely quickly while ignoring most conventional attacks. You are extremely vulnerable to grounding, which ejects and injures you.

name: Radio Waves
description: #(Tag:sound)(Tech) Emit electromagnetic waves that disable and cripple all technology with an interface. With training, you can fine-tune them to activate or control electronics instead.

name: Impulse
description: #(Tag:electric)(Tag:sense)Quicken your body's electrical signals to proportionally increase reflexes and speed. Overuse may cause nerve damage.

name: Godspeed
description: #(Tag:electric)(Tag:movement)(Tag:sense)Overhaul your nervous system with your own lightning for near-instant reflexes and extreme speed. It damages your body over time, so extended use is not recommended.

name: Electrokinesis
description: #(Tag:electric)Create and control electricity at will, from shooting lightning bolts to tweaking your own bioelectricity. You cannot control electromagnetic waves.

name: Electromagnetokinesis
description: #(Tag:electric)Sense, interact with and control electromagnetism, a fundamental force of the universe, letting you control magnetic objects, create railguns, shoot lightning, tweak bioelectricity and more.

name: Assign
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:electric)Assign polarity to objects by touch so they attract or repel each other. More energy expended means stronger polarity.

name: Electromaster
description: #(Tag:electric)Hold complete control over Electromagnetism, a fundamental force of the universe, with unmatched range, power and precision.

name: Stun Shock
description: #(Tag:electric)Disrupt someone's bioelectricity by touch to stun or paralyze them; with training you can manipulate their bodies further. Stronger opponents are harder to affect.

name: Lightning Breath
description: #(Tag:electric)Charge and unleash a breath of devastating lightning waves. Longer charging and more energy mean a stronger breath.

name: Railgun
description: #(Tag:electric)Turn any magnetic object in your grasp into a railgun projectile. Higher mass costs more, and you must aim it.

name: Frozen Lightning
description: #(Tag:electric)Wield and control frozen lightning. Unlike incredibly hot regular lightning, it is proportionally colder, freezing whatever it electrocutes or passes through.

name: Lightning Spear
description: #(Tag:anti-draconic)(Tag:electric)Conjure a throwable spear of lightning (does not travel at lightning speed) with penetrative power that deals increased damage against draconic entities.

name: Great Lightning Spear
description: #(Tag:anti-draconic)(Tag:electric)Conjure a throwable spear of lightning (does not travel at lightning speed) with penetrative power that deals increased damage against draconic entities, rending their scales and hides and nulling their defence.

name: Sunlight Spear
description: #(Tag:anti-draconic)(Tag:electric)(Tag:fire)(Tag:light)Conjure a throwable spear of sun-imbued lightning with penetrative power that deals increased damage against draconic entities and unholy beings.

name: Thunder Cloak
description: #(Tag:buff)(Tag:electric)Cloak your body in thunder to increase speed, power and reflexes while imbuing electricity into your attacks.

name: Chidori
description: #(Tag:buff)(Tag:electric)Cloak your hands in violent sharp electricity that boosts piercing and cutting, turning them into lightning blades.

name: Lightning Bolt
description: #(Tag:electric)Release a bolt of lightning from your hands at a target that travels at the speed of lightning.

name: Electromagnetic Sight
description: #(Tag:electric)(Tag:sense)Shift your vision to see electromagnetism and electricity even through walls, instinctively distinguishing and understanding them.

name: Electricity
description: #(Tag:electric)(Tag:enhancer)Create and control electricity (not kinesis) and use it to slightly enhance your stats. You can sense and see nearby currents even through walls, and ground opponents' lightning with your body.

name: Attention
description: #(Tag:alter)Manifest a very eye-catching, distracting aura centered on yourself, making you incredibly noticeable in whatever you do.

name: Lightning Claws
description: #(Tag:electric)Create claws of violent lightning over your hands to sever and electrocute enemies simultaneously.

name: Pebble Sling
description: #(Tag:earth)Conjure pebbles and small rocks to sling at enemies, minorly inconveniencing them or hurting them if they hit eyes.

name: Rock Throw
description: #(Tag:earth)Conjure rocks and small stones to launch as projectiles. Not very powerful, but a rock to the head always hurts.

name: Stone Bullet
description: #(Tag:earth)Conjure rocks and small stones to shoot like bullets with lethal power, making you a living stone gun.

name: Boulder Hurl
description: #(Tag:earth)Conjure and hurl a large boulder at enemies. Regardless of your strength, its weight does not affect your throwing, whether person-sized or house-sized.

name: Rock Shotgun
description: #(Tag:earth)Conjure multiple small rocks and launch them at lethal speeds.

name: Bullet
description: #(Tag:earth)Conjure lead or other metal bullets from small to high calibre and launch them at supersonic to hypersonic speeds. More energy means higher calibre and speed.

name: Move Earth
description: #(Tag:earth)Telekinetically move earth in your sensory range. It has little lethal power.

name: Quicksand
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:earth)Turn ground into quicksand that grabs and pulls anyone who steps on it.

name: Earth Spikes
description: #(Tag:earth)Create, control and launch spikes of earth and rock, including erupting them from the ground in sensory range.

name: Meteor Strike
description: #(Tag:earth)Call down meteors from the sky. Size and speed depend on energy expended.

name: Chain & Shackle
description: #(Tag:earth)Create metal chains and shackles that erupt from the earth to bind enemies. They track and chase opponents, making them very hard to dodge.

name: Catapult
description: #(Tag:earth)Create and launch giant boulders at enemies. Regardless of your strength, their weight does not affect your throwing, whether person-sized or house-sized.

name: Stonesprout
description: #(Tag:earth)Sprout rock and stone constructs such as walls and pillars from surfaces for defense, terrain or smashing enemies.

name: Micro Ferrokinesis
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:kinesis)Manipulate metals on a small but extremely precise scale. You cannot hurl cars, but you could shape gold into an ornate ring with microscopic carvings.

name: Earth Armor
description: #(Tag:earth)Create earth armour around your body to absorb blows and attacks without impeding mobility or speed.

name: Earthquake
description: #(Tag:earth)Create earthquakes causing massive environmental destruction.

name: Fissure
description: #(Tag:earth)Create fissures in objects to shatter or split them. Harder objects need more energy to fissure.

name: Ferrokinesis
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:kinesis)Telekinetically control and shape metal in sensory range, such as ripping it from buildings into spears, flying on metal bands, or controlling iron-rich blood.

name: Terrakinesis
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:kinesis)Telekinetically control earth and rock in your sensory range.

name: Armor
description: #(Tag:enhancer)Create very durable reinforced metal armour on your body that enhances endurance. Stronger users form stronger metal, and you can reshape it with concentration.

name: Metal Kaiser
description: #(Tag:earth)Create metal such as giant blades, walls and pillars from any non-organic surface. More energy creates more metal.

name: Iron Manipulation
description: #(Tag:earth)Telekinetically control iron and iron-based objects in your perception. Control and strength depend on focus and mana spent.

name: Extinction Meteors
description: #(Tag:earth)Bring down giant meteors for massive devastation and damage. Mass, power and speed depend on energy expended. Quite expensive to use.

name: Pocket Sand
description: #(Tag:earth)Conjure and launch a handful of sand from your hands. Shouting "pocket sand!" while doing so might make it stronger.

name: Sandshot
description: #(Tag:earth)Conjure and launch sand from your fingers at non-lethal but painful speeds.

name: Sandstream
description: #Launch powerful sand streams from your body to hinder vision and injure enemies like sandblasting.

name: Sandblast
description: #(Tag:earth)Launch blasts of high-velocity sand clouds that rend and shred metals and especially flesh.

name: Death Valley Duster
description: #(Tag:earth)Conjure violent sand and dust clouds to launch in immensely powerful sandblast-like bursts that shred targets.

name: Primordial Earth
description: #(Tag:earth)Control earth, dust and sand in sensory range to unleash giant sand blasts, launch jagged boulders and erupt stalagmites.

name: Primordial Ancient
description: #(Tag:earth)Control earth, dust and sand to extreme levels. It lacks precision but holds unbelievable destructive power.

name: Karura's Blessing
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:passive)Karura's blessing is an autonomous sand shield that protects from danger automatically without consuming mana.

name: Burial
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:anti-immortal)(Tag:earth)Instantly bury any ground-touching target underground, suffocating and crushing them. Burying a corpse prevents necromancy and revival on them.

name: Conjure Lesser Earth Elemental
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:summon)Conjure and command Lesser Earth Elementals from your energy, such as Mudmen, Stone Golems, Sand and Claymen, for earth-based magic and similar effects. You can only conjure elementals at or below Uncommon familiar power, with power, shape and ability set by your expertise and level. They drain your energy to persist and act and vanish if supply stops, though sufficient time, energy and skills can make them permanent; elementals do not count as Familiars.

name: Conjure Earth Elemental
description: #(Tag:construct)(Tag:earth)(Tag:summon)Conjure and command Earth Elementals from your energy, such as Earth Sprites, Iron Golems and Stone Atronachs, for earth-based magic and similar effects. You can only conjure elementals at or below Rare Familiar power, with power, shape and ability set by your expertise and level. They drain your energy to persist and act and vanish if supply stops, though sufficient time, energy and skills can make them permanent; elementals do not count as Familiars.

name: Conjure Greater Earth Elemental
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:summon)Conjure and command powerful Greater Earth Elementals from your energy, such as Diamond Golems, Regirocks and Elder Magma Elementals (DnD), for earth-based magic and other abilities. You can only conjure elementals at or below Elite Familiar power, with power, shape and ability set by your expertise and level. They drain your energy to persist and act and vanish if supply stops, though sufficient time, energy and skills can make them permanent; elementals do not count as Familiars.

name: Golem Creation
description: #(Tag:construct)(Tag:earth)(Tag:summon)Animate and command golems of earth, mud, sand or metal. More durable, powerful golems cost more. Make them temporary for less energy or permanent for very high cost.

name: Titan Armor
description: #(Tag:earth)Fuse with earth to form gigantic kaiju-proportioned armour around yourself. Bigger armour expends more energy.

name: Golem Armor
description: #(Tag:construct)(Tag:earth)(Tag:enhancer)Create a golem around yourself from ground beneath your feet or materials you touch, acting as armour that enhances physical stats.

name: Stalagmite Burst
description: #(Tag:earth)Unleash stalagmite blades that erupt from the ground to impale enemies.

name: Thousand Arrows
description: #Create and launch spears or arrows of surrounding ground as artillery, traps or projectile bombardment.

name: Metal Manipulation
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:kinesis)Control the shape and form of all metals you touch.

name: Mud Manipulation
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:water)Conjure and control mud to create swamps underfoot or bombard opponents.

name: Crystal Shower
description: #(Tag:earth)Create crystals to shoot as projectiles. Larger, faster crystals expend more energy.

name: Crystal Spikes
description: #(Tag:earth)Create durable but brittle crystal spikes from the ground or any touched surface to impale opponents or serve as barriers.

name: Diamond Skin
description: #(Tag:enhancer)Cover your body in diamond-like texture, massively boosting durability and mass against all damage. Even as a base human you shrug off high-calibre bullets, tank shells, car impacts and fire unfelt, and even a missile cannot kill you though it hurts.

name: Crystal Creation
description: #(Tag:earth)Create crystals on your body or touched surfaces, controlling shape and size during creation but unable to alter them afterward.

name: Crystals
description: #(Tag:earth)Create and sprout crystals from your body as spikes, skin armour, or cash to sell. (AUTHOR NOTE: Crystal refers to a nebulous crystalline structure that is durable, not allowing you to make ANY type of crystalline structure.)

name: Gem Creation
description: #(Tag:earth)Create precious gems that hold much energy or mana. Larger, more valuable gems cost more energy.

name: Pure Gem Creation
description: #(Tag:earth)Create pure precious gems that hold immense energy and serve as vessels. Purer, more potent gems cost more energy.

name: Sand Veil
description: #(Tag:earth)Create a small localized sandstorm on your location that hides your presence inside it while you see through it freely.

name: Fool Sand
description: #(Tag:earth)Conjure autonomous sand that shapeshifts, attacks and defends without input to protect you, eliminate enemies or provide utility.

name: Desert Weaponry
description: #(Tag:earth)Create sand-and-wind weapons and attacks such as giant sand blades, spears and hammers to unleash as projectiles.

name: Sandstorm Body
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:transformation)Turn your body into a living sand cloud and reform at will. Damage to the sand reflects onto you.

name: Dig
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:movement)Dig and move underground incredibly fast like a mole, breathing underground too. You dig faster than you sprint.

name: Dowsing
description: #(Tag:divination)(Tag:earth)Detect metals around you like mental radar. More valuable metals register more distinctly.

name: View Earth
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:sense)Share vision with earth to feel it and locate everything inside it. Default range 5km, increasable with training.

name: Wire
description: #(Tag:earth)Create and control metal wires; control ends once a wire separates from your body. You can reinforce wires with energy for extra durability.

name: Pika
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:transformation)Fuse with earth for complete terrain control: shape, move, and reform it, or form a giant golem around yourself.

name: Desert Logia
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:transformation)Create, control, and turn into sand. You can also drain moisture to dry objects and turn stone into sand.

name: Blackout
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:illusion)Banish all light from an area, making mundane sight nigh impossible. Larger areas cost more energy.

name: Shadow Travel
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:movement)Sink into shadows and travel within them like Black Sabbath from JoJo. Sunlight while inside burns you and deals damage.

name: Shadow Hands
description: #(Tag:dark)Manifest controllable floating hands of shadow. They can grip, crush, slash, and combine into larger, stronger forms.

name: Sethan
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:dark)(Tag:time)Move your shadow as a living, attacking creature. Those who step on it rapidly de-age until you are unconscious or deactivate it; stronger opponents de-age slower.

name: Shadow Puppeteer
description: #(Tag:dark)Extend your shadow; when it touches a target's shadow, their movements mimic yours until dispelled.

name: Shadow Tag
description: #(Tag:dark)Treat people's shadows as tangible; step on or pin them to stop escape, or grab and pull targets toward you.

name: Shadow Dart
description: #(Tag:dark)Conjure and launch silent shadow darts made of energy.

name: Shadow Cloak
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:stealth)Cloak yourself in shadows to blur perception and muffle sound, enhancing stealth.

name: Shadow Stalker
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:movement)(Tag:transformation)Enter a shadow state with your equipment to phase through solid matter. With training, unphase bolts inside targets to bypass durability. Shadow form is highly vulnerable to electricity and aerosols.

name: Shadow Ball
description: #(Tag:dark)Conjure and launch a fast, destructive shadow orb that deals extra damage to spirits.

name: Shadow Blade
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:martial)Conjure a lightweight, very sharp shadow blade with adjustable size and shape. It ignores around 10% of target durability, always dealing some damage.

name: Shadow Scythe
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:martial)Conjure a shadow scythe with adjustable size and shape. It cuts only what you will it to and ignores a portion of target durability.

name: Reaper's Scythe
description: #(Tag:anti-recovery)(Tag:dark)(Tag:martial)Conjure a pure-darkness scythe with adjustable size and shape. It fully ignores physical objects and barriers and blocks regeneration and resurrection from its wounds, but drains your energy in proportion to what you cut.

name: Death's Instrument
description: #(Tag:anti-recovery)(Tag:dark)(Tag:martial)Call forth death's instrument, a pitch-black scythe ignoring all physical and magical durability. Its wounds strike body and soul and cannot be healed by mundane means.

name: Bottomless Swamp
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:dark)Turn surrounding ground into a bottomless swamp that traps and sinks steppers. Fully submerged targets are incapacitated in a stasis-like state.

name: Dark Spear
description: #(Tag:anti-holy)(Tag:dark)Conjure and launch dark-energy spears that deal extra damage to holy and divine beings.

name: Shadow Storage
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:space)Extend your shadow across 2D surfaces to sink objects into stasis storage. No weight limit; stored objects can be ejected anytime.

name: Shadow Claws
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:martial)Conjure sharp, lightweight Shadow Claws over your hands for slashing. Training extends their length and sharpness.

name: Shadow Chains
description: #(Tag:anti-recovery)(Tag:dark)Create and control chains woven from your shadow. Snared enemies rapidly lose energy.

name: Blind
description: #(Tag:curse)(Tag:debuff)Curse opponents to block sight via touch or a thrown rune-like hex, a moderately fast projectile. Duration depends on magic resistance; targets that cannot resist it can be blinded permanently.

name: Grue
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:illusion)Create a darkness cloud that blots out the senses of those inside, making perception extremely difficult. Strong targets partially resist.

name: Deafness
description: #(Tag:curse)(Tag:debuff)Curse opponents to block hearing via touch or a thrown rune-like hex, a moderately fast projectile. Duration depends on magic resistance; targets that cannot resist it can be deafened permanently.

name: Numbness
description: #(Tag:curse)(Tag:debuff)Curse opponents to block touch via touch or a thrown rune-like hex, a moderately fast projectile. Duration depends on magic resistance; targets that cannot resist it can be numbed permanently.

name: Mute
description: #(Tag:curse)(Tag:debuff)Curse opponents to block speech via touch or a thrown rune-like hex, a moderately fast projectile. Duration depends on magic resistance; targets that cannot resist it can be muted permanently.

name: Conjure Shadowbeast
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:summon)Conjure a temporary autonomous shadow familiar. Its power scales with energy spent.

name: Gate of Nightmares
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:summon)Summon a gigantic 10-meter darkness gate to unleash a controlled horde of shadow beasts. More energy yields more beasts.

name: Dark Lance
description: #(Tag:anti-holy)(Tag:anti-recovery)(Tag:dark)Conjure and unleash dark-energy lances, exceptionally lethal to holy beings. Their wounds are difficult to heal.

name: Abyss
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:buff)(Tag:dark)(Tag:debuff)Reality Marble - Pull targets into the Abyss, which rapidly drains their energy and vitality. All dark abilities are boosted inside.

name: Void Tendril
description: #(Tag:dark)Conjure and control void tendrils to grapple, crush, whip, and pierce. You can share sensation with them.

name: Shade Cloak
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:movement)(Tag:transformation)Briefly shift into shadow to phase through attacks and magic. Weak only to light and holy magic; limited to 1 second at a time with a 3-second cooldown.

name: Cursecraft
description: #(Tag:curse)(Tag:debuff)Create and apply curses based on your abilities. E.g. light becomes blinding, strength becomes weakness, etc.

name: Darkness Devil
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:infernal)As the fear of darkness incarnate, hold authority over all darkness and shadows to control them at will.

name: Black Hole
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:gravity)Conjure and control weaker small-scale virtual black holes. With training, you can conjure real black holes.

name: Void Dragon's Breath
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:space)Charge and unleash erosive void breath that drains the energy of what it touches. Longer charge and more energy mean a stronger breath.

name: Void Mirror Image
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:illusion)(Tag:summon)Conjure controlled clones of yourself that cannot interact with the world and serve as distractions.

name: Void Travel
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:movement)(Tag:space)Slip into the void dimension to traverse space without interacting with the real world; time flows slower there. Distance covered equals real distance for short-range teleportation. 30-second stay, increasable with training. 5 Minute cooldown.

name: Chaos Entity Release
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:movement)(Tag:space)(Tag:transformation)Release physical form to become a Void Observer, a sentient grey energy cloud that slips into the void at will, intangible yet able to observe reality. Staying inside slowly drains energy and grants near-immunity to physical force, but damage taken reflects onto your real body.

name: Void Path
description: #(Tag:dark)Open gates to the Void Dimension to traverse it, banish entities inside, or bring entities out. Use with caution.

name: Void Distorter Form
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:dark)(Tag:transformation)Transform into a Void Distorter, a Void-native being that distorts and shapes void to ravage the natural world with spatial distortions. Can also use Void Travel.

name: Abyssal Jail
description: #(Tag:dark)Manifest Abyss in the natural world to trap entities in a localized Abyss that isolates and drains their energy and vitality. Breaking out by force is possible but incredibly difficult.

name: Abyss Skin
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:space)Cover your skin in Abyss for potent defense with no offensive benefit. It dissipates contacted energy, including kinetic and heat, but sudden powerful attacks can bypass absorption.

name: Yami
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:buff)(Tag:dark)(Tag:debuff)Shroud surroundings in ominous darkness with rouge clouds, boosting dark abilities and infernal beings while weakening all Holy beings and abilities.

name: Darkness Logia
description: #(Tag:dark)Create, control, and turn into Darkness at will. It can absorb and store anything but amplifies your sense of pain.

name: Shadow Eyes
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:summon)Conjure small eye-shaped shadow familiars that autonomously observe and relay information. They have no combat ability but hide potently.

name: Shadow Beast Form
description: #(Tag:dark)Turn into a giant amorphous shadow monster like Dark Shadow from MHA. Greatly vulnerable to holy and light effects.

name: Shadow Armor
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:enhancer)Create lightweight, very durable shadow armor with freely alterable shape. While active, it boosts physical abilities and darkness abilities.

name: Umbrakinesis
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:kinesis)Weave shadow and darkness into physical form and control it, such as shadow chains, spikes from a target's shadow, or darkness lances.

name: Abyss Barrier
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:space)Weave Abyss into a physical barrier that absorbs and dissipates energy. Nigh unbreakable without overwhelming force, except against holy attacks.

name: Shadow Monarch
description: #(Tag:dark)Extract shadows from corpses as commanded minions, immortal while restored by your mana. Raisable level and stored count depend on your energy.

name: Flashlight
description: #(Tag:light)Emit a moderate-intensity light beam from your hands. A handy flashlight replacement with little other use.

name: Flash
description: #(Tag:light)Emit bright blinding light from your hands, or dimmer light for utility. Ineffective beyond close range.

name: Illumination
description: #(Tag:light)Conjure telekinetically controlled points of bright light. Extra energy makes them semi-permanent.

name: Exorcist's Light
description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:light)Conjure and emit exorcising light, useless against normal beings but highly effective against dark or unholy beings.

name: Invisibility
description: #(Tag:light)(Tag:stealth)Bend light around yourself or a touched object to render it invisible.

name: Flash Grenade
description: #(Tag:light)Conjure a light ball that bursts into blinding flash and noise, disorienting enemies and heavily harming dark enemies.

name: Light of Glory
description: #(Tag:buff)(Tag:light)(Tag:martial)(Tag:mental)Call victorious light from the heavens to bolster allies. Those touched gain slightly increased physical stats, mental resistance, vigor, and courage.

name: Light Grenade
description: #(Tag:light)Conjure and launch a fast, powerful grenade of exploding light energy.

name: Beam
description: #(Tag:light)Shoot a near-instant beam of concentrated light and heat from your fingers.

name: Lesser Blessing
description: #(Tag:buff)(Tag:holy)Grant a minor blessing of Holy Energy that slightly augments one chosen physical stat: Vitality, Strength, Resilience, Agility, stamina. Lasts one hour; only one blessing per target.

name: Blessing
description: #(Tag:buff)(Tag:holy)Grant a Holy Energy blessing: Augmentation (augments a chosen stat like strength, resilience, vitality, etc.), Might (slightly augments all attributes), or Mind (slightly augments Energy Regeneration and Output). Lasts one to three hours by energy spent; only one per target.

name: Greater Blessing
description: #(Tag:buff)(Tag:holy)Grant a greater Holy Energy blessing: Augmentation (significantly augments a chosen stat like strength, resiliency, vitality, regeneration, etc.), Boost (augments all attributes for more energy), or Mind (slightly augments Energy Regeneration and Output). Lasts one to three hours by energy spent; only one per target.

name: Divine Blessing
description: #(Tag:buff)(Tag:fire)(Tag:holy)Bestow blessings once an hour for one hour: Recovery (Rare Rank Regeneration plus cure of all non-inborn ailments), Might (increases all attributes), or Warding (cleanses curses and raises resistances). Blessings can also mimic abilities, e.g. Ignite grants fire resistance and affinity.

name: Law of Regression
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:holy)(Tag:recovery)Regress causality to return something to its original or intended form while dispelling all negative status. Greater regression costs more energy.

name: Disc of Light
description: #(Tag:light)Conjure and launch a sharp searing light disc that returns in an arc.

name: Guidance of Grace
description: #(Tag:divination)(Tag:holy)Grace light creates a visible-only-to-you path toward your objective or something aiding it.

name: Barrier of Light
description: #(Tag:light)Create an easily deployed light-magic barrier. Less sturdy, but strong against curses, spirits, and negative status.

name: Hardlight Weaponry
description: #(Tag:light)(Tag:martial)Create strong, lightweight hard-light weapons that deal extra damage to dark-aligned foes. They lack durability and fade when damaged.

name: Sky Fracture
description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:light)Rain holy-light weapons from the sky, from swords and glaives to skyscraper-sized lances, scaling with energy spent.

name: Confessor's Light
description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:light)Create a sky spotlight compelling anyone caught to truthfully answer questions asked. You are immune.

name: Purification
description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:light)(Tag:recovery)Bathe a target in purifying light to cleanse negative effects and foreign substances. Potency scales with energy.

name: Greater Purification
description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:light)(Tag:recovery)Bathe a target in powerful purifying light to cleanse negative effects and foreign substances. Potency scales with energy.

name: Holy Weapon
description: #(Tag:buff)(Tag:holy)(Tag:light)Coat your armament in holy light, enhancing its power and quality and dealing extra damage to dark-aligned beings.

name: Blessing of Arms
description: #(Tag:buff)(Tag:holy)(Tag:martial)Bless an armament to upgrade it by half a stage (+) and grant its wielder a matching bonus intermediate skill, e.g. an Uncommon sword becomes Uncommon+ and grants Intermediate Swordsmanship while held. Only one at a time.

name: Smite
description: #(Tag:buff)(Tag:holy)(Tag:martial)Suffuse your next attack with divine power, amplifying it and dealing severe damage to unholy beings.

name: Golden Fist
description: #(Tag:buff)(Tag:holy)(Tag:light)(Tag:martial)Cover your fists in deadly golden light that strengthens punches, punishes evil, and deals severe damage to unholy and spirit beings.

name: Exorcism
description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:spirit)Bathe a target in golden light to exorcise negative effects, curses, and possessions. Against spirits or unholy beings, it burns like holy flame.

name: Blade of Light
description: #(Tag:buff)(Tag:light)(Tag:martial)Infuse your blade with reinforcing light mimicking its properties; e.g. swords launch light slashes, hammers emit golden shockwaves, etc.

name: Resuscitation
description: #(Tag:life)(Tag:recovery)Revive the dead within 10 minutes or restore vitality to fighting condition. Training extends the timeframe.

name: Swords of Revealing Light
description: #(Tag:debuff)(Tag:light)Create and control light swords that seal a target's energy when impaled. Stronger targets can resist.

name: Minor Healing Light
description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:light)(Tag:recovery)Bathe a target in healing light to restore some health and vigour. Scales with power; stronger targets cost more.

name: Healing Light
description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:light)(Tag:recovery)Bathe a target in healing light to heal even severe wounds. Scales with power; stronger targets cost more.

name: Greater Healing Light
description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:light)(Tag:recovery)Bathe a target in healing light to heal even grievous wounds and lethal damage. Scales with power; stronger targets cost more.

name: Divine Healing Light
description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:light)(Tag:recovery)Bathe a target in healing light to restore them from even lethal damage; any wound short of death can be healed. Scales with power; stronger targets cost more.

name: Pillar of Light
description: #(Tag:light)Call down a pillar of searing light anywhere in sensory range. Deals extra damage to unholy beings.

name: Judgement Call
description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:light)Summon an erupting fountain of pure divine light dealing massive pillar-like destruction, lethal to Unholy beings, plus purification. Drains most energy; stronger than some Epic abilities but held back by cost and charge time.

name: Genesis
description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:light)"May there be mercy on man and machine for their sins." Call a gigantic crucifix of absolute holy light dealing country-erasing judgment; no Unholy being survives, while allies caught are healed of all conditions. Spends all energy; 30-day cooldown.

name: Light Trick
description: #(Tag:illusion)(Tag:light)Bend light into sight-deceiving optical illusions. Light can be solidified for disguise, but touch reveals the trick.

name: Light Speed
description: #(Tag:light)(Tag:movement)(Tag:transformation)Briefly become a ray of light to travel at lightspeed in a straight line before reforming.

name: Sanctuary
description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:recovery)Create a large overhead light beam granting allies healing, regeneration, and cleansing. Maintenance costs energy.

name: Light Logia
description: #(Tag:light)(Tag:transformation)Create, manipulate, and transform into light energy at will.

name: Claws
description: #(Tag:bio)Grow durable, sharp claws on your fingertips.

name: Horns
description: #(Tag:bio)Grow sturdy, pointy horns on your head.

name: Tail
description: #(Tag:bio)Grow a strong, dexterously controlled tail.

name: Jaw
description: #(Tag:bio)Turn your teeth into very sharp, durable fangs.

name: Natural Weapons
description: #(Tag:bio)Weaponize attached biological body parts, e.g. nails into claws, teeth into fangs.

name: Razor Claws
description: #(Tag:bio)Turn nails into non-dulling razor claws that tear flesh and metal with ease.

name: Carapace
description: #(Tag:bio)Grow tough armor-like carapace over flesh for defense. Toughness scales with physical stats.

name: Exoskeleton
description: #(Tag:bio)Grow very sturdy exoskeleton armor granting endurance and protection. Power and durability scale with physical stats.

name: Scales
description: #(Tag:bio)Grow damage-resistant scales serving as flexible skin armor. Toughness scales with physical stats.

name: Dragon Scales
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:draconic)Grow incredibly tough dragon scales, more durable than any human material, also reducing elemental damage taken. Toughness scales with physical stats.

name: Powerful Wings
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:movement)Grow powerful wings that lift you regardless of weight. Stronger than your base physicality, they can shatter bones as weapons.

name: Immunity System
description: #While Immutable is in an active ability slot, you are immune to poisons, diseases, and negative biological effects.

name: Monomolecular Claws
description: #(Tag:bio)Transform nails into sleek black claws with molecule-thin edges and undiminished durability. Adjustable up to 1 meter long.

name: Bone Manipulation
description: #(Tag:bio)Freely manipulate your bones and any bones in sensory range; reshape and alter your own bones' size, shape, and properties. Bones regenerate quickly while active.

name: Organ Spikes
description: #(Tag:bio)Sprout biological-matter spikes from anywhere on your body without pain in creation or use.

name: Ukaku
description: #(Tag:bio)Manifest wing-like RC-Cell appendages shifting from fluid-like to steel-tough. Release precise high-speed armor-piercing feather barrages or slash like a steel whip.

name: Koukaku
description: #(Tag:bio)Manifest a morphing arm-like RC-Cell appendage from the shoulder blade, tougher and denser than steel. Shape it into spears, claws, shields, etc.

name: Rinkaku
description: #(Tag:bio)Manifest multiple flexible Rinkaku tentacles of RC Cells from the lower back, shifting from fluid-like to steel-tough. Use them to pierce, whip, grab, or maneuver.

name: Bikaku
description: #(Tag:bio)Manifest a tail-like Bikaku RC-Cell appendage at the tailbone, shifting from fluid-like to steel-tough. Defend, whip, and pierce like a giant flesh tail.

name: Kakuja
description: #(Tag:bio)Manifest armor-like Kakuja RC Cells shifting from fluid-like to steel-tough, massively boosting stats. Form depends on the user, from building-sized wings to 16 pillar-thick tentacles tougher than titanium and faster than bullets.

name: Ghoul Physiology
description: #(Tag:necro)(Tag:transformation)Transform into a flesh-eating ghoul superhuman with a Special RC-Cell limb, gaining a random Kagune of the 4 types and near-immunity to conventional weapons below 9mm. You suffer ravenous hunger for human flesh and cannot eat other food; lingering hunger persists after deactivation until fed, but feeding slightly strengthens you.

name: hybrid Ghoul Physiology
description: #(Tag:necro)(Tag:transformation)Transform into a hybrid ghoul, far stronger than average ghouls with none of their weaknesses. Massively amplifies physical attributes, grants powerful regeneration and a random Kagune, and removes the need to eat human flesh while retaining its benefits.

name: Dragon Kakuja
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:transformation)"Become a true biological terror." Take the form of a Dragon Kakuja, an over 10km centipede-like dragon of RC cells stronger than any artificial material. Passively emit high-density RC clouds that turn nearby things into flesh-eating superhuman monsters under your telepathic control, and morph your body into tentacles or flesh monsters.

name: Keratin Manipulation
description: #(Tag:bio)Generate and control keratin to form constructs like horns, armour, and shields, or fire scales and needles.

name: Fierce Wings
description: #(Tag:bio)Grow wings whose feathers you telekinetically control as projectiles, extra limbs, or weapon enhancements. Feather power scales with your physical stats.

name: Stim
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:recovery)Flood your body with natural stem cells to rebuild it, at high stamina and resource cost. Requires available nutrients to work or it harms you instead; can be transferred to others via fluid exchange.

name: Conditioning
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:growth)While in an active slot, your body continuously conditions itself as if working out and recovering simultaneously. Slowly approach your biological peak over time and gain increased workout efficiency.

name: Bio Armor
description: #(Tag:bio)Manifest and wear bio armour that shapeshifts and autonomously adapts to your body. Can form blades, spikes, shields, and similar structures.

name: Body Refinement
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:growth)Refine bodies into a more ideal state: build muscle, remove impurities, and adjust size. Cannot alter genetics; stronger targets cost more energy.

name: Absolute Control
description: #(Tag:bio)Gain complete instinctual control over your body and brain, down to hormones and blood flow. Operates on intent and prevents accidental self-harm.

name: Shape Altering
description: #(Tag:alter)Alter your body's shape, but cannot create biological impossibilities like turning your head into tentacle whips. Larger alterations cost more energy.

name: Shapeshifting
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:transformation)Freely morph your body without breaking conservation of mass or altering genetics. You are protected from harm caused by your own shapeshifting.

name: Gene Refinement
description: #Alter and improve genetic structures by reinforcing, cutting, or overhauling them. Thereby improves the target's body and any biologically-based abilities.

name: Minor Regeneration
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:recovery)Gain a minor healing factor that closes lacerations and stabs during a fight, but won't fully recover you mid-fight. Expend energy to heal faster.

name: Regeneration
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:recovery)Gain a healing factor that closes wounds at speeds visible to the naked eye, often by the fight's end. Survive non-lethal wounds while you have energy; expend energy to heal faster.

name: High Speed Regeneration
description: #(Tag:healing)Gain rapid healing that closes bullet holes and stabs in seconds. Expend energy to heal even faster.

name: Super Regeneration
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:recovery)Gain a Wolverine-level healing factor without immortality; survive anything that doesn't instantly kill you while you have energy. Expend energy to heal even faster.

name: Regenerative Immortality
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:recovery)Gain regenerative immortality against mundane wounds; regenerate from the largest remaining living piece, even if split vertically. You can still be incapacitated, and fully running out of energy causes true death.

name: Redundant Physiology
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:recovery)Survive like a cockroach: when wounded, your body adapts to keep you alive without blood, lungs, or even a heart by repurposing other parts as substitutes.

name: Biological Adaptation
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:recovery)(Tag:transformation)Your body constantly rebuilds itself to counter stimuli, such as fire-resistant skin against fire, plating against cuts, or sharper claws. Adaptations are strictly biological and fade over time or when dispelled.

name: Vampire Physique
description: #(Tag:vampiric)Become a classic vampire with superhuman physical abilities, bat transformation, and bloodsucking. Retain all traditional weaknesses: crucifixes, garlic, wooden stakes, sunlight, and holy water.

name: Animorph
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:transformation)Freely morph into any mundane animal you know. Retain all your abilities while gaining the animal's physical traits.

name: Gills
description: #(Tag:bio)You have gills for breathing underwater, though they are inconvenient.

name: Hormone Manipulation
description: #(Tag:bio)Freely create, control, and design custom hormones. Inject them into others via bloodstream exposure or fluid exchange.

name: Tentacles
description: #(Tag:bio)Manifest controllable biological tentacles that act as extra limbs to smash, grab, whip, and manipulate.

name: Four Arms
description: #(Tag:bio)Manifest an extra set of arms that are as easy to control as your first pair.

name: Venom Injection
description: #(Tag:poison)Become venomous, injecting venom through bites or claws, or spraying it orally or via powers. Venom potency scales with your physical stats.

name: Poisoned Flesh
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:poison)Turn your flesh and blood into potent poison by expending energy; potency scales with energy spent and vitality. Poison becomes inert once the ability is cancelled or swapped out.

name: Poison Factory
description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:poison)Design, concoct, and expel any poison from your body while gaining poison resistance. Can combine with other abilities for esoteric poisons; overuse causes nausea and sickness.

name: Poison Breath
description: #(Tag:poison)Exhale a cloud of poisonous gas that also erodes physical matter.

name: Doku
description: #(Tag:poison)Freely create and manipulate poisonous substances, with potency scaling with energy expended.

name: Paralysis
description: #(Tag:poison)Create a paralytic agent in your body to expel through pores or spray orally as gas.

name: Blood Manipulation
description: #(Tag:blood)Telekinetically control your own blood. You cannot generate extra blood without regeneration, so spend it wisely.

name: Hemokinesis
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:kinesis)(Tag:life)(Tag:vampiric)Telekinetically control blood within your sensory range, but not in quantities smaller than you can perceive. Controlling blood inside someone requires being stronger than them.

name: Greater Hemokinesis
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:kinesis)(Tag:life)(Tag:vampiric)Sense and telekinetically control all blood within your sensory range, your own or an enemy's. Meaningful control of blood inside a target requires being stronger than them.

name: Teleportation
description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:space)Teleport to any location you have visited or seen with your own eyes. Longer range increases energy consumption and cooldown.

name: Blink
description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:space)Instantly teleport up to 10 meters to a normally accessible spot in line of sight, excluding through glass; range improves with training. Has a slight cooldown, and overuse causes intense vertigo.

name: Instant Transmission
description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:space)Instantly teleport to any sensed or previously visited location, bringing passengers along. Energy cost scales slightly with distance and passenger count; requires mental focus.

name: Rewind
description: #(Tag:recovery)(Tag:time)While in an active slot, build an energy stockpile by diverting a portion of your natural regeneration, manifesting by default as a horn. Spend the stockpile to rewind time's effects on a target, costing more for stronger or resisting targets and less for weaker ones. Cannot affect immaterial things such as soul, energy, or mind.

name: Haste
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:buff)(Tag:time)Accelerate your own time and that of anything you touch. Greater acceleration causes more strain and energy cost.

name: Apport
description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:space)Swap the locations of two items of approximately equal worth, within 10% price variation. You must touch at least one object, with both in your sensory range.

name: Swap
description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:space)Instantly swap the locations of any targets in your line of sight. More powerful targets cost more energy and strong enough ones can resist.

name: Boogie Woogie
description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:space)Swap the locations of two energy-possessing targets within your sensory range by clapping. Clapping is required to activate.

name: Dismantle
description: #(Tag:kinetic)Send invisible slashes directed by hand motions. Stronger slashes cost more energy.

name: Cleave
description: #(Tag:kinetic)Instantly cut any object you touch with no cues. Energy cost scales with durability; high enough magic resistance grants immunity.

name: Reality Slash
description: #(Tag:space)Create and launch a flying slash that severs spacetime, ignoring all conventional durability and barriers.

name: Dimensional Lock
description: #(Tag:debuff)(Tag:space)(Tag:time)Dimensionally lock an area to block spacetime abilities like teleportation, portals, and time travel inside it. Larger areas cost more energy; strong enough targets can break the lock.

name: Stillness
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:ice)(Tag:space)Freeze an object's time, rendering it inviolable and locked to its current speed and state; even a thrown pebble becomes unstoppable and immovable. Can be used on yourself for invulnerability, but strains the heart immensely and lasts only a few seconds.

name: Infinity
description: #(Tag:space)Infinitely divide the space between you and a target, making it impossible for them to reach you. Requires constant mental calculation, strains the brain immensely, and can liquify it with overuse.

name: Limitless
description: #(Tag:space)Distort space via three applications: Blue creates a powerful attracting force, Red a powerful repelling force, and Neutral infinitely divides space to prevent approach. These can be combined and expanded with experience, but cost much energy with effectiveness scaling with calculation ability.

name: Distortion
description: #(Tag:space)Distort and warp space to deal massive damage.

name: Clockblocker
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:ice)(Tag:time)Freeze an object in spacetime, rendering it completely inviolable and invulnerable. Duration and cost scale with energy spent and target strength; strong enough targets are immune.

name: The Hand
description: #(Tag:space)Scrape away space with either hand, pulling the remaining space together to fill it. Ignores conventional durability but has short range and high energy cost.

name: Time Manipulation
description: #(Tag:time)Manipulate time in a select area or target by speeding up, slowing down, stopping, or reversing it. Sufficiently strong targets can resist.

name: Slow Down
description: #(Tag:time)Slow down time for everything except yourself. More energy expended yields slower time.

name: Superhot
description: #(Tag:time)Time moves relative to you: it slows as you slow and speeds as you speed, stopping if you stand still. Strong enough targets may resist or ignore it.

name: Doppelganger
description: #(Tag:summon)Produce a seamless doppelganger you control mentally, though it has none of your abilities. You may maintain a number equal to your ability slot count.

name: Clone Split
description: #(Tag:summon)Split into several bodies, halving your stats per clone. Each clone needs one of your ability slots to use abilities, excluding Clone Split; if a clone dies, its stats return over 8 hours.

name: Divergent Avatars
description: #(Tag:summon)Split into multiple directly-controlled bodies, freely distributing ability slots and energy among them. Each avatar needs at least 5% of your stats; a dead avatar's stats return after 24 hours.

name: King Crimson
description: #(Tag:space)(Tag:time)Skip time, becoming absolutely intangible by separating from causality; actions against you during the skip are negated while yours persist. For example, after a 10-second skip trading blows, you return unharmed while your opponent keeps their wounds; can also phase through objects and reposition.

name: Gold Experience
description: #(Tag:life)(Tag:summon)(Tag:transformation)Imbue objects with life energy to turn them into autonomous living beings or constructs of your choice. Creations must be of roughly similar mass.

name: Anti Gravity
description: #(Tag:gravity)Remove gravity's influence from a target or area in your vision, creating zero-gravity, or invert and amplify gravity to hurl targets skyward.

name: Zero Gravity
description: #(Tag:gravity)Your body moves as if in zero gravity, letting you float freely though with little control.

name: Low Gravity
description: #(Tag:gravity)Create low-gravity zones in your line of sight, reducing the weight and falling speed of objects inside.

name: Burden Breaker
description: #(Tag:movement)"More speed" While active, your speed ignores physics including air resistance, gravity, and friction. You gain momentum indefinitely until deactivated, making it incredibly uncontrollable and potentially stranding you at the universe's edge.

name: Nuclear
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:poison)Create and control localized nuclear reactions with your energy, becoming a living nuclear weapon platform. Increased use causes radiation poisoning that fades over time.

name: Radiation Absorption
description: #(Tag:growth)(Tag:poison)(Tag:recovery)Absorb radiation to convert into energy, permanently increasing your reserves by absorbing large amounts over time.

name: Shrug It Off
description: #(Tag:recovery)Shrug off ailments and negative status effects like blindness, bleeding, or curses as a cure scaling with physical stats.

name: Vermin Lord
description: #(Tag:summon)Sense and telepathically command vermin such as insects and mice within your sensory range.

name: Mandom
description: #(Tag:time)Rewind time by 6 seconds in a localized 50-meter area. Those in range remain aware of the rewound 6 seconds.

name: Resurrection
description: #(Tag:life)(Tag:recovery)(Tag:spirit)Revive an entity dead no longer than you have been alive. Requires sacrifices like money, valuables, or artefacts scaling with target strength, doubled for unwilling targets.

name: Blast Mark
description: #(Tag:fire)Mark objects with a rune you can charge with energy to detonate at any time. Explosion power scales with energy spent; stored energy fades over time.

name: Carbon Manipulation
description: #(Tag:kinesis)Telekinetically sense and control carbon down to a molecular level. Controlling carbon inside living creatures is harder based on their power relative to yours.

name: Soul Read
description: #(Tag:spirit)Ask a soul yes-or-no questions it must answer truthfully. Cannot be used on targets stronger than you.

name: Emergency Exit
description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:passive)Passive: when lethally injured, automatically teleport to the safest area within a 1000-meter radius. Has a 30-minute cooldown.

name: Protean
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:passive)(Tag:transformation)Your body adapts to make your abilities more efficient and stronger, fading when disabled. For example, claws boost overall strength while fire manipulation grants heat tolerance.

name: Sunshine
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:fire)(Tag:holy)Blessed by the sun: under sunlight, massively increase stats and energy and create intense flames. At noon for one minute, enter "The One" for even greater stats, flames, and near-invulnerability.

name: Draconic Escalation
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:fire)(Tag:transformation)Under danger or combat, assume a draconic form that strengthens with time and danger, and recedes without it. Higher escalation grants basic pyrokinesis, regeneration, and enhanced physical stats.

name: Revengence
