description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:meta)Build up energy as you are hurt, then charge any ability or spell with it for a devastating effect. Each 10% health lost adds 2x power, reaching 10x at 10% health remaining; 8-hour cooldown.

name: Metallica
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:earth)(Tag:kinesis)Precisely manipulate and sense all iron in a 10-meter radius, forming elaborate constructs or blades from a target's blood. Can control blood inside living beings.

name: Glass Manipulation
description: #(Tag:kinesis)Telekinetically control glass and glass-based objects within your sensory range.

name: Oil Manipulation
description: #(Tag:kinesis)Telekinetically control oil and oil-based substances such as petrol, fuel, asphalt, crude oil, and plastic within your sensory range.

name: Silicon Manipulation
description: #(Tag:kinesis)Telekinetically shape and control silicon down to an atomic level, including glass, sand, quartz, silicone, and most electronics within your sensory range.

name: Plastic Manipulation
description: #(Tag:kinesis)Telekinetically control plastic and plastic-based substances and objects within your sensory range.

name: Fabric Manipulation
description: #(Tag:kinesis)(Tag:nature)Telekinetically control fabric within your sensory range, including cotton, silk, wool, and kevlar. Can create your own clothes or turn enemies' clothes against them.

name: String Manipulation
description: #(Tag:kinesis)Generate and manipulate supernaturally durable strings with supernatural precision. You lose control if they lose contact with your body.

name: Copper Manipulation
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:kinesis)Telekinetically control copper and copper-based constructs within your sensory range.

name: Rust Inducement
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:necro)Induce rust in metals through physical contact.

name: Gold Manipulation
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:kinesis)Telekinetically control gold and gold-based constructs within your sensory range.

name: Gearbox
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tech) Manipulate the output of machines you own, lowering output to preserve durability or pushing them to their very limits even without the means to do so.

name: Mystic Eyes of Enchantment
description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:mental)(Tag:ocular)Hypnotise and mind-control those who make eye contact with you. High-willpower or stronger targets can break out.

name: Conjure Vines
description: #(Tag:neutral)Conjure energy-construct vines you control. Once they leave your body you lose control and they fade over time.

name: Hookwolf
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:transformation)Assume the form of a large shifting mass of metal needles, hooks, and blades, altering shape and size at energy cost. Damage to the metal doesn't harm you, but your body inside remains vulnerable.

name: Mystic Eyes of Death Perception
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:ocular)See lines of death as cracks along objects or people; destroying a line instantly and absolutely kills or destroys the target. Only works where the concept of death applies; overuse causes severe brain damage.

name: Superpower
description: #(Tag:enhancer)Gain superhuman power: run faster than a train, punch harder than a missile, and shrug off tank shells, all scaling with physical stats. Training results are considerably enhanced.

name: Haki
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:mental)(Tag:sense)(Tag:spirit)Harness willpower physically to reinforce things, gain extrasensory perception, and exert spiritual pressure. Can train in all Haki types.

name: Conqueror's Haki
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:mental)(Tag:spirit)Exert your willpower as a wave of power that knocks unconscious those with weaker willpower.

name: Armament Haki
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:spirit)Reinforce your body or a held object with an invisible hardening forcefield that can touch the intangible. At higher mastery it can be projected.

name: Observation Haki
description: #(Tag:divination)(Tag:sense)(Tag:spirit)Expand a sensory field to detect movements and objects inside. At higher mastery, distinguish targets, energy, and even emotions.

name: Elemental Lungs
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:dark)(Tag:electric)(Tag:fire)(Tag:ice)(Tag:light)(Tag:poison)(Tag:water)Charge your lungs with any elemental energy to unleash breath attacks such as acid, darkness, fire, ice, and light.

name: Vitality Drain
description: #(Tag:life)(Tag:recovery)Drain a target's vitality on touch to heal yourself. Stronger targets yield less drain.

name: Blood Tax
description: #(Tag:blood)(Tag:passive)(Tag:recovery)Whenever someone injures you, they lose a portion of energy or stamina to you, letting you recover even while damaged.

name: Hook & Line
description: #Conjure an energy hook-and-line usable as a weapon. Wounding someone with the hook lets you reel them to you, one target at a time.

name: Minefield
description: #(Tag:neutral)Conjure a grid pattern along terrain and detonate sections of it through the grid.

name: Density Manipulation
description: #(Tag:gravity)Increase or decrease your own density or that of wielded objects. Greater changes cost more energy to maintain.

name: Star Rage
description: #(Tag:gravity)Increase your mass without penalties to speed or stature, making physical attacks unimaginably stronger and potentially collapsing into a black hole. Higher mass costs more energy to maintain.

name: Lock On
description: #(Tag:martial)Lock onto targets so thrown projectiles home in and become nigh impossible to dodge unless they leave range.

name: Absolute Accuracy
description: #(Tag:martial)Any projectile you throw will hit if physically possible, such as threading a human hair through a 1mm hole 10 kilometres away.

name: Energy Emission
description: #(Tag:neutral)Emit energy as beams or pulses using your own energy. More energy spent and longer charging yield stronger emissions.

name: Kinetic Energy Absorption
description: #(Tag:kinetic)Absorb and store kinetic energy in your body to enhance your blows when released. Stored energy fades if unused.

name: Kinetic Energy Manipulation
description: #(Tag:kinetic)Manipulate kinetic energy in your sensory range by negating, applying, changing, or redirecting it. Cannot control more than your body can exert.

name: Vector Manipulation
description: #(Tag:kinetic)Create and control vectors at Level 5 Esper level, controlling the movement of basically anything: teleporting, stopping, accelerating, and more.

name: Halt
description: #(Tag:kinetic)Stop all kinetic energy of a target, even a meteor. Larger forces cost more energy; has a 1-second cooldown.

name: Lockdown
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:space)Lock down an area centred on you so nobody can enter or leave and spacetime abilities are disabled. Absolute enough that even a god cannot breach it; requires energy and cannot be maintained indefinitely.

name: Stick
description: #(Tag:alter)Stick to objects like super glue.

name: Fear Gaze
description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:mental)Gaze into someone's eyes to make them recall their greatest fear. Stronger targets cost more energy, and strong-willed ones are less affected.

name: Glide
description: #(Tag:movement)Lets you glide 1cm above the ground without friction, moving as if skating.

name: Absolute Gateway
description: #(Tag:alter)Creates a door that breaches any barrier or defense it is placed on, letting you bypass it without teleporting.

name: Pacifists Domain
description: #(Tag:alter)Erects a domain centered on yourself where no one, including you, can commit violence.

name: Quake
description: #(Tag:kinetic)Conjures massive vibrations, tremors, and quakes through any medium like air, water, or ground, strong enough to devastate landmasses. Can shatter objects like glass and partially bypass durability.

name: Adamantine Skin
description: #(Tag:enhancer)Your skin is nigh-invulnerable to all harm without durability negation at similar power. You also resist durability negation, reducing its efficiency so it cannot fully pierce you.

name: Phoenix Zoan
description: #(Tag:avian)Lets you transform into a Blue Phoenix or hybrid at will. Grants increased physical abilities, flight, extreme regeneration, and healing flames.

name: Hydra Form
description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:poison)(Tag:recovery)(Tag:transformation)Lets you transform into a Hydra or hybrid at will. Grants massively increased physical abilities, high-tier poison immunity, poison breath, extreme limb-regrowing regeneration, and survival of up to 9 beheadings.

name: Thunderbird Form
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:avian)(Tag:electric)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:transformation)Lets you transform into a thunderbird or hybrid at will. Grants increased physical abilities, flight, lightning emission, and weather manipulation.

name: Portal Creation
description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:space)Creates resizable portals to anywhere in sensory range or anywhere you have visited. A portal cannot close while something is inside it.

name: Doormaker
description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:space)Creates portals that can cross even dimensions, placed anywhere you can perceive or have visited.

name: Clairvoyance
description: #(Tag:divination)(Tag:sense)Extends your sight beyond your eyes, controllable like a free spectator camera.

name: Super Jump
description: #(Tag:movement)Lets you leap great distances, such as over a building for a regular person. Also grants immunity to falling damage.

name: Shaper
description: #(Tag:bio)Freely manipulates flesh and biomaterials by contact with perfect cellular precision. Larger power gaps let targets resist your changes more.

name: Tool Manipulation
description: #(Tag:kinesis)Assigns an object under your lifting strength as a target to telekinetically control with extreme limb-like precision.

name: Energy Drain
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:recovery)Drains energy from living targets via contact. Larger power gaps reduce how much you can drain at once.

name: Double Jump
description: #(Tag:movement)Lets you jump once off thin air as if it were solid.

name: Sky Jumper
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:movement)Lets you treat air as jumpable platforms anytime, but you cannot stand on it for more than a second without falling.

name: Clothes Beam
description: #(Tag:alter)Fires a laser beam that dresses anyone in any mundane clothing of your choice.

name: Spirit Gathering
description: #(Tag:spirit)Channels and uses as your own the energy of anyone willing to share it, regardless of distance.

name: Power of Destruction
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:infernal)Conjures and controls pure destructive energy that can annihilate anything with enough magical power.

name: Full Counter
description: #(Tag:alter)With precise timing, counters any attack thrown at you and returns it with double power.

name: Destruction Incarnate
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:transformation)You are Destruction Incarnate, turning your body into a vessel for nigh-endless destructive energy that can wipe almost anything from existence.

name: Ice Man
description: #(Tag:ice)(Tag:kinesis)(Tag:recovery)(Tag:transformation)You are everything ice: plunge worlds into an ice age, rebuild your body from ice, or unleash absolute-zero temperatures at will.

name: Phoenix Force
description: #(Tag:avian)Hosts the Phoenix Force, source of all life and fire in the universe, but it exerts no control or influence over you; you simply channel its abilities.

name: Stinger
description: #Imbues any attack with absolute inviolability, unstoppable even by dimensional boundaries or reality-warping.

name: Rally
description: #(Tag:buff)(Tag:mental)Emits a rousing cry that bolsters allies with lion-like courage and endless motivation, turning even a chef into a warrior able to fell a soldier.

name: Cybele
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:earth)(Tag:ocular)Medusa - Your unimaginably beautiful eyes petrify anything in your gaze or anything that meets your eyes. Larger power gaps slow the petrification.

name: Third Person
description: #(Tag:sense)Shifts your perspective from first-person to an orbiting third-person camera around you, as in Dark Souls.

name: Seek Guidance
description: #(Tag:divination)While active, shows commentary from those who were, could have been, or would have been, helpful or deceitful. Includes trapped-treasure warnings, hidden-wall locations, or trap prompts, like messages in Eldensoulsborne Games.

name: Immune
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:passive)While in an active slot, grants immunity to poison, illness, curses, debuffs, and all negative status effects.

name: Gunpowder Manipulation
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:fire)Conjures and telekinetically manipulates gunpowder, shaping constructs or detonating it on command. Larger volumes cost more energy.

name: Vita Telum
description: #(Tag:life)Converts your life into supernaturally durable weapons of solidified blood emerging from an open wound. Greater vitality or sacrificed lifespan makes them stronger, with lifespan sacrifice also granting powerful effects based on your abilities and traits. Created weapons fade in power over time until returning to normal blood.

name: Authority of Lust
description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:mental)(Tag:passive)(Noncon) When activated, everyone who can see you treats you as an object of affection, platonic or romantic, with stronger effect at larger power gaps in your favor. Mundanes may surrender life savings or spouse, while equals may only treat you as an ordinary friend.

name: Steal
description: #(Tag:movement)Remotely steals an unbound target's possession within 10 meters without them noticing. More valuable objects cost more energy.

name: Grand Theft
description: #(Tag:movement)Steals ALL unbound possessions from a target within 5 meters into your subspace inventory. You can narrow the range to steal specific targets more easily.

name: Record
description: #(Tag:mental)Trash Count - Records your sight into memory in perfect detail, recallable anytime as if constantly in mind, surpassing photographic memory.

name: Arousal
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:nsfw)(Nsfw)(Noncon) Makes targets in your vision aroused, or climax with enough arousal. Stronger targets cost more energy, and far stronger ones notice your attempts.

name: Audacity
description: #(Tag:mental)(Tag:stealth)Lets you go unnoticed as people ignore you to their utmost, allowing theft, break-ins, or kills without comment. Stronger targets resist more, noticing drastic acts; upkeep costs energy and stamina.

name: Mind Reading
description: #(Tag:divination)(Tag:mental)Reads a focused target's surface thoughts, emotions, or deeper thoughts and opinions. Stronger targets drain more energy.

name: Telepathy
description: #(Tag:mental)Exchanges thoughts with others within energy-dependent range, reading surface thoughts or communicating one- or two-way. Multiple targets heavily strain your mind.

name: Crimson Fucker
description: #You are a descendant of Alucard, the Crimson Fucker himself, sharing all his natural abilities.

name: Basilisk Form
description: #(Tag:transformation)Transforms into a basilisk at will, partially or fully. Your gaze petrifies and paralyzes, your scales grant natural armor, and you highly resist curses.

name: Wendigo
description: #(Tag:ice)Transforms into a Wendigo partially or fully. Grants increased ice affinity, enhanced physical stats, blizzard summoning, and supernatural tracking, but may instill human-flesh appetite.

name: Oni
description: #(Tag:infernal)Transforms into an Oni partially or fully. Grants enhanced physical stats and minor healing, but vulnerability to holy.

name: Phoenix Form
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:avian)(Tag:fire)(Tag:life)(Tag:recovery)(Tag:transformation)Transforms into a Phoenix partially or fully. Grants enhanced physical stats, major fire affinity, incredible regeneration, and revival from death once every 30 days.

name: Tinker - Redundant
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Modifies existing technology in purposeless ways granting no tangible benefit, like yellowing a phone screen, adding useless car wheels, or fitting a car with a propeller too weak to lift it.

name: Mirror Force
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:neutral)Reflects magical attacks back with a large forcefield.

name: Disguise
description: #(Tag:illusion)Alters an object's color and texture by touch until its structural integrity is compromised.

name: Fishman Form
description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:transformation)(Tag:water)Transforms into a fishman, an amphibious humanoid-fish race. Grants greatly increased physical abilities over humans, further empowered when submerged.

name: Lock
description: #(Tag:alter)Places locks on entities that block interaction until unlocked by condition, key, or brute force. Cannot lock resisting living beings.

name: Unlock
description: #(Tag:alter)Conceptually unlocks entities, from locks to inner potential. More abstract or difficult targets cost more energy; imagination and energy are your limits.

name: Dragon Form
description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:transformation)Transforms into a western dragon partially or fully, granting enhanced stats and energy plus the ability to use other abilities as breath attacks.

name: Energization
description: #(Tag:transformation)Converts flesh into energy to become an energy being. More flesh yields more energy but greater vulnerability to energy attacks.

name: Everlasting Dragon Form
description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:earth)(Tag:recovery)(Tag:transformation)Transforms into a giant everlasting dragon partially or fully. With intact stone scales of immortality, needs no sustenance and gains regeneration, powerful breath, and extreme damage resistance, but loses immortality if scales break and stays vulnerable to lightning.

name: Lunarian Form
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:fire)(Tag:transformation)"No, it doesn't give you the pass" Temporarily transforms into a Lunarian, an extinct sky-faring race, with free winged flight and bodily fire manipulation for attacks and more. Intact flame grants extreme durability; lost flame removes it but grants slight speed instead.

name: Soul Window
description: #(Tag:divination)(Tag:ocular)(Tag:spirit)When activated, lets you see and interact with souls and spirits, and grasp general intent by looking into eyes.

name: Sharingan
description: #(Tag:illusion)(Tag:mental)(Tag:ocular)(Tag:sense)Transforms your eyes into the one-tomoe Sharingan of the Uchiha Clan, evolvable through training and severe mental trauma. Grants greatly enhanced vision, memorization of seen Martial Moves and Spells you can replicate, and hypnosis scaling with power gap, breakable by strong shock.

name: Byakugan
description: #(Tag:mental)(Tag:ocular)(Tag:sense)Transforms your eyes into the Hyuga Clan's Byakugan. Grants massively enhanced, near-omnidirectional vision that pierces obstacles and clearly sees and tracks energy.

name: Nine Eyes
description: #(Tag:divination)(Tag:ocular)When activated, differentiates objects into nine titular colors with distinct meanings, such as threat levels and glimpses of fate and destiny. Ununlocked colors appear colorless, and divinely empowered objects or people cannot be perceived. For more info: https://the-second-coming-of-gluttony.fandom.com/wiki/Nine_Eyes

name: Strength
description: #(Tag:enhancer)Grants super strength to lift cars, punch through reinforced concrete, and bend metal like rubber. Scales with base strength, costs energy to maintain, and can be further augmented with more energy.

name: Speed
description: #(Tag:enhancer)Grants supernatural speed to outrun cars and outpace dragonflies. Scales with base speed, costs energy to maintain, and can be further augmented with more energy.

name: Toughness
description: #(Tag:enhancer)Grants supernatural durability, ignoring low-caliber bullets and damaging cars that hit you. Scales with base durability, costs energy to maintain, and can be further augmented with more energy.

name: False Master
description: #(Tag:martial)While active, instinctively reveals any held weapon's full capabilities and grants temporary Adept Rank Mastery in its category.

name: Atlas
description: #(Tag:enhancer)"The Giant held up the very skies" Grants immense strength to carve mountains and move cities with bare hands given enough energy, plus shockwave release. Consumes energy when active.

name: Star Toss
description: #(Tag:enhancer)Grants ultimate strength to pluck stars and shatter planets. Immeasurably strong and augmentable without limits.

name: Extreme Speed
description: #(Tag:movement)Lets you move at extreme, hard-to-control speeds. Further augmentation is possible, but greater speed burns more energy.

name: Godlike Speed
description: #(Tag:movement)Grants ultimate speed where sound is a statue and light a turtle. Augmentable without limits with enough energy.

name: Invincible
description: #(Tag:enhancer)Makes you "Title Card" extremely durable, with nuclear weapons barely causing a first-degree burn. Augmentable to extreme levels.

name: No Friction
description: #(Tag:alter)Eliminates friction of a target you are touching.

name: Phase Shift
description: #(Tag:enhancer)Switches between offensive form with enhanced speed and strength, and defensive form with enhanced durability and resistance.

name: Hunter
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:sense)Greatly augments physical stats, especially hearing and focus to lock onto a heartbeat a street away. Scales with basic stats.

name: Quiet
description: #(Tag:sound)Creates a zone silencing all sound inside or blocking its escape, or mutes specific targets by touch. Can silence your abilities at increased energy cost.

name: Widen
description: #(Tag:meta)Extends an ability's area of effect without reducing power, such as doubling or tripling it, at higher energy cost.

name: Penetrate
description: #(Tag:meta)Augments abilities with penetration to better ignore resistances and bypass immunities, letting even a lich be cursed or a fire dragon burnt.

name: Boost
description: #(Tag:meta)Raises a targeted ability below Legendary by a full stage.

name: Delay
description: #(Tag:meta)Casts an ability with delayed effect, such as a fireball firing 1 minute later in place, or healing held until needed.

name: Permeation
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:transformation)Phases through objects and attacks non-selectively, so you can fall through ground and go blind phasing your head. Disabling inside solid matter ejects you headfirst at high speed.

name: Dress Break
description: #(Tag:alter)Destroys a touched target's clothing or armor by touch, delayable up to an hour.

name: Multiplicity
description: #(Tag:meta)Uses multiple instances of an ability at once, like triple fireball or tenfold lightning strike, each costing appropriate energy.

name: Deduction
description: #(Tag:divination)(Tag:mental)Deduces information from targets via enhanced observation, matching a genius detective like Sherlock Holmes given detailed observation.

name: Condemnation
description: #(Tag:buff)(Tag:debuff)(Tag:holy)"Let there be judgment." Casts judgment based on target karma; against irredeemable evil by a positive-karma user, victim power drops 10x while your power rises 10x against them. 8-hour cooldown.

name: Salt King
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:transformation)Turns you into the Salt King, creating, controlling, and transmuting targets into supernaturally powerful salt within eyesight range. Targets need at least your parity to resist transmutation.

name: Gravity
description: #(Tag:gravity)Creates and controls gravitational fields.

name: Gravity Manipulation
description: #(Tag:gravity)Accurately controls gravity on a massive scale: invert gravity to hurl islands skyward, craft imitation black holes, or crush with extreme gravity. Limited by imagination and gravity's power, with training able to remove a planet's gravity.

name: Optimization
description: #(Tag:meta)Optimizes targets, cutting electronics' energy use or maximizing your spells' and abilities' efficiency.

name: Perfect Unknowable
description: #(Tag:stealth)Temporarily erases all evidence of existence: no energy signature, scent, sight, sound, or perception until you attack.

name: Life Share
description: #(Tag:life)(Tag:recovery)Shares your life force to heal others via touch, remotely with further mastery.

name: Wheel of Mahoraga
description: #(Tag:alter)Manifests a wheel behind you that spins upon encountering an insurmountable phenomenon, adapting you to resist damage or harm previously unhittable foes. Adaptation fades when canceled, but gained knowledge and techniques remain.

name: Decay
description: #(Tag:necro)Destroys touched objects by spreading decay to dust, expandable with training. Strong targets partially resist.

name: Wither
description: #(Tag:necro)(Tag:poison)Emits a withering aura that drains vitality, breaks targets down internally, and disables regeneration, lingering like poison. With training, grows more potent and usable as a tangible attack.

name: Sublimate Presence
description: #Melds your presence with the environment while still, making you nigh-impossible to discern from foliage or dirt.

name: Mark
description: #(Tag:divination)Marks targets by touch, keeping perfect awareness of their location and distance while active.

name: Future Sight
description: #(Tag:divination)Sees several seconds into the future that would occur without intervention. Extendable with training.

name: Precognition
description: #(Tag:divination)Peers into the near future for energy, from moments when inexperienced to several seconds when skilled. May trigger automatically before a lethal blow.

name: Diagnosis
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:divination)Touching a target reveals a detailed diagnosis of their health.

name: Date Scouter
description: #(Tag:divination)Brings up a target's status page showing likes, dislikes, and kinks.

name: Absolute Territory
description: #(Tag:buff)(Tag:meta)Creates a 100-meter zone ranking up all abilities by one stage and boosting physical abilities, while barring others' authority inside. You cannot leave while active, and upkeep costs large energy.

name: Branding
description: #(Tag:divination)(Tag:movement)Brands unresisting targets as yours, revealing their location and condition. Lets you summon yourself to them or them to you with a 24-hour cooldown.

name: Soul Marriage
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:divination)(Tag:meta)(Tag:movement)Soul-marries a willing target with a kiss, granting a soul ring. Share energy freely, teleport to each other with an 8-hour cooldown, track state and location, and bestow or reclaim your abilities without penalty.

name: Mirror
description: #(Tag:meta)Copies a touched Legendary-or-below power for 1 hour in place of this ability, replaceable anytime with no cooldown. 2-hour cooldown.

name: Power Mimicry
description: #(Tag:meta)Adds a touched target's ability to storage by touch. Can switch to any stored power at any time, but mimics only one ability at once.

name: Ability Drain
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:bio)(Tag:meta)Forcefully absorbs a touched target's biology-based ability. Fails on blessings, curses, authorities, and similar.

name: Beast Mimicry
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:transformation)Mimics or manifests aspects of any beast consumed within 24 hours, like crab-shell armor or hydra regeneration.

name: Overhaul
description: #(Tag:kinesis)Deconstructs and reconstructs matter at will, down to molecular levels with training.

name: Pocket Dimension
description: #(Tag:space)Grants a 1km x 1km pocket dimension for storing almost anything, expanding as you grow stronger. Access requires physical portals, so beware.

name: Inventory
description: #(Tag:space)Grants an inventory subspace preserving inanimate targets in stasis, holding 100 tons by default and scaling with physical stats. Stores by willing touch and withdraws within 1 meter of your body.

name: Synthesis
description: #(Tag:alter)Combines two objects into one with their desired traits, such as merging pebbles toward adamantite or iron swords into an unbreakable sword.

name: Sonar
description: #(Tag:sense)(Tag:sound)Provides a sonar to detect your surroundings.

name: Life Radar
description: #(Tag:life)(Tag:sense)Detects all lifeforms and shapes within a 100-meter radius, expandable with training.

name: Devil Control
description: #(Tag:infernal)Completely and absolutely controls any lesser being, but you must first prove they are lesser.

name: Arbor
description: #(Tag:nature)Creates and extends controllable, reinforceable wood constructs from your body.

name: Contractual Recreation
description: #Invokes any owned legally binding receipt for its effect, like a hot-spring receipt to refresh yourself or a house receipt to summon a controllable copy.

name: Trajectory Manipulation
description: #(Tag:kinesis)Manipulates trajectories of perceived projectiles: curve bullets around you, sharply turn thrown spears without losing momentum, or reverse fireballs. Stronger projectiles resist more.

name: Hermit Purple
description: #(Tag:divination)(Tag:spirit)Summons Hermit Purple as manipulable translucent purple vines that divine the future, with accuracy improvable through training.

name: Somnabulist
description: #(Tag:bio)Emits very powerful sleeping gas from your skin as purple mist.

name: Phantom Touch
description: #(Tag:mental)(Tag:spirit)(Noncon) Lets you touch a target at range, making them feel your hands or mouth on a spot of your choosing. These are phantom sensations only and cannot physically affect them.

name: Collaring
description: #(Tag:command)Lets you collar a defeated or submitting target, preventing them from moving to harm you and forcing them to obey your orders. Manifests as a translucent, hideable collar and chain around their neck.

name: Material Swim
description: #(Tag:alter)Lets you pass through physical objects as if they were water, without affecting their state or structural integrity.

name: Kaleidoscope
description: #(Tag:space)(Tag:time)A True Magic that lets you manipulate parallel worlds.

name: Heaven's Feel
description: #(Tag:recovery)(Tag:spirit)A True Magic that turns your soul into an immortal, high-dimensional entity generating infinite energy.

name: Denial of Nothingness
description: #A True Magic that lets you create anything creatable, given enough energy.

name: Lycanthropy
description: #(Tag:beastkin)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:recovery)(Tag:sense)(Tag:transformation)Lets you transform into a werewolf with enhanced physical abilities and common werewolf traits. You can spread it to turn others into werewolves.

name: Despair Aura I
description: #(Tag:mental)(Tag:necro)Lets you emit an aura of despair that makes people uneasy and weaker targets fearful.

name: Despair Aura II
description: #(Tag:mental)(Tag:necro)Lets you emit an aura of despair that causes unease and fear toward you, overwhelming weaker-willed targets with unbearable fear and panic.

name: Despair Aura III
description: #(Tag:mental)(Tag:necro)Lets you emit an aura of despair causing deep unease and fear, crushing weaker targets' morale and leaving them in despair, unable to retaliate.

name: Despair Aura IV
description: #(Tag:mental)(Tag:necro)Lets you emit an aura of despair causing unease, fear, and terror. You can drive weaker targets to insanity by focusing on them, and make armies of weaker foes kneel in hopelessness.

name: Despair Aura V
description: #(Tag:mental)(Tag:necro)Lets you emit an aura of death and despair commanding fear, terror, and hopelessness. It can physically crush opponents to their knees, affects weaker opponents more, and can kill significantly weaker targets outright.

name: Rubber Body
description: #(Tag:transformation)Your body stretches and compresses like rubber, scaling with your physical stats.

name: Magic Jammer
description: #(Tag:magic)Lets you destroy or disable magical constructs, costing more energy against stronger constructs.

name: Contract Creation
description: #(Tag:alter)Lets you enforce the clauses and conditions of any contract you make. Conditions must be set while enforcement is active, and enforcement binds both you and your target.

name: Binding Vow
description: #(Tag:meta)Lets you create binding vows, promises with reality itself. Breaking a vow between parties inflicts the penalty regardless of strength. You can also make self-vows, sacrificing something to boost energy output, such as being weaker at night to be stronger by day.

name: Chop Chop
description: #(Tag:transformation)Lets you split your body apart and telekinetically float the parts around with your feet as the anchor. You are immune to slashing attacks while active, but limbs too far from your feet go inactive.

name: Lord of Shades
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:transformation)You are the embodiment of the Void, a vast devouring abyssal fluid that seeks to consume. You can shape it into tendrils, barbs, blades, fangs, mouths and more, defaulting to barbed tendrils; you can turn into void, shapeshift, corrupt living creatures to strengthen and control them though it can be resisted, and subsume beings to store them or drain their energy without gaining it.

name: Almighty Push
description: #(Tag:kinetic)Lets you exert incredible repulsive force, enough to wipe out entire streets as a normal human. Has a 5-second cooldown.

name: Universal Pull
description: #(Tag:kinetic)Lets you exert incredible attractive force to pull distant targets or bury a target under surrounding objects. Has a 5-second cooldown.

name: Operation
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:space)Lets you create a circular zone where you control space like an operating table, swapping objects, amputating without harm, removing hearts, teleporting, and more with training. Maintaining the zone and using the power costs immense energy.

name: Azure Dragon Form
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:electric)(Tag:fire)(Tag:transformation)Lets you transform into a giant Eastern Azure Dragon or hybrid at will, massively boosting physical abilities. Grants elemental breath attacks like fire, lightning, and air, plus fire clouds to lift things or fly.

name: Buddha Form
description: #(Tag:transformation)Lets you transform into a giant golden Buddha statue, massively boosting physical abilities. Grants golden shockwaves and near-invulnerability to most damage in this form.

name: Cow Form
description: #(Tag:transformation)Lets you transform into a cow or cow hybrid at will, boosting physical abilities, vitality, and stamina. Grants bovine traits while transformed.

name: Sea Snake Form
description: #(Tag:poison)(Tag:transformation)(Tag:water)Lets you transform into a sea snake or sea snake hybrid at will, greatly boosting physical abilities. Grants minor regeneration, water breathing and mobility, plus lethal poison breath.

name: Tantric Healing
description: #(Tag:nsfw)(Tag:recovery)(Nsfw) Lets you heal ailments and negative status effects through sexual intimacy, including scars, old wounds, diseases, and mitigated curses. Greater intimacy and release increases effectiveness.

name: Assembly
description: #(Tag:alter)Lets you automatically assemble accessible parts into any item you have built before or know how to make. Subpar materials produce lesser versions.

name: Pearl Jam
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:recovery)Lets you imbue Pearl Jam into your cooking to drastically improve it. Based on food quality, ingredients, and your power, it gains effects like healing and curing illness.

name: Trace On
description: #Lets you create weapons from magical energy as long as you know their construction. Stronger weapons cost more energy.

name: Structural Analysis
description: #(Tag:sense)Lets you run energy through an object or construct to build a detailed mental blueprint, revealing weaknesses and flaws.

name: Hound Nose
description: #(Tag:passive)(Tag:sense)Passively boosts your smell to supernatural levels, letting you pick out one scent in a hundred and track week-old scents across a city. Can be further augmented with energy.

name: Hawk Eyes
description: #(Tag:passive)(Tag:sense)Passively boosts your sight to supernatural levels, letting you see accurately from a hundred kilometers away. Can be further augmented with energy.

name: Bat Ears
description: #(Tag:passive)(Tag:sense)Passively boosts your hearing to supernatural levels, letting you hear from kilometers away and pick out a coin drop in a busy mall. Can be further augmented with energy.

name: Usurper
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:meta)"Complete Victory" If you make an opponent recognize their complete and utter defeat to you, you permanently take one of their abilities. Works only once per target.

name: Exchange
description: #(Tag:meta)Lets you swap one of your powers with another person's power with their consent, as long as both abilities share the same rank.

name: Finger Gun
description: #(Tag:kinetic)"Bang" Lets you point your index finger, say bang, and blast the target with telekinetic energy.

name: Telekinesis
description: #(Tag:kinetic)Lets you grab and manipulate objects in sensory range with energy, shaping telekinesis like an invisible forcefield. Greater applied force costs more energy.

name: Greater Telekinesis
description: #(Tag:kinesis)(Tag:kinetic)Lets you manipulate objects directly with willpower rather than outside force. Strong enough to throw skyscrapers and tear up streets at base level, improvable with training.

name: True Telekinesis
description: #(Tag:kinesis)(Tag:kinetic)Your telekinesis is second to none, usable as forcefield, invisible force, or direct object manipulation, limited only by training. Rivals or exceeds Tatsumaki from One Punch Man.

name: Daily Grind
description: #(Tag:growth)(Tag:passive)Once this ability has spent 24 total hours in an active slot, permanently add a regular grown person's strength and endurance to your stats. Repeatable.

name: Training Booster
description: #(Tag:growth)(Tag:meta)(Tag:passive)While active, all training is twice as effective, doubling for each empty ability slot: 1 empty slot = 2x, 2 = 4x, 3 = 8x, etc.

name: Scouter
description: #(Tag:divination)Lets you accurately gauge an opponent's abilities and power level even if they try to hide them.

name: Danger Rating
description: #(Tag:divination)Lets you view a target's danger to you as safe, moderate, dangerous, lethal, or certain death.

name: Lifeblood
description: #(Tag:life)(Tag:recovery)Lets you imbue your blood with vitality so drinkers are healed, with more vitality giving more healing. Moderate imbuing is harmless but leaves you weakened and exhausted.

name: Strength Sap
description: #(Tag:life)Lets you drain an opponent's strength through touch and temporarily add it to your own, with victims slowly recovering. Killing with it permanently grants 10% of their physical abilities. Stronger opponents drain slower.

name: Devil Trigger
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:transformation)Lets you tap inner demonic power to transform into a Devil form, greatly enhancing physical abilities and power. As a normal human you could tear tanks apart barehanded, scaling with your abilities.

name: Sin Devil Trigger
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:transformation)Lets you ascend your Devil form to its apotheosis, massively boosting power and physical abilities and wielding pure demonic power to boost existing abilities. Burns stamina and health extremely quickly; a wall-breaking fireball could annihilate city blocks.

name: Angel Form
description: #(Tag:holy)Lets you transform into an angel or angel hybrid, boosting physical stats and energy. Lets you infuse abilities and items with holy energy and fly with wings.

name: Archangel Form
description: #(Tag:holy)Lets you transform into an archangel or archangel hybrid, massively boosting physical stats. Lets you infuse abilities and items with pure holy energy and intuitively use blessings, healing, protection, and all Holy Abilities below Elite Rank.

name: New Order
description: #(Tag:alter)Lets you place RULES on the world or objects, only as strong as you are. Examples include strengthening an object or granting yourself "Can grab lightning." Requires knowing a target's self-associated name, except for objects. Limited to 2 orders at once, increasable with training; stronger orders cost more energy.

name: Word Magic
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:ice)Lets you actualize words written in the air, such as FREEZE to freeze, IMMOVABLE to pin mid-air, and BURN to ignite. Words too strong for your level fail.

name: Life Fiber Creation
description: #(Tag:life)Lets you convert lifeforce into Life Fibers, stronger than any artificial material yet more elastic than silk. You can freely control them and surround yourself to significantly boost physical abilities.

name: Life Fiber hybrid
description: #(Tag:life)(Tag:transformation)Your body is infused with Life Fibers, granting massively superhuman physical abilities, incredible healing, and immense vitality. Wounds pull back together, even rejoining halves split apart.

name: Infernal Chains
description: #(Tag:infernal)Lets you conjure infernal barbed chains to bind foes or wield as weapons.

name: Angel Style
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:holy)(Tag:passive)One Punch Man, Puri Puri Prisoner - For each % of skin uncovered, energy output and physical abilities rise by the same %, reaching 2x when fully naked.

name: Heavenly Restriction
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:meta)While active, you cannot use energy or mana in any way. In exchange, physical abilities rise with your energy reserves, you are immune to spells cast directly on you, and you cannot be detected or directly targeted by magical means.

name: White Tiger Form
description: #(Tag:transformation)Lets you transform into a snow tiger or hybrid, gaining enhanced senses, predatory instincts, natural weapons, increased physical stats, and tiger traits.

name: Swamp Logia
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:transformation)(Tag:water)Lets you generate, control, create, and turn into mud or bottomless swamp. You can drag objects or people inside to store them in stasis.

name: Idle Death Gamble
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:transformation)See https://jujutsu-kaisen.fandom.com/wiki/Idle_Death_Gamble

name: Susanoo
description: #(Tag:spirit)Lets you form a humanoid energy construct around your body with exceptional defense for attack and defense, while retaining selective intangibility to act from inside. Starts skeletal, growing stronger and more complete with training.

name: Perfect Mangekyo Sharingan - Sasuke
description: #Grants Sasuke Uchiha's Mangekyo Sharingan plus enhanced normal Sharingan abilities. Lets you summon and control Amaterasu and summon a Susanoo.

name: Susanoo Ribs
description: #(Tag:spirit)Lets you form Susanoo's ribs from your energy as durable, selectively intangible defense you can attack from inside.

name: Barrier
description: #(Tag:neutral)Lets you form an adjustable, incredibly durable circular or dome barrier. Damaging it reflects lacerations onto attackers, but cracking it causes internal damage and coughing blood, with breaking causing worse backlash. Training can alter shape, size, and number.

name: Spider Man
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:divination)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:insectoid)"Don't forget the hyphen!" Bitten by a radioactive spider, you gain enhanced physical abilities, wall-climbing, natural web production, and precognition, without spider-totem hassle.

name: Bloodlust
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:mental)Cloaks you in a killer's aura, boosting instincts into a sixth sense for striking, weak spots, and anticipating movements. Grants the senses of a veteran killer.

name: Phasing
description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:space)Lets you phase through objects and let objects phase through others. Unphasing inside another object causes massive damage ignoring conventional durability.

name: The Absorber
description: #(Tag:neutral)Lets you absorb contacting energy of all kinds - kinetic, thermal, radiation, etc. - and convert it to your own. Absorbing strains the body and overuse causes damage.

name: Magic Arrow
description: #(Tag:neutral)Conjures a simple attributeless energy arrow projectile whose direction you can curve.

name: Momentum
description: #(Tag:movement)The longer you keep moving, the faster you go, up to 500%. Limit expandable with training.

name: Fa Jin
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:kinetic)Lets you build kinetic energy in limbs through repeated movement, then release it for bursts of power and speed. Stockpiled energy slowly fades if unused.

name: Glowing Eyes
description: #(Tag:light)(Tag:ocular)Your eyes can glow. Provides no tangible advantage but looks cool.

name: Slipper
description: #(Tag:alter)Your skin is slippery like oiled ice, making grappling you extremely annoying.

name: Waypoint
description: #(Tag:movement)Lets you leave waypoints to warp to at any time. Setting or traveling takes 10 seconds. Max waypoints equal ability slot count x 3.

name: Wood Release
description: #(Tag:nature)Wood Release lets you create, shape, and control wood and plant life. Roots you create can absorb and suppress energy/mana.

name: Dust Release
description: #(Tag:space)Lets you form three-dimensional translucent constructs like spheres and cubes that, once launched, reduce anything passing through to dust on a molecular level.

name: Skill Drain
description: #(Tag:growth)(Tag:mental)Lets you drain others' skills through touch to worsen theirs and improve yours, e.g. swordsmanship. Cannot exceed the victim's level, so draining 1000 novices will not make you a sword god.

name: Velocity
description: #(Tag:movement)You move 10x faster but influence the world 10x less. Punches hit 10x weaker and air resistance hits 10x stronger, etc.

name: Chameleon Hide
description: #(Tag:stealth)While standing still, you turn invisible by bending light around yourself.

name: Rinnegan
description: #(Tag:kinetic)(Tag:necro)(Tag:ocular)(Tag:recovery)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:summon)(Tag:transformation)Grants the Six Paths Technique: Deva for attraction and repulsion, Asura for body alteration, Human for soul extraction, Animal for summons, Preta for chakra absorption, and Naraka via the King of Hell, plus the Outer Path over life and death to revive the dead. Also grants energy-flow sight and unparalleled sensory abilities.

name: Object Attraction
description: #(Tag:kinetic)Lets you slowly draw small objects toward you, handy for grabbing the remote without leaving bed.

name: Rad Child
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:poison)(Tag:recovery)Lets you absorb radiation for regeneration and boosted physical abilities while irradiated. Absorbed radiation can permanently improve physical abilities and energy reserves.

name: Weather
description: #(Tag:divination)Lets you accurately predict a given area's weather for a week.

name: Weather Report
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:alter)(Tag:electric)(Tag:water)Lets you control weather and atmosphere passively or actively, including lightning, water conjuring, past phenomena, storms, air composition, and wind. Can act autonomously to defend you or follow intent.

name: Hurting
description: #(Tag:infernal)Lets you directly damage a target by pointing, causing lacerations.

name: Dark Orb
description: #(Tag:dark)Lets you conjure a dark-energy orb to hurl as a projectile.

name: Internet Access
description: #(Tech) Lets you access your local world's internet through your mind to instantly look up information.

name: Frisk
description: #(Tag:divination)Lets you see a viewed target's full inventory, clothing, carried items, and a quick summary.

name: Ripen
description: #(Tag:necro)Lets you ripen and mature organic objects that cannot resist.

name: Forced Activation
description: #(Tag:alter)Lets you forcefully activate and use a touched target's ability while they are willing or unable to resist.

name: Tactile Telekinesis
description: #(Tag:kinesis)(Tag:kinetic)Lets you telekinetically manipulate objects you touch, such as crumpling a car. Less effective on stronger targets.

name: Tinker - Bombs
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Lets you build explosion-related technology and operate it, from simple explosives to time-freezing, glass-transmuting, or teleporting bombs, drawing on your abilities for inspiration.

name: Tinker - Efficiency
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Lets you build efficiency-related technology and streamlined versions of existing tech.

name: Tinker - Drones
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Lets you build drone-related technology, such as surveillance, turret, or building drones.

name: Tinker - Blasto
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Lets you build biology and minion-creation tech, including custom plants, drugs, clones, and homunculi from available materials. Can draw inspiration from your abilities and traits.

name: Tinker - Prosthetics
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Lets you build prosthetic and limb-replacement tech like bionic arms, mecha legs, and weaponized arms with hidden guns and blades. Can draw inspiration from your abilities and traits.

name: Tinker - Cryogenics
description: #(Tag:ice)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Lets you build cryonics-related tech like stasis chambers, frost grenades, ice guns, and fridges. You'd make Doctor Freeze proud.

name: Tinker - Pyrotechnics
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Lets you build pyrotechnics-related tech like flamethrowers, super napalm, and missiles. You'd make Firefly proud.

name: Tinker - Hacking
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Lets you build hacking-related tech for hijacking and interfacing with other technology.

name: Tinker - Ai
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Lets you build AI-related tech, from smart assistants and sentient companions to full Ultron.

name: Tinker - Bio
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Lets you build biology-related tech for living organisms, including diseases, elixirs, clones, healing pods, and custom races.

name: Tinker - Vehicles
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Lets you build vehicle and transportation tech, like laser-cannon cloaked cars or supersonic wave-immune ships. If it is a vehicle, you can build it.

name: Tinker - Repair
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Lets you build maintenance and repair tech. You can also spot flaws and fix almost any technology.

name: Tinker - Travel
description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Lets you build transportation and travel tech like teleportation pods, hypersonic cars, and wingsuits. If it gets you from A to B, you can probably build it.

name: Tinker - Teleportation
description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:space)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Lets you build teleportation tech like telepads and teleportation pods.

name: Tinker - Melee Weapons
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Lets you build melee-weapon tech like fire swords, vibration blades, and grenade hammers. If it is a non-magical melee weapon, you can probably build it.

name: Tinker - Ranged Weapons
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Lets you build ranged-weapon tech like laser cannons, revolvers, and missile batteries.

name: Tinker - Capture and Restraint
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Lets you build capture and restraint tech such as power-suppressing cuffs, containment foam, and durable cells.

name: Tinker - Construction
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Lets you build construction tech such as super cement, reinforced steel, and highly efficient schematics.

name: Tinker - Cloaking
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Lets you build cloaking tech like invisibility fields, anti-radars, and sound suppression.

name: Tinker - Analysis
description: #(Tag:divination)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Lets you build data-analysis tech like scouters, observation drones, and predictive programs.

name: Tinker - Mecha
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Lets you build giant mechs like Evangelion, Code Geass, or Gundam.

name: Tinker - Cyberpunk 2077
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Lets you build technology from the Cyberpunk 2077 universe.

name: Tinker - Metal Gear
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Lets you build technology from the Metal Gear universe.

name: Tinker - Androids
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Lets you build android and artificial-lifeform construction tech.

name: Tinker - RWBY
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Lets you build technology from the RWBY Universe, including Dust synthesis.

name: Tinker - Code Geass
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Build technological constructs or contraptions from the Code Geass universe.

name: Tinker - Computers
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Build tech related to personal computers, such as small supercomputers, etc.

name: Tinker - Games
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Build tech related to games or entertainment programs. You are over 100x more efficient than an average experienced full dev team at making them.

name: Tinker - Dreadon
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Build tech emulating Dreadon from Calamity Mod, harnessing practically any energy. Includes hyper light chainsaws, black hole bombs, cosmic-energy godslaying mechs, a godslaying sword of damned souls, and an instant universe-range sniper; limits are creativity, resources, and time.

name: Tinker - Sensors
description: #(Tag:sense)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Build tech related to sensors, sensing, and tracking like radars, sonars, magic sensors, trackers, etc.

name: Tinker - Star Wars
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Build technological constructs or contraptions from the Star Wars universe, including Kyber Crystal synthesis.

name: Tinker - Defense
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Build tech related to defense or securement, like barrier projectors, reinforced chassis, turrets, etc.

name: Tinker - Armor
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Build armored suits or power armor such as Iron Man Suit or Fallout Power Armor. Any powered suit up to 5x your size; larger counts as a mech.

name: Tinker - Fallout
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Build constructs from the Fallout universe, such as Fusion Batteries, Chems, Power Armor, Stealth Boys, etc. Excludes Big MT Technology.

name: Toggle
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:meta)Toggle objects or targets on and off; does not work on living beings. Applies to radios and even your own abilities.

name: Technopathy
description: #(Tag:mental)(Tag:tech)(Tech) "Talk to the power" to communicate with and command machines with code or interfaces. Resistance equals firewall strength.

name: Dark Hand
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:martial)(Tag:recovery)(Tag:spirit)Drain lifeforce from grabbed people into yourself if they cannot resist. You can also coat your hand for extra damage or spread it as a medium-sized shield.

name: Polymerization
description: #(Tag:spirit)(Tag:summon)Temporarily fuse your familiars together or with yourself. Stronger fusions cost more energy, and maintaining fusion drains energy over time.

name: Viltrumite Physiology
description: #(Tag:transformation)You are a pure-blooded Viltrumite with insane durability, space flight, incredible physical and sensory abilities, and a highly adaptable body.

name: Kryptonian Physiology
description: #(Tag:transformation)You are a pure-blood Kryptonian; yellow sun supercharges your cells, granting heat vision, ice breath, tactile telekinesis, flight, super physique, and all other Kryptonian abilities. Longer sunlight soak strengthens these abilities and permanently improves energy reserves.

name: Saiyan Physiology
description: #(Tag:transformation)You are a pure-blooded Saiyan with superhuman physique, rapid improvement, and abnormal energy. Your tail paralyzes you when grabbed, full moon turns you into a mindless Oozaru with massively enhanced stats, and near-death recovery makes you significantly stronger.

name: Soft & Wet
description: #Release soap bubbles that plunder a property from touched targets, like floor friction to make it slippery or hydration to cause thirst.

name: Soften
description: #(Tag:alter)Soften touched objects while retaining other properties; steel becomes dough-like but stays as heavy and durable. Shapes stay changed while hardness slowly returns after release.

name: Harden
description: #(Tag:alter)Harden touched objects while retaining properties, like fire into a hot barrier or water into a platform. Consistency slowly returns after release.

name: Clone
description: #(Tag:summon)Clone yourself with a hive mind; you can use abilities through any body. Creating and maintaining clones costs energy rising exponentially per clone, and a portion of a clone's death damage reflects onto you.

name: Multiply
description: #(Tag:summon)Create physical-body clones that cannot use abilities but carry your physical traits at formation; forming during active abilities is more taxing. You share one hive mind, clones need no upkeep, and you can hold 10 at a time, increasable with training.

name: Avatar Creation
description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:summon)Turn abilities into avatars by giving each at least 10% of max energy storage. Avatars can act independently or under your control, use only the given ability plus your basic stats, and return energy and ability on dispel or after 1 hour if destroyed.

name: Twice
description: #(Tag:summon)Clone yourself and others, but clones have independent minds and massively reduced durability. You can clone only two targets at a time, clones can clone with even lower durability, and after 10 iterations clones cannot retain form.

name: Clay Bombs
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:fire)(Tag:summon)Form clay constructs that move independently and explode on command. More infused energy means stronger explosions.

name: Dark Matter
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:dark)Generate and control nonexistent Dark Matter, which can take any property: combustible, ashifying organics, new matter states, elements, life, clones, powers, etc. Only limit is computational power.

name: Nilbog
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:life)(Tag:summon)Recycle biomass into customized self-aware minions; required biomass must equal result biomass. Minions can take any biologically possible form, like fire-breathing horses with graphene scales with practice, and are unconditionally loyal.

name: World Painting
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:space)Bring paintings to life as enterable pocket dimensions or worlds depending on power; even minimally, a small forest with inhabitants. With training, create your own mini-world.

name: Wonder of U
description: #(Tag:alter)Protected by Calamity itself: pursuers or those aware of you suffer escalating calamities until they stop or die. Closer proximity escalates from falling trees up to their own abilities killing them; calamity kills grant no tickets.

name: Bloody Imitation
description: #(Tag:life)(Tag:transformation)Transform appearance to match someone whose blood you consumed, down to minute details. Disguise duration equals ml consumed x 1 minute.

name: Bloody Replication
description: #(Tag:life)(Tag:transformation)Transform into someone by consuming their blood, exactly copying physical abilities, their ability and usage, plus basic info. Duration equals ml consumed x 1 minute.

name: Tetramand Transformation
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:transformation)Take Tetramand or Tetramand-hybrid form, among the galaxy's mightiest warriors with durable red skin, four eyes, four arms, and second-to-none strength.

name: Cement Manipulation
description: #(Tag:kinesis)Conjure and manipulate cement into constructs, walls, weapons, and back into less solid form.

name: Slime Physique
description: #(Tag:amorphous)Transform fully or partially into slime, mostly negating physical damage and exploiting a slimy physique.

name: Cursed Flames
description: #(Tag:curse)(Tag:fire)Throw green fireballs that cannot burn inanimates, bouncing off them like rubber, but devour living flesh and stick like glue.

name: Burning Sea
description: #(Tag:curse)(Tag:fire)(Tag:infernal)Throw crimson flame balls strengthened by water; dousing with water is like throwing crude oil on fire.

name: Brimstone
description: #(Tag:infernal)Conjure and wield Brimstone Crag flames tempered by tortured souls' agony. Incomparably hot, incinerating everything and burning intangibles like souls.

name: Ranchor
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:space)(Tag:spirit)Wield Ranchor, ultimate brimstone flames of malice and revenge. Burns anything including souls, energy, and flesh, but also burns the user to a lesser extent with more use.

name: Banishing Fire
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:holy)Holy fire gifted to clerics by angels as blessings, harmless to regular living creatures like humans and animals. Deals extreme damage to unholy or darkness beings and blocks their healing.

name: Holy Flame
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:holy)Wield angels' holy flames, no stronger than normal fire against regular living creatures like humans and animals. Deals extreme damage to unholy or darkness beings, blocks healing, and can burn away afflictions if skilled.

name: Star of Comprehension
description: #(Tag:growth)(Tag:mental)(Tag:passive)While in an active slot, massively boost comprehension: learn a book from one read and imitate martial arts from video or live exchange. Learn and master skills at supernatural rates.

name: Divinity Fire
description: #(Tag:fire)You are a God of Fire with domain over all fire, creating and controlling any type and shaping its temperature and effect.

name: Rabbit Form
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:sense)(Tag:transformation)Partially or fully transform into a rabbit or hybrid, gaining enhanced physicality focused on leg jumping and kicking, plus a substantial libido boost.

name: Ifrit
description: #(Tag:fire)Transform into an Ifrit, a fire-born spirit. Cannot use water or water-based abilities as one, but fire abilities are much stronger with natural flame generation.

name: Ifrit Sultan
description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:fire)(Tag:water)Transform into an Ifrit Sultan, ancient flame spirit ruling fire spirits with ancient-dragon-level power. Strengthens all fire abilities, disables cryo/hydrokinesis, and grants natural pyrokinesis plus fire immunity.

name: More Eyes
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:ocular)Manifest eyes anywhere on your body without disorientation from multiple vision.

name: Extension
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:meta)Extend durations beyond norm by consuming energy, such as blessings, lifespans, expiry dates, or burning flames. Must interact with the target.

name: Size Manipulation
description: #(Tag:alter)Manipulate size and mass of a touched target; each doubling or halving doubles the cost. Changes revert after a set time.

name: Shrink
description: #(Tag:transformation)Shrink yourself to 20x smaller with proportionally reduced power; unshrink anytime. Limit increasable with training.

name: Minimize Me
description: #(Tag:transformation)Shrink yourself up to 20x smaller without losing power; hits equally hard at 180cm or 18cm. Limit increasable with training.

name: Gigantism
description: #(Tag:transformation)Increase size and mass up to 10x; holding it drains stamina and burns energy faster. Can grow larger with training.

name: Titanic
description: #(Tag:transformation)Increase size and mass up to 100x; holding it drains stamina and burns energy faster. Can grow larger with training.

name: Enlarge
description: #(Tag:alter)Enlarge touched targets permanently or temporarily, with permanence costing far more. More energetic objects are harder and costlier to enhance.

name: Message
description: #(Tag:mental)Send one-way telepathic messages to anyone in sensory range.

name: Induce Baldness
description: #(Tag:curse)"A power so cruel" induces baldness on contact, gradually or instantly removing all hair. May make you the mortal enemy of most.

name: Dream Mirror
description: #(Tag:divination)(Tag:mental)View dreams of anyone in sensory range like a livestream. Can likely influence dreams by whispering in their ears.

name: Share Sense
description: #(Tag:mental)(Tag:sense)Link senses with willing others via touch, seeing from each other's perspective. Too many links cause disorientation.

name: Sleep Talk
description: #(Tag:command)Talk to sleepers to influence them, shaping dreams or opinions like hypnosis.

name: Probability Estimation
description: #(Tag:divination)View probabilities of any questioned outcome, like dying tomorrow or finding something somewhere. Always accurate except around blind spots.

name: Adhesion
description: #(Tag:alter)Turn skin incredibly sticky to cling to walls or hold ordinary people. You feel no difference and control which parts stick.

name: Lion Form
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:transformation)Turn into a proud lion or hybrid at will, gaining enhanced physicality, paralyzing roar, and natural weapons. Mundane animals defer to you as king unless you harm them.

name: Fake Weapon
description: #(Tag:illusion)Create illusionary weapons in hands for intimidation.

name: Bear Manipulation
description: #(Tag:command)Take control of all bears within 50 meters. Good luck finding that many bears.

name: Healing Kiss
description: #(Tag:recovery)Heal by kissing, supercharging the target's natural regeneration with your energy.

name: VATS
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:mental)"Vault-Tec Assisted Targeting System" puts your body on autopilot to aim attacks or aids melee as a helpful Intermediate-level combat AI.

name: Warp Mist
description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:space)Create and control portal-like dark mists shapable to your liking, reaching anywhere visited or seen. With training, use coordinates and images for unvisited places plus more mist.

name: Phenex
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:fire)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:recovery)You are the Phenex, immortal through flames that near-instantly regenerate you from a single shred. Also wield powerful flames and winds with ease.

name: Crack
description: #(Tag:anti-recovery)(Tag:space)Create tears in things in range, neutralizing attacks or directly ravaging targets for massive damage. Tears resist healing, taking hours even for Epic-ranked healing.

name: Number Man
description: #(Tag:mental)You possess nigh-infinite computational power for numbers and calculations, shaming even the strongest sci-fi supercomputers in math.

name: Route
description: #(Tag:divination)See a guiding line to any location you precisely know.

name: Stockpile
description: #(Tag:meta)Stockpile energy while in an active slot, holding up to 3x your storage but taking 24 hours to fill completely.

name: Cockroach Physique
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:recovery)(Tag:transformation)Turn into a humanoid cockroach or hybrid at will, gaining extreme resilience, increased physicality, and mundane cockroach traits.

name: Candy Paramecia
description: #(Tag:nature)Create and control candy as viscous syrup that hardens under your control; control ends after separation. With training, make it steel-hard and manipulate it off-body.

name: Bronze Creation
description: #(Tag:earth)Create and shape bronze, the superior metal and alloy, into weapons, armor, or constructs. Can reinforce it with your energy.

name: Blood Burn
description: #(Tag:blood)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:life)Significantly enhance physical stats by burning blood, losing 1ml per second. Can raise to 10ml per second for up to 5x strength.

name: Devil Regeneration
description: #(Tag:healing)(Tag:infernal)Gain extreme regeneration regrowing limbs in seconds, fueled by others' blood rather than energy. More blood means more regeneration; a large cup restores near-death to peak.

name: Tower of Babel
description: #(Tag:mental)Scramble senses of everyone within 500 meters, causing extreme disorientation like falling sensation, nausea, vertigo, tinnitus, deafness, etc.

name: Reactive Activation
description: #(Tag:meta)Set conditions on abilities for auto-activation, e.g. barrier on high-speed projectile or healing on foreign substance entry.

name: The Camper
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:passive)(Tag:recovery)"I can stay here all day" - Standing still over 10 seconds boosts energy, stamina, and health regen plus durability and resistance. Moving feet over 10cm from start ends it.

name: Energy Regeneration
description: #(Tag:recovery)Regenerate energy/mana by consuming stamina instead.

name: Bloody Carthus
description: #(Tag:life)(Tag:recovery)Sacrifice health to instantly recover energy; more energy recovered means more damage taken.

name: Monarch's Indifference
description: #(Tag:mental)Author's PoV - Fully suppress emotions to act with complete indifference toward your goal. Also fully counters mind manipulation or telepathy aimed at you.

name: Emotion Spectrum
description: #(Tag:divination)(Tag:spirit)See emotions as colored auras, e.g. yellow happiness, green envy, black despair, red anger, etc.

name: Sugar Rush
description: #(Tag:enhancer)Consume sugar for temporary super strength scaled to amount consumed, followed by a massive sugar crash.

name: Scarlet Rot
description: #(Tag:life)(Tag:poison)Create, control, and inflict Scarlet Rot, a deadly foreign-god infection eroding mind and body into mindless savagery.

name: Path to Love
description: #(Tag:divination)View how to romance people and unlock their romance questlines. If you still fail with this, there is probably no path to love for you.

name: Path to Victory
description: #(Tag:divination)Create a path to any mechanically possible goal, even one-in-googol odds, with impossibly precise execution and nigh-omniscient calculation except blind spots. Can use paths as guidelines only.

name: Spectral Claw
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:spirit)Manifest a large demon-like clawed arm over your own with superhuman strength and grip to crush steel and lift cars, extendable and slightly growable. Damage to it reflects onto your real arm.

name: Shield
description: #(Tag:neutral)Create translucent dome or wall barriers acting as physical defenses.

name: Absolute Barrier
description: #(Tag:neutral)Cross fingers to create one transparent barrier with controllable shape and size. Completely invulnerable to mundane damage like physical force, thermal, lightning, etc.

name: Shock Absorption
description: #(Tag:kinetic)Body absorbs kinetic energy like a sponge, reducing physical attack effectiveness.

name: Hydrogen Manipulation
description: #(Tag:ice)(Tag:water)Sense and telekinetically control hydrogen with perfect precision, the universe's most abundant element. Use it to manipulate air and water, create explosions, or freeze with liquid hydrogen.

name: Oxygen Manipulation
description: #(Tag:air)Sense and telekinetically control oxygen atoms with perfect precision to control air, drive combustion, corrode via oxidation, rip oxygen from objects, or poison with pure oxygen clouds.

name: Sharpen
description: #(Tag:buff)Sharpen touched objects, from monomolecular blades to swung air forming razor winds.

name: Dragon Projection
description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:summon)Create translucent dragon-limb projections for varied uses: arms to cut, smash, or protect, head to bite or breathe flames, wings to fly or glide.

name: Hydra Projection
description: #(Tag:draconic)Unleash hydra-head projections from body or back to crush, bite, smash, or constrict with the neck. A severed head needs time to resummon.

name: Natural Armory
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:earth)Turn touched objects into stable cold weapons regardless of matter, like water scythe, stone spear, air sword, or fire whip. The world is your armory.

name: Unlimited Bladeworks
description: #(Tag:divination)(Tag:fae)(Tag:martial)(Tag:summon){Reality Marble} scan and understand any weapon encountered to store in a mental armory, then project it with identical attributes for energy. With practice, pull others into your sword-filled mental world. Excludes Alien, Fae, and Divine weapons by default.

name: Reinforcement
description: #(Tag:buff)(Tag:enhancer)Reinforce structure and quality of touched objects or yourself. More energy means stronger but harder-to-maintain reinforcement.

name: Alteration
description: #(Tag:transformation)Alter shape and structure of touched objects, e.g. sharper, blunter, longer. Can turn a sword into a polearm while retaining abilities.

name: Makeover
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:illusion)(Tag:transformation)Change anything purely cosmetic about yourself, like ability color, hair color, pupil shape, skin color, etc.

name: Power to Reject Death
description: #(Tag:necro)(Tag:recovery)(Tag:spirit)On death resurrect as undead scaled to slot count, then after 24 hours revive as original self. 1=Skeleton, 2=Skeleton Warrior/Mage, 3=Dullahan/Necromancer, 4=Death Knight/Lich, 5+=Dread Knight/Elder Lich. 10-day cooldown.

name: Dead Apostle Ancestor Form
description: #(Tag:infernal)(Tag:life)(Tag:necro)(Tag:time)(Tag:transformation)(Tag:vampiric)Temporarily become a Dead Apostle Ancestor, strongest Vampire rank, with incredible physical/magical prowess, mist transformation, and time-reversal regeneration consuming your blood while heart remains and blood exists. Forms a Legendary-ranked Idea Blood from your life/experiences and can create full undead apostles.

name: Crush
description: #(Tag:kinetic)Remotely crush objects in line of sight, increasing pressure with energy output. Stronger targets are harder to crush.

name: Schrodinger
description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:recovery)(Tag:space)(Tag:time)You are everywhere and nowhere at once; close eyes to appear anywhere you know. Costs no energy/mana and may not be true teleportation.

name: Catch the Rainbow
description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:water)Under rainfall, stand on raindrops, teleport through them, or wield them as knives. Works only in actual rain, not falling water.

name: Ratio Technique
description: #(Tag:neutral)Split targets into imaginary lines creating a weak spot at the seven-to-three ratio point. Hitting it deals critical damage.

name: Killer Queen
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:fire)(Tag:spirit)Turn touched things into bombs detonable anytime, either catching the object or leaving it unscathed; contact-spread bypasses durability. Can also weak-explode via Killer Queen to disintegrate; strong targets partly resist.

name: Diver Down
description: #(Tag:alter)Dive into objects to restructure from inside, healing innards or fusing objects. Can also hide inside people or objects.

name: Berserk
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:martial)(Tag:mental)"Power at what cost?" Gain extreme strength, endurance, and near pain immunity for lost inhibitions and trance. Even ordinary men can throw trucks, tear tanks, and eat missiles.

name: Move Mimicry
description: #(Tag:meta)Mimic any one displayed opponent move or ability into Mimic and unleash the identical effect. Cannot copy above Epic, single stored ability, single use, then resets. 8-hour cooldown.

name: Clockwork
description: #(Tag:time)Rewind time with 1-minute charges; spending one returns you 1 minute back. Gain a charge every 24 hours, hold up to 30.

name: Luck Aura
description: #(Tag:alter)Store and unleash luck, gaining a charge every 24 hours for extreme luck like surviving lethal attacks or finding exactly what is needed. Excludes gacha tickets; hold up to 7.

name: Lucky Strike
description: #(Tag:alter)Turn luck your way for 1 hour of extraordinary fortune of all kinds. Cooldown: 7 days 7 hours 7 minutes.

name: Eye of Discernment
description: #(Tag:divination)(Tag:ocular)(Tag:sense){Mystic Eyes} See through all illusions and deceit; illusions reveal true forms and you sense deceptive intent and which words are true.

name: Enchanting
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:fire)(Tag:meta)Enchant items from your abilities and traits, e.g. pyrokinesis grants fire enchantments, or imbue the power itself as limited-use consumables. Strength depends on item and power level.

name: Greater Enchanting
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:meta)Lets you enchant items based on your abilities and traits, granting related effects or imbuing the ability itself as limited uses. Enchantment strength scales with the item and your power level.

name: Esper Silence
description: #(Tag:mental)(Tag:meta)Lets you disable a target's ability by touching them. Duration scales with power difference, minimum 3 seconds. 5-minute cooldown.

name: Flawed Return
description: #(Tag:time)Lets you rewind time up to 5 minutes with a 10-minute cooldown. Your body rewinds too, so injuries and exhaustion carry over.

name: Save & Load
description: #(Tag:time)Gives you 12 manual save files you can save and load at any time. No quicksaves or autosaves.

name: Xavier
description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:mental)Makes you an extremely powerful telepath able to communicate tens of kilometers away and mold human minds like clay.

name: We Are Network
description: #(Tag:mental)Lets you borrow processing power from objects by touch, slowing them while massively speeding yourself up. Overuse can cause brain damage to both parties.

name: Gallant
description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:mental)Lets you sense emotions and fire projectiles that deal no damage but temporarily alter the target's emotions, such as euphoria or depression.

name: Emotion Sense
description: #(Tag:sense)Lets you sense people's emotions, with training discerning their causes and finer details.

name: Heartbreaker
description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:mental)Lets you manipulate emotions of people within 50 meters, subtly tweaking or overwhelming them with anything from adoration to suicidal urges. Effectiveness scales with power difference.

name: Piloting
description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:mental)(Tag:spirit)Lets you pilot people's bodies by eye contact, suppressing their minds or with their permission. Your body falls unconscious while piloting; stronger will or power can resist. Training can let you pilot multiple people.

name: Snap Out of It!
description: #(Tag:mental)(Tag:recovery)Lets you clear negative mental conditions like fear, panic, or mind control with a firm slap. Effectiveness scales with your physical stats.

name: Force of Will
description: #(Tag:mental)While active, makes you immune to status effects like fear, panic, sadness, and despair, leaving you highly motivated and determined.

name: Frenzy
description: #Makes you immune to negative mental effects while blood-drunk, trading most inhibitions for a large instinct boost.

name: Trance
description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:mental)Lets you snap your fingers to entrance anyone focused on you, letting you subtly influence them until harm snaps them out. Fails on the strongly strong-willed or stronger than you.

name: Suggestion
description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:mental)Lets you plant mental suggestions that targets mistake for their own ideas, steering or conditioning them.

name: Hypnosis
description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:mental)Lets you hypnotize off-guard targets to subtly or directly influence them. Higher willpower resists more strongly.

name: King of the Castle
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:summon)Lets you transmute the ground into a castle shaped by your mental state, plus soldiers and beasts made from it. You can reshape it at will, including weaponry like cannons or guns. Constructs deactivate if you leave the castle.

name: Memory Reading
description: #(Tag:divination)(Tag:mental)Lets you read the memories of an unresisting target by placing your palm on their forehead. Stronger resistance makes reading harder.

name: Graviton Tyrant
