name: Conjure Rock
description: #(Tag:earth)Allows you to manifest rock constructs from energy without controlling them beyond creation and shaping, such as rock weapons, boulders, walls, and blocks.

name: Wallmaster
description: #(Tag:alter)You can make a wall from anything in your arsenal or any touched object or ground, from stone and ice to wind, sunlight, and raw energy. Size and durability scale with energy. Walls.

name: Swordmaster
description: #(Tag:martial)You can make a sword from anything in your arsenal, held objects, or touched unoccupied material, from fire and ice to light, wind, energy, and swords. Power and duration scale with energy. Swords.

name: Knighting
description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:martial)(Tag:meta)(Tag:summon)You can convert one of your abilities into an armament bestowed on a willing recipient, with weapon powers based on that ability. Knights cannot refuse your orders, lose status permanently if reclaimed, must know the burden, and can be teleported to you every 24 hours.

name: Burden of Servitude
description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:meta)"Servitude at a price" Allows you to collar a target in exchange for a portion of your abilities or traits. Collared targets cannot disobey and can be summoned anytime. Stronger targets demand more granted abilities, grants are permanently lost even if killed, and too-strong targets are immune.

name: Greed's Deal
description: #(Tag:command)"Everything and everyone has a price." You can buy anything from anyone if you pay enough, from items to devotion or murder. Price depends on relative power and willingness; weak souls go for a dollar, strong ones may need epic items. Payment in gold or valuables burns out of existence.

name: Reaper's Voice
description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:mental)"Deal with their baser instincts, not their logic" You can command through fear, with greater fear and intimidation granting greater command, even for children, kingdoms, or lives. Obeyed commands cannot be opposed after, as the fear returns when resisted.

name: Subtitles
description: #(Tag:divination)Who needs dub? You get subtitles for relevant attended sounds, transcribing speech in any language with tone like "Good for you to finally join us (Sarcastically)" and effects like [Assassin's Footsteps] or [Fireball Chant].

name: Tinker - Robotics (I)
description: #(Tag:summon)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build Robotics technology, at this level only simple and mostly mundane robots like autonomous claw arms or butter-robots.

name: Tinker - Robotics (II)
description: #(Tag:summon)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build Robotics technology like simple average-man-capable robots, gun-bots, up to B-1 Droids or B-2s with training.

name: Tinker - Robotics (III)
description: #(Tag:summon)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build complex capable robots like combat, maid, or worker bots, up to Sentry Bots, Executor Droids, or GLaDOS with mind and resources.

name: Tinker - Robotics (IV)
description: #(Tag:summon)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build powerful useful robots like army-wasting giants, moving castles, and dust-sized repair bots. Go build your Metal Gears.

name: Tinker - Robotics (V)
description: #(Tag:summon)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Allows you to build nearly any autonomous mechanical unit, from Metal Gear armies and ninja clans to human-like 100x-strong biorobots and nuke-proof superintelligent machines. Integrated other-branch Tinker tech is significantly boosted.

name: Kudoku
description: #(Tag:growth)(Tag:meta)(Tag:poison)Kudoku lets you expel very weak poison via pores, nails, or mouth. While active-slotted, surviving ingested or inflicted poisons raises Kudoku's potency proportionally with more imbueable effects, from mild paralytic to godslaying venom. Starting rating is Trash, and it grants poison resistance scaling with potency when slotted.

name: Cursebed
description: #(Tag:curse)(Tag:growth)(Tag:magic)Your soul assimilates curses afflicted on you over time, then lets you replicate and use them by expending energy. Stronger curses take longer to assimilate and strong enough ones can ignore the effect. (Does not affect Gacha Curses).

name: Hive Lord
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:insectoid)(Tag:poison)(Tag:transformation)You can transform to take on and mix-match traits of any Earth insect. Manifest features like a scorpion's tail and venom, dragonfly wings, cockroach resilience, and more.

name: Hell Flame
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:infernal)Conjure and shape infernal flames used by demons. They are especially strong against living beings, burning vitality with flesh while weakening them and hindering healing via their unholy attribute. Rather energy-intensive unless you are an Infernal.

name: Greater Hell Flame
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:infernal)Conjure and shape potent infernal flames used by high-ranking demons. Very hot and effective against living beings, they stick like glue and curse what they burn to hinder healing. Rather energy-intensive unless you are an Infernal.

name: Holy Light
description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:light)Conjure and shape Holy Light used by Angels as balls of light, energy blasts, or blades of light. It sets Infernal, Unholy, or Necrotic targets alight with holy flames, but deals significantly less damage otherwise. (A/N: Holy Light is NOT light speed despite the name).

name: Greater Holy Light
description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:light)Conjure and shape searing Holy Light used by high-ranking Angels, or call it down from the sky. It sets Infernal, Unholy, or Necrotic opponents alight on contact, burns away same-attribute attacks and curses, and spares anything you do not wish to hurt. Significantly reduced potency otherwise. (A/N: Holy Light is NOT light speed despite the name).

name: Star of Change
description: #(Tag:transformation)Temporarily change your race to any Race Change trait in the gacha ranked Rare or below while active. You can only transform into one race at a time.

name: Argonaut
description: #(Tag:enhancer)Charge any attack to temporarily bypass your maximum energy output; longer charge yields more power. 10x power costs 10x energy. You can charge only one action at a time, and interruption wastes the energy without unleashing the effect.

name: Tinker - Vehicles (III)
description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)This tinker ability lets you design and build technology related to vehicles, including impossible supernatural ones. Examples include a sound-speed ship that does not shake, an air-riding motorcycle via hard light, a sports car 10x better armored than a tank with a year of fuel efficiency, or a killdozer rivaling the Batmobile.

name: Fumofication
description: #(Tag:transformation)Touch a target to turn them into a fumo immune to all damage, though they still feel everything done to them. Stronger targets can resist, and duration scales with energy expended and power difference. You cannot Fumo someone for 1 hour after they awaken from the effect.

name: Void Shadow
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:sense)(Tag:space)(Tag:summon)Conjure an invulnerable shadow copy of yourself that cannot interact with the world. It moves extremely fast, can disrupt others' vision, and lets you see through its eyes. Lasts 30 minutes at base, one at a time; duration can be increased by training.

name: Void Distortion
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:dark)Pull on the Void Dimension to cause spatial disruptions in the material world. It inflicts massive devastation and damage in exchange for incredibly taxing energy expenditure.

name: Choices & Choices
description: #(Tag:divination)When you need to make a choice, activate to view up to 3 relevant choices and their vague outcomes. For example, [We shouldn't go +reputation with X --Reputation with Y, Z Dies].

name: Tinker - Resources
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) This Tinker speciality lets you design, modify, and build technology related to acquiring materials.

name: Fate Draw
description: #(Tag:meta)Roll a random number out of 22 to invoke the effect of that Major Arcana Tarot Card. Cooldown: 120 Hours.

name: Inanimate Interrogation
description: #(Tag:divination)"Interrogate" inanimate objects for information, such as asking a wall who entered in 24 hours, a weapon how to use it, or a building how to infiltrate it. Objects must tell the truth based only on what they have seen, heard, or know about themselves. Forcing more recall costs more energy.

name: Hustle
description: #(Tag:recovery)Yomi Hustle - "It may be your only move" lets you "Hustle" by performing a gesture lasting at least half a second, like snapping fingers with a taunt or lounging mid-fight. On completion you regain energy and stamina, more the longer and more stylish and aggravating the hustle. Can only be used in active combat against an enemy meaning you genuine harm.

name: Restraint Levels
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:meta)Place "Restraint Levels" on willing or unable-to-resist targets, including yourself. They can seal abilities and forms or block certain power levels. They can only be lifted by you or a designated target speaking the unlock phrase.

name: Marionette Grasp
description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:sense)Take control of a target's physical body in your line of sight, moving them against their will. Stronger targets cost more energy to control and maintain. You can share senses, control additional targets at greater mental and energy cost, or narrow control to parts like fingers to save energy.

name: Edict
description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:mental)Impose rules by touching targets and expending energy; targets feel incredible mental compulsion to follow them, like forbidding milk, forcing travel at set times, or banning clothes in a room. Stronger targets are harder to affect, and edicts against self-preservation are exponentially harder.

name: Phantom Sensation
description: #(Tag:illusion)(Tag:spirit)(Noncon) Project sensations of actions onto someone in your line of sight without physically affecting them. You can project groping, licking, scratching, choking, burning, stabbing, hanging, etc., provided you could do those things without the ability.

name: Mind Blast
description: #(Tag:mental)Send a wave of shimmering psionic energy through your eyes. On hitting a sentient target it causes mental damage, confusion, and painful headaches. Effectiveness depends on the target's mental and magical power.

name: Geass - Command
description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:mental)Give an absolute command to anyone you make eye contact with; they must obey if physically capable. Usable only once per person, and targets comparable to or stronger than you can resist or ignore it. Does not cost energy to use.

name: Geass - Memory
description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:mental)Rewrite a target's memories through direct eye contact. Greater detail and volume cost more energy and time, scaling with power difference and willpower, and rewritten memories can be broken through. Training improves speed, efficiency, detail, and accuracy.

name: Geass - Suspension
description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:mental)(Tag:time)Suspend the time perception of sentient beings in a dome around you, freezing them in place. Maintaining it greatly drains vitality and energy based on range size, target count, and target power. It affects all targets in range indiscriminately.

name: Conjure Lesser Water Elemental
description: #(Tag:ice)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:summon)(Tag:water)Conjure or summon Lesser Water and Ice Elementals from your energy and command them, such as Nymphs, Water Fairies, etc., or similar beings from other worlds using water-based magic. Limited to Uncommon familiar power or less; power and form scale with your expertise and level. They draw on your energy to persist and act, vanishing if supply stops, but with enough time, energy, and skill you can make them permanent. Elementals are not counted as Familiars by the system.

name: Conjure Water Elemental
description: #(Tag:ice)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:summon)(Tag:water)Conjure or summon Water and Ice Elementals from your energy and command them, such as Nereids, High Water Fairies, Undines, etc., or similar beings using water-based magic. Limited to Rare Familiar power or less; power and form scale with your expertise and level. They draw on your energy to persist and act, vanishing if supply stops, but with enough time, energy, and skill you can make them permanent. Elementals are not counted as Familiars by the system.

name: Conjure Greater Water Elemental
description: #(Tag:ice)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:summon)(Tag:water)Conjure powerful Greater Water and Ice Elementals from your energy and command them, such as Sirens, Oceanids, Noble Water Fairies, Regice, etc., using water-based magic and other abilities. Limited to Elite Familiar power or less; power and form scale with your expertise and level. They draw on your energy to persist and act, vanishing if supply stops, but with enough time, energy, and skill you can make them permanent. Elementals are not counted as Familiars by the system.

name: Conjure Lesser Air Elemental
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:summon)Conjure or summon Lesser Air and Sky Elementals from your energy and command them, such as Wind Sprites, Living Clouds, Wind Elementals, etc., using air and sky-based magic. Limited to Uncommon familiar power or less; power and form scale with your expertise and level. They draw on your energy to persist and act, vanishing if supply stops, but with enough time, energy, and skill you can make them permanent. Elementals are not counted as Familiars by the system.

name: Conjure Air Elemental
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:summon)Conjure or summon Air and Sky Elementals from your energy and command them, such as Storm Elementals, Wind Fairies, Nimbus Clouds, Cloud Elementals, etc., using wind-based magic. Limited to Rare Familiar power or less; power and form scale with your expertise and level. They draw on your energy to persist and act, vanishing if supply stops, but with enough time, energy, and skill you can make them permanent. Elementals are not counted as Familiars by the system.

name: Summon Greater Air Elemental
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:summon)Conjure powerful Greater Air Elementals from your energy and command them, such as Hurricane Elementals, Greater Wind Spirits, Greater Storm Elementals, Thunderbirds, etc., using air-based magic and other abilities. Limited to Elite Familiar power or less; power and form scale with your expertise and level. They draw on your energy to persist and act, vanishing if supply stops, but with enough time, energy, and skill you can make them permanent. Elementals are not counted as Familiars by the system.

name: Summon Lesser Fire Elemental
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:summon)Conjure or summon Lesser Fire Elementals from your energy and command them, such as Fire Spirits, Living Candlelight, Fire Eaters, etc., using fire-based magic. Limited to Uncommon familiar power or less; power and form scale with your expertise and level. They draw on your energy to persist and act, vanishing if supply stops, but with enough time, energy, and skill you can make them permanent. Elementals are not counted as Familiars by the system.

name: Summon Fire Elemental
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:summon)Conjure or summon Fire Elementals from your energy and command them, such as Fire Fairies, Fire Elementals, Fire Atronachs, Efreets, etc., or similar beings using fire-based magic. Limited to Rare Familiar power or less; power and form scale with your expertise and level. They draw on your energy to persist and act, vanishing if supply stops, but with enough time, energy, and skill you can make them permanent. Elementals are not counted as Familiars by the system.

name: Summon Greater Fire Elemental
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:summon)Conjure powerful Greater Fire Elementals from your energy and command them, such as Firebirds, Greater Efreets, Flame Devourers, etc., using fire-based magic and other abilities. Limited to Elite Familiar power or less; power and form scale with your expertise and level. They draw on your energy to persist and act, vanishing if supply stops, but with enough time, energy, and skill you can make them permanent. Elementals are not counted as Familiars by the system.

name: Summon Lesser Demon
description: #(Tag:infernal)(Tag:summon)Summon Lesser Demons from the Underworld to serve and obey you, such as Imps, Capra Demons, Demon Eyes, etc., limited to Uncommon Familiar power or less. They are bound to your will while manifested and need your constant energy to stay summoned and use abilities; slain servants reform in the Underworld and can be resummoned, and you can strengthen them with more magic. You can make them permanent with a sufficient blood sacrifice by tier; for an Uncommon Demon, sacrifice of an Uncommon target. Permanent demons no longer need your energy.

name: Summon Demon
description: #(Tag:infernal)(Tag:summon)Summon Demons from the Underworld to serve and obey you, such as Demons, Succubi/Incubi, Taurus Demons, etc., limited to Rare familiar power or less. They are bound to your will while manifested and need your constant energy to stay summoned and use abilities; slain servants reform in the Underworld and can be resummoned, and you can strengthen them with more magic. You can make them permanent with a sufficient blood sacrifice by tier; for an Elite Demon, sacrifice of an Elite Target. Permanent demons no longer need your energy.

name: Summon Fiend
description: #(Tag:infernal)(Tag:summon)Summon Fiends from the Underworld, a nobler variant of demons, to serve and obey you, such as Fiends, Greater Succubi/Incubi, Oni (Fate), Soul Eaters (Overlord), etc., limited to Elite Familiar power or less. They are bound to your will while manifested and need your constant energy to stay summoned and use abilities; slain servants reform in the Underworld and can be resummoned, and you can strengthen them with more magic. You can make them permanent with a sufficient blood sacrifice by tier; for an Elite Demon, sacrifice of an Elite Target. Permanent demons no longer need your energy.

name: Summon Archfiend
description: #(Tag:infernal)(Tag:summon)Summon Archfiends from the Underworld, a royal variant of demons, to serve and obey you, such as Archfiends, Succubi/Incubi Kings/Queens, Oni Rulers (Fate), Arch Devils (Overlord), Devils (Chainsaw Man), etc., limited to Epic Familiar power or less. They are bound to your will while manifested and need your constant energy to stay summoned and use abilities; slain servants reform in the Underworld and can be resummoned, and you can strengthen them with more magic. You can make them permanent with a sufficient blood sacrifice by tier; for an Epic Demon, sacrifice of an Epic Target. Permanent demons no longer need your energy.

name: The Gates of Hell
description: #(Tag:infernal)(Tag:summon)Summon all but the strongest infernals from the Underworld to serve and obey you, such as True Demons, Devils (Chainsaw Man), Efreet Sultans, Greater Daemons (Warhammer), etc., limited to Legendary Familiar power or less. They are bound to your will while manifested and need your constant energy to stay summoned and use abilities; slain servants reform in the Underworld and can be resummoned, and you can strengthen them with more magic. You can make them permanent with a sufficient blood sacrifice by tier; for a Legendary Demon, sacrifice of a Legendary Target. Permanent demons no longer need your energy.

name: Roentgenium Manipulation
description: #(Tag:neutral)Sense and telekinetically control Roentgenium in a radius around you. Range and power can be increased by training, scaling with your energy reserves.

name: Charon's Bell
description: #(Tag:necro)(Tag:spirit)Ring the Ferryman's bell to call the souls of the dead to you, by default all souls in range, or a specific soul instantly if you hold something relevant like corpse parts or mementos, as long as their soul is in your dimension. Powerful unwilling targets can resist. Called spirits are not commanded but can be interacted with, and you can store 100 souls by default, equal to a grown person, increasing with energy reserves.

name: Call to Arms
description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:summon)(Gacha) Call to Arms rolls the familiar gacha to temporarily grant you a familiar fighting by your side for 1 hour, then it disappears. At 1 Ability Slot you pull Bronze, 2 slots = Silver, 3 slots = Gold, 4 Slots = Platinum, capping at 5 slots = Diamond. 24 Hour cooldown.

name: Summon Angelic Guardian
description: #(Tag:fae)(Tag:holy)(Tag:summon)Temporarily summon a low-ranking Angel or Holy Spirit from the Heavenly Realm, such as Lesser Light Fairy, Angel Guardians, Archangel Flames (Overlord), 2 Winged Angels, etc., limited to Uncommon familiar power or less. Bound to your will, it needs your constant energy to stay and use magic; slain angels restore in the Heavenly Realm and can be resummoned, and more energy lets them exert more power. You can permanently bind one via a long prayer ceremony sacrificing appropriate valuables and energy.

name: Summon Angel
description: #(Tag:fae)(Tag:holy)(Tag:summon)Temporarily summon a lower-ranking Angel or Holy Spirit from the Heavenly Realm, such as Light Fairies, Pixies, Unicorns, Principalities, 4 Winged Angels, etc., limited to Rare familiar power or less. Bound to your will, it needs your constant energy to stay and use magic; slain angels restore in the Heavenly Realm and can be resummoned, and more energy lets them exert more power. You can permanently bind one via a long prayer ceremony sacrificing appropriate valuables and energy.

name: Summon Principality
description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:summon)Temporarily summon a middle-ranked Angel or Holy Spirit from the Heavenly Realm, such as Noble Light Spirits, Principalities, Valkyries, 6 Winged Angels, etc., limited to Elite familiar power or less. Bound to your will, it needs your constant energy to stay and use magic; slain angels restore in the Heavenly Realm and can be resummoned, and more energy lets them exert more power. You can permanently bind one via a long prayer ceremony sacrificing appropriate valuables and energy.

name: Summon Dominion
description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:summon)Temporarily summon a very high-ranked Angel or Holy Spirit from the Heavenly Realm, such as Light Spirit Lords, Dominions, 8 Winged Angels, Archangels (Hota), Valkyrie Chiefs, etc., limited to Epic familiar power or less. Bound to your will, it needs your constant energy to stay and use magic; slain angels restore in the Heavenly Realm and can be resummoned, and more energy lets them exert more power. You can permanently bind one via a long prayer ceremony sacrificing appropriate valuables and energy.

name: Heavenly Gate
description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:summon)Temporarily call forth Heavenly Realm armies, swarms of lower angels or great guardian angels and light spirits, such as Empresses of Light, Thrones, 10 Winged Angels, etc., limited to Legendary familiar power or less. Bound to your will, they need your constant energy to stay and use magic; slain angels restore in the Heavenly Realm and can be resummoned, and more energy lets them exert more power. You can permanently bind one via a long prayer ceremony sacrificing appropriate valuables and energy.

name: Familiar Manifestation
description: #(Tag:summon)Temporarily call upon a limb or body part of a familiar you own to use as an attack. The familiar itself takes no damage.

name: Kill Process
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tech) "The End of Machine" enforces "Kill Process" on any technology eclipsing Mundane Earth, forcing ruin upon it: chips torn apart, processors melted, chassis shredded, code mangled, and non-souls sent to oblivion. Potency scales with divergence from Mundane Earth tech and your power difference to the target, but even a normal person could down a spaceship with a glare. Can only affect technology and tech-based targets.

name: Elemental Sight
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:earth)(Tag:fire)(Tag:sense)(Tag:water)Attune to Elemental Forces and energy: feel air, see heat, hear lightning, taste earth. See all Fire, Water, Air, and Earth in line of sight through everything else, including brain electricity, blood water, and cable electricity. Magically charged elements appear more vibrant.

name: Corpus Weapon
description: #(Tag:buff)(Tag:martial)(Tag:necro)Imbue a held weapon or your limbs with necrotic energy. It amplifies attacks, hinders healing, and directly hurts vitality, dealing extra damage to living targets by exhausting vitality. You can also throw it as a projectile from weapon or fist.

name: Necrotic Weapon
description: #(Tag:buff)(Tag:martial)(Tag:necro)Imbue a held weapon or your limbs with withering necrotic energy. It amplifies attacks; wounds on living beings inflict spreading necrosis and rigor mortis if held long enough, while inanimate targets corrode and decay. You can also throw it as a projectile or temporarily extend the weapon beyond range.

name: Dread Blade
description: #(Tag:buff)(Tag:martial)(Tag:necro)Suffuse weapons or limbs with potent Necrotic and Darkness energies, amplifying destruction based on energy expended. Living wounds are cursed to hinder healing and spread worsening necrosis and weakness per resistance, while inanimate objects corrode, wither, and degrade. You can also fire projectiles like flying slashes or temporarily extend the weapon.

name: Gravelords Blade
description: #(Tag:buff)(Tag:curse)(Tag:martial)(Tag:necro)Channel the Gravelords' Blade into any weapon or your body, suffusing it with Death and Curses. It greatly amplifies destruction per energy expended; living wounds gain Gravelord's Curse, nearly unhealable, spreading death essence for damage over time and weakness, with a chance to instantly kill weaker targets, costing energy to maintain. Inanimate objects corrode and degrade. You can also fire projectiles, extend the weapon, or manifest a pure-energy weapon for extra cost.

name: Ruin Edge
description: #(Tag:buff)(Tag:curse)(Tag:martial)(Tag:necro)Suffuse any armament or your body with cursed ruinous energies. They massively amplify destruction and decay whatever they strike, whether magic, physical defences, space, or nebulous targets. Living wounds gain Ruin Curse, unhealable unless lifted, causing continuous weakening and pain that you can always track, with a chance to instantly kill weaker targets, costing energy to maintain. Inanimate targets are corroded to dust unless toughest. You can also fire projectiles, extend the weapon, or manifest a pure-energy weapon for extra cost.

name: Lesser Animate Undead
description: #(Tag:necro)(Tag:summon)Imbue a corpse with Necrotic energy to reanimate it as a lesser undead under your command, such as skeletons, zombies, wights, etc., at most as strong as an Uncommon familiar. Quality and power depend on corpse quality, corpse strength, and your power; stronger undead cost more energy. The number you can control scales with energy reserves.

name: Animate Undead
description: #(Tag:necro)(Tag:summon)Animate corpses into undead such as Death Knights, Death Warriors, Undead Mages, Lesser Vampires, Wraiths, Bone Wyverns, or an undead version of the corpse, limited to Rare Familiar power or less. Tier depends on corpse quality and your power; stronger undead cost more energy. The number you command scales with energy, minimum 100 at once.

name: Greater Animate Undead
description: #(Tag:necro)(Tag:summon)Animate corpses into undead such as Dread Knights, Liches, Vampires, Wraiths, Soul Eaters, Bone Dragons, or an undead version of the corpse, limited to Elite Familiar power or less. Tier depends on corpse quality and your power; stronger undead cost more energy. The number you command scales with energy, minimum 500 at once.

name: True Necromancy
description: #(Tag:necro)(Tag:summon)Enact true necromancy sanctioned by Death itself to raise corpses into undead such as Gravelords, Night Liches, Vampire Lords, Nightmare Kings, Undead Dragons, Corpse Titans, or an undead version of the corpse, limited to Epic Familiar power or less. Tier depends on corpse quality and your power; stronger undead cost more energy. The number you command scales with energy, minimum 2500 at once.

name: Exalted Necromancy
description: #(Tag:necro)(Tag:summon)Perform Exalted Necromancy beyond merely raising the Dead, raising corpses into undead such as Necro Kaisers, Overlords, Vampire Kings, Undead Dragon Lords, Reapers, etc., or an undead version of the corpse, limited to Legendary Familiar power or less. Tier depends on corpse quality and your power; stronger undead cost more energy. The number you command scales with energy, minimum 10000 at once.

name: Divinity Necromancy
description: #(Tag:necro)(Tag:summon)Wield divinity to use the dead as army and servants; you can turn even an average man's corpse into an Undead Dragon or Gravelord. You can animate any corpse into a True Undead keeping all abilities and memories from life and further empowered by your divinity, as long as it is dead. Power and number scale with your power, with up to 100000 controllable even as a base human.

name: Authority of Death
description: #(Tag:life)(Tag:necro)(Tag:summon)Wield the Authority of Death, the End. Merely point to claim lives; claiming lives and resurrecting the dead is easier than breathing. You can even kill unkillable targets by granting the concept of death. Stronger targets cost more energy.

name: Divinity Earth
description: #(Tag:earth)As a god of earth, wave a hand to move continents, snap fingers to call life-wiping meteors, raise an arm to raise mountains, or glare to send civilization-devastating sandstorms. As long as it is Earth and you have enough energy, you can do it.

name: Divinity Sky
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:electric)Possess divinity over the Sky. Bring down kilometer-wide lightning pillars, alter atmospheric composition at will, create city-flinging tornadoes, create a planet's atmosphere, and make adamantite-tough clouds to float on. As long as it is the sky and you have enough energy, you can do it.

name: Tinker - Arcology
description: #(Tag:nature)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Design, build, modify, and construct technology for creating and maintaining Arcologies, self-sufficient megastructures housing people as self-contained cities. Includes construction drones, self-recycling soil, maintenance robots, surveillance, farming, recyclers, and all else needed for function. Such technology only works when creating or inside an Arcology.

name: Summon Lesser nature Spirit
description: #(Tag:nature)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:summon)Summon a lesser nature spirit, requiring sufficient fertile ground nearby, such as Junimo, Lesser Dryads, maneater plants, Ents, etc. Limited to Uncommon familiar power or less; strength depends on your power. It draws on your energy to stay manifested and use abilities, unsummoning if unfueled, but with proper skills, time, and energy you can make it permanent.

name: Summon nature Spirit
description: #(Tag:nature)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:summon)Summon a nature spirit, requiring sufficient fertile ground nearby, such as nature Spirits, Dryads, Giant Animated Plants, Treants, Dendroid Soldiers, etc. Limited to Rare familiar power or less; strength depends on your power. It draws on your energy to stay manifested and use abilities, unsummoning if unfueled, but with proper skills, time, and energy you can make it permanent.

name: Summon Greater nature Spirit
description: #(Tag:nature)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:summon)Summon a greater nature spirit, requiring sufficient fertile ground nearby, such as Noble Dryads, Haunted Trees, Treant Lords, Dendroid Warriors, etc. Limited to Elite familiar power or less; strength depends on your power. It draws on your energy to stay manifested and use abilities, unsummoning if unfueled, but with proper skills, time, and energy you can make it permanent.

name: Mirror World
description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:space)Access a Mirror Dimension at will by turning any sufficiently reflective surface into a portal. Inside there are no living beings, only an empty reflection of the real world, and native objects cannot be removed, hold no energy, and provide no sustenance. You can throw objects and people inside, and entry and exit is only via your mirror portals.

name: Foxfire
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:illusion)Wield Foxfire, the Kitsune signature. Though weaker than same-tier flames, it lasts long and can change shape and texture to create disguises, illusions, and deceptions.

name: Nine-Tailed Foxfire
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:illusion)Wield Nine-Tailed pale blue flames. Though less potent than same-tier flames, they cost less energy to create and maintain. You can freely shape them in form, texture, color, and sound, even convincingly mimicking a person.

name: Sunlight
description: #(Tag:light)(Tag:nature)Conjure a ball of pure sunlight that hovers and moves at will. It perfectly mimics the regular sun and costs little energy to maintain. You can preload spheres with energy to make semi-permanent sunlight they slowly deplete.

name: Bamboo Sprout
description: #(Tag:nature)Sprout supernaturally durable energy-imbued culms anywhere in vision, optionally sharpened. Use them for walls, spikes, or impalement. Created bamboo is permanent but loses supernatural durability over time, returning to normal.

name: Vinelash
description: #(Tag:nature)Create supernaturally strong vines from your body under your control. Durability, strength, and size scale with energy; wield them like extra limbs as whips, grapples, or binds, and sprout thorns for extra energy. They vanish once unfueled.

name: Leaf Blade
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:nature)Conjure a long leaf blade with supernatural durability and great sharpness, though still not very durable. You can also conjure smaller leaves as throwing projectiles. Created leaves are permanent but lose supernatural properties over time.

name: Razor Leaves
description: #(Tag:nature)Conjure and telekinetically control supernaturally durable, sharp leaves. Launch sweeping knife-storms, pin targets, conjure larger weapon-leaves, or make razor whirlwinds. More energy yields sharper, tougher leaves in greater numbers.

name: Stun Spore
description: #(Tag:nature)(Tag:poison)Conjure pale-green spore clouds that paralyze and immobilize when breathed in. Stronger opponents are less affected, ranging from day-long knockout to mild limb stiffness. Uningested clouds dissipate in 5 minutes.

name: Overclock
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:tech)(Tech) Overclock technology with your own energy to push it beyond limits. It performs better but burns durability faster and risks damage. More energy means greater boost and greater potential damage.

name: Tinker - Redundancy
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Give technology you create or modify heavy redundancies, making it frustratingly hard to disable. You can make a fragile phone work flawlessly with shattered screen, exposed wires, water immersion, and half-melted chassis.

name: Vanish
description: #(Tag:stealth)Temporarily vanish utterly from reality, erasing your existence so nothing can track, hit, affect, or predict you. While vanished you rest bodiless in white nothingness, able only to think until you end it and reappear in place. It consumes energy and ends automatically when depleted.

name: Thermal Vision
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:ice)(Tag:ocular)(Tag:sense)Switch your vision to perfectly accurate thermal vision, seeing heat signatures without impairing regular vision.

name: Varied Vision
description: #(Tag:ocular)(Tag:sense)Switch between Thermal, Infrared, and Night vision at will without impairing regular vision.

name: Bubbling
description: #(Tag:neutral)Encase targets in bubbles about as durable as 1cm of glass, scaling with power, that slowly float or hover midair and pop when damaged. You can encase yourself and slowly steer the float.

name: Lube Dispensation
description: #Dispense body-safe water-based lube from your body. Make your body slick at will, release it from any point like a dispenser, or shoot it like a low-power hose.

name: Rough Knuckle
description: #(Tag:enhancer)Slightly augment fists with energy, letting an average man shatter bricks. More energy means greater augmentation, but it is inefficient.

name: Light Waltz
description: #(Tag:movement)Cover body parts in a light-like aura reducing pressure on surfaces to almost nothing, letting you walk on cobwebs or water. It does not reduce damage taken; falls still hurt you but not where you land.

name: Camera Mark
description: #(Tag:divination)(Tag:sense)Place glowing red runes on stable surfaces acting as cameras you can view mentally anytime. The count depends on maximum energy, minimum 5.

name: Project Image
description: #(Tag:illusion)Conjure stationary 2D planes showing images or video you accurately remember or imagine. They are as durable as 1cm of untempered glass.

name: Truth Assertion
description: #(Tag:command)Make others believe the truth of your words, but while active you cannot speak or communicate with intent to deceive. A glowing white choker appears around your neck while active.

name: Sweat
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:water)Sweat on command, either stopping sweating or sweating at supernatural levels to cool down.

name: Black Trial
description: #(Tag:divination)(Tag:movement)(Tag:sense)Wield the Black Trial hunting sinned blackened souls. See souls by color: whiter is purer, blacker is more sinful. After observing a Black Soul you can mark it, track it anywhere, and teleport to it anytime.

name: Smoke Conduit Physiology
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:fire)(Tag:recovery)(Tag:transformation)Wield Smoke Conduit powers with a mild physical boost. Absorb, generate, manipulate, emit, and briefly become Smoke, and absorb smoke to augment regeneration. Conduit abilities use absorbed element, not your energy. You start with basics and must train for complex techniques.

name: Neon Conduit Physiology
description: #(Tag:light)(Tag:movement)(Tag:recovery)(Tag:transformation)(Tech) Wield Neon Conduit powers with a mild physical boost. Absorb, generate, manipulate, emit, and briefly become Neon, greatly augmenting speed, and absorb Neon Light to augment regeneration. Conduit abilities use absorbed element, not your energy. Note: You do not move at or near light speed. You start with basics and must train for complex techniques.

name: Oil/Napalm Conduit Physiology
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:fire)(Tag:recovery)(Tag:transformation)Wield Oil/Napalm Conduit powers with a mild physical boost. Absorb, generate, manipulate, emit, and briefly become Napalm/Oil to fire blasts, douse foes, or restrain them, and absorb it to augment regeneration. Conduit abilities use absorbed element, not your energy. You start with basics and must train for complex techniques. (Lowered rating due to scarcity of element).

name: Ice Conduit Physiology
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:ice)(Tag:recovery)(Tag:transformation)Wield Ice Conduit powers with a mild physical boost. Absorb, generate, manipulate, and emit Ice, briefly become Icy Vapor, and use cryokinesis for vapor blasts, icicles, erupting ice constructs, and more, absorbing Ice to augment regeneration. Conduit abilities use absorbed element, not your energy. You start with basics and must train for complex techniques.

name: Concrete Conduit Physiology
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:recovery)(Tag:transformation)Wield Concrete Conduit powers with a mild physical boost. Absorb, generate, manipulate, emit, and encase yourself in concrete armor boosting physicals or fire concrete spikes, absorbing Concrete to augment regeneration. Conduit abilities use absorbed element, not your energy. You start with basics and must train for complex techniques. (In the absence of concrete, Sedimentary rocks can be used as a substitute).

name: Lightning Conduit Physiology
description: #(Tag:electric)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:recovery)(Tag:transformation)Wield Lightning Conduit powers with a mild physical boost. Absorb and manipulate Electricity and Magnetism to launch lightning bolts, EMPs, polarity fields, electromagnetic walls, etc., absorbing electricity to augment regeneration and with intensive training overdrive others' regeneration via bioelectricity. Conduit abilities use absorbed element, not your energy. You start with basics and must train for complex techniques. Note: No, you cannot time-travel or travel at lightning speed.

name: Video Conduit Physiology
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:light)(Tag:recovery)(Tag:summon)(Tag:transformation)(Tech) Wield Video Conduit powers with a mild physical boost. Absorb artificial light from video displays to fuel Hard Light Constructs like weapons, armor, and temporary minions, angels, and demons, and with practice bend light for invisibility, absorbing Video to augment regeneration. Conduit abilities use absorbed element, not your energy. You start with basics and must train for complex techniques. Note: You can't pull people into Video worlds.

name: Fight Mode
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:martial)Fill your body with adrenaline, norepinephrine, cortisol, endorphins, testosterone, and dopamine to enter an enhanced fight mode. Get your head in the game without suffering overdose consequences.

name: Induce Lactation
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:nsfw)(Nsfw)(Noncon) Induce lactation on targets in your line of sight, provided they are biologically capable.

name: Anchor Back
description: #(Tag:movement)Place a mark where you stand; while active you can teleport back to it. Greater distance costs more energy. Only one mark at a time.

name: Adventure Line
description: #(Tag:divination)Manifest a yellow ground line leading to an adventure if followed. By adventure, an interesting reachable event, good or dangerous, like an undiscovered eatery or a lethal murderer on spree. Whatever you meet is guaranteed interesting.

name: Hormone Regulation
description: #(Tag:bio)Control your body's hormones, secreting more, lowering levels, or shifting concentrations for effects like forced concentration or depression. Exercise caution to avoid harming your body or biochemistry.

name: Tanuki's Leaves
description: #(Tag:illusion)(Tag:transformation)Wield Tanuki Yokai leaves, conjuring leaves that shapeshift into any desired object with altered size and texture. Durability and longevity scale with supplied energy, reverting when depleted. You can also leaf-disguise people while you keep supplying energy.

name: Tonguelash
description: #(Tag:bio)Reinforce and elongate your tongue from several to dozens of meters. Use it as a whip, extra limb, or the other obvious uses.

name: Meal
description: #(Tag:alter)Enhance food you cook to be more nutritious, amplifying existing ingredient properties. Taste improves proportionally to cooking quality.

name: Mental Out
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:command)(Tag:water)Mental Out controls human and human-adjacent minds with incredible precision, controlling, altering personalities, or subtly manipulating them, but marks the target's eye. It works via hyper-specialized ultra-micro hydrokinesis, requiring extensive study to adapt to non-human biology. Effectiveness scales with power difference.

name: Rebake
description: #(Tag:alter)Expend energy to recreate any food you cooked with your own hands as an exact permanent replica. Cost depends on complexity, ingredient expense, and volume. Cannot create food with supernatural effects.

name: Rasengan
description: #(Tag:neutral)Weave energy into a multi-rotating sphere inflicting incredible damage on hit. It needs time and concentration to build properly. With training you can enlarge it, throw it, or combine it with elemental abilities for variants.

name: Thought Acceleration
description: #(Tag:mental)Concentrate to accelerate brain processing to think faster in less time. With practice and combat skill it can be used in combat. Overuse has negative consequences.

name: Eros Hide
description: #(Tag:nsfw)(Tag:stealth)(Nsfw) Erect an aura around yourself and your partner making actions inside not perceived as sexual or indecent. You could have sex in public and no one would bat an eye.

name: Caladrious Form
description: #(Tag:avian)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:movement)(Tag:recovery)(Tag:transformation)Turn into or hybridize the Caladrious, white bird of healing. You gain slightly enhanced physicals, can see sickness, and absorb ailments by touching diseased or cursed targets. You gain great curse and illness resistance, purging them by bathing in sunlight at a rate scaling with reserves. Unholy and dark abilities are blocked, while holy and recovery are enhanced.

name: Envenom
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:poison)Imbibe poison to boost performance, greatly increasing physicals, awareness, alertness, and pain resistance. It damages your body with poison.

name: Sightline
description: #(Tag:divination)When activated, create red lines connecting to everyone who can visually sense you, highlighting them through lines.

name: Soul Arrow
description: #(Tag:spirit)Draw energy from life and soul to shape a simple curving arrow projectile. Its power scales with soul might plus energy levels.

name: Great Soul Arrow
description: #(Tag:spirit)Shape life and soul energy into a refined, potent Soul Arrow that curves mid-flight toward targets. Its power scales with soul might plus energy levels.

name: Soul Spear
description: #(Tag:spirit)Condense refined soul energy into a powerful piercing spear that curves mid-air to home in and pierce defenses. Its power scales with soul might plus energy levels.

name: Crystal Soul Spear
description: #(Tag:spirit)Condense refined soul energy further empowered by crystallization into a crystalline spear that curves mid-air with incredible piercing power. Its power scales with soul might plus energy levels.

name: Bulk Up
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:enhancer)Bulk up to reinforce all muscles to superhuman strength, letting even a base human tear apart and throw cars. Overuse causes extreme soreness and muscle tears.

name: Creation
description: #(Tag:neutral)Create objects and matter with magical energy if you remember exactly how to make them, from phones to gold bars to magical swords. Higher mass and more magical objects cost more energy.

name: Inner Gate
description: #(Tag:space)You hold an inner gate converting energy into elemental mana for varied elemental magic depending on aptitude.

name: Highlight
description: #(Tag:divination)Mark a target by touch with a Highlight, giving them a colored outline you can see within eyesight range. Visible even if vision-impaired or blocked by obstacles.

name: Bequeath
description: #Grant others percentages of your own base physical stats, like 10% Strength or 20% Agility. Granted amounts are permanently lost but retrainable; only unaltered base stats work.

name: Rescale
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:meta)Reallocate your physical stats as percentage shares, defaulting to 500.0% split 100.0% each among Vitality, Strength, Toughness, Agility, and stamina. While active, freely redistribute as long as you keep enough to survive, e.g. 10.0% Agility and 190.0% Toughness.

name: Liaison
description: #Select Liaisons up to your number of ability slots; they can wield all your currently slotted abilities through you using your energy. Requires Liaison slotted to stay active.

name: Absolute Terror Field
description: #(Tag:spirit)Harness your own AT Field, an invisible soul barrier centered on you visible only on sufficient impact. Reshape it with mastery; power scales with energy reserves and soul strength.

name: Challenge
description: #(Tag:command)"Come at me!" Designate targets in line of sight to feel an immense, hard-to-resist urge to maim or kill you. Targets must be in your sensory range and vice versa.

name: Dying Will Flame
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:meta)Automatically gain a Sky Dying Will Flame matching your temperament.

name: Sky Flames
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:fire)(Tag:meta)Dying Will Flames of Harmonization that also let you temporarily fuse with another ability to create a greater flame-based ability.

name: Storm Flames
description: #(Tag:fire)Dying Will Flames of Disintegration that tear apart targets violently instead of burning.

name: Rain Flames
description: #(Tag:debuff)(Tag:fire)(Tag:water)Dying Will Flames of Tranquility; these water-like flames weaken whatever they touch, reducing effect intensity.

name: Sun Flames
description: #(Tag:buff)(Tag:fire)(Tag:light)Dying Will Flames of Activation; these light-like flames boost whatever they affect, healing, ability output, or physical performance. Use can tax the affected target.

name: Lightning Flames
description: #(Tag:electric)(Tag:fire)Dying Will Flames of Hardening that solidify and harden objects, e.g. turning air into walls, forming lightning barriers, or wielding lightning as sharp blades.

name: Mist Flames
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:illusion)(Tag:stealth)Dying Will Flames of Construction that alter looks, texture, smell, etc. to fool the five senses and can condense enough to pass as real objects, but with comparatively weak firepower.

name: Cloud Flames
description: #(Tag:buff)(Tag:fire)(Tag:summon)Dying Will Flames of Propagation that increase, replicate, and duplicate targets, e.g. copying a sword, boosting muscle mass, or making mirror images; stronger effects cost more energy. Excellent for large-scale effects despite weak firepower.

name: Drillmaker
description: #(Tag:neutral)Make, not break. Create energy drills you telekinetically control as projectiles or wielded weapons. Strength and rotation scale with energy expended.

name: Bloody Loan
description: #(Tag:life)(Tag:recovery)"Future for the Present." Freely recover energy, but when you stop siphoning you suffer damage proportional to energy gained, from mild cuts to nigh-unhealable wounds to death.

name: Bloody Savings
description: #(Tag:life)(Tag:meta)(Tag:recovery)"Present for the Future." Expend health and energy to store at a 5 to 1 ratio, reclaimable anytime while this stays in the active slot.

name: Barbs
description: #(Tag:martial)While active, strikes and blunt attacks cost more energy but act as if covered in razor/barbed wire, leaving lacerations proportional to attack power.

name: Equal Blood
description: #(Tag:blood)(Tag:enhancer)"This will hurt both of us." Increases damage targets take from your attacks, but you take a portion of the damage you inflict.

name: Trial
description: #(Tag:divination)See people in grayscale by your sense of morality; the more immoral by your morals, the darker they appear.

name: Inversion
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:ice)(Tag:meta)Invert the effect of any slotted Ability, e.g. Pyrokinesis to Cryokinesis or Curse to Bless, but double its energy cost.

name: Lesser Curse
description: #(Tag:curse)(Tag:magic)Place a curse by touch lowering one chosen physical attribute, Strength, Resilience, stamina, Vitality, or Agility. Potency and duration scale with your strength advantage and energy spent; only one curse per target.

name: Curse
description: #(Tag:curse)(Tag:magic)Apply one of three curses by touch: Weakness lowers Strength, Resilience, and stamina; Ruination hinders Energy and Vitality regeneration; Obsufication weakens all five senses. Potency and duration scale with your strength advantage and energy spent; only one curse per target.

name: Watcher's Curse
description: #(Tag:curse)(Tag:magic)Apply the Watcher's Curse, placing a floating ethereal eye over the target that transmits its location and sight to you. Can also anchor abilities and spells cast through it.

name: Root
description: #(Tag:nature)(Tag:recovery)Grow ethereal roots into the ground, rooting you in place to drain energy and nutrients and accelerate vitality and energy regeneration.

name: Kamikaze
description: #(Tag:life)Expend your own Vitality to detonate a powerful violent explosion from your body. More Vitality means a stronger blast; minimum cost must considerably hurt you.

name: Tower Down
description: #(Tag:mental)"Fractured Language" Temporarily bring down the Tower of Babel, making all communication impossible in 1km, written, spoken, or gestured remain incomprehensible. Range grows with strength; energy cost scales with people affected.

name: Physical Trauma Response
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:enhancer)Flesh hardens against physical trauma: sudden impacts/strikes above a threshold compact muscles, fat, skin, and all layers at the impact point into brief armor without impeding movement.

name: Tinker - Mech (I)
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Design, modify, and build Mech tech and large piloted armors. At this level, create basic mechs like construction exosuits or clunky mechs with standard armor and machine guns.

name: Tinker - Mech (II)
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Design, modify, and build Mech tech and large piloted armors. At this level, create proper combat-ready mechs, sleek agile briefly-flying types, armored low-mobility types, or easily-repaired modular ones. Can also design mech-only weaponry/modules based on your other abilities and traits.

name: Tinker - Mech (III)
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Design, modify, and build Mech tech and large piloted armors. At this level, create powerful versatile mechs rivaling Knightmares, e.g. large mechs enduring missile barrages with street-demolishing cannons and guns. Can also design mech-only weaponry/modules based on your other abilities and traits.

name: Tinker - Mech (IV)
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Design, modify, and build Mech tech and large piloted armors. With enough resources and time, create skyscraper-sized esoteric energy-harnessing forcefield-protected Mecha with dozens of modules that withstand nuclear warfare and annihilate city blocks and cities with cannons.

name: Tinker - Mech (V)
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Design, modify, and build Mech tech and large piloted armors. With resources, knowledge, and time, create your dream Mecha to shame Gundams, antimatter-powered Hadron cannons, planet-sized spacefaring mechs with Death Star cannons. Can also design mech-only weaponry/modules based on your other abilities and traits.

name: Tinker - Hydro
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tag:water)(Tech) Design, modify, and build Water-based tech, from dehydration guns, sprinklers, hydro cannons, and efficient irrigation up to 100-meter-radius water-ripping bombs and water-fueled engines, depending on skills, experience, and materials.

name: Tinker - Aero
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Design, modify, and build Air/atmosphere tech, from blow dryers, efficient turbines, wind bombs, flying machines, and blimps up to weather devices, tornado grenades, and vacuum bombs, depending on skills, experience, and materials.

name: Tinker - Henshin
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tag:transformation)(Tech) Design, modify, and build transformation tech, e.g. armor-donning belts, car-to-jet transformers, combining jets forming a mech, lion-pen, anti-transformation bands, and stylish mandatory themed armors harnessing exotic materials, depending on skills, experience, and materials.

name: Tinker - Ultrakill
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:life)(Tag:summon)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tinker)(Tech) Design, modify, and build Ultrakill tech, specializing in robots from hyper-mobile units to mobile artillery to skyscraper-sized ones with overwhelming weapons and defenses. Built tech must be fueled primarily by Blood.

name: Pyronite Form
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:fire)(Tag:transformation)Temporarily transform into a Pyronite or hybrid at will, gaining boosted physical stats, durability, and energy-scaling natural pyrokinesis. Greatly boosts Fire Affinities but disables Ice/Water abilities.

name: Ectonurite Form
description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:stealth)(Tag:transformation)Temporarily transform into an Ectonurite or hybrid at will, manipulating body protoplasm to fly and turn incorporeal. While incorporeal can possess weaker-willed living beings, but deathly weak to sunlight and electricity.

name: Vulpimancer Form
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:sense)(Tag:transformation)Temporarily transform into a Vulpimancer or hybrid at will, a large brutish canine with greater physicality, keen smell, and echolocation. Vulnerable to high-pitched noise, flames, and bestial instincts.

name: Necrofriggan Form
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:ice)(Tag:movement)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:transformation)(Tag:undead)Temporarily transform into a Necrofriggan or hybrid at will, a winged cryokinetic moth-like alien with superhuman physique and flight. Freeze on touch, exhale freezing wind, phase intangible while freezing, and resist extreme temperatures.

name: Petrosapien Form
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:transformation)Temporarily transform into a Petrosapien or hybrid at will, a living crystalline silicon alien with enhanced strength and extreme durability. Grow body crystals as weapons or from the ground, and with experience telekinetically control them for energy.

name: Volann Form
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:transformation)(Tag:water)Temporarily transform into a Piscciss Volann or hybrid at will, a large shark/anglerfish humanoid with superhuman physicality and steel-tearing claws and jaws. Traverse water and breathe in it freely, but vulnerable to dehydration.

name: Vaxasaurian Form
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:transformation)Temporarily transform into a Vaxasaurian or hybrid at will, a giant dinosaur-like alien with massively enhanced strength, durability, and frame. Expend energy to grow several times larger.

name: Aerophibian Form
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:movement)(Tag:transformation)Temporarily transform into an Aerophibian or hybrid at will, a mantaray-like alien with slightly superhuman stats, extreme-speed flight, and Neuroshock blasts from eyes and tail. Highly resistant to fire, heat, and electricity; can traverse water and space freely.(Cannot Enter Hyperspace).

name: Orishan Form
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:transformation)(Tag:water)Temporarily transform into an Orishan or hybrid at will, a hydrokinetic crustacean alien with increased strength and durable exoskeleton. Use energy-scaling Hydrokinesis and blast/drain high-pressure water from hands.

name: Amperi Form
description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:electric)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:transformation)(Tag:water)Temporarily transform into an Amperi or hybrid at will, a ghost-like amphibious electrokinetic jellyfish with stretchable tentacles and free air/water float. Wield Electrokinesis to generate, absorb, and redirect electricity; can phase intangible while still shocking, or become pure electricity to travel conductors or possess technology.

name: Florauna Form
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:nature)(Tag:recovery)(Tag:transformation)Temporarily transform into a Florauna or hybrid at will, a sentient plant alien with malleable exotic-plant body. Wield Chlorokinesis to control and fuse with plants, regenerate, and grow plants from your body, but extremely vulnerable to extreme temperatures.

name: Fusrodah
description: #(Tag:kinetic)(Tag:sound)"Force, Balance, Push" Convert your voice into a concussive kinetic Shout that unbalances or launches targets. Power scales with energy levels.

name: Comprehensive Recovery
description: #(Tag:passive)(Tag:recovery)While Recovery stays slotted, every 24 hours slotted you are fully cured of all injuries, afflictions, curses, illnesses, and other health issues below Divine Rank. Removing it resets the timer.

name: Hoard
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:space)Access spatial storage for non-living objects like an inventory. While active, value stored (as gold coins) boosts physical stats, e.g. a thousand coins adds a grown person's strength.

name: Guard
description: #(Tag:alter)Mark a target as your Guard ward; damage they would take transfers to you proportionally, their 10% damage becomes your 10% damage.

name: Greater Guard
description: #(Tag:alter)Mark any number of targets as wards; damage meant for them transfers to you as if you took the hit, their decapitation could be your nick and vice versa. Maintaining marks costs energy.

name: Rampart
description: #(Tag:enhancer)"Infallible Fortress" Massively boost all resistances and defenses while your feet stay within 10cm of activation point; even a human could face-tank a missile. Interruption triggers 10-second cooldown.

name: Slow Lane
description: #(Tag:debuff)(Tag:time)Conjure shapeable, sizeable force fields usable as projectiles that stop and settle on hit. Movement inside is slowed proportionally to target strength and energy spent. Maintenance costs energy.

name: Mystic Eyes of Slowness
description: #(Tag:debuff)(Tag:ocular)(Tag:time)These mystic eyes slow targets in your field of vision. Slow degree scales with energy spent and target strength relative to you.

name: Mystic Eyes of Transfusion
description: #(Tag:life)(Tag:ocular)(Tag:recovery)These mystic eyes manipulate Vitality of targets in view, drain vitality to heal yourself, give your own to heal them, or transfer between two others. Amount scales with energy spent and relative strength; willing targets cost less.

name: Ram
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:movement)The longer you travel in a straight line, the faster and stronger you become. While active you move only in straight lines, with control worsening over distance.

name: God Driver
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:movement)As long as you keep moving straight, you grow stronger, faster, and tougher until a spear that can pierce gods. You move only in straight lines, losing control the longer you go.

name: Providence
description: #(Tag:buff)(Tag:holy)(Tag:light)"Cloak yourself in the Light of the Heavenly God". While active, a light aura massively amplifies all Resistances and Defenses, further amplified against Dark, Infernal, and Curse effects.

name: Sing
description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:mental)(Tag:sound)Imbue voice with emotion and intent to resonate with listeners. Amplified when singing, further when singing skillfully.

name: Siren's Song
description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:mental)(Tag:sound)Imbue your voice with siren power to sleep or entrance susceptible hearers into trance. Amplified by skillful singing; strong wills resist better.

name: Greater Natural Weapons
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:martial)Transform your body into natural weaponry without self-harm, plated gauntlet hands with bone knives, whip tongue with sharp tip, reinforced shark-like jaws, etc.

name: Diction
description: #(Tag:blood)(Tag:meta)(Tag:sound)Infuse your voice with your abilities, applying their effect to hearers as if touched, Fireball Diction burns listeners, Hemokinesis Diction disrupts bloodflow. Both abilities must be slotted.

name: Chargeback
description: #(Tag:alter)Convert blood into temporary gold coins that, when struck by a fast enough projectile, redirect it to the nearest enemy's weakspot. Attacks far beyond your level can break the coins.

name: Parry
description: #(Tag:kinetic)Parry by striking an attack at the perfect moment to invert its force. Parryable attack types scale with user capability.

name: Deep Dredge
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:summon)(Tag:water)Summon deep abominations, tentacles, maws, spikes, from any nearby sufficiently large water body to maul enemies. Power scales with energy spent.

name: Abyssal Dredge
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:eldritch)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:summon)(Tag:water)Invoke Abyssal Ones to conjure tentacles, maws, spikes, and temporary deep minions from any nearby water body for energy. Their wounds injure mind and body.

name: Ravage of Ryleh
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:eldritch)(Tag:summon)(Tag:water)Invoke Ryleh's wrath, using any sufficiently large water body as a gateway to summon tentacles, maws, monstrosities, spikes, madness waves, and Deep Kingdom familiars per energy spent.

name: Acid Rain
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:poison)(Tag:water)Summon black clouds raining harsh acid that burns flesh, tarnishes metals, and amplifies Poison abilities in range. Range and potency scale with energy spent.

name: Caustic Storm
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:poison)(Tag:water)Summon a storm of flesh-and-metal-melting caustic rain and harsh winds. Potency and range scale with energy spent, from a single-cloud shower to eroding multiple city blocks.

name: World Melter
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:poison)(Tag:water)Summon a ravaging acidic storm of flesh-stripping acid and life-ruining radioactive winds that pollute land. Inside its radius, all regeneration and healing are disabled.

name: Acid Cloak
description: #(Tag:poison)(Tag:water)Cloak your body in corrosive acidic energy that dissolves and burns on contact. Corrosion scales with energy spent.

name: Solver Slime Form
description: #(Tag:amorphous)(Tag:poison)(Tag:transformation)(Tag:water)Freely turn your body into hyper-acidic corrosive slime that melts on contact while letting you morph freely. Potency scales with energy spent.

name: Acid
description: #(Tag:poison)(Tag:water)Expel and control body acid harming organic and inorganic materials. Quantity and potency depend on energy spent.

name: Greater Acid
description: #(Tag:poison)(Tag:water)Expel and control powerful body acid harming organic and inorganic materials; wounds are harder to heal. Quantity and potency depend on energy spent.

name: Melter
description: #(Tag:poison)(Tag:water)Release and telekinetically control powerful body acid melting organic and inorganic materials; wounds are harder to heal. Quantity and potency depend on energy spent.

name: Dissolver
description: #(Tag:poison)(Tag:water)Release and telekinetically control incredibly potent body acid with incredible melting plus energy-eroding properties that disrupt spells and abilities. Quantity and potency depend on energy spent.

name: Grand Dissolution
description: #(Tag:poison)(Tag:water)Expel and telekinetically control Grand Dissolution, an impossibly potent acid melting anything given enough energy, flesh, stone, magic, even space. Quantity and potency depend on energy spent.

name: Sympathetic Link
description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:mental)Share emotions both ways with someone by contact, feeling their pain/happiness, making them feel yours. Stronger targets cost more energy to link.

name: Conflagration Emotion
description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:mental)Share and spread your emotions over an area, courage to allies, hatred/anger at foes, fear/pain into armies. Energy cost scales with target strength, range, and target count.

name: House of Memories
description: #(Tag:mental)Impart your memories to others, from simple information to traumatic experiences, ego-shattering foreign memory influx, or looping injury memories. Stronger, resilient targets and more memories cost more energy.

name: Arid Hell
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:fire)Conjure superheated sand from your body and telekinetically shape it into walls, weapons, or melting waves. Quantity and heat scale with energy spent.

name: Ride on Time
description: #(Tag:summon)(Tag:tech)Conjure temporary familiar vehicles with working functions, from cars and balloons to planes and attack helicopters. Larger, more complex vehicles cost more to create and maintain.

name: Force
description: #(Tag:kinetic)Conjure and emit blasts of raw kinetic force. Power and scale with energy spent.

name: Astral Walk
description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:spirit)Freely project your soul from your body, leaving it comatose while you wander and still use abilities normally. Maintaining ghost form costs energy, more when using abilities.

name: Grave Buster
description: #(Tag:necro)Burst skeletal limbs and projections from ground near you, grabbing hands, skewering ribs, defending femurs. Size, quantity, and quality scale with energy spent.

name: Parthenogenesis
description: #"Originally named Babymaker" Create 'Eggs' from your familiars with much energy and time; incubated eggs hatch as their Familiar's child with weaker versions of its abilities that strengthen with growth.

name: Morbing
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:dark)(Tag:life)(Tag:necro)(Tag:transformation)(Tag:vampiric)Functionally the same as [Vampire Physique (Rare)], but you must shout "I'm beginning to Morb!" or "It's Morbing time!" to use it.

name: Flame Bone of the Starving
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:necro)(Tag:summon)Expend energy to summon flaming giant-skeleton parts, e.g. ribs for defense, hands as gauntlets, underground impalers, and even detonatable parts.

name: Ganta Gun
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:life)A Branch of Sin expending vitality to condense blood into a fired bullet projectile; more vitality and blood means stronger bullets.

name: Crow Claw
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:life)The Crow Claw is a Branch of Sin expending vitality to condense blood into sickle-like blades on your body. Power depends on vitality and blood used.

name: Whip Wing
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:life)The Whip Wing is a Branch of Sin expending vitality to condense blood into body-emerging whips controlled like limbs. Power scales with vitality and blood used.

name: Blood Fist
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:life)The Blood Fist is a Branch of Sin expending vitality to condense blood into solid armoring layers that protect and empower strikes. Power scales with vitality and blood used.

name: Condor Candle
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:fire)(Tag:life)Condor Candle is a Branch of Sin expending vitality to remotely combust your blood into fire. Fire and combustion power scale with vitality.

name: Owl's Eyeball
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:life)Owl's Eyeball is a Branch of Sin expending vitality to form blood orbs you telekinetically control and detonate. Power scales with vitality and blood used.

name: Voljang Form
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:fire)(Tag:transformation)Transform into and maintain a Voljang or hybrid for energy: a towering fire-breathing gorilla with immense strength and volatile temper. Gain enhanced physicality, instincts, rage, fire breath, and body flames; surrendering to rage unlocks a stronger Berserk form.

name: Shogun Ceanatour
description: #(Tag:water)Transform into and maintain a Shogun Ceanatour or hybrid for energy: a massive bladed crustacean beast. Gain tough exoskeleton, large bladed arm-limbs, and underwater breathing/movement, but vulnerable when dry.

name: Lunagaron Form
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:ice)(Tag:transformation)Transform into and maintain a Lunagaron or hybrid for energy: an agile werewolf-like Fanged Beast expelling supercooled mist and icing its body. Gain enhanced physicality, senses, and agility, plus energy-fueled freezing breath and cold armoring ice.

name: Velkhana Form
description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:ice)(Tag:transformation)Transform into and maintain a Velkhana or hybrid for energy: a powerful ice Elder Dragon with enhanced physicality, scaly defense, and flight. Breathe flash-freezing supercooled mist, manifest icebergs, and coat yourself in icy armor. Fire abilities unusable, cryokinetics stronger.

name: Nergigante Form
description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:recovery)(Tag:transformation)Transform into and maintain a Nergigante or hybrid for energy: a brute-force Elder Dragon with massively enhanced physicality, dulled pain, boosted Enhancer and Recovery potency, flight, weaponizable body spikes, and limb-regrowing basic regeneration.(No asexual reproduction included).

name: Amatsu Form
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:electric)(Tag:transformation)(Tag:water)Transform into and maintain an Amatsu or hybrid for energy: the Calamity of the Skies Elder Dragon. Gain considerable physicality, free flight, and weather control to unleash wind, lightning, water, and ice.

name: Fatalis Form
description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:fire)(Tag:recovery)(Tag:transformation)Transform into and maintain a Fatalis or hybrid at will: the apex Elder Dragon predator. Gain massively enhanced stats, dragon-element wielding, searing flame breaths (plus Fire and Thunder Dragon Element if strong enough), and enhanced recovery and resilience to survive most lethal wounds.

name: Ignis Boost
description: #(Tag:buff)(Tag:fire)(Tag:meta)While slotted, augment potency and efficiency of all Fire/Heat Based Abilities.

name: Hydro Boost
description: #(Tag:buff)(Tag:ice)(Tag:meta)(Tag:water)While slotted, augment potency and efficiency of all Water/Ice Based Abilities.

name: Aero Boost
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:buff)(Tag:meta)While slotted, augment potency and efficiency of all Air/Wind Based Abilities.

name: Terra Boost
description: #(Tag:buff)(Tag:earth)(Tag:meta)While slotted, augment potency and efficiency of all Earth/Metal Based Abilities.

name: Ten Shadows
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:summon)Ten Shadows lets you summon 10 engraved Shikigami, each requiring a defeating ritual first to bind it. If a Shikigami (or any familiar) dies, transfer its power to a surviving Ten Shadows Shikigami. With skill, distort shikigami forms and wield their powers via limited manifestation.

name: Dash
description: #(Tag:movement)Perform a momentary burst dash in any direction in a 360 angle around you.(Cannot dash above or below.).

name: Focused Strikes
description: #(Tag:alter)Mark a line-of-sight target as your Target; while active you cannot harm anyone but that target, your attacks on others simply fail.

name: Familiar Arms
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:summon)Temporarily convert familiars into wieldable armaments inheriting their abilities, e.g. Taurus Demon into Axe or dragon into Spear. Broken weapons wound but do not kill the familiar.

name: Drifting Mines
description: #(Tag:fire)Expend energy to unleash drifting mines, floating explosive energy balls you can detonate anytime. Power scales with energy spent.

name: Weapon Mode
description: #(Tag:transformation)Turn yourself into a disposition-suited Weapon Form wieldable by others to share your abilities. Freedom is greatly restricted and damage taken reflects onto your real form.

name: Perfect Interface
description: #(Tag:mental)(Tag:tech)(Tech) Manipulate any machine interface as if wired to your nerves and brain via physical contact.

name: Adamantine Sealing Chains
description: #(Tag:debuff)(Tag:earth)(Tag:spirit)Manifest and control Uzumaki Adamantine Sealing Chains as incredibly durable chains that suppress and seal bound targets' energy. Suppression scales with energy spent and your power advantage; chain power and count scale with energy used.

name: Sight +1
description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:ocular)(Tag:sense)(Tree)(Meta:sight:1) You can view locked nodes one extra connection away from unlocked nodes.

name: Sight +2
description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:ocular)(Tag:sense)(Tree)(Meta:sight:2) You can view locked nodes two extra connections away from unlocked nodes. Overrides Sight +1.

name: Far Sight
description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:ocular)(Tag:sense)(Tree)(Meta:see-far) You can view locked nodes within a set distance of unlocked nodes, even if unconnected to them.

name: Trace Name
description: #(Tag:meta)(Tree)(Meta:trace-name) You can trace a route to the closest locked nodes whose name contains a chosen word or phrase.

name: Trace Description
description: #(Tag:meta)(Tree)(Meta:trace-desc) You can trace a route to the closest locked nodes whose description contains a chosen word or phrase.

name: Glimpse
description: #(Tag:meta)(Tree)(Meta:reveal-temp) Single use. Reveal the full tree for 10 seconds.

name: Omnisight
description: #(Tag:meta)(Tree)(Meta:reveal-full) Permanently reveal the entire tree.

name: Echo
description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:sound)(Tree)(Meta:echo) Single use. The next ticket you are awarded pays double points.

name: Survey
description: #(Tag:meta)(Tree)(Meta:survey:1) You can see the names of locked nodes one extra connection away from unlocked nodes.

name: Source Compass
description: #(Tag:meta)(Tree)(Meta:compass) You can trace a route to the closest locked node of any chosen source.

name: Sight: Ability
description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:ocular)(Tag:sense)(Tree)(Meta:sight-cat:ability:1) You can view ability nodes one extra connection away from unlocked nodes.

name: Sight: Item
description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:ocular)(Tag:sense)(Tree)(Meta:sight-cat:item:1) You can view item nodes one extra connection away from unlocked nodes.

name: Sight: Skill
description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:ocular)(Tag:sense)(Tree)(Meta:sight-cat:skill:1) You can view skill nodes one extra connection away from unlocked nodes.

name: Sight: Trait
description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:ocular)(Tag:sense)(Tree)(Meta:sight-cat:trait:1) You can view trait nodes one extra connection away from unlocked nodes.

name: Sight: Familiar
description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:ocular)(Tag:sense)(Tag:summon)(Tree)(Meta:sight-cat:familiar:1) You can view familiar nodes one extra connection away from unlocked nodes.

name: Telekinetic Launch
description: #(Tag:kinesis)Rip loose concrete, furniture, and machinery from the environment and hurl it as telekinetic artillery; charged throws stagger even the Hiss.

name: Seize
description: #(Tag:mental)Weaken an enemy then seize their mind outright, turning them into a temporary ally that fights and dies for you.

name: Debris Shield
description: #Tear rubble from the surroundings into a rotating barrier that eats gunfire, then launch the whole shield back at whoever shot you.

name: Evade
description: #(Tag:movement)A short telekinetic dash that phases through incoming fire; upgraded chains link multiple dashes together.

name: Levitate
description: #(Tag:movement)Rise and drift on telekinetic lift while raining debris from above; full upgrades allow true flight and meteor ground slams.

name: Icarus Landing System
description: #Fall from any height wrapped in an electromagnetic glare shield that disperses on impact, landing unharmed every time.

name: Smart Vision
description: #(Tag:ocular)(Tag:sense)See living targets and machines through walls, with threats, cameras, and robots highlighted and assessed.

name: Glass-Shield Cloaking
description: #(Tag:stealth)Bend light around yourself to turn nearly invisible while moving slowly; it drinks energy fast so keep moving with purpose.

name: Titan Shield
description: #Project hardened dermal armor that shrugs off bullets and explosions while active, at a heavy energy cost.

name: Remote Hacking
description: #Breach cameras, turrets, robots, and door panels from a distance without ever touching a terminal.

name: CASIE
description: #(Tag:mental)Read micro-expressions and pheromones to profile anyone mid-conversation, then nudge them toward the answer you wanted.

name: Psycast Skip
description: #(Tag:teleport)Teleport yourself or a nearby pawn a short distance, blinking through walls and out of danger at the cost of neural heat.

name: Psycast Farskip
description: #(Tag:teleport)Open a skipgate that relocates your whole caravan across the world map, or dumps an enemy raid somewhere far away.

name: Psycast Berserk Pulse
description: #(Tag:enhancer)Drive every humanlike in an area into a murderous berserk rage, friend and foe alike. Do not stand in the pulse.

name: Psycast Invisibility
description: #(Tag:stealth)Vanish from enemy perception entirely and walk through a raid unseen; attacking breaks the effect.

name: Word of Serenity
description: #Speak with irresistible calm that ends mental breaks on the spot and steadies volatile colonists.

name: Time Walk
