description: #(Tag:card)(Tag:infernal)Tarot Card - Summons infernal chains that restrain and weaken a target, though strong enough targets can break free. 48 hour cooldown.

name: XVI - The Tower
description: #(Tag:card)Tarot Card - Releases uncontrollable ruinous energy that can destroy entire city blocks, partially ignores durability, and disorients enemies. 120 hour cooldown.

name: XVII - The Star
description: #(Tag:card)(Tag:energy-recovery)(Tag:meta)Tarot Card - Restores all energy and stamina and resets all Ability Cooldowns. 240 hour cooldown.

name: XVIII - The Moon
description: #(Tag:card)(Tag:illusion)Tarot Card - Constructs a convincing illusionary world of your choosing that fools all 5 senses for 1 hour. 120 hour cooldown.

name: XIX - The Sun
description: #(Tag:card)(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:meta)Tarot Card - Instantly recovers all health and resets all Item Cooldowns. 240 hour cooldown.

name: XX - Judgement
description: #(Tag:card)(Tag:mental)Tarot Card - Compels someone to tell what they believe is the truth without intending to trick you. 120 hour cooldown.

name: XXI - The World
description: #(Tag:card)(Tag:meta)Tarot Card - Permanently fuses two abilities of the same rank into an ability of higher rank. 240 hour cooldown.

name: Volcano
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:fire)(Tag:weapon)A flame sword forged from hell-depth ore. Amplifies Fire-based abilities when used as a focus.

name: Starlight
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:light)(Tag:light+)(Tag:weapon)A light rapier forged from the Empress of Light's wing. Deals light damage and amplifies Light-based abilities when used as a focus.

name: Ghastly Glaive
description: #(Tag:polearm)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:spirit+)(Tag:weapon)A foreign-world glaive that summons wraith projections using the wielder's life energy. Amplifies Soul-based abilities when used as a focus.

name: North Pole
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:ice)(Tag:ice+)(Tag:polearm)(Tag:weapon)A crystalline spear forged from the shattered Ice Queen's remains. Lets the wielder fire frigid blasts with their own energy and amplifies Ice-based abilities when used as a focus.

name: Daybreak
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:fire+)(Tag:light+)(Tag:polearm)(Tag:weapon)A pure-energy spear from fallen-star shards. Lets the user hurl copy projections like javelins and amplifies Fire and Light-based abilities when used as a focus.

name: Sunfury
description: #(Tag:bludgeon)(Tag:fire)(Tag:flexible)(Tag:weapon)A flame flail from the underworld's depths. Creates an explosion on every impact.

name: Blue Moon
description: #(Tag:bludgeon)(Tag:flexible)(Tag:weapon)A flail from the cursed dungeon made of incredibly durable material, with a chain stretching up to 50 meters.

name: Ice Blade
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:ice)(Tag:ice+)(Tag:weapon)A magically enchanted solid-ice saber that holds its sharpness. Releases frigid energy with your own energy and boosts ice abilities when used as a focus.

name: Space Dolphin Machine Gun
description: #(Tag:gun)(Tag:machine)(Tag:space)(Tag:tech)(Tag:weapon)(Tech) A space dolphin crafted into a futuristic machine gun that shreds any mundane material. Its fire rate makes ammo consumption hard to keep up with.

name: Onyx Blaster
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:gun)(Tag:tech)(Tag:weapon)A shotgun crafted from pure-darkness shards. Converts energy/mana into dark onyx bullets dealing unholy damage instead of consuming bullets.

name: Death's Sickle
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:necro)A sickle from the Reaper's cold dead hands. Releases necrotic projections with your own energy and boosts Dark and Necrotic abilities when used as a focus.

name: Inferno Fork
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:fire+)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:infernal+)(Tag:polearm)(Tag:weapon)A crimson trident from the cursed dungeon's depths. Fires flame blasts with your energy/mana and boosts Fire and Unholy abilities when used as a focus.

name: Last Prism
description: #(Tag:catalyst)(Tag:light)(Tag:light+)(Tag:magic+)A moon prism. Infusing energy/mana releases incinerating light rays converging into one large laser, or greatly boosts light-based abilities when used as a focus.

name: Holy Water
description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:water)A large glass vial of 500ml high-quality holy water for rituals or dealing with the unholy. Restock Timer: 4 hours.

name: Golden Cross
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:holy)A golden cross blessed by a powerful angel. Worn around the neck, it wards off evil and curses and burns nearby demonic entities.

name: Super Absorbent Sponge
description: #A sponge holding approximately 1,000,000,000 liters of water without changing size or weight.

name: Heavy Blade
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:weapon)A very durable longsword with controllable weight from 5 kg to 50,000 kg.

name: Metal Gear Excelsus
description: #(Tag:machine)(Tag:tech)(Tag:vehicle)(Tag:weapon)(Tech) A gigantic multi-city-block-sized arachnid mech with retractable blades, giant plasma cannons, and uncanny mobility and dexterity. Built to withstand advanced nuclear weaponry, constantly repaired by nanomachines, with living quarters.

name: The Straw Hat
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:mundane)Holds great sentimental value to a certain sun god, but little material value.

name: Modified Compound V
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:elixir)(Tag:meta)Drinking it grants a random Gold Gacha ability usable even in ability storage.

name: Sharingan Jar
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:resource)A pair of freshly unlocked Sharingan from Sasuke Uchiha, stored in preservative fluid. Can be implanted by a skilled enough doctor.

name: Byakugan Jar
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:resource)A pair of freshly unlocked Byakugan from Neji Hyuga, stored in preservative fluid. Can be implanted by a skilled enough doctor.

name: Iron Man Armor Mark III
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:tech)(Tag:weapon)(Tech) Iron Man's iconic armored suit. Useful but not particularly powerful, and very hard to repair if broken.

name: Infinity Gauntlet
description: #(Tag:armor)The gauntlet itself, very durable, but stones not included.

name: Greed's Coin
description: #(Tag:meta)(Gacha) "Fancy your chances?" Choose an inventory ticket and flip a coin. Heads gives the ticket an advantage; Tails destroys it.

name: Durable Baseball Bat
description: #(Tag:bludgeon)(Tag:weapon)An extremely durable baseball bat that takes at least a nuclear bomb to deform.

name: Combat Armor
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:growing)A tailored basic Combat Armor set. Place 10 kilograms of any ore inside, and after 24 hours the armor's composition changes to that ore or metal.

name: Kamui Senketsu
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:bound)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:life)(Tag:transformation)Sentient clothing made exclusively of liber that synchronizes with its wearer, extremely augmenting physical abilities while draining vitality. More durable than any artificial material, it can act independently and shapeshift into various forms.

name: Goku Uniform 1star
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:bio)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:life)A school uniform of 10% Life Fibers granting superhuman strength to break walls and flip cars. Extremely durable beyond carbon fiber. Choose colors before taking it out.

name: Goku Uniform 2star
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:bio)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:life)A uniform of 20% Life Fibers granting superhuman strength to punch through solid metal and throw cars. Extremely durable beyond carbon fiber. Choose colors and design before taking it out.

name: Goku Uniform 3star
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:bio)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:life)(Tag:transformation)A uniform of 30% Life Fibers granting superhuman strength to demolish buildings. Extremely durable beyond carbon fiber; choose colors and design before taking it out. Consuming your vitality unlocks a second form that further increases its abilities.

name: Your Laptop
description: #(Tag:mundane)(Tech) Your laptop or computer from back on Earth, still connected to your Earth internet.

name: Infinite Bowl of Spaghetti
description: #(Tag:production)An infinite spaghetti bowl that cannot be poured out, but servings can be taken infinitely. The spaghetti is always comfortably warm and tastes pretty good.

name: Kaneda's Bike
description: #(Tag:vehicle)(Tech) A very fancy, fast, iconic sci-fi-ish bike.

name: Any Vehicle Voucher
description: #(Tag:ticket)(Tag:vehicle)(Tech) Exchangeable anytime for any Mundane Vehicle in your world, from supercar to cruise ship. The vehicle teleports in front of you with all legal work handled.

name: Refined Heart-Shaped Herb
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:elixir)(Tag:enhancer)A Wakandan herb blessed by Bast, refined to remove side effects and mystical strings for safe consumption. Grants enhanced strength, speed, stamina, durability, reflexes, agility, and instincts. Restock Timer: 240 hours.

name: Senzu Bean
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:energy-recovery)(Tag:health-recovery)A mystical bean cultivated by Earth's guardian. Eating it instantly restores physical condition to peak, fully restores energy, and satiates for 10 days. Restock Timer: 720 hours.

name: Unknown Mask
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:divination-resistance+)(Tag:stealth)A white featureless full-face mask removable only at the wearer's will or by breaking it. Opaque and resistant to thinker abilities, yet the wearer sees through it without issue.

name: Monster Cell
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:transformation)A hand-sized virus-like cell. Eating it makes you unbelievably stronger and transforms you into a monstrous creature with extended lifespan, at the cost of never developing further by natural means.

name: Ability Ticket
description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:ticket)(Gacha) A ticket acting as a 6x Advantage Platinum Ability Gacha Ticket.

name: Trait Ticket
description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:ticket)(Gacha) A ticket acting as a 6x Advantage Platinum Trait Gacha Ticket.

name: Skill Ticket
description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:ticket)(Gacha) A ticket acting as a 6x Advantage Platinum Skill Gacha Ticket.

name: Uroboros Virus
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:consumable)(Tag:transformation)A powerful transforming virus. Mismatched hosts become an anomalous mass of blackened matter with incredible regeneration; matched hosts gain enhanced stats and bio-immortality with commandable viral healing. Or pour the vial into the ocean and watch the apocalypse.

name: Tvirus
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:consumable)(Tag:transformation)A highly viral super-virus mutating victims into enhanced zombie-like creatures with little brain activity. Rare compatible hosts gain only superhuman capabilities and regeneration without mutation, and a scientist might refine it. Or pour the vial into the ocean and watch the apocalypse.

name: Modified Tvirus
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:consumable)(Tag:elixir)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:health-regeneration+)(Tag:meta)A modified T-Virus syringe granting all T-virus benefits with none of the downsides: superhuman physical abilities, regeneration, and telekinesis.

name: The Beherit
description: #(Tag:infernal)(Tag:summon)A red face-like egg that can call down the God Hand. Sacrificing your everything in the Eclipse lets you join the Godhand as an Apostle. ...If you're considering using this, something is truly wrong with you.

name: Chekhov's Box
description: #(Tag:storage)A wrapped-gift box that gives precisely the item you need for the situation, as long as it is Rare rank or below. Vanishes once used.

name: Cloak of Levitation
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:movement)A Sorcerer Supreme relic allowing free flight. Self-aware, it can pull its wearer from danger and hinder opponents on its own.

name: Plague Canister
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:poison)(Tag:tech)(Tech) A canister of the Plague, a self-replicating nanomachine virus devouring biomass and turning living things into mindless biomechanically enhanced zombies for its hivemind. Releasing it without sufficient biokinetic or techno mastery dooms the world, though without a core they lack a hivemind command center.

name: Mehrunes Razor
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:dagger)(Tag:space)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:time)(Tag:weapon)Mehrunes Dagon's dagger. Capable of cutting anything the user can interact with, space, time, soul, connections, etc. The only limit is the user, not the dagger.

name: Skeleton Key
description: #(Tag:tool)Magical key of Nocturnal that can unlock anything the user perceives, from locks and walls to inner potential and portals to other worlds. Its only limit is the user, not the key.

name: Cloak of Elvenkind
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:stealth)A hooded elven cloak woven from shadow that renders the wearer invisible while the hood is raised and resistant to divination and scrying. Nearly undetectable while motionless.

name: Annihilation Maker
description: #(Tag:bound)(Tag:dark)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:summon)(Tag:weapon)One of the strongest Longinus crafted by God that creates shadow monsters from the user's shadow by expending mana, with abilities based on the user's imagination and abilities. When removed from inventory, it is a small marble that fuses with whoever swallows it.

name: Unknown Dictator
description: #(Tag:bound)(Tag:earth)(Tag:electric)(Tag:tech)(Tag:weapon)Unknown Dictator, one of the modern Longinus, manipulates metal and technology on a massive scale and constructs advanced tech like ion cannons and aura engines at will without detailed input. Stronger users create stronger creations. When removed from inventory, it is a small marble that fuses with whoever swallows it.

name: Zenith Tempest
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:bound)(Tag:electric)(Tag:water)(Tag:weapon)Zenith Tempest, one of the mightiest Longinus, controls weather, atmosphere, and natural elements like fire, wind, lightning, and water to call down lightning, country-wiping storms, and more. A powerful enough user can shred the planet's surface with violent storms. When removed from inventory, it is a small marble that fuses with whoever swallows it.

name: Star Buster Blaster
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:bound)(Tag:gun)(Tag:weapon)A highest-order Longinus built for simplicity whose sword can cut gods and whose gun can annihilate islands even in basic form. It is incredibly difficult to control, and a misfire may destroy the landmass the user stands on. When removed from inventory, it is a small marble that fuses with whoever swallows it.

name: Canis Lycaon
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:bound)(Tag:curse)(Tag:dark)(Tag:fire)(Tag:summon)(Tag:weapon)Canis Lycaon, one of the Longinus created by God, manifests an extremely powerful black wolf avatar wielding a cursed blade and lets the user sprout cursed blades from their body as weapons. With training, the user can wield cursed flames that prevent healing and sprout blades from any shadow in perception range. When removed from inventory, it is a small marble that fuses with whoever swallows it.

name: True Longinus
description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:light)(Tag:polearm)(Tag:weapon)The greatest holy spear, containing a piece of God, bears a tremendous holy aura that can utterly annihilate any demonic being weaker than a god. With training, the user can access its variety of forms.

name: Telos Karma
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:bound)Telos Karma, God's treasure, twists causality and fate to affirm the effect the user wants by altering history. Larger effects and stronger targets consume more energy. When removed from inventory, it is a small marble that fuses with whoever swallows it.

name: Regulus Nemea
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:blade)(Tag:bound)(Tag:summon)(Tag:weapon)Battle Axe of the Nemean, one of the Longinus crafted by God, is a large golden battle axe that protects its wielder from projectiles and can become an independent projection of the original Nemean Lion with invincible skin. With training, the user can unlock its Balance Breaker forms. When removed from inventory, it is a small marble that fuses with whoever swallows it.

name: Nereid Kyre
description: #One of the newly manifested Longinus that controls the ocean and charms dragons through singing, limited by the user's singing and magical power. A powerful enough user can sink continents and tame the grandest dragons. When removed from inventory, it is a small marble that fuses with whoever swallows it.

name: Can of Pain
description: #(Tag:consumable)A simple cola-tasting canned drink that causes immense agony lasting up to several minutes. Restock Timer: 24 hours.

name: Nights Edge
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:dark)(Tag:dark+)(Tag:weapon)A sword of night formed from the world's essences with exceptional durability and sharpness that enhances all darkness abilities when used as a focus. Under certain conditions, it can unlock true power comparable to Excalibur itself.

name: Moonveil
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:magic)(Tag:magic+)(Tag:weapon)A glintstone masterpiece katana that projects the user's slashes as blue blades of light and amplifies spells when used as a focus.

name: Malikeths Black Blade
description: #(Tag:anti-divine)(Tag:anti-immortal)(Tag:blade)(Tag:divine)(Tag:necro)(Tag:weapon)A sword carrying traces of Destined Death that unleashes black flames by expending energy/mana to permanently harm lifeforce. Wounds it inflicts cannot be healed by anything less than divine intervention.

name: Beginners Guide to Runecraft
description: #(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:magic)(Tome) A beginner's guide to basic Nordic/Scandinavian runecraft written personally by Allfather Odin. Studying it teaches the art of Runecraft.

name: Grow Your Own Golem Kit
description: #(Tag:construct)(Tag:production)(Tag:summon)A beginner-friendly golem-growing kit even a child can use, containing a person-sized pot, watering can, pack of cores, and notebook. Place a core, desired golem materials, and a specification note in the pot, bury it in any dirt in a sunny spot, and water twice morning and night for 7 days before digging up the finished golem. Energy-rich soil speeds the process.

name: Cape of Rebellion
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:health-regeneration+)A blood-red stained cape that proportionally augments the wearer's Physical Abilities and Regeneration for every negative status effect borne while wearing it, such as burning, poison, curse, freezing, bleeding, or blindness. (A/N: Gacha curses do not count).

name: Halo of Light
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:dark-resistance+)(Tag:holy+)(Tag:infernal-resistance+)(Tag:light+)An angel's Halo worn like a hat that does not fall off unless removed. While worn, it grants resistance to all ailments, especially Dark and Infernal attacks and effects, greatly boosts Light and Holy abilities, and constantly applies slight healing to the wearer.

name: Devil Horns
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:dark+)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:infernal+)A headband shaped as cartoonish devil horns that substantially boosts all Darkness and Infernal abilities and traits while worn.

name: Blade of Hatred
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:weapon)An old, worn, rusty blade covered in dried blood that is only as strong as it looks unless brandished against a target that has inflicted suffering on the user. Against such targets, it powers up proportionally to all damage they have ever inflicted, reaching legendary strength against a mortal enemy but remaining trash against a first-time opponent.

name: Brass Knuckles
description: #(Tag:fist)(Tag:weapon)A pair of simple but sturdy brass knuckles.

name: Ring of the Paladin
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:holy)(Tag:light)(Tag:water)An enchanted ring of a legendary paladin infused with his prayers that holds 3 charges and recovers 1 charge every hour. Spend a charge to cast a Rare tier Heal, grant one Uncommon tier blessing like strength or agility, or bless an object with holy energy to create holy water or a temporarily blessed weapon effective against the unholy.

name: Earplugs
description: #(Tag:accessory)A pair of simple earplugs that completely blocks the wearer's hearing while worn.

name: Second Face
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:illusion)A simple white mask that makes the wearer appear as a completely different, always identical person, serving as a second identity.

name: Mirror Blade
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:weapon)A sword embodying envy that alone is only as strong as a sharp iron sword. It can temporarily become the strongest weapon within a 1 km radius for 1 hour, then enters a 24 hour cooldown.

name: Amulet of Imitation
description: #(Tag:accessory)An amulet that transforms you into the shape of any creature you touch while holding it until you dispel the transformation. Cooldown: 8 hours.

name: Light Sword
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:light)(Tag:weapon)Not a lightsaber, this sword is crafted purely from solid light and is incredibly light and sharp but somewhat fragile. If broken, leaving it where it receives light gradually repairs it.

name: Private Jet
description: #(Tag:vehicle)A luxury private jet with its own Golem Pilot and Golem Server that requires no fuel. Snacks and amenities inside replenish over time.

name: Charismatic Sunglasses
description: #(Tag:social)(Tag:tool)A pair of really cool-looking sunglasses that make you seem more charismatic.

name: Sword of Judgement
description: #(Tag:anti-infernal)(Tag:anti-undead)(Tag:blade)(Tag:holy)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:weapon)A divinely blessed sword that imbues great might and magical power and boosts holy and light abilities when used as a focus. It also fills the user with righteous rage, driving them berserk against unholy and undead beings unless tamed.

name: The Armageddon Blade
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:fire)(Tag:fire+)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:infernal+)(Tag:strength+)(Tag:weapon)The mythical Blade of Armageddon that imbues great power but burns to touch and boosts fire and unholy abilities when used as a focus. The user can expend energy to call down Armageddon, raining hellfire from the skies onto the mortal world.

name: Sword of Hellfire
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:infernal)A sword forged and bathed in hellfire whose blade can be wreathed in violent flames by expending energy. It boosts fire abilities when used as a focus.

name: Angellic Alliance
description: #(Tag:agility+)(Tag:blade)(Tag:defence+)(Tag:holy)(Tag:magic+)(Tag:strength+)(Tag:weapon)A divine heavenly sword that greatly increases the wielder's physical and magical abilities, strengthens and inspires any army or allies under their command, and boosts holy and light abilities when used as a focus. The user can also expend energy to grant any blessing of Rare tier or below.

name: Titans Thunder
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:electric)(Tag:electric+)(Tag:strength+)(Tag:weapon)A thunder sword granting the power and might of giants, including extreme physical strength and the ability to rain down thunder by expending energy. It enhances lightning-based abilities when used as a focus.

name: Armor of the Dammed
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:curse)(Tag:curse+)(Tag:dark)(Tag:dark+)(Tag:defence+)(Tag:strength+)Pitch-black armor with a demonic visage worn by the most wicked conquerors that augments physical abilities and amplifies darkness-based abilities when used as a focus. With training, it can unleash massive-scale curses like slow, misfortune, and weakness to debilitate entire armies.

name: Power of the Dragon Father
description: #(Tag:draconic)Armor crafted from a mighty dragon's corpse that imbues great physical might and extreme magic resistance through its scales.

name: Spellbinders Hat
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:magic)(Tag:summon)A legendary archwizard's hat containing echoes of his spells that grants Dimensional Door (100 km portal), Fly (fly at land speed), Magic Mirror (reflect magic back), Implosion (severe explosive damage), and Summon Elemental (summon a chosen elemental roughly as strong as you for 30 minutes). This artifact holds 3 charges at a time and recovers 1 charge every 8 hours.

name: Admirals Hat
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:summon)(Tag:vehicle)A legendary admiral's hat that conjures any mundane seabound vessel, from destroyer-class warships to cruise ships, manned by a spirit crew. You can summon a vessel every 720 hours, and wearing the hat grants Master rank Riding on any seabound vessel.

name: Cloak of Silence
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:anti-magic)While worn, this cloak prevents the user from using any magic below Epic rank and prevents any magic below Epic rank from affecting them.

name: Cape of Velocity
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:movement)A cape that makes the wearer faster while worn.

name: Cloak of the Undead King
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:necro)(Tag:necro+)(Tag:spirit+)The legendary undead king's cloak that boosts all necromancy and soul-based abilities and removes the limit on undead controlled at once while worn.

name: Charm of Eclipse
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:anti-magic)A mystical charm emitting an aura that inflicts magical interference on those around the user, reducing their magical capabilities.

name: Wizards Well
description: #(Tag:magic)(Tag:production)(Tag:tool)A large cauldron filled to the brim with magical power equal to the user's maximum. It instantly refills to the brim at 8 am every morning.

name: Orb of Silt
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:earth+)(Tag:necro+)(Tag:tool)An orb of raw ancient magical power that boosts earth-based abilities and magic for its holder.

name: Orb of Firmament
description: #(Tag:air+)(Tag:electric)(Tag:electric+)(Tag:tool)An orb of raw ancient magical power that boosts wind and lightning-based abilities and magic for its holder.

name: Orb of Driving Rain
description: #(Tag:air+)(Tag:electric+)(Tag:tool)An orb of raw ancient magical power that boosts water and ice-based abilities and magic for its holder.

name: Orb of Tempestuous Fire
description: #(Tag:fire)An orb of raw ancient magical power that boosts fire-based abilities and magic for its holder.

name: Tome of Air
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:electric)(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:magic)(Tome) A legendary imbued tome from an ancient kingdom that lets its holder cast its contained spells even without training. Spells can also be learned through study to cast without the book. Spell List: https://heroes.thelazy.net/index.php/School_of_Air_Magic

name: Tome of Earth
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:magic)(Tag:necro)(Tome) A legendary imbued tome from an ancient kingdom that lets its holder cast its contained spells even without training. Spells can also be learned through study to cast without the book. Spell List: https://heroes.thelazy.net/index.php/School_of_Earth_Magic

name: Tome of Water
description: #(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:holy)(Tag:ice)(Tag:magic)(Tag:water)(Tome) A legendary imbued tome from an ancient kingdom that lets its holder cast its contained spells even without training. Spells can also be learned through study to cast without the book. Spell List: https://heroes.thelazy.net/index.php/School_of_Water_Magic

name: Tome of Fire
description: #(Tag:curse)(Tag:fire)(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:magic)(Tome) A legendary imbued tome from an ancient kingdom that lets its holder cast its contained spells even without training. Spells can also be learned through study to cast without the book. Spell List: https://heroes.thelazy.net/index.php/School_of_Fire_Magic

name: Sphere of Permanence
description: #(Tag:magic)(Tag:tool)A magical orb that prevents magic removal on a target, granting immunity to dispelling spells or abilities.

name: Orb of Vulnerability
description: #(Tag:anti-resistance)(Tag:tool)A magical orb that lets its holder bypass immunities and resistances, such as harming living fire or poisoning a hydra.

name: Angel Feather Arrows
description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:tool)A quiver of infinite angel-feather-fletched arrows that retain maximum speed in flight until hitting a target.

name: Vial of Lifeblood
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:elixir)(Tag:health-regeneration+)(Tag:vitality+)A vial of condensed vitality in blood form that grants enhanced vitality, minor healing, and increased lifespan when drunk.

name: Elixir of Life
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:elixir)(Tag:poison-resistance+)(Tag:vitality+)The legendary Elixir of Life that grants boundless vitality, immunity to most poisons and illnesses, and a hundredfold lifespan increase when drunk.

name: Endless Purse of Gold
description: #(Tag:production)(Tag:tool)A purse of endless riches that fills with 500 200-gram pure gold coins every 24 hours and can hold an infinite amount.

name: Horn of the Abyss
description: #(Tag:necro)(Tag:summon)(Tag:tool)An eldritch horn from the abyssal depths that raises the dead as shoggoths, fangarms, or other loyal deep creatures.

name: Archmages Robes
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:magic+)Suspiciously comfortable archmage robes that let you learn magic much quicker and amplify spells you cast.

name: Altar of Fire
description: #(Tag:barracks)(Tag:building)(Tag:fire)(Tag:spirit)An altar of fire that collects natural mana to birth fire spirits loyal to you as its owner.

name: Altar of Air
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:barracks)(Tag:building)(Tag:spirit)An altar that collects natural mana to birth air and lightning spirits loyal to you as its owner.

name: Altar of Water
description: #(Tag:barracks)(Tag:building)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:water)An altar that collects natural mana to birth water and ice spirits loyal to you as its owner.

name: Elemental Conflux
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:barracks)(Tag:building)(Tag:earth)(Tag:fire)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:water)An altar converging natural elements and collecting natural mana to birth spirits of all elements loyal to you as its owner.

name: Pyre
description: #(Tag:barracks)(Tag:building)(Tag:fire)(Tag:life)An ash altar that births firebirds and phoenixes loyal to you as its owner when given enough wealth and energy sacrifices.

name: Dragon's Hoard
description: #(Tag:draconic)- A cave with ideal dragon living conditions and plenty of treasure. Take its gold and gems for yourself or use it as storage for your valuables, which none can enter without your permission.

name: Dragon Utopia
description: #(Tag:draconic)A gigantic castle with ideal living conditions for practically any dragon, housing a horde of various loyal dragons. You can admit other dragons in exchange for servitude.

name: Hydra Pond
description: #(Tag:building)A large, incredibly poisonous swampy pond populated by Hydra loyal to you as its owner.

name: Nymph Waterfall
description: #(Tag:barracks)(Tag:building)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:water)A magical waterfall where lesser water-spirit Nymphs are naturally born and remain loyal to you as its owner.

name: Maelstrom
description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:summon)(Tag:water)A large water whirlpool containing many dangerous seabound creatures, including the sea serpent Haspid, under your command.

name: Magic Forest
description: #(Tag:barracks)(Tag:building)(Tag:holy)(Tag:nature)A large forest with high magical concentration and unique herbs, populated by ents, treants, and even legendary unicorns under your command. It slowly replenishes itself over time.

name: Crystal Cave
description: #(Tag:barracks)(Tag:building)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:earth)A large cavern of unique red crystals holding potent magical power and energy, with crystal dragons under your command. Crystals replenish over time.

name: Frozen Cliffs
description: #(Tag:barracks)(Tag:building)(Tag:draconic)A gigantic frozen mountain range taller than Everest with extreme magical energy, housing many powerful dragons and the legendary azure dragon to serve under your command.

name: Cloud Temple
description: #(Tag:barracks)(Tag:building)(Tag:earth)A gigantic temple over a kilometer tall and several wide that summons absolutely loyal stone Giants and Titans to serve you in exchange for wealth sacrifices like gold and gems. Beware, summoning costs are rather expensive.

name: Experimental Shop
description: #(Tag:barracks)(Tag:building)(Tag:earth)(Tag:production)A giant experimental workshop manned by talented loyal gremlin master artisans who craft items with provided resources. They can also build animated legendary stone giants and various golems to serve you.

name: Portal of Glory
description: #(Tag:barracks)(Tag:building)(Tag:holy)(Tag:teleport)A divine gate that produces angels to serve you over time when given enough energy and resources such as gold.

name: Garden of Revelations
description: #(Tag:building)(Tag:magic)A beautiful flower garden with a mystical aura where studying and learning magic is easier.

name: Fountain of Youth
description: #(Tag:building)(Tag:life)(Tag:time)A large ornate fountain whose waters reverse aging while bathing, rewinding one year of biological age per hour spent inside.

name: Magic Spring
description: #(Tag:building)(Tag:energy-regeneration+)A large spring of rapidly replenishing mana-rich water where bathing very quickly replenishes magical power.

name: Marika's Hammer
description: #(Tag:anti-dark)(Tag:anti-infernal)(Tag:anti-undead)(Tag:bludgeon)(Tag:holy)(Tag:weapon)A partially broken yet supernaturally durable stone hammer that boosts holy abilities and spells.

name: Sacrificial Doll
description: #(Tag:curse)(Tag:tool)A simple straw-and-twine doll vaguely resembling the user that can substitute for any sacrifice, including human, vitality, body part, or soul part, then vanishes. Only usable by the one who rolled it.

name: Relic Gold
description: #(Tag:tool)A gold coin with no real use that all who see it perceive as incredibly valuable. You could trade it for a real artifact and the recipient would still consider it fair.

name: Stack of Gold Bars
description: #(Tag:mundane)A stack of ordinary gold bars totaling 33 kilograms.

name: Greedy Ring
description: #(Tag:accessory)An ornate red-and-gold ring that attracts wealth, making it easier to make money and find treasures.

name: Gold Ring Gift
description: #(Tag:accessory)A gold ring to gift a loved one whose patterns customize themselves to the recipient. Restock Timer: 48 hours.

name: Chlorophyte Bar
description: #(Tag:material)(Tag:nature)A refined Chlorophyte bar from the deep ancient jungles, far more flexible and durable than mundane metal, capable of converting sunlight into energy. Synergizes very well with bio and nature abilities. Restock Timer: 8 hours.

name: Aerolite Bar
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:material)A refined Aerolite bar from the sky islands infused with sky energy that releases wind and can emulate weather under special conditions when infused with energy. Synergizes very well with lightning and air. Restock Timer: 8 hours.

name: Astral Bar
description: #(Tag:material)(Tag:space)A refined, nigh-unbreakable bar from the Astral Infection containing refined cosmic energy that releases cosmic energies when infused with energy. Restock Timer: 8 hours.

name: Broken Biome Blade
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:nature)(Tag:weapon)A broken sword handle that produces a blade with the properties of whatever element it is infused with when given energy.

name: Roxcalibur
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:bludgeon)(Tag:holy)(Tag:restricted)(Tag:weapon)The legendary sword in the stone that you could not pull out; wield it stone and all as a bludgeoning weapon. Meeting all original Excalibur conditions lets you draw it to gain both Excalibur and an unbreakable rock.

name: Sahara Slicers
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:dagger)(Tag:earth)(Tag:weapon)A pair of arid daggers that manifests 10 arid shivs every 30 seconds to launch as a volley at opponents.

name: Unbreakable Blade
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:weapon)A simple sharp steel longsword that is completely unbreakable and undamageable.

name: Bag of Endless Coins
description: #(Tag:resource)(Tag:storage)A bag that produces 1000 gold coins every day.

name: Endless Bag of Ninja Supplies
description: #(Tag:production)(Tag:tool)A satchel-sized bag holding 100 shurikens, 100 kunai, 100 caltrops, 50 explosive tags, and a katana, all high-quality steel. Contents replenish every 24 hours.

name: Portable Supercomputer
description: #(Tag:machine)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tool)(Tech) A laptop with power on par with humanity's strongest supercomputers that stays connected to the native internet regardless of location.

name: Bag of Ore
description: #(Tag:material)(Tag:production)(Tag:tool)A torso-sized duffel bag yielding 33 kilograms of any mundane ore every 24 hours.

name: Portable Pharmacy
description: #(Tag:production)(Tag:tool)A simple satchel yielding any item found in an average pharmacy.

name: Droid Factory
description: #(Tag:barracks)(Tag:building)(Tag:production)(Tag:tech)(Tech) An autonomous factory producing droids under your command when supplied with appropriate materials.

name: Flowing Water Crushing Rock Fist Manual
description: #(Tag:water)Bang's manual with detailed training in Flowing Water Crushing Rock Fist. Those without it cannot replicate the art.

name: Grimoire of Izalith
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:magic)(Tome) A grimoire teaching the Pyromancies of the Great Swamp and Izalith. Spell List: https://darksouls.fandom.com/wiki/Pyromancy_(Dark_Souls)

name: Tome of the Way of the White
description: #(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:holy)(Tag:light)(Tag:magic)(Tome) Rhea of Thorolund's tome teaching all her Way of the White miracles. | Spell List: https://darksouls.fandom.com/wiki/Rhea_of_Thorolund#Wares

name: Tome of Orbeck
description: #(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:magic)(Tome) Orbeck of Vinheim's tome of research and anecdotes teaching all his spells. | Spell List: https://darksouls.fandom.com/wiki/Orbeck_of_Vinheim#Wares

name: Rites of the Dragon Communion
description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:magic)(Tome) Church rites for communing with great dragons to borrow their powers for miracles. Spell List: https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Dragon+Communion+Incantations

name: Rites of the Dragon Cult
description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:magic)(Tome) Dragon Cult rites teaching miracles that imitate the great dragons' power. Spell List: https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Dragon+Cult+Incantations

name: Capsule Case
description: #(Tag:building)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tool)(Tech) A case of 20 Capsule Corp capsules holding a house, fridge, oven, large preserved food stores, boat, high-tech motorcycle, etc. Any slightly upgraded mundane appliance or vehicle counts as a capsule here. Restock Timer: 48 hours.

name: Rites of the Erdtree
description: #(Tome) Rites of the ancient Erdtree worshippers teaching its miracles. Spell List: https://eldenring.wiki.fextralife.com/Erdtree+Incantations

name: Grimoire of Spatial Magic
description: #(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:magic)(Tag:space)(Tome) A book of Clover Kingdom Spatial Magic secrets teaching its contained spells. Spell List: https://blackclover.fandom.com/wiki/Spatial_Magic

name: Grimoire of Lightning Magic
description: #(Tag:electric)(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:magic)(Tome) A book of Clover Kingdom Lightning Magic secrets teaching its contained spells. Spell List: https://blackclover.fandom.com/wiki/Lightning_Magic

name: Grimoire of Water Magic
description: #(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:magic)(Tag:water)(Tome) A book of Clover Kingdom Water Magic secrets teaching its contained spells. Spell List: https://blackclover.fandom.com/wiki/Water_Magic

name: Grimoire of Ice Magic
description: #(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:ice)(Tag:magic)(Tome) A book of Clover Kingdom Ice Magic secrets teaching its contained spells. Spell List: https://blackclover.fandom.com/wiki/Ice_Magic

name: Grimoire of Darkness Magic
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:magic)(Tag:space)(Tome) A book of Clover Kingdom Darkness Magic secrets teaching its contained spells. Spell List: https://blackclover.fandom.com/wiki/Dark_Magic

name: Grimoire of Light Magic
description: #(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:light)(Tag:magic)(Tome) A book of Clover Kingdom Light Magic secrets teaching its contained spells. Spell List: https://blackclover.fandom.com/wiki/Light_Magic

name: Familiar Contract
description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:tool)A contract registering willing, informed signers in your gacha as familiars treatable like any other familiar. It fails if signed without knowing its function.

name: Master Blacksmith Commission
description: #Rip this ticket to visit a master blacksmith's forge and commission any equipment by providing materials, then return and receive the item within 7 days at latest. The blacksmith is not a god, so limits apply. Restock Timer: 360 hours.

name: Giant Ominous Floating Obsidian Sphere
description: #(Tag:building)A gigantic pure obsidian ball, 5 km in radius, always floating 100 meters above ground. It constantly emits a humming pitch audible from over 50 km away. That's all.

name: Beauty Perfume
description: #(Tag:social)(Tag:tool)A bottle of pink perfume amplifying your attractiveness to the opposite gender.

name: Bellowing Dragoncrest Ring
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:magic+)A special everlasting-dragon-engraved ring for only the most accomplished Vinheim Dragon School sorcerers that boosts the wearer's magic strength.

name: Dusk Crown Ring
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:magic+)Princess Dusk of Oolacile's birth-gifted crown-shaped ring that converts a portion of vitality into energy/mana, increasing ability and spell potency.

name: Great Swamp Ring
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:fire+)A ring chiseled from flame-salamander bone by Great Swamp blighted Pyromancers that bolsters its wearer's flames, increasing fire ability and spell potency.

name: Chaos Witch's Ring
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:fire+)The Witch of Izalith and her daughters, scorched by the Flame of Chaos, offered this pyromancy-teaching ring to humans. It greatly bolsters its wearer's flames, increasing fire ability and spell potency.

name: Sage's Ring
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:magic+)A ring from a preacher twin, the Crystal Sages, to Farron's Undead Legion that eases learning and casting while worn, reducing spell energy costs.

name: Sahelanthropus
description: #(Tag:machine)(Tag:tech)(Tag:vehicle)(Tag:weapon)(Tech) A nuclear-armed bipedal tank modified for a human operator, armed with a high-power railgun, guided missile launchers, retractable flexible nanofiber HF blades, and independent sensory drones deploying explosives, flamethrowers, and high-caliber machine guns. Its depleted uranium armor can be enriched by its internal reactor and detonated as a nuclear explosion. Ammo and missiles restock every 24 hours, and it self-repairs via nanomachines.

name: Twilight Healing
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:bound)(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:holy)A Sacred Gear created by God manifesting as ornate rings that convert your energy into neutral healing energy for yourself or others, with potency scaling to energy expended.

name: Gravity Jail
description: #(Tag:holy)A Sacred Gear created by God manifesting as glowing Magical Eyes that expend energy to increase gravity on any location or target in your line of sight. When taken from inventory, it appears as a marble that fuses with whoever swallows it.

name: Boosted Gear
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:bound)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:transformation)One of the Longinus created by God housing Ddraig's soul, the Heavenly Dragon of Domination. This gauntlet amplifies your stats by expending stamina, with higher boosts costing more stamina.

name: Divine Dividing
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:bound)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:transformation)One of the Longinus created by God housing Albion's soul, the Heavenly Dragon of Supremacy. These wings grant flight and divide enemies' magical power to replenish your own reserves, venting excess through the wings.

name: Holy Collider
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:fire)(Tag:fire+)(Tag:holy)(Tag:holy+)(Tag:weapon)A sword carved from the profaned god's corpse that emits divine flame explosions on contact and releases holy flames by expending your energy. Holy and fire abilities are amplified when using it as a focus.

name: Jackal & Casull
description: #(Tag:fire)An unwieldy pair of hand-cannon pistols wielded by a certain vampire: white Casull and black Jackal. Each holds 6 rounds of 13mm blessed silver exploding rounds and requires supernatural strength to wield and fire without tearing your arms off. You receive 2 magazines every 24 hours.

name: Dragon Slayer
description: #(Tag:anti-dragon)(Tag:blade)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:weapon)A massive dull unwieldy sword larger than a man and supernaturally durable. Having bathed in the blood of countless spirits and astral beings, it can harm and kill the immaterial.

name: Wastelanders Survival Kit
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:consumable)(Tag:gun)(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:tool)(Tag:weapon)(Tech) A true courier's loadout containing Elite Riot Gear, a fully modified Anti-Material Sniper Rifle, Riot Shotgun, .44 Magnum revolver, bowie knife, 5 repair kits, 10 stim packs, 5 doctor's bags, and 200 ammo for each weapon.

name: The Courier's Stash
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:consumable)(Tag:gun)(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:tool)(Tag:weapon)(Tech) A large briefcase containing lightweight metal armour, a double-barrel shotgun with 20 packs of 20 shells, 4 basic repair kits, and 5 stim packs.

name: Hei Gui Stealth Suit
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:stealth)(Tag:tech)(Tech) Chinese special-unit armour for infiltration and stealth with dense armour and mesh. It emits a light-bending forcefield that renders the user invisible.

name: Feng Shui Engine
description: #(Tag:agility+)(Tag:defence+)(Tag:implant)(Tag:strength+)An advanced prosthetic eye housing a miniature Tandem Engine that generates extreme artificial Qi to massively enhance all physical abilities. Overuse may cause strain.

name: Enma
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:weapon)A masterpiece sword once wielded by Kozuki Oden with a will of its own that releases the wielder's energy in bursts. Until tamed, it forcefully drains and constantly releases the user's energy.

name: Shusui
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:buff+)(Tag:weapon)A masterpiece sword once wielded by Ryuma, its blade permanently blackened from absorbing his hardening. It is nigh unbreakable, razor-sharp, and an excellent conductor of energy.

name: Pip-Boy 3000
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tool)(Tech) A wrist-worn Personal Information Processor powered by an internal fission battery. It autonomously monitors your health, connects to networks, maps areas, shines light, and more.

name: Power Fist
description: #(Tag:fist)(Tag:tech)(Tag:weapon)(Tech) A pneumatic power fist that boosts punches to superhuman level. It offers little benefit to those already superhuman.

name: Rasaka's Fang
description: #(Tag:anti-recovery)(Tag:blade)(Tag:dagger)(Tag:poison)(Tag:weapon)A dagger carved from Rasaka's venomous fang, perpetually imbued with venom that paralyzes those it cuts and makes their wounds harder to heal.

name: Rasaka's Venom
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:defence+)(Tag:elixir)(Tag:poison)A pouch of refined Rasaka venom; ingesting it fully grants increased physical resistance at the cost of weakened muscles, which poison resistance can negate.

name: Knight Killer
description: #(Tag:anti-armor)(Tag:blade)(Tag:dagger)(Tag:weapon)A large dagger built for heavily armoured opponents, dealing more damage against stronger armour.

name: Baruka's Dagger
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:dagger)(Tag:ice)(Tag:ice+)(Tag:weapon)An extremely durable, sharp large dagger wielded by a frost elf chieftain. It increases the potency of ice and cold abilities using it as a focus.

name: Demon King's Daggers
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:dagger)(Tag:dark+)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:infernal+)(Tag:weapon)A pair of daggers forged from the demon king's corpse that synchronize with your strength, growing stronger proportionally. They increase the potency of unholy abilities using them as a focus.

name: Demon King's Longsword
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:electric)(Tag:electric+)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:infernal+)(Tag:weapon)A giant sword wielded by the demon king that summons devastating thunderstorms with each swing, growing stronger with its user.

name: Kamish's Wrath
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:dagger)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:weapon)A pair of daggers made from the dragon Kamish, nigh unbreakable and sharper than any artificial blade. They synchronize with your mana to adjust strength, and you can increase their weight at will.

name: Teleportation Amulet
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:movement)An ornate platinum amulet that teleports the wearer anywhere they can see, with a 1-minute cooldown.

name: Divine Crucifix
description: #(Tag:catalyst)(Tag:holy+)(Tag:light+)A holy crucifix blessed by a divine spirit whose presence immensely weakens unholy and dark beings and instantly kills weaker ones. Holy or light abilities channelled through it gain potency.

name: Telepathic Implant
description: #(Tag:implant)(Tag:mental)(Tag:tech)(Tech) A neural implant for two-way communication with one target at a time within your perception. It manifests as a ticket that automatically installs itself when torn.

name: Ripperdoc Ticket
description: #(Tag:implant)(Tag:tech)(Tag:ticket)(Tech) A ticket that transfers you to a mechanical Ripperdoc's clinic to install Cyberpunk 2077 implants or ones you bring, for the right price. His top-quality wares are expensive and may require bartering. You return upon leaving, can spend only 24 hours inside, and Restock Timer: 15 Days.

name: Clover Amulet
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:luck+)A golden amulet with jade engraved as a 4-leaf clover that grants good luck.

name: Holy Antidote
description: #(Tag:holy)A vial of powerful holy antidote that cures all diseases and ailments below Legendary rank. Restock Timer: 7 Days.

name: Sandevistan
description: #(Tag:implant)(Tag:perception+)(Tag:tech)(Tech) A cybernetic spine replacement that massively heightens time perception, slowing time around you while taxing your brain; overuse may cause brain damage. It manifests as a ticket installed instantly on whoever rips it.

name: Omni Phone
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tool)(Tech) A mobile phone that connects to networks regardless of distance, with vast storage, an aeon-grade firewall, and supercomputer-surpassing processing power.

name: Ender Pearl
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:movement)A round crystalline pearl of spatial energy that teleports the thrower to where it breaks. Restock Timer: 8 hours.

name: Character Card Wolverine
description: #(Tag:card)(Tag:consumable)(Tag:health-regeneration+)A character card granting yourself or another Wolverine's full healing factor for 10 minutes. 3 uses.

name: Bronze Heart Ticket
description: #(Tag:mental)(Tag:social)(Tag:ticket)(Noncon) Think of the person you want to affect and rip the ticket to make them like you slightly more. It is not mind control but retroactive reality and probability bending, with no unwanted side effects.

name: Silver Heart Ticket
description: #(Tag:mental)(Tag:social)(Tag:ticket)(Noncon) Think of the person you want to affect and rip the ticket to make them like you more. It is not mind control but retroactive reality and probability bending, with no unwanted side effects.

name: Gold Heart Ticket
description: #(Tag:mental)(Tag:social)(Tag:ticket)(Noncon) Think of the person you want to affect and rip the ticket to make them like you a lot more. It is not mind control but retroactive reality and probability bending, with no unwanted side effects.

name: Royal Heart Ticket
description: #(Tag:mental)(Tag:social)(Tag:ticket)(Noncon) Think of the person you want to affect and rip the ticket to make them like you considerably more. It is not mind control but retroactive reality and probability bending, with no unwanted side effects.

name: Cupid's Ticket
description: #(Tag:mental)(Tag:social)(Tag:ticket)(Noncon) Think of the person you want to affect and rip the ticket to make them fall in love with you. It is not mind control but retroactive reality and probability bending, with no unwanted side effects.

name: Auto Doc
description: #(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:machine)(Tag:tech)(Tech) An autonomous advanced doctor station from Big MT. created by Doctor Mobius. This large capsule performs even the most complicated procedures with near-perfect expertise from simple instructions when hooked to sufficient power.

name: Blight Spewer
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:gun)(Tag:poison)(Tag:tech)(Tag:weapon)(Tech) An advanced flamethrower spewing Plague Nanomachine clouds that seek flesh and devour it from the inside out. The nanomachines disintegrate after a few seconds as a safety precaution.

name: Shadethrower
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:gun)(Tag:necro)(Tag:tech)(Tech) A modified flamethrower converting regular burnable fuel into corrupted flames that rapidly rot whatever they burn.

name: Heavenly Gale
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:bow)(Tag:electric)(Tag:holy)(Tag:weapon)A divine bow crafted from earth and cosmos essences that converts any nocked arrow into exotic resonance crystals. They summon resonant lightning where they strike, powerful enough to flay gods alive and rend the surface world.

name: Telluric Gale
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:bow)(Tag:fire)(Tag:holy)(Tag:weapon)A bow crafted from the profaned goddess's remains that converts any nocked arrow into powerful scorching bolts of divine holy flame powered by your energy.

name: The Storm
description: #(Tag:bow)(Tag:electric)(Tag:weapon)A bow carved from the storm weaver's remains that converts any nocked arrow into a lightning bolt scaling with its wielder's power.

name: Hoarfrost Bow
description: #(Tag:bow)(Tag:ice)(Tag:weapon)A mystical bow made from the frozen castle's essence that turns any nocked arrow into freezing mist scaling with its wielder's power.

name: Lunarian Bow
description: #(Tag:bow)(Tag:weapon)A bow crafted from the natural world's elements that converts your energy into energy arrows to fire.

name: Phoenix Feather
description: #(Tag:avian)(Tag:consumable)(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:life)Placing this feather on a corpse whose soul still exists and is not blocked by Legendary rank or higher resurrection prevention revives them, consuming the feather. Restock Timer: 720 hours.

name: Grimm Pool
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:summon)A large jar of evil black goop that summons loyal lesser Grimm once it lands on a stable surface.

name: The Stand Arrow
description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:tool)An ornate meteorite arrow from outer space; those stabbed either slowly succumb to severe fever or, with enough willpower and potential, awaken a Stand (Roll a Platinum Ticket to decide which Stand gets awakened in the target.).

name: Wolverine's Skeleton
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:earth)(Tag:material)Wolverine's Adamantium-bonded skeleton, virtually unbreakable albeit short, with all genetic material scrubbed so no Wolverine will regenerate from it.

name: Nano Machine Heart
description: #(Tag:electric)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:implant)(Tag:tech)(Tech) Senator Armstrong's high-tech nanomachine heart. Implanted, it massively enhances your physiology, absorbs other nanomachines, drains electricity to charge, and hardens against physical trauma or on command.

name: Danzo's Right Arm
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:illusion)(Tag:implant)(Tag:perception+)Danzo's right arm in mint condition, made of Hashirama cells and implanted with 10 Sharingans. Implant it for Sharingan and Hashirama cell benefits, or dismantle it to use all parts separately.

name: Hashirama Cells
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:health-regeneration+)(Tag:implant)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:nature)(Tag:vitality+)A vial of Hashirama Senju's living cells; if successfully implanted, they considerably increase vitality and energy reserves and grant considerable passive regeneration that consumes energy.

name: Rinnegan Jar
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:implant)A pair of Rinnegan plucked from Nagato in preserving fluid, surgically implantable in yourself or others to gain their abilities. They require vast energy to handle.

name: Fire Release Jutsu Scroll
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:magic)(Tome) A large scroll recording all Fire Release Jutsu up to A rank for study and training. Those without the user's permission cannot understand its contents.

name: Water Release Jutsu Scroll
description: #(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:magic)(Tag:water)(Tome) A large scroll recording all Water Release Jutsu up to A rank for study and training. Those without the user's permission cannot understand its contents.

name: Wind Release Jutsu Scroll
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:magic)(Tome) A large scroll recording all Wind Release Jutsu up to A rank for study and training. Those without the user's permission cannot understand its contents.

name: Earth Release Jutsu Scroll
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:magic)(Tome) A large scroll recording all Earth Release Jutsu up to A rank for study and training. Those without the user's permission cannot understand its contents.

name: Lightning Release Jutsu Scroll
description: #(Tag:electric)(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:magic)(Tome) A large scroll recording all Lightning Release Jutsu up to A rank for study and training. Those without the user's permission cannot understand its contents.

name: T-51b Power Armor
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:tech)(Tech) Pre-Great War mass-produced power armour that shrugs off low-calibre bullets and lets an average man lift a car overhead. Powered by a fusion core replaced with a new one every 24 hours.

name: Gene Seed Ticket
description: #(Tag:growing)(Tag:meta)(Tag:nature)(Tag:ticket)(Tech) A ticket transporting you to robotic surgeons for a perfected Transhuman Astartes creation procedure, granting Astartes augments without downsides. It will not affect your looks or body shape.

name: Justice's Shades
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:divination)The blind demon's cool shades that let you tell when someone speaking to you thinks they are lying.

name: E-11 medium blaster rifle
description: #(Tag:gun)(Tag:tech)(Tag:weapon)(Tech) A standard Stormtrooper rifle firing high-heat bolts that kill average light-armoured targets in one shot and blast concrete. It has Lethal, Stun, and Sting settings with a 500-shot cartridge, replaced daily.

name: Soul Solid
description: #(Tag:spirit)Brook's cane sword, extremely sharp, durable, and undulled after years of use. It is also extremely dapper.

name: Wado Ichimonji
description: #A Wano master-crafted great-grade katana, extremely sharp and absurdly durable. Excellent at channelling energy, making abilities channelled through it cost slightly less.

name: Tozama
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:dagger)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:weapon)A basic cursed short-sword tool, sharp and durable, able to interact with and harm spiritual beings.

name: Split Soul Katana
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:weapon)A powerful cursed large broadsword that ignores durability to cut physical matter and strike the soul directly, inflicting wounds unhealable by normal means.

name: Repair Powder
description: #(Tag:consumable)Enchanted golden powder; spreading the entire bag over a weapon restores durability and repairs damage if still in one piece. Stronger or more magical items need more powder. Restock Timer: 12 hours.

name: Threaded Cane
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:bludgeon)(Tag:flexible)(Tag:weapon)A workshop hunter weapon with a cane form sharp enough to hurt beasts. Its trick form splits into numerous blades forming a whip that rends and shreds flesh at range.

name: Chikage
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:life+)(Tag:weapon)An exceptional, incredibly durable katana wielded by Annalise's royal Vileblood guards. Its engraved runes let you sink the blade into your flesh to imbue it with vital essence and amplify its power. While wielding it, all Necromancy and Blood-based abilities are amplified.

name: Holy Moonlight Sword
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:holy)(Tag:power+)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:weapon)An ancient sword wielded by Ludwig that expends your energy to channel the abyssal cosmos and wreathe itself in moonlight for amplified power. You can expel the moonlight for stronger strikes, release energy bursts, or channel your own powers through it for boosted power.

name: Reiterpallasch
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:gun)(Tag:weapon)A refined Cainhurst knight weapon combining rapier and gun without compromise. It transforms into a bayonet to amplify the gun, and you can convert your blood into quicksilver bullets to feed it.

name: Saw Cleaver
description: #(Tag:anti-beast)(Tag:blade)(Tag:weapon)An iconic hunter weapon transforming between long cleaver and serrated saw. It grows stronger against more beastlike opponents.

name: Bottle of Infinite Lotion
description: #(Tag:tool)A simple bottle containing infinite slimy lotion, squeezable manually. Tampering with the bottle breaks it.

name: Power Pole
description: #(Tag:bludgeon)(Tag:polearm)(Tag:weapon)Son Goku the Saiyan's incredibly durable Bo Staff, freely extendable in length by expending your energy.

name: Kubikiribocho
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:weapon)An oversized cleaver curved sword of the Seven Swordsmen of the Mist, incredibly durable and energy-conductive. However damaged, it repairs itself by absorbing blood.

name: Malorian Overture
description: #(Tag:gun)(Tag:tech)(Tech) A heavy-duty powerful Malorian Arms double-action revolver that punches through half-borgs with each bullet. You get 30 bullets daily.

name: Deed to Land
description: #(Tag:ticket)A land deed; rip it in half to have always owned land in a location favourable to you.

name: Deed to Mansion
description: #(Tag:ticket)A mansion deed; rip it in half to have always owned a lavish mansion maintained by an unseen, uninteractable Schrödinger crew.

name: Door to Jail
description: #(Tag:dimension)Opens a door to an automaton-maintained jail block where occupants cannot use abilities or a portion thereof unless allowed by you or your appointed warden, reduced to mundane human output unless specified otherwise. Occupants heal slowly and receive 3 meals daily from automatons.

name: Five Hundred Cigarettes
description: #(Tag:mundane)500 generic non-brand cigarettes for taking the edge off.

name: Rust Bucket
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:vehicle)(Tech) Maxwell Tennyson's large cozy RV repeatedly upgraded with Plumber Technology. An effective mobile home that flies and carries numerous offense and defense systems.

name: Transformer Spark
description: #(Tag:summon)(Tag:tech)(Tag:transformation)(Tech) A Transformer's being; imbue it into any sufficiently large technology to turn it into a Transformer registered as a familiar.

name: ColorS
description: #(Tag:illusion)(Tag:tool)A small book-like magic item that changes your clothing's color scheme by sliding your finger over it.

name: Gale Force Reading Glasses
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:air)(Tag:mental)Magical spectacles letting you read any held book 64x faster without losing comprehension.

name: Music Player
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:tool)(Tech) An indestructible music player with excellent sound, built-in speakers and headphones. It plays any song the holder has heard and archives it.

name: Archenemy
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:weapon)A sealed sword imbued with extremely uncontrollable magical power that unleashes a slash cutting several city blocks at minimum when unsheathed. Keep it sheathed.

name: Magic Ticket
description: #(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:magic)(Tag:ticket)(Tome) A magical ticket granting a grimoire of a chosen Fairy Tail magic branch upon ripping. Excludes Lost, Ancient, Time, Space, Dragonslayer, Archive, or any magic above Elite tier; the chosen category becomes a studyable Grimoire.

name: FEV Vat
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:tech)(Tag:transformation)(Tech) An industrial vat of Forced Evolutionary Virus turning any dropped-in human into a Super Mutant. Dropped-in animals gain increased abilities or die.

name: Null Void Projector
description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:space)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tool)(Tech) A handheld projector opening portals to the Null Void or banishing whatever it hits there, requiring recharge between shots. Incapacitating someone via the Null Void grants no feat.

name: Tome of Destruction
description: #(Tag:electric)(Tag:fire)(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:ice)(Tag:magic)(Tome) A tome compiling Skyrim's destruction spells for training and learning. Spell List: https://elderscrolls.fandom.com/wiki/Destruction_(Skyrim)

name: Tome of Restoration
description: #(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:magic)(Tome) A tome compiling Skyrim's restoration spells for training and learning. Spell List: https://elderscrolls.fandom.com/wiki/Restoration_(Skyrim)

name: Tome of Conjuration
description: #(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:magic)(Tag:summon)(Tome) A tome compiling Skyrim's conjuration spells for training and learning. Spell List: https://elderscrolls.fandom.com/wiki/Conjuration_(Skyrim)

name: Tome of Alteration
description: #(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:magic)(Tag:transformation)(Tome) A tome compiling Skyrim's alteration spells for training and learning. Spell List: https://elderscrolls.fandom.com/wiki/Alteration_(Skyrim)

name: Tome of Illusion
description: #(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:illusion)(Tag:magic)(Tome) A tome compiling Skyrim's illusion spells for training and learning. Spell List: https://elderscrolls.fandom.com/wiki/Illusion_(Skyrim)

name: Potara Earrings
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:transformation)A pair of magical earrings worn one each by two beings to permanently fuse them into one entity with the sum of their powers and abilities.

name: Celestial Bronze
description: #(Tag:material)(Tag:spirit)A mythical Mount Olympus metal deadly to magical or mythical beings yet harmless to the mundane, passing through them. You get 3 10 kg bars; Restock Timer: 24 hours.

name: Stygian Iron
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:material)(Tag:necro)A River Styx metal that destroys or absorbs the essences of those it kills, extremely durable and amplifying darkness, necromancy, and infernal abilities. You get 3 10 kg bars; Restock Timer: 24 hours.

name: Ebony Blade
description: #(Tag:anti-magic)(Tag:blade)(Tag:growing)(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:necro)(Tag:weapon)Mephala's Daedric Artifact: an indestructible sharp katana absorbing slain victims' vitality to heal you and silencing those it strikes against casting magic. It is strengthened by slaying those who consider you a friend.

name: Emperor's Blade
description: #(Tag:anti-dark)(Tag:anti-infernal)(Tag:blade)(Tag:holy)(Tag:holy+)(Tag:light+)(Tag:weapon)The ultimate divine anti-evil blade forged by Odin, Ra, and Rama, usable only by the righteous and good. Completely unbreakable and incredibly sharp, reinforced by your spirit, it vaporizes parts of darkness or infernal creatures it damages. It massively amplifies holy and light abilities as a focus.

name: Stopwatch
description: #(Tag:time)(Tag:tool)A stopwatch stopping the universe's time around the user, often employed by Ugly Bastards or people whose hair obscures their eyes.

name: Rick's Portal Gun
description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tool)(Tech) A portal gun from one of the multiverse's smartest yet stupidest and drunkest inventors, opening portals to any non-spatial-blocked location including other universes if you know coordinates or specifications. Portal fluid refills every 24 hours.

name: Ring of the Bull
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:defence+)(Tag:strength+)This golden ruby ring grants increased strength and endurance, half flat boost and half percentage boost.

name: Riptide
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:tool)(Tag:water)(Tag:water+)(Tag:weapon)The Poseidon demigod's Celestial Bronze sword, exceptionally durable and sharp yet unable to harm the mundane. It switches between pen and sword at will and boosts water affinity as a focus.

name: Helm of Darkness
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:dark)(Tag:movement)(Tag:stealth)Hades' ornate helmet granting complete invisibility to all senses, wall-phasing, and shadow-melting, plus a primordial fear aura. Its abilities consume your energy.

name: Hyperbolic Time Chamber
description: #(Tag:dimension)(Tag:gravity)(Tag:time)A gravity-enhanced dimension for training or hideout with 3-to-1 time dilation: three days inside equal one outside. Access it from any door you place your hands on.

name: Weapon Voucher
description: #(Tag:ticket)(Tag:weapon)A ticket for any one mundane cold weapon; tear it and think of the weapon to receive it in your hands.

name: Nail of Helena
description: #(Tag:bound)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:tool)A true divine artifact used to nail the saint to the cross; nailed to someone's heart, it transforms them into a Monster of God (See trait: Monster of God).

name: Dragon Dictionary
description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:magic)(Tome) Parthuunax's dictionary teaching anyone Thu'um, containing all Tamriel Shouts for study. Learning speed depends on magical and vocal talent, with more powerful esoteric shouts and stages harder to learn. Spell List: https://elderscrolls.fandom.com/wiki/Dragon_Shouts

name: Cupid's Arrow
description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:tool)(Noncon) An arrow making two pierced people fall in love; stab each target once, with the first stabbed falling for the second. Repeat reversed for reciprocity. Legendary rank or stronger targets can resist.

name: Hand of Midas
description: #(Tag:tool)(Tag:transformation)King Midas's severed hand retaining its gold-touch; anything touched with the pointer finger under 5 tons or weaker than Epic rank becomes solid gold. Living beings can resist depending on strength.

name: FREAK Chip
description: #(Tag:implant)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tool)Incognito's high-tech complex chip transforming the implanted into an artificial Hellsing vampire with all powers and weaknesses. Transformation rarely fails depending on compatibility, the chip fuses once implanted, and reverse-engineering requires Expert Biology and Master Mechanics.

name: Retroactive Builders Contract
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:production)A folded contract promising full satisfaction; insert build specifications, location, and sufficient funds covering construction and labor, then sign. It burns to ash, your request having been retroactively expertly built with the money removed. Restock Timer: 720 hours.

name: Mansion of the Boundary
description: #(Tag:dimension)(Tag:movement)A taste-tailored mansion sitting in the middle of everything in its own impenetrable dimension even Outer Ones cannot breach. Enter through any door you touch and exit at any door in reality, even other multiverses or gardens.

name: Plague Reaper Armor
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:bio)(Tag:bio+)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:poison)(Tag:poison+)(Tag:poison-resistance+)(Tag:tech)(Tech) High-tech plague doctor armour fused with Plague Nanovirus, greatly amplifying physical stats with aiming HUD. Immune to diseases and poison below Divine Level, it greatly amplifies your poison and bio abilities and can temporarily release Nanoviruses to rot enemies from within before dissolving safely.

name: Wulfrum Armor
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:tech)(Tech) Simple high-tech wulfrum armour with reasonable defense and comfort. An activated switch turns it into power armour with a supplied powerful machine gun; this mode has a 24-hour cooldown.

name: Photon Ripper
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:light)(Tag:tool)(Tag:weapon)(Tech) Dreadon's Exo-material chainsaw projecting dozens of adjustable hard-light teeth spinning at insane speeds, shredding almost anything. Slight overkill for trees.

name: Master Ninja's Belt
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:agility+)(Tag:movement)A master ninja's inconspicuous black belt granting incredible acrobatics, wall-sticking, fall damage immunity, and muffling of unintentional sounds up to speaking volume.

name: Smoke Bomb
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:movement)"Smoke Bomb!" A simple-looking smoke bomb that, thrown at your feet, teleports you anywhere within 25 meters you could enter if it obscures you from everyone. Restock Timer: 12 hours.

name: ASTER Augmentation Ticket
description: #(Tag:defence+)(Tag:dexterity+)(Tag:implant)(Tag:mind+)(Tag:reflex+)(Tag:strength+)(Tag:ticket)(Tech) A ticket sending you to advanced robotic doctors for a perfected ASTER procedure turning you into a Spartan regardless of age or condition. It grants a more durable skeleton, enhanced musculature, visual acuity, reflexes, and mental clarity.

name: MJOLNIR Powered Assault Armor IV
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:tech)(Tech) Advanced power armour for superhumans, highly flexible without hindering mobility while enhancing physical capabilities and protecting against harm and terrain. It includes basic AI and HUD to manage features.

name: Ultimate Nullifier
description: #(Tag:machine)(Tag:tech)(Tech) The Ultimate Weapon capable of destroying anything from small targets to universes and timelines, provided the user can wield it without perishing.

name: The Infinity Gauntlet
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:armor)(Tag:space)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:time)The Mad Titan's Infinity Gauntlet containing all Infinity Stones, letting the user wield their nigh-unlimited power as long as they can handle it. The perfected gauntlet withstands all Stones without issue.

name: Chaos Card
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:necro)A simple-looking card of unknowable power. Thrown at a target it kills instantly on contact unless the target is immortal, then becomes inert and unusable.

name: Ring of the Shooting Star
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:consumable)(Tag:meta)A Ring containing 3 uses of Wish. Each wish replicates the effect of any ability of Mythical tier or below once.

name: Sukuna's Finger
description: #(Tag:curse)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:tool)A finger containing 1/20th of Ryomen Sukuna, the King of Curses, radiating incredible cursed energy that attracts cursed lifeforms. A cursed being that ingests it gains a power boost, while a proper vessel will either incarnate as 1/20th Sukuna, share the vessel with him, or defeat his fragment and consume its power.

name: Sukuna's Fingers
description: #(Tag:curse)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:tool)All 20 fingers of Ryomen Sukuna, the King of Curses, each containing 1/20th of his power and radiating incredible cursed energy that attracts cursed lifeforms. A cursed being ingesting a finger gains a power boost, while a proper vessel will either incarnate as 1/20th Sukuna, share the vessel with him, or defeat his fragment and consume its power.

name: Eye of Agamotto
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:time)(Tag:tool)The Eye of Agamotto containing the Time Stone, one of the 6 Infinity Stones. It allows time manipulation such as stopping time, time travel, and time loops as long as the user harnesses it correctly, with greater exertion causing backlash that can kill.

name: Power Stone
description: #(Tag:alter)(Tag:tool)The Power Stone, one of the 6 Infinity Stones and most powerful artifacts. It grants immense destructive power to empower the body or weapons or fire as blasts and projections, capable of shattering planets when used correctly, though few can withstand its full power.

name: Soul Stone
description: #(Tag:spirit)(Tag:tool)One of the Infinity Stones, among the most powerful artifacts in existence. It allows control of souls, bestowing life and resurrection, as long as the user can handle its power.

name: Shadow Perfume
description: #(Tag:dark)(Tag:stealth)(Tag:tool)A bottle of pitch-black cologne that erases the user's scent and partly muffles movement for 1 hour when applied.

name: Ring of Suppression
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:stealth)A smooth black nondescript ring that completely erases your energy signatures unless you are actively using abilities or spells.

name: Neuralyzer
description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:mental)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tool)(Tech) The electro bio-mechanical neural transmitting zero synapse repositioner flashes targets to erase selected memories and leave them suggestible, with settings configurable on the device. Strong-willed or more powerful targets may resist.

name: Jarate Training Kit
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:tool)"Comes with an infinite supply of kidney enlarging pills." A training manual for effectively utilizing piss in combat by training with kidney enlarging pills.

name: 1 UP
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:life)A green, odd-looking mushroom that grants an extra life when consumed, instantly reviving the user at maximum health upon death.

name: Portal Gun
description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:space)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tool)(Tech) An Aperture Science Portal Gun firing blue and orange pulses that each open a person-sized portal where they land, linked to the opposite colour. Only one portal of each colour can exist at once.

name: Gordon's Crowbar
description: #(Tag:anti-alien)(Tag:bludgeon)(Tag:weapon)Gordon Freeman's legendary crowbar, stained with innumerable aliens' blood. It deals conceptually more damage to all inhuman enemies.

name: Stamin-Up
description: #(Tag:agility+)(Tag:consumable)(Tag:stamina+)"For when you are going at it long and fast." This soda slightly enhances agility and stamina for 1 hour after finishing an entire can, without stacking from additional cans; drinking more than 3 different buff drinks at once causes intense haemorrhaging, strokes, and heart attacks. Restock Timer: 24 hours.

name: Deadshot Daiquiri
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:divination)"I'm not even gonna try and spell that." Drinking an entire can temporarily increases proficiency and accuracy with all ranged weapons and projectile-based abilities for 1 hour, without stacking from additional cans; drinking more than 3 different buff drinks at once causes intense haemorrhaging, strokes, and heart attacks. Restock Timer: 24 hours.

name: Vulture's Aid
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:divination)"Like a scavenging Vulture" Vulture's Aid grants treasure sight to see outlines of treasures and objects of interest through walls after finishing an entire can, without stacking from additional cans; drinking more than 3 different buff drinks at once causes intense haemorrhaging, strokes, and heart attacks. Restock Timer: 24 hours.

name: Melee Macchiato
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:strength+)"This really 'packs a punch' badum tss!" Melee Macchiato grants temporary enhanced strength and melee skills for 1 hour after finishing an entire can, without stacking from additional cans; drinking more than 3 different buff drinks at once causes intense haemorrhaging, strokes, and heart attacks. Restock Timer: 24 hours.

name: Juggernog
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:defence+)(Tag:vitality+)"Reach for me, Jugger Girl. Oorah." Juggernog grants temporary enhanced Vitality and Resilience for 1 hour after finishing an entire can, without stacking from additional cans; drinking more than 3 different buff drinks at once causes intense haemorrhaging, strokes, and heart attacks. Restock Timer: 24 hours.

name: Speed Cola
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:dexterity+)"Crazy Sugar High" Speed Cola grants temporary enhanced Dexterity for 1 hour after finishing an entire can, without stacking from additional cans; drinking more than 3 different buff drinks at once causes intense haemorrhaging, strokes, and heart attacks. Restock Timer: 24 hours.

name: Death Perception
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:perception+)"You can't escape death" Death Perception grants temporary reaper's gaze to see outlines of enemies through walls and any obstruction for 1 hour after finishing an entire can, without stacking from additional cans; drinking more than 3 different buff drinks at once causes intense haemorrhaging, strokes, and heart attacks. Restock Timer: 24 hours.

name: Bonk!
