description: #(Tag:agility+)(Tag:consumable)(Tag:perception+)Drinking Bonk! massively increases reflexes and slows perceived time for 8 seconds to dodge almost all incoming attacks, then leaves you exhausted. You must also survive its extreme sugar and radiation. Restock Timer: 72 hours.

name: Homerun
description: #(Tag:bludgeon)(Tag:kinetic)(Tag:weapon)An inordinately durable baseball with vastly increased knockback, imbuing objects or targets with increased velocity on contact.

name: Deeds' Bell
description: #(Tag:summon)(Tag:tool)A silver ornate bell that summons supernatural butler Mr. Deeds when rung to perform any one butler-capable task, such as laundry, killing, making a sandwich (no ingredients needed), taxes, or providing a gold bar (no gold access needed). If unable, he will say so and ask for an alternative. Cooldown: 12 hours.

name: Cassandra Nova's Sling Ring
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:movement)(Tag:space)(Tag:time)A sling ring from the Void, its band set with a Time Stone and a Reality Stone. Unlike a common sling ring, it can open a door out of the Void and into other realities, not merely between known dimensions; picture the destination and step through. The stones are socketed, not wielded: they won't answer to you as Infinity Stones while set, and prying them free is the kind of project that destroys the ring, the stones, or you.

name: Psychic Paper
description: #(Tag:illusion)(Tag:mental)(Tag:tool)Psychic paper that makes viewers see what they expect, such as IDs, papers, or permits. It fails against exceptionally strong beings or geniuses who may notice the difference.

name: Holy Grail
description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:resource)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:tool)A chalice holding incredible raw magical power. It can serve as an immense mana source or grant wishes achievable through magic below Legendary Tier. Restock Timer: 720 hours.

name: Warhammer 40k
description: #(Tag:mundane)40,000 regular-quality standard iron warhammers, retrievable one at a time from system storage. What did you think it was?

name: Demon Blood Blade
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:blood)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:life)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:weapon)A tough, sharp unholy blade forged from the blood of the demon Kee-Oth. It deals increased damage to Angelic and Holy beings, can harm spiritual creatures, and offers further use to Hemokinetics.

name: Moondrip
description: #(Tag:anti-magic)(Tag:consumable)A powerful potion of long-condensed moon power. Emptying the bottle on a spell dispels it if Elite level or below; drinking it cleanses the user of magic effects of the same level. Restock Timer: 24 hours.

name: God Emperor's Blade
description: #(Tag:anti-infernal)(Tag:blade)(Tag:fire)(Tag:fire+)(Tag:weapon)A top weapon personally created by the God Emperor of Mankind through Science and Warpcraft, possibly still holding part of his essence. As Anathema to Demon and Infernal beings, it vaporizes all but the strongest (Legendary and above) with a graze. Its Psyker flames can launch attacks and empower your pyrokinetic abilities.

name: Salt
description: #(Tag:mundane)A handful of salt distilled from the tears of failed rolls.

name: Snake's Box
description: #(Tag:stealth)(Tag:tool)An unassuming cardboard box that completely suppresses the presence, energy, and aura of anything inside or covered by it. If destroyed, it returns to item space pristine in an hour.

name: Blades of Chaos
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:fire)(Tag:fire+)(Tag:flexible)(Tag:growing)(Tag:mental)(Tag:strength+)(Tag:weapon)Ares' Blades of Chaos, forged by Hephaestus in Hades' furnace and received from the moment of creation. The bound wielder gains immense physical might and unnatural war anger, absorbing victims' lifeforce for further strength and able to absorb and use imbued power sources. They also empower fire attributes when used.

name: Blade of Olympus
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:alter)(Tag:blade)(Tag:divine)(Tag:earth)(Tag:fire)(Tag:holy)(Tag:water)(Tag:weapon)The Blade of Olympus, forged from the Heavens, Seas, Afterlife, and Earth, and strongest weapon of the Olympian Gods, able to shatter titans in a single swing. It holds divine might to create Divine Energy projections, amplify the user's Divine Attributes, and enhance all Divine-related items and abilities they hold.

name: Leviathan Axe
description: #(Tag:aquatic)(Tag:blade)(Tag:ice)(Tag:ice+)(Tag:weapon)The Leviathan Axe, peer of Mjolnir, is an unbreakable sharp rune-imbued axe. It projects shapeable frost aura for attacks, greatly augments Ice/Frost attributes while held, and returns to the hand when thrown.

name: Draupnir Spear
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:air+)(Tag:polearm)(Tag:weapon)A spear forged for Kratos and imbued with the winds of all realms, worn as a ring that manifests up to 8 spears at once. Held spears project energy as wind and boost wind attribute, and summoned spears can be detonated into wind explosions at any time.

name: Canto
description: #(Tag:implant)(Tag:tech)(Tech) The Canto, a legendary mythic Cyberdeck implant functioning as a powerful brain-connected computer. Its sentient Super AI lets you interface with and easily hack even the toughest networks. Manifests as a ticket that installs itself when ripped.

name: Kano's Eye
description: #(Tag:implant)(Tag:tech)(Tech) A high-tech cybernetic eye implant without the faceplate, switching between infrared, heat, electromagnetic, X-ray, and other vision modes. It fires variable-power condensed energy beams fueled by your energy reserves. Manifests as a ticket that perfectly implants itself in whoever rips it.

name: Hsu's Cybernetic Heart
description: #(Tag:defence+)(Tag:implant)(Tag:maximum-energy+)(Tag:stamina+)(Tag:strength+)(Tag:tech)(Tech) A high-tech cybernetic heart replacement granting superhuman physical abilities plus increased stamina and energy regeneration, weaker when your energy is lower. It can fire a chest death laser if left uncovered (implanted beneath muscle by default), charging extra reserves over time for the laser. Manifests as a ticket that perfectly implants itself in whoever rips it.

name: Classic Omnitrix
description: #(Tag:bound)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tool)(Tag:transformation)(Tech) The Classic Omnitrix, the first version released. This biologically-bound watch transforms the user into any of 10 aliens (possibly more with experimentation) for roughly 30 minutes before cooldown, and can capture DNA of contacted creatures to become them. Tampering requires at least Master Mechanics and Biology.

name: Omnitrix
description: #(Tag:bound)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tool)(Tag:transformation)(Tech) The True Omnitrix, Azmuth's final version. It transforms the user into any of millions of stored aliens, from living gravity-manipulating planetoids to multiversal reality warpers.

name: Chaquetrix
description: #(Tag:bound)(Tag:summon)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tool)(Character) (Tech) A weird Omnitrix variant that creates and summons the selected alien as a breeding-compatible companion to help or "help" you. It holds only the original 10 but includes a lifeform analyser to eventually expand the roster.

name: Divine Stone
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:resource)Despite its name, not of Divine Origin. This 10cm crystallised-energy crystal holds enchantments very well and melts over time into an Ambrosia with incredibly potent healing and curing properties.

name: Falcon's Eye
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:perception+)A Shen Gong Wu monocle granting super sight to see through objects, see in darkness, and see far.

name: Mantis Flip Coin
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:movement)A Shen Gong Wu coin on a rope necklace that grants high jumping and enhanced acrobatics when worn on the body.

name: Captain's Shield
description: #(Tag:shield)Captain America's Proto-Adamantium shield, one of the toughest materials known, withstanding even the toughest blows. It bounces back to its owner when thrown.

name: Guardian Shield
description: #(Tag:shield)An extremely durable bracelet unfolding into a supernaturally durable shield faster than a blink. It can also serve as a bludgeon.

name: Shield Saw
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:shield)(Tag:weapon)(Tech) "You will never see a cooler shield" A high-tech chainsaw-shield hybrid that blocks extremely well and is incredibly durable. Its fast-spinning blades adjust trajectory mid-flight and return to the user when thrown.

name: Feedbacker
description: #(Tag:implant)(Tag:kinetic)(Tag:tech)(Tech) V1's disembodied arm as a prosthetic implant with tremendous strength and speed, able to punch bullets faster and parry energy blasts. It fuels itself by consuming the user's or others' blood, and can heal the user by stealing others' blood. Manifests as a ticket that installs the prosthetic when ripped.

name: Marksman Revolver
description: #(Tag:gun)(Tag:kinetic)(Tag:tech)(Tech) An incredibly high-tech revolver outclassing anti-tank rounds, manifesting up to 4 throwable gold coins. Hitting a coin ricochets the bullet toward the closest hittable weak point, growing stronger with each chained coin. It fires high-velocity metal shards with extreme efficiency lasting days of shooting, replenishable by adding more metal.

name: Dust Supply Crate
description: #(Tag:production)(Tag:resource)A supply crate of refined high-quality Remnant dust for your own use, containing 5 kg of your chosen dust. Restock Timer: 120 hours.

name: Crescent Rose
description: #(Tag:gun)(Tag:polearm)(Tag:tech)(Tag:weapon)(Tech) An ungodly mechashift fusion of massive scythe and high-calibre sniper rifle, compactable and shiftable between rifle, war scythe, and other combat forms. Includes a magazine of chosen dust sniper rounds every 24 hours.

name: Myrtenaster
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:gun)(Tag:tech)(Tag:weapon)(Tech) "Don't even try to spell it." A mechashift revolver rapier with 6 dust-round slots that cuts with flames, frost, and more depending on the activated cartridge. You get 6 dust rounds per day of your chosen type.

name: Sento
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:perception+)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:summon)(Tag:weapon)Sento, an ancient blade of Kenshi's clan housing his ancestors' spirits, with exceptional durability and sharpness. Wielding grants enhanced senses and telekinetic sword control, and with enough spirit affinity, imbuing energy temporarily summons them to aid you.

name: Light Cycle
description: #(Tag:light)(Tag:tech)(Tag:vehicle)(Tech) A high-tech sleek sci-fi bicycle that is extremely durable, fast, and cool. It never needs recharging or fuel.

name: Robot Workbench
description: #(Tag:machine)(Tag:production)(Tag:tech)(Tech) An advanced Robot Workbench recycling raw materials into parts to assemble or upgrade any configuration the original Workbench can produce. Appropriate materials are required.

name: Robot Assembly
description: #(Tag:barracks)(Tag:building)(Tag:machine)(Tag:production)(Tag:tech)(Tech) An advanced room-sized station converting input raw materials into robot parts for assembly, limited to blueprints fed into it with Fallout Robots included by default. Part quality depends on input material quality.

name: Web Fluid & Shooters
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tool)(Tech) "Don't forget the hyphen!" A vial of patented web fluid and wrist-equippable webshooters, with one full vial granted every 24 hours.

name: Goblin Glider
description: #(Tag:vehicle)(Tag:weapon)(Tech) A high-tech mind-controlled glider flying at great speeds with bladed weapon edges and some storage space. It refuels every 8 hours and slowly self-repairs unless completely damaged.

name: Mechanical Tentacles
description: #(Tag:implant)(Tag:tech)(Tech) A high-tech harness with 4 mechanical tentacle arms moved by thought or independently per commands. The arms have supernatural strength and task-dependent integrated tools.

name: 2008 Menu #4 Cheese and Vegetable Omelette
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:mundane)The infamous "Vomelette" MRE: unpalatable but edible and digestible food. Restock Timer: 10 minutes.

name: Favour Cheque
description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:ticket)A blank cheque to cash in a favour, insufficient for acts strongly against the target's morals but enough for great inconvenience like rent-free housing. It burns upon use.

name: A Doctor's Appointment
description: #(Tag:divination)(Tag:healing)(Tag:ticket)A doctor's appointment ticket that instantly grants a detailed note on physical condition plus many possible treatments for any conditions. Restock Timer: 120 hours.

name: Tactical Trenchcoat
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:storage)A cool-looking, exceptionally durable yet comfortable trenchcoat. All pockets are 10x bigger inside for extra storage.

name: Chaos Gacha Promotional Shirt
description: #(Tag:armor)A regular white shirt reading "I rolled a ticket and all I got was this stupid shirt in return." If destroyed or lost, it reappears accessible to the user in mint condition.

name: Forgiveness Ticket
description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:ticket)Give this ticket to bury the hatchet and be forgiven for anything except murder. The target must have been at least neutral toward you before.

name: Skeleton in Closet
description: #(Tag:mundane)A completely ordinary skeleton from an ordinary person, complete with its own closet.

name: Fairy Dust
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:fae)(Tag:movement)Fairy Dust freshly shaken from Tinker Bell. This pouch floats 5 grown people for 1 hour or one grown person for 5 hours. Restock Timer: 24 hours.

name: Skippy
description: #(Tag:gun)(Tag:tech)(Tech) Skippy, a Smart Handgun firing homing bullets with onboard AI that aims on the fly and distinguishes ally from enemy, while judging your actions. You get 5 magazines every 24 hours.

name: Herrera Outlaw
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:vehicle)(Tech) The Herrera Outlaw, a stylish luxury limousine built for Night City with windows resisting anything below .50 calibre. Not the best car, but stylish wheels sure to impress.

name: Regalia
description: #(Tag:tech)(Tag:vehicle)(Tech) This fully upgraded Regalia is a powerful, durable, self-driving, incredibly stylish supercar that converts into a flying vehicle. Fuel refills automatically every 8 hours.

name: Zero Point Energy Gloves
description: #(Tag:kinetic)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tool)(Tech) High-tech gloves firing energy beams on point that immobilize on hit while letting you move victims as desired. Strong targets can resist or break free; the gloves draw on your energy reserves.

name: Demon-Slayer Blade
description: #(Tag:anti-magic)(Tag:blade)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:weapon)A large black blade dispelling any contacted magical spell or effect of Legendary rank or below. Its anti-magic energy fires black energy slashes or levitates the sword back to the user.

name: The Slaughterhouse
description: #(Tag:dimension)(Tag:production)(Tag:resource)This rusty old key opens a door to the Slaughterhouse, whose workers supply any amount of mundane Earth-native meat on demand, breed, raise, and butcher any two live breedable animals for you at 60x efficiency, and perfectly process, pack, and return any non-living meat sent in. You may enter the universe-sized complex of soulless butchers and workers, but do not get lost or wander. WARNING: Do not send anything you do not want harvested for meat, including yourself; the workers do not care for reason.

name: Yukari Fumo
description: #(Tag:fumo)(Tag:movement)Shake this fumo violently to open a portal to any visited location in your current dimension. Only one portal open at a time.

name: Blue Spider Lily
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:insectoid)(Tag:resource)(Tag:transformation)An incredibly fragile rare flower in a special container. Properly refined into medicine, it turns the ingester into a Progenitor Demon (Legendary Trait).

name: Volendrung
description: #(Tag:bludgeon)(Tag:weapon)Volendrung, an enchanted nigh-unbreakable Daedric hammer that saps hit targets' strength, temporarily weakening them. Expending energy activates a paralysis enchantment whose duration depends on target strength.

name: Reaper's Census
description: #(Tag:divination)(Tag:necro)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:tool)A simple notebook tracking every sapient life lost in your current dimension, requiring rough face and name knowledge to jump to a target's page or manual paging otherwise. Each deceased page lists cause of death, time since death, corpse or largest-remains location, and soul location if in the same dimension. The book reforms somewhere accessible if destroyed.

name: Venom Vial
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:poison)(Tag:strength+)A sealed vial of Venom, a powerful fast-acting steroid enhancing physical strength for 12 hours before leaving weakness, with debilitating withdrawal and possible urge to break backs. Restock Timer: 24 hours.

name: Origin Rounds
description: #(Tag:anti-magic)(Tag:tool)(Tag:weapon)An otherwise ordinary .30-06 bullet made from the ground ribs and soul fragments of Kiritsugu Emiya, the Magus Killer. On direct hit it enforces Severing and Binding on the target's magic, temporarily disrupting magic and abilities. Restock Timer: 12 hours.

name: Erza Fumo
description: #(Tag:fumo)(Tag:movement)An Erza Scarlet Fumo that instantly swaps your worn clothes with any owned clothing you picture when shaken violently, leaving the old clothes in their place.

name: Lancelot Albion
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:tech)(Tag:vehicle)(Tech) The Lancelot Albion, among the strongest, most advanced Britannian Knightmares. It carries reinforced armour, super high-speed energy-wing flight, slash harkens, advanced Factsphere detection, wing energy projectiles, Blaze Luminous energy shields, Super V.A.R.I.S. Rifle blasts or Hadron Cannon mode, and Maser Vibration Sword. Its Yggdrasil Drive refills every 24 hours, and it is nigh impossible for regular people to operate.

name: Gurenn Seiken
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:tech)(Tag:vehicle)(Tech) Gurenn, the strongest, most advanced Knightmare Frame: an incredibly mobile marvel of destruction with advanced armour, super high-speed energy-wing flight, slash harkens, and Radiant Wave Technology for offense and defense. It creates barriers that disintegrate or destroy projectiles and objects while blocking physically, and focuses into devastating blasts and close-range bursts. Radiation Wave ammo and Ygdrassil Drive Sakuradite replenish every 24 hours.

name: Gawainn
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:tech)(Tag:vehicle)(Tech) Gawainn, a tall Experimental Knightmare perfected by the Black Knights for one or two pilots. It carries Reinforced Armour, Floatation flight systems, 10 finger-mounted slash harkens, and 2 shoulder-mounted devastating Hadron Cannons. Its Ygdrassil Drive replenishes every 24 hours.

name: Sutherland
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:tech)(Tag:vehicle)(Tech) The Sutherland, the basic mass-produced Britannian Knightmare. It carries armour, mounted machine gun, landspinner propulsion, Factsphere sensor, two slash harkens, and basic Knightmare assault rifle. Its Ygdrassil Drive and weapon ammunition replenish every 24 hours.

name: Magic Reflecting Mirror
description: #(Tag:magic)(Tag:tool)An ornate golden hand mirror perfectly reversing any magical attack contacting its surface, instantly reversing its direction.

name: Nazar
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:anti-curse)(Tag:curse-resistance+)(Tag:infernal-resistance+)An eye-shaped blue glass charm passively granting decent resistance to curses and negative energy. It breaks to nullify any Epic rank or above curse afflicting the user.

name: Scooby Snacks
description: #(Tag:consumable)A box of dog treats no person has reason to eat, but familiars and candidates love. It pours indefinitely for a lifetime supply.

name: Familiar Card
description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:summon)(Tag:tool)The Ainsworths can suck it. This Familiar Card captures one familiar for another person to insert and activate, granting only its abilities, not stats. It can be forcefully ejected by recalling the familiar to familiar space.

name: Gun Cache
description: #(Tag:gun)(Tag:production)A dark grey duffle bag producing copies of any mundane Basic Earth public-use firearm or bullet magazine with bullets, from revolvers to sniper rifles. Limited to 20 kg pulled per day.

name: Rivers of Blood
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:blood)(Tag:curse)(Tag:weapon)Mohg champion's old katana, stained by countless blood yet incredibly durable and sharp. Flesh wounds from it haemorrhage unnaturally fast.

name: The Jar
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:anti-divine)A large wearable head jar once worn by a tarnished warrior who vanquished the rot goddess a thousandfold. It grants increased physical abilities, reflexes, and instincts against Gods or Divine entities. Despite appearances, it does not hinder vision and is supernaturally durable.

name: Contract from Below
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:meta)"Is it worth the price?" A worn blood-stained paper granting equal-rank Summon Demon without using an ability slot when signed in blood after offering 3 equal-level sacrifices (Abilities, Items, Familiars etc.; Skills excluded), e.g. a Rare Ability plus 2 Rare Items for Summon Demon (Rare). Single use upon signing; refundable for free to reclaim its ticket.

name: Covenant from Above
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:holy)(Tag:meta)"Devotion at a price." A gold scroll trimmed in silver granting equal-rank Summon Angel without using an ability slot when signed in blood after offering 3 equal-level sacrifices (Abilities, Items, etc.; Skills and Familiars excluded), e.g. an Elite Ability plus 2 Elite Items for Summon Angel (Elite). Single use upon signing; refundable for free to reclaim its ticket.

name: Dimensional Courier
description: #(Tag:tool)A phone with a single dialled number contacting the Dimensional Courier. The Courier buys anything civilian-purchasable with money from anywhere you have visited, even across realities and dimensions, delivering within 8 hours at most. They take 10% commission per purchase.

name: Vial of Everflowing Blood
description: #(Tag:blood)(Tag:life)(Tag:production)(Tag:tool)An ornate red vial endlessly pouring fresh healthy O- blood when tipped, manifested rather than belonging to any person.

name: Ring of Sustenance
description: #(Tag:accessory)A ring constantly providing full sustenance while worn, regardless of dietary needs.

name: Morgue
description: #(Tag:dimension)This key turns any door into a gate to The Morgue, an endlessly vast store of fresh indistinct human corpses. Any biological matter inside stops decaying and stays preserved.

name: Grow Your Own Darkroot Garden Kit
description: #(Tag:life)(Tag:nature)(Tag:production)(Tag:resource)A box with all essentials to grow Darkroot flora, including special fertilisers, seeds, and spores for Ents, Mushroom People, red and purple moss, green blossoms, glowing plants, etc. Corpses of powerful beings serve as extra fertiliser for faster growth.

name: Lifeblood Seeds
description: #(Tag:life)(Tag:nature)(Tag:production)(Tag:resource)Seed packets of Lifeblood (Plasmium), a sentient blue fluid growing into self-producing plants in nearly any fertile environment. Ingesting it temporarily boosts vitality and acts as potent medicine, but overuse risks addiction and parasitic takeover unless constitution allows symbiosis granting regeneration and sustenance. It spreads rapidly if not carefully cultivated.

name: The Casino
description: #(Tag:dimension)Manifest a door to the Casino, a full facility in a 1 km x 1 km pocket dimension with slots, poker, stocked bar, private rooms, etc., manned by unobservable Schrodinger workers. Damage slowly repairs, and anyone may leave anytime via the main doors.

name: Emperor's New Clothes
description: #(Tag:armor)The Emperor wasn't actually naked. These invisible comfortable clothes auto-conform with incredible defense, immune by default to low-calibre gunfire and scaling with natural defenses, plus lesser physical boosts. Wearing any other clothes nullifies all effects.

name: Cookie Jar
description: #(Tag:production)A flagship "Bakery" glass jar of practically limitless warm fresh chocolate chip cookies from a compressed universe optimised solely for cookie production. Note: DO NOT BREAK THE JAR. Note 2: DO NOT BREAK THE JAR; THE BAKERY IS NOT RESPONSIBLE FOR THE CONSEQUENCES OF BREAKING THE JAR.

name: Yuuka Fumo
description: #(Tag:fumo)(Tag:nature)A Kazami Yuuka Fumo that continuously enriches soil and boosts crop growth speed and quality in a 2 km x 2 km range when placed. Carried, it increases Chlorokinetic potency.

name: Flintslate
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:tool)A refined Flintgem slate making sharpened bladed weapons temporarily red-hot without damage for 5 minutes. Usable up to 3 times every 24 hours.

name: Mimic Ore
description: #(Tag:material)(Tag:meta)A blank featureless ore identical to iron alone, transmuting fully into any contacted metal of at least 5 kg after 1 hour of direct contact if Epic rarity or lower, then losing mimicry. You get 3 5 kg bars. Restock Timer: 240 hours.

name: Idiot's Guide to Einzbern Homunculi
description: #(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:life)(Tag:magic)(Tome) Justeaze Lizrich von Einzbern's simplified yet fully effective homunculus-creation guide for even regular people. It details Einzbern and advanced Justeaze-model Homunculi plus vats and related production items.

name: Idiot's Guide to Amestris Alchemy
description: #(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:magic)(Tag:transformation)(Tome) A guide to Amestris State Military Alchemy covering Transmutation Circles for all basic elements (Water, Earth, Wind, Fire, etc.), activation, and advanced effective use, required reading to use Alchemy. (Note: Excludes human transmutation, Scar's disintegration, and Philosopher Stone creation; only circles previously used by State Alchemists).

name: Idiot's Guide to Father's Philosophy
description: #(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:life)(Tag:magic)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:transformation)(Tome) Father's (Dwarf in the Flask) guide to specialised Alchemy for Philosopher's Stones and advanced Homunculi. Study enables Human Transmutation circles converting living Human or Humanoid souls into Philosopher's Stones, potent fuel draining ensouled power, and creating advanced superhuman homunculi from them. Each homunculus may copy any ONE possessed ability of Elite rank or below, drawing stone energy to use it with cost scaling to power, requiring replacement when depleted.

name: Chekhov's Gun
description: #(Tag:gun)(Tag:weapon)An otherwise ordinary M1 Garand that quickly appears at hand whenever useful, whether under a couch, rug, etc. Found pristine and fully loaded regardless of prior location or condition, and retains this property even when modified.

name: Icon of Greed
description: #(Tag:tool)"They would do anything for it." A simple gold coin embodying greed, compelling viewers to possess it at any cost, from selling family to swearing fealty or killing kin, with stronger entities more resistant. Once willingly given, it becomes normal, yet trades stay yours with the giver satisfied and unseeking return.

name: Heal Juice
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:energy-recovery)(Tag:health-recovery)A green juice vial restoring the drinker to perfect health, resolving all complications and negative statuses. Requires full dose, as dilution ruins it; heals anything except death if consumable.

name: Universal Rations
description: #(Tag:consumable)A bottle of 100 flavorless small white pills, each equaling a regular meal that fully satiates for at least 8 hours with all nutrients for any race or peculiarity. Restock Timer: 120 hours.

name: Pocket Universe
description: #(Tag:dimension)No hyperbole: a pocket-sized gate to an entire replica mundane universe without cognizant creatures or civilizations. Freely movable and pocket-carriable, expanding to 50 meters in circumference and shrinking to 5cm, always leading to coordinates 0.0.

name: High Roller Suite
description: #(Tag:dimension)Congratulations, gambler: a key temporarily turning any door into a gate to the High Roller Suite, a luxury hotel room with 3 beds, 2 bathrooms, running water, electricity, heat, local internet, and other amenities. It auto-cleans perfectly every 24 hours, exists in the middle of nowhere and requires the key to exit, returning users to their entry point. The key cannot be lost or destroyed.

name: Fairy Boots
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:agility+)(Tag:energy-regeneration+)(Tag:fae)(Tag:nature)(Tag:nature+)Living-material boots greatly enhancing running speed, growing stepped-on mundane plants instantly to maturity with lush flora in a 1-meter radius and flowers in their wake rather than creating plants. Standing in nature while worn increases energy regeneration and nature affinity.

name: Garden of Eden Seed
description: #(Tag:nature)Unassuming grass seeds that quickly grow in any soil or sand without nutrients into a lush garden enriching surrounding ground and air energy quality. The garden expands non-invasively until fenced, yielding much faster healthier crops and healthier vigorous cattle. Restock Timer: 720 hours.

name: Uber Fertilizer
description: #(Tag:nature)Fertilizer from a mad scientist using eldritch waste, growing crops 30x faster for 24 hours with perfect nutrients regardless of needs. Each bag covers exactly 1 acre. Restock Timer: 240 hours.

name: Staff of Regrowth
description: #(Tag:catalyst)(Tag:nature)(Tag:nature+)A staff of solidified flower suffused with nature energy. Expend energy to nourish and rapidly grow plants in range, even reviving half-dead seeds on arid land into lush fertile ground; stronger or demanding plants cost more energy. Amplifies nature-based abilities channeled through it.

name: Reroll Chip
description: #(Tag:meta)(Gacha) A golden poker chip that lets you reroll your latest gacha ticket, discarding its result for a different result on the same ticket. The chip vanishes upon use.

name: Vibranium Weave Patch
description: #(Tag:material)(Tag:transformation)An ordinary-looking sticker that suffuses clothing with integrated Vibranium weaving, making it incredibly durable and able to disperse kinetic energy so even a baseline human can survive a tank shell. Only enough for up to 5 kg of clothing.

name: The Rock
description: #(Tag:bludgeon)(Tag:weapon)The rock King Arthur pulled a sword from. Magically enchanted to be utterly indestructible to all effects below Mythical level.

name: One Million Buzzsaws
description: #One million 3-meter permanently spinning steel buzzsaws from the White Palace that cannot be stopped without being destroyed. Each must be taken from storage manually and can injure a careless user.

name: Instant Death Soup
description: #(Tag:consumable)A pot of very hot spicy soup that instantly kills anyone who willingly drinks it while knowing its effects, regardless of constitution or abilities. The whole soup must be consumed for it to take effect.

name: Very Hot Soup
description: #(Tag:anti-divine)(Tag:anti-recovery)(Tag:blood)(Tag:consumable)(Tag:curse)(Tag:fire)(Tag:holy)(Tag:infernal)A pot of incredibly hot spicy soup; consuming the entire pot covers the consumer's body in [(Rare)Cursed Flames], [(Elite)Blood Flames], [(Elite)Holy Flames], and [(Elite)Godslayer Apostle Flames].

name: Morphing Blade
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:weapon)A 3 kg iron sword with a pure iron blade that can change shape while conserving mass. Destroyed or separated parts lose this property, as does reforging or modifying the sword.

name: Escape Ticket
description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:ticket)A ticket that when torn teleports the user to a 4x4x4m prison-like extradimensional bunker stocked with clean water and MREs for 8 hours. The user cannot leave early without spatial manipulation and can be tracked by those with spatial abilities; release is automatic after 8 hours.

name: Gun Voucher
description: #(Tag:gun)(Tag:ticket)(Tech) A ticket redeemable by tearing and thinking of any commercially available gun sold in the USA in 2016. You also receive a magazine for the chosen weapon every 24 hours.

name: Earring of Hearing
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:perception+)A pair of clip-on earrings that boost the wearer's hearing and acuity to Barn Owl level.

name: Hawk Glasses
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:perception+)Ordinary-looking glasses that grant the wearer the farsight and visual acuity of a Bald Eagle.

name: Hound Collar
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:perception+)A red dog collar that grants the wearer the smell and olfactory abilities of a Gray Wolf.

name: Horseshoe Necklace
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:perception+)A horseshoe necklace that grants the wearer the stamina and leg strength of a Mustang Horse.

name: Ghost Blade
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:dagger)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:weapon)A sharp long dagger of the ghosts of New Londo whose curse lets it wound spiritual beings. It does not inflict soul damage on living beings.

name: Black Knight Set
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:blade)(Tag:shield)(Tag:weapon)Armor and weapons of the Black Knights of Lordran, with armor that stays perfectly fitted unless your body shape changes drastically. Contains a Greatsword, Battle Axe, Halberd, Sword, and Shield.

name: Perfume Pouch
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:defence+)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:poison)(Tag:production)A Perfumers' pouch containing one each of Acid Spraymist, Poison Spraymist, Bloodboil Aromatic, Ironjar Aromatic, and Uplifting Aromatic. Another set is added every 24 hours.

name: Explosive Tag Deck
description: #(Tag:production)(Tag:weapon)A leather deck of standard Hidden Leaf Explosive Tags that explode with decent power when imbued with energy. The user can set the detonation delay and, with practice and pre-imbuing, detonate them remotely. Contains 5 tags that restock every 24 hours.

name: Eochaid's Dancing Blade
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:weapon)The famed, extremely sharp and durable blade of a family of executioners. The user can expend energy to make it fly at their will with the same power as a normal swing.

name: Sword of St. Trina
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:magic)(Tag:weapon)A clerics' sword of St. Trina with a weak blade that converts the user's energy into magical purple mist that puts inhalers into deep sleep. Stronger targets require longer exposure.

name: Velvet Sword
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:magic)(Tag:weapon)Saint Trina's supernaturally sharp and durable velvet-dyed sword. It expends the user's energy to unleash the Mist of Eternal Sleep, putting targets into slumber that cannot be broken even by harm; stronger targets need longer exposure and wake more easily.

name: Ferryman's Favor
description: #(Tag:spirit)(Tag:ticket)An IOU cheque proving Charon the Ferryman owes you a favor. Tearing it has Charon bring you any one dead soul from the world you tore it in, plus the largest part of their corpse, with soul and body in separate sealed containers.

name: Sentry Turrets
description: #(Tag:gun)(Tag:machine)(Tag:tech)(Tech) A shipment of 9 Aperture Science Sentry Turrets with twin machine guns, cheap and reliable for keeping out intruders. Bullet reserves refill every 24 hours (bullets cannot be removed). Restock Timer: 168 hours.

name: Barrel of Everflowing Oil
description: #(Tag:production)(Tag:resource)A standard black barrel containing infinite quality medium crude oil that flows at 10 gallons per minute when tipped. If damaged or forcefully modified, it loses this property.

name: Job Application Form
description: #(Tag:tool)"Does this scare you?" An ordinary-looking job application form that, when correctly filled and handed to an employer, guarantees the applicant is hired regardless of job or qualifications, though not that they keep the job. Single use.

name: Ancient Fruit Wine
description: #(Tag:consumable)A bottle of finest Iridium Quality Ancient Fruit Wine, handcrafted and aged with superb refined taste but no supernatural effects and high artisan value. Restock Timer: 12 hours.

name: Satchel of Seeds
description: #(Tag:nature)(Tag:production)An ordinary-looking satchel with virtually unlimited Earth-surface seeds and saplings from 2020; reach in while thinking of the target to retrieve it, up to 10 kg every 24 hours. Includes a notepad detailing every item inside.

name: Dunce Cap
description: #(Tag:accessory)A simple white cap reading "dunce," used to shame someone.

name: Hera's Breastmilk
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:elixir)(Tag:growth+)"Hey, it worked for Hercules" A bottle of Goddess Hera's freshly squeezed breastmilk; drinking the entire bottle vastly increases bodily potential, letting even a regular human train to superhuman strength and durability without increasing talent or training speed. Restock Timer: 168 hours.

name: Mystic Eye Killers
description: #(Tag:accessory)Stylish ordinary-looking glasses that suppress the wearer's eye-based abilities and magic while granting resistance to others' ocular abilities. Overwhelmingly strong abilities can overpower this effect.

name: Nichirin Ingots
description: #(Tag:fire+)(Tag:material)3 5 kg ingots of sunlight-absorbed Scarlet Ore Nichirin, a very durable anti-demon metal that amplifies Fire-based abilities and withstands extreme temperatures without deforming. Restock Timer: 120 hours.

name: Relic of Knowledge
description: #(Tag:divination)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:summon)(Tag:tool)A divine Brother Gods relic that summons the spirit Jinn, who answers one question per use as long as a non-divine being in your current world knows the answer. You may converse with the smart, wise, non-combatant Jinn freely, but gain another question only every 720 hours.

name: Desert Key
description: #(Tag:dimension)An ornate key that when turned in a large space creates a portal to a 5 km x 5 km x 5 km desert pocket dimension with harsh sun, strong wind, and cold nights where few creatures survive. The exit gate stays open and leads to where the entrance was last opened.

name: Forest Key
description: #(Tag:dimension)(Tag:nature)An ornate key that when turned in a large space creates a portal to a 5 km x 5 km x 5 km temperate forest pocket dimension full of life, resources, and Earth natives like wolves. The exit gate stays open and leads to where the entrance was last opened.

name: Beach Key
description: #(Tag:dimension)An ornate key that when turned in a large space creates a portal to a 10 km x 10 km x 10 km beach and sea pocket dimension full of sea life, ideal for fishing or vacation. The exit gate stays open and leads to where the entrance was last opened.

name: Tundra Key
description: #(Tag:dimension)An ornate key that when turned in a large space creates a portal to a 5 km x 5 km x 5 km frozen tundra pocket dimension with perpetual cold, snowstorms, some Earth life, and visible northern lights. The exit gate stays open and leads to where the entrance was last opened.

name: Dust Mines Key
description: #(Tag:dimension)(Tag:resource)An ornate key that when turned in a large space creates a portal to a 500 km x 500 km x 500 km lifeless cave pocket dimension containing Raw Dust Crystals and rarer varieties in lesser amounts, requiring special equipment and caution to excavate. The exit gate stays open and leads to where the entrance was last opened.

name: Magic Lake Key
description: #(Tag:dimension)(Tag:energy-regeneration+)An ornate key that when turned in a large space creates a portal to a 5 km x 5 km x 5 km cave pocket dimension with a giant crystal-blue magically charged lake. Bathing in it speeds energy recovery, and its water is an excellent alchemical ingredient. The exit gate stays open and leads to where the entrance was last opened.

name: Hot Springs Key
description: #(Tag:dimension)(Tag:health-regeneration+)An ornate key that when turned in a large space creates a portal to a 5 km x 5 km x 5 km pocket dimension with a small mountain, natural healing hot springs, bamboo forest, and great view; the mountain cannot be descended. Springs slightly accelerate natural healing and replenish automatically. The exit gate stays open and leads to where the entrance was last opened.

name: Apartments Key
description: #(Tag:dimension)An ornate key that when turned in a large space creates a portal to a 1 googol kilometers cubed pocket dimension lined with lifeless but powered Earth-standard apartments facing an empty center. The exit gate stays open and leads to where the entrance was last opened.

name: Silver Samurai Armor
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:blade)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:tech)An Adamantium-plated powered exoskeleton with superheated Adamantium blade, over 100 tons lifting strength, and life support letting even a sick old man use it fully. It conforms to any vaguely humanoid user and recharges to full within an hour when not in active use. (Mutagen manipulation device not included).

name: Psycho
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:mental)An addictive soldier's combat drug that suppresses pain, induces bloodthirsty haze, and boosts reflexes, metabolism, and concentration, with heavy addiction and side effects a skilled chemist might improve. You get 8 doses in a bandoleer. Restock Timer: 24 hours.

name: Mentats
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:mind+)A miracle drug that temporarily heightens mental clarity, thought speed, and memory retention, but is highly addictive and overuse can cause permanent memory loss and mental disorders a skilled chemist might fix. You get a box of 8 doses. Restock Timer: 76 hours.

name: Buffout
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:defence+)(Tag:stamina+)(Tag:strength+)A potent temporary pre-war steroid that boosts endurance, strength, and reflexes enough to punch through wood and shrug off a baseball bat. Restock Timer: 76 hours.

name: Super Rod
description: #(Tag:tool)A baitless fishing rod that lures compelled fish and is more likely to attract quality or powerful sea-dwellers.

name: Dragonslayer Spear
description: #(Tag:anti-dragon)(Tag:electric)(Tag:polearm)(Tag:weapon)Ornstein the Dragonslayer's large essence-imbued spear that channels the user's energy to wreathe it in lightning. It is more lethal against draconic enemies.

name: Cipher Pata
description: #(Tag:fist)(Tag:holy)(Tag:weapon)A holy hand-worn blade of shapeless ciphers that is almost impossible to clash with. Its power scales with the user's maximum energy.

name: Crystal Spear
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:polearm)(Tag:resource)(Tag:weapon)A pure-crystal spear tougher than steel that can also serve as a magic-casting catalyst like a wand.

name: Pharis' Bow
description: #(Tag:bow)(Tag:weapon)The legendary archer Pharis' finely crafted powerful long-range bow, retaining essence that slightly aids aim. Comes with 30 standard arrows that restock every 24 hours.

name: Glock
description: #(Tag:gun)(Tag:weapon)(Tech) The reliable, simple Glock 19 for most basic handgun needs. You get a magazine every 24 hours.

name: Darkmoon Bow
description: #(Tag:bow)(Tag:magic)(Tag:weapon)Gwyndolin's Darkmoon bow that empowers arrows with your magical energy plus moon energy, with greater effect on its special moonlight arrows. Comes with 24 arrows that restock every 48 hours.

name: Silver Spoon
description: #(Tag:anti-infernal)(Tag:anti-monster)(Tag:holy)(Tag:tool)A pure silver spoon personally blessed by the heavenly god, extremely lethal against vampires, ghouls, werewolves, and similar beings. Doubles as cutlery.

name: Irithyll Knight Set
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:blade)(Tag:ice)(Tag:ice-resistance+)(Tag:polearm)(Tag:weapon)Pontiff Sulyvahn Outrider armor and weapons forever cloaked in freezing mist: Irithyll Straightsword, Irithyll Rapier, Pontiff Knight Curved Sword, Pontiff Knight Great Scythe, and conforming Outrider Armor with great defense and cold protection. Infusing the blades with energy drops their temperature further and emits freezing mist.

name: Vordt's Great Hammer
description: #(Tag:bludgeon)(Tag:ice)(Tag:ice+)(Tag:weapon)Vordt of the Boreal Valley's incredibly heavy titanite great hammer, requiring inhuman strength to swing, with a frost-imbued head forever below freezing. It boosts ice-based abilities channeled through it.

name: Sunlight Sword
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:defence+)(Tag:electric+)(Tag:holy)(Tag:holy+)(Tag:strength+)(Tag:weapon)A simple-looking expert Anor Londo straight blade holding Sunlight power. Raising it to praise the sun while imbuing energy strengthens you and nearby allies physically for 3 minutes, 30-minute cooldown. Boosts lightning and fire abilities channeled through it.

name: Reduvia
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:dagger)(Tag:life)(Tag:weapon)The Lord of Blood servants' jagged blood-dripping dagger that fires its never-drying blood as a flying slash when infused with energy. Slightly reduces Vitality costs of abilities and effects while held.

name: Dragonslayer Swordspear
description: #(Tag:anti-dragon)(Tag:electric)(Tag:electric+)(Tag:polearm)(Tag:weapon)The Nameless King's lightning-infused dragonslaying swordspear. Expending energy calls down a sky bolt and strengthens its lightning cloak. Boosts lightning abilities when used as a focus.

name: Holy Hand Grenade of Antioch
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:holy)(Tag:weapon)A saint-blessed grenade with 1 kiloton of power that deals extra damage to unholy enemies. Restock Timer: 24 hours.

name: Arc Reactor
description: #(Tag:machine)(Tag:tech)(Tech) Tony Stark's revolutionary Arc Reactor using a new element difficult even for tinkers to replicate. It runs indefinitely, providing over 5 gigajoules per second.

name: Vorpan
description: #(Tag:bludgeon)(Tag:tool)(Tag:weapon)An unbreakable frying pan that doubles as a practical cooking utensil and hits slightly stronger than usual.

name: Costume Wardrobe
description: #(Tag:production)A regular closet with infinite mundane clothing under 5 kg and under a standard gold coin in value, appearing per the reacher's desires, from lingerie to formal to cosplay. Only 50 outfits per day.

name: Golden Apple Tree
description: #(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:nature)(Tag:production)A seed growing a tree that bears Golden Apples (uncommon item), requiring very nutrient-dense soil and an energy-rich environment to flourish.

name: Gag of Silence
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:nsfw)(Tag:stealth)A red ball gag that suppresses all noise from the wearer when worn. Useful for spies and ninjas.

name: Veil of Invisibility
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:nsfw)(Tag:stealth)A cloak that turns the wearer invisible as long as it is their only clothing.

name: Feline Attachment
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:agility+)(Tag:nsfw)(Tag:reflex+)(Nsfw) A cat-tail buttplug that when worn increases reflexes, agility, balance, and acrobatics while reducing fall damage.

name: Bondage of Enduring
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:defence+)(Tag:nsfw)(Tag:stamina+)(Nsfw) Bondage ropes worn in place of clothes that boost durability and stamina regeneration and convert pain into pleasure.

name: Bunny's Blessings
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:social)(Nsfw) A raunchy bunny-ears headband and bunny-tail buttplug set that slightly increases charm and appeal to others.

name: Prayer Beads
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:holy+)(Tag:nsfw)(Nsfw) Silver devotional beads that boost Holy and faith-based abilities and connection to Holy beings while all beads are inside the anal cavity.

name: Whip of Ecstasy
description: #(Tag:flexible)(Tag:nsfw)(Tag:weapon)(Nsfw) A supernaturally durable whip that deals only superficial harm, converting the rest of its normal damage into sexual pleasure.

name: Helltaker's Apron
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:skill+)The Helltaker's black Satan-embroidered apron that speeds cooking improvement, especially pancakes.

name: Second Skin
description: #(Tag:agility+)(Tag:armor)(Tag:defence+)(Tag:strength+)A skintight ultra-light black bodysuit that stimulates body and muscles to unlock latent power and physical performance while amplifying sensation; less efficient over other clothing. Tougher than steel and slowly self-mending if torn.

name: Bucket of Milk
description: #(Tag:ailment-recovery)(Tag:consumable)A bucket with 1 liter of milk that, if drunk in one motion, dispels all current unnatural afflictions, curses, sickness, magical effects, good or bad, but not wounds, lacking restorative properties, nor effects that have become part of the drinker.

name: Shikai - Ryujin Jakka
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:bound)(Tag:fire)(Tag:fire+)(Tag:growing)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:weapon)A soul-bound spiritual katana manifesting a raging inferno; output, control, and blade strength scale with the user, defaulting to boulder-shattering and house-burning. Amplifies the user's fire abilities. (A/N: Does not give spiritual energy, cannot be evolved).

name: Bankai - Ryujin Jakka
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:bound)(Tag:fire)(Tag:fire+)(Tag:necro)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:weapon)Ryujin Jakka's Bankai, a burnt blade whose power and heat scale with the user, granting four directional abilities: East concentrates all flames in the blade for maximum destruction, West cloaks the body in extreme defensive heat, South raises slain corpses as puppets, and North unleashes all power in a superheated slash. (A/N: Does not give spiritual energy, cannot be evolved).

name: Shikai - Shinso
description: #(Tag:bound)(Tag:growing)(Tag:polearm)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:weapon)Shinso, a soul-bound wakizashi whose strength scales with the user. Its Shikai extends its length, with max size and speed scaling with the user and defaulting to 10x base length. (A/N: Does not give spiritual energy, cannot be evolved).

name: Bankai - Shinso
description: #(Tag:bound)(Tag:polearm)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:weapon)Shinso's Bankai, a soul-bound wakizashi at maximum power whose strength scales with the user. It extends to insane lengths at blinding speed, up to several kilometers and nigh unreactable if the user is strong enough, without the poison ability. (A/N: Does not give spiritual energy, cannot be evolved).

name: Shikai - Kyokai Suigetsu
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:bound)(Tag:mental)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:weapon)Kyokai Suigetsu, a soul-bound katana scaling with the user, places viewers under "Absolute Hypnosis" to manipulate all 5 senses, persisting after Shikai ends if they saw its release. Hypnosis effectiveness scales with user-target power difference. (A/N: Does not give spiritual energy, cannot be evolved).

name: Shikai - Minazuki
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:bound)(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:summon)(Tag:weapon)Minazuki, a soul-bound katana scaling with the user, transforms by command into a giant flying creature that swallows people to heal them, with healing scaling with the user. (A/N: Does not give spiritual energy, cannot be evolved).

name: Bankai - Minazuki
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:bound)(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:life)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:summon)(Tag:weapon)Minazuki's Bankai, a soul-bound katana at maximum power scaling with the user, covers the battlefield in a controlled blood-like substance to enhance attacks or heal self and others, with potency scaling with the user. (A/N: Does not give spiritual energy, cannot be evolved).

name: Shikai - Tachikaze
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:air+)(Tag:blade)(Tag:bound)(Tag:growing)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:weapon)Tachikaze, a soul-bound wakizashi scaling with the user, sends detonatable empowered wind slashes and boosts wind abilities channeled through it. (A/N: Does not give spiritual energy, cannot be evolved).

name: Bankai - Tachikaze
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:air+)(Tag:armor)(Tag:blade)(Tag:bound)(Tag:fist)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:weapon)Tachikaze's Bankai, soul-bound wrapping knuckle-dusters with upper-body armor at maximum power scaling with the user, releases powerful wind explosions with every punch and boosts wind abilities channeled through it. (A/N: Does not give spiritual energy, cannot be evolved).

name: Shikai - Gonryomaru
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:bound)(Tag:electric)(Tag:electric+)(Tag:growing)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:weapon)Gonryomaru, a soul-bound rapier scaling with the user, wraps its blade in lightning to empower it and fire lightning slashes, boosting electricity abilities channeled through it. (A/N: Does not give spiritual energy, cannot be evolved).

name: Bankai - Gonryomaru
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:bound)(Tag:electric)(Tag:electric+)(Tag:spirit)Gonryomaru's Bankai, a soul-bound rapier at maximum power scaling with the user, controls weather to call down powerful lightning and wreaths the sword in violent lightning, greatly boosting electricity abilities channeled through it. (A/N: Does not give spiritual energy, cannot be evolved).

name: Asauchi
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:bound)(Tag:growing)(Tag:spirit)Asauchi, a dormant unnamed soul-bound weapon that fits and grows with the user, scaling with them. Unlocking Shikai grants a unique user-natured ability at or below Rare rank, upgraded to Epic rank upon unlocking Bankai.

name: Hell Hammer
description: #(Tag:bludgeon)(Tag:fire)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:weapon)An incredibly durable infernal hammer of hellflame-tempered steel that bursts into hellflame explosions on impact proportional to physical force.

name: Exorcists Mace
description: #(Tag:bludgeon)(Tag:holy)(Tag:weapon)A blessed sanctified-steel mace, incredibly durable and formidable, suffused with Holy Light. Exceptionally effective against Unholy entities.

name: Clergy Ring
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:holy)(Tag:magic)An angel-blessed ring gaining 1 charge every 8 hours up to 3, each activating one effect: 1: Smite - charges fists or held weapon with holy energy for the next strike. 2: Blessing - boosts one chosen physical stat for 5 minutes. 3: Purify - cures afflictions with strength scaling with user energy.

name: Thalasin
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:mental)Thalasin - A prescription box with packs of 8 pills each that chemically induce their emotion regardless of biology, including Anger, Sadness, Happiness, Fear, Relief, Hope, Frustration, Pride, Lust, etc. Restock Timer: 24 hours.

name: Evil Ring
description: #(Tag:tool)A mundane iron ring of exceptional evil and malice, but with no ability to affect anything or communicate to act on it.

name: Heavy Rock
description: #(Tag:tool)An ordinary head-sized rock always slightly heavier than its lifter's maximum liftable weight.

name: Farmland Key
description: #(Tag:dimension)(Tag:nature)(Tag:production)(Tag:resource)An ornate key that when turned in a large space creates a portal to a 10 km x 10 km x 10 km tilled farmland pocket dimension with refilling pond and farmhouse, where always-fertile dirt grows any magical or mundane crop tended tirelessly by Scarecrow golems. The dimension's water and dirt cannot be taken out. The exit gate stays open and leads to where the entrance was last opened.

name: Element Zero
description: #(Tag:gravity)(Tag:material)A sealed insulated crate of 5 tons of super-rare Element Zero ("Eezo") that when electrically stimulated creates a "Mass Effect" field raising or lowering nearby objects' virtual mass. Restock Timer: 48 hours.

name: Ahzidial
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:fire)(Tag:fire+)(Tag:fire-resistance+)An enchanted Ebony dragon priest mask granting Fire and heat resistance while boosting Fire affinity and Fire abilities' potency.

name: Zahkriisos
description: #(Tag:air-resistance+)(Tag:armor)(Tag:electric+)(Tag:electric-resistance+)An enchanted Ebony dragon priest mask granting Lightning and Wind resistance while boosting Lightning affinity and Lightning abilities' potency.

name: Dukaan
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:ice)(Tag:ice+)(Tag:ice-resistance+)An enchanted Ebony dragon priest mask granting Ice and Cold resistance while boosting Ice affinity and Ice abilities' potency.

name: Otar
description: #(Tag:air-resistance+)(Tag:armor)(Tag:electric-resistance+)(Tag:fire-resistance+)(Tag:ice-resistance+)An enchanted Malachite dragon priest mask granting considerable resistance to Ice, Cold, Heat, Fire, and Lightning.

name: Stormbreaker
description: #(Tag:air+)(Tag:blade)(Tag:bludgeon)(Tag:electric)(Tag:electric+)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:health-regeneration+)(Tag:weapon)A mastercraft Uru axe-hammer complementing Thor's powers, telekinetically commandable, granting flight, immense physicality, and regeneration. It commands lightning and storms in massive waves or sky-called bolts, and massively enhances Sky and Lightning abilities as a focus. (Not connected to Bifrost).

name: The Trumpet of Apocalypse
description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:light)(Tag:summon)(Tag:tool)"Judgement" The Apocalypse Trumpet that when blown summons a self-fueled [Heavenly Gate (Mythical)] unleashing a massive angel army including Dominions, Principalities, Thrones, and 4 Seraphim before vanishing. The army lasts indefinitely as independent entities under your command.

name: Can of Whoopass
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:summon)A regular tin can labeled with its function; opening it summons 6 Gold Familiar Gacha familiars to beat the opener to death. They persist with intense focus until the target dies, then disappear.

name: Hephaestus' Forge Key
description: #(Tag:building)(Tag:production)(Tag:tool)An ornate key that when turned in a large space creates a portal to a 100mx100m godworthy forge pocket dimension with unbreakable tools and a furnace hotter than the sun's core yet safe. Nothing originally in the forge can be removed. The exit gate stays open and leads to where the entrance was last opened.

name: Shrimp Fried Rice
description: #(Tag:consumable)A plate of excellent fried rice by the greatest Shrimp chef in his universe, whose culinary school credentials should not be doubted.

name: Safeguard Ring
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:movement)"Safety is paramount." A worn ring that upon detecting considerable danger covers the wearer in a Rare rank Barrier and teleports them to the safest location within 25000 meters. It breaks after use. Restock Timer: 168 hours.

name: Kitchen Gun
description: #(Tag:tool)It's the kitchen gun! Aim at dirty appliances, countertops, or furniture and pull the trigger to shoot-clean the target.

name: Loud Ring of Invisibility
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:stealth)A wooden light-bending invisibility ring that continuously screams to reveal the wearer, yelling things like "THEY ARE HERE!" and "LOOK OVER HERE!"

name: Clergy Robes
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:curse-resistance+)(Tag:dark-resistance+)(Tag:infernal-resistance+)Faithful white-and-black clergy garb of very tough fabric granting minor resistance to darkness, curses, and negative energy.

name: One Day Blinding Stew
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:curse)An unusually hot, spicy yet nutritious stew for misbehavers that blinds the drinker for 24 hours. Restock Timer: 12 hours.

name: Clown Nose
description: #(Tag:mundane)A bright red clown nose that honks when squeezed.

name: Sword of the Storm
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:air+)(Tag:blade)(Tag:weapon)An intangible Shen Gong Wu sword that when imbued with energy creates powerful winds and enhances wind and weather abilities.

name: Third Arm Sash
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:weapon)A Shen Gong Wu sash acting as a controllable third arm, long, flexible, and considerably stronger than a grown person.

name: Ascalon
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:blade)(Tag:defence+)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:mental-resistance+)(Tag:reality-manipulation)(Tag:weapon)Azmuth's Ascalon, one of the universe's greatest weapons, channeling reality's fundamental forces to create Cosmic-energy armor granting immense physical boost, defense, and mental immunity. It can cleave anything including realms, reality, and spacetime for teleportation, and project energy slashes. It can deflect, reflect, and cut energy itself, and drain the powers of opponents it stabs.

name: Duffel of Hardware
description: #(Tag:machine)(Tag:production)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tool)(Tech) A simple backpack with unlimited average-hardware-store contents, retrieved by physically reaching in for a known item.

name: The Market Catalogue
description: #(Tag:production)(Tag:tech)(Tag:tool)(Tech) A catalogue ordering anything from any regularly accessible Base Earth store for instant delivery. Everything costs double, adjusted to your current world's economy.

name: Surplus Stockpile
description: #(Tag:production)(Tag:resource)(Tag:tech)(Tech) A cardboard box of seemingly infinite mundane raw materials like wood, stone, ore, and rope, with only 50 kg removable every 24 hours. If lost or destroyed, you will stumble upon it intact when searching.

name: Box of Scraps
description: #(Tag:machine)(Tag:production)(Tag:resource)(Tag:tech)(Tech) "If Tony Stark could make do with it, so can you" A box of unlimited scrapped Earth electronics the average Joe discarded, retrieved only by reaching in, no tipping.

name: Scrapyard
description: #(Tag:building)(Tag:machine)(Tag:production)(Tag:resource)(Tag:tech)(Tech) A placeable 250 x 250 meter scrapyard that fills over time with scrap from Earth copies, from busted cars to discarded electronics, rarely an almost-intact military tank or a rotten bed.

name: Peach Tree
description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:nature)An apotropaic Peach Tree whose leaves, bark, wood, and fruit ward evil, curses, and demons, with wooden swords as effective as steel against ghosts or demons. Comes with multiple saplings.

name: Thirty Dollars
description: #(Tag:meta)Thirty dollars in cash.

name: Life Fiber Loom
description: #(Tag:life)(Tag:production)A large sophisticated Loom weaving Life Fibers for clothing by sacrificing own or others' vitality into fiber. Higher-quality lifeforce yields more fiber.

name: Flesh Eater Core
description: #(Tag:implant)(Tag:race-change)(Tag:transformation)A perfected Flesh Eater Core that when pressed into a chest merges to make a Blade-Living Being mix with increased stats, signature element, and manifestable signature weapon. As a Flesh Eater they may choose a suitable Driver to draw energy from and share Blade powers with.

name: Empty Key
description: #(Tag:dimension)An ornate crystal key that when turned in a large area creates a portal to a 100 km x 100 km x 100 km emptiness dimension containing only air and an indestructible glass-like floor. The exit portal stays open and leads to where the key was last used.

name: Clarent
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:weapon)Clarent, Mordred's Brilliantly Shining Royal Sword that slew Artoria Pendragon, amplifies physical abilities, energy output, and charisma while the wielder rightfully holds the title of King. Killing a Monarch with it transforms it into Clarent Blood, lifting restrictions for free use; otherwise it is only a very durable blunt blade.

name: Flesh Prison
description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:summon)A non-sentient angelic Prison of Flesh wielding Holy and Unholy energy to defend itself at all costs. It contains King Minos's Prime soul, released by slaying the prison; the occupant may not be friendly.

name: Jason's Mask
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:mundane)Jason Voorhees's iconic hockey mask, dirty and foul-smelling.

name: Green Spandex
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:growth+)(Tag:stamina+)A green spandex suit brimming with YOUTH!!!!! Worn with nothing else, it slightly boosts physical training gains and stamina recovery.

name: The House of Leaves
description: #(Tag:dimension)(Tag:mental)(Tag:space)A brass key that, turned in a sufficiently open space, opens a door to a pocket dimension containing a normal-looking suburban family home. Ignore its sometimes non-Euclidean geometry, shifting measurements, impossibly large labyrinthine structures, infohazards, and possibly murderous sentient house.

name: The Dragon Balls
description: #(Tag:draconic)(Tag:reality-manipulation)(Tag:summon)The seven dragon balls are scattered randomly across your current planet. Once gathered, Shenron grants the gatherer one wish within his power, or any ability below a 6.9 rating.

name: Pika Pika no Mi
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:light)(Tag:meta)(Tag:transformation)The Pika Pika no Mi is an awful-tasting Devil Fruit granting the ability [Light Logia](Divine). The first to digest any part gains the ability and renders the rest inert, but gains the Curse of the Sea: unable to use energy when submerged in still water with rapidly draining stamina. Stacking two Curses of the Sea on one person kills them instantly.

name: Magu Magu no Mi
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:earth)(Tag:fire)(Tag:meta)(Tag:transformation)The Magu Magu no Mi is an awful-tasting Devil Fruit granting the ability [Magma Logia](Mythical). The first to digest any part gains the ability and renders the rest inert, but gains the Curse of the Sea: unable to use energy when submerged in still water with rapidly draining stamina. Stacking two Curses of the Sea on one person kills them instantly.

name: Hie Hie no Mi
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:ice)(Tag:meta)(Tag:transformation)The Hie Hie no Mi is an awful-tasting Devil Fruit granting the ability [Ice Logia](Mythical). The first to digest any part gains the ability and renders the rest inert, but gains the Curse of the Sea: unable to use energy when submerged in still water with rapidly draining stamina. Stacking two Curses of the Sea on one person kills them instantly.

name: Bashonen
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:earth)(Tag:electric)(Tag:fire)(Tag:tool)(Tag:water)(Tag:weapon)Bashonen is a large fan that releases large amounts of one of five elements (Fire, Wind, Earth, Lightning, Water) when swung with imbued energy and a verbal command. Output scales with energy expended.

name: Sword of the Thundergod
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:electric)(Tag:electric+)(Tag:weapon)A Vajra-shaped sword handle that forms a lightning energy blade when imbued with energy, scaling in power with energy imbued. Electricity-based abilities channeled through it are more potent.

name: Knuckleblaster
description: #(Tag:implant)(Tag:kinetic)(Tag:tech)A ticket that, when torn, installs this strong close-combat mechanical arm onto the tearer. It generates shells from spare metal to expend for shockwaves.

name: The Slave Waiver
description: #(Tag:command)(Tag:tool)A simple notebook containing explicit rules for how it works. A signer who has read the rules and is smart enough to comprehend the consequences relinquishes all rights to you, must obey all your commands, and cannot act against you.

name: Phone A Friend
description: #(Tag:tool)A simple one-use landline phone. Dial while picturing the face of someone whose name you know in your current universe and they receive a copy to answer with. Calls last at most 1 hour, after which the phone is erased from existence.

name: Ejaculatte
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:nsfw)(Nsfw)(Noncon) A strangely branded but normal-looking can of coffee that makes the drinker orgasm intensely and uncontrollably when drunk. Restock Timer: 8 hours.

name: The Census
description: #(Tag:divination)(Tag:tool)A book listing name, address, occupation, and short bio of every named living sapient creature within a 1 million-kilometer range. It auto-sorts and filters by age, race, address, height, etc. per your specifications, and you can open directly to a being's page if you know their name and appearance.

name: Extremely Loud Metal Pipe
description: #(Tag:tool)An ordinary-looking aluminum pipe that produces an extremely loud clatter when dropped, enough to cause nearby hearing damage.

name: Hell Taxes
description: #(Tag:infernal)(Tag:material)(Tag:spirit)Hell now owes you taxes, paid as 100 envelopes each containing a sinner's soul. Use or trade them as you like. Restock Timer: 336 hours.

name: Heaven Taxes
description: #(Tag:holy)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:summon)Even Heaven owes you taxes, paid as 100 envelopes each containing a dose of Holy Energy. Each dose works as an uncommon healing spell or an uncommon dispel, or 50 envelopes at once can invoke the Ability: Summon Angelic Guardian once. Restock Timer: 336 hours.

name: Hircine's Ring
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:transformation)(Tag:transformation+)Hircine's daedric artifact lets the wearer turn into a Werewolf at will and grants greater control over any transformation-based ability.

name: Physician's Ring
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:dexterity+)(Tag:mind+)(Tag:skill+)A simple platinum and pink diamond ring that, when worn, increases comprehension, dexterity, and mental acuity for medical matters like medicine-making or surgery.

name: Leather Bag of Holding
description: #(Tag:storage)(Tag:tool)A worn leather bag of holding containing 1x1x1m of space inside. Anyone reaching inside instinctively knows its contents and how to retrieve what they want.

name: Bronze Bag of Holding
description: #(Tag:storage)(Tag:tool)A dashing bronze bag of holding containing 5x5x5m of space inside. Anyone reaching inside instinctively knows its contents and how to retrieve what they want.

name: Silver Bag of Holding
description: #(Tag:storage)(Tag:tool)A proper silver bag of holding containing 25x25x25m of space inside. Anyone reaching inside instinctively knows its contents and how to retrieve what they want.

name: Golden Bag of Holding
description: #(Tag:storage)(Tag:tool)An exceptional gold bag of holding containing 100x100x100m of space inside. Anyone reaching inside instinctively knows its contents and how to retrieve what they want. Time and space do not flow properly inside, keeping everything in stasis.

name: Platinum Bag of Holding
description: #(Tag:storage)(Tag:tool)A brilliant shimmering platinum bag of holding containing a 2500x2500x2500m subspace inside. Anyone reaching inside instinctively knows its contents and how to retrieve what they want. It can place contents in spatial stasis and clean them if the user wishes.

name: Diamond Bag of Holding
description: #(Tag:storage)(Tag:tool)A Diamond-woven new frontier in Bag of Holding engineering containing a timeless 100x100x100 km subspace. Anyone reaching inside instinctively knows its contents and how to retrieve what they want. It can split into up to 100 bags sharing the same subspace and remerge into one.

name: Gate of Holding
description: #(Tag:storage)(Tag:tool)(Tag:weapon)An ornate key that, while in your possession, lets you expend energy to open portals to a nigh-infinite timeless holding dimension for inanimate objects only. You always know its contents and can drop or eject chosen contents at considerable speed by expending more energy.

name: Tobimune
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:fire)(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:movement)(Tag:perception+)(Tag:weapon)One of the Seven Enchanted Blades, Tobimune amplifies the user's energy to power 3 abilities but is very difficult to master; a true master can unlock more. It creates and controls Black Feathers for wings and sensory awareness: Crow swaps you or your weapon with any feather in range; Owl creates massive sky eyes that massively expand sensory range; Suzaku expends energy for flames that heal you and damage enemies.

name: Cloud Gouger
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:electric)(Tag:fire)(Tag:ice)(Tag:weapon)One of the Seven Enchanted Blades, Cloud Gouger amplifies the user's energy into Clouds and Cloud Dragons for three techniques. Mei turns them into powerful lightning bolts or a speed-boosting lightning cloak; Yui turns them into massive ice bursts and freezing; Kou turns them into massive water waves or dense mist.

name: Arata
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:bio)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:growing)Arata is a briefcase quinque made from the Corpse Collector's Kakuja that, when activated, clothes you in a Kakuja bodysuit far tougher than mundane metal and greatly boosts physical abilities. It places heavy strain on you and will try to eat you if worn too long.

name: Rubicante
description: #(Tag:bound)(Tag:fire)(Tag:gun)(Tag:weapon)Dubbed "Purgatory's Invitation", Rubicante is a flamethrower Teigu with a large wearable canister. It fires extremely hot glue-like flames that melt metal and cannot be extinguished even by water, plus fireball projectiles or a near-nuclear self-destruct blast. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to use and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.

name: Pumpkin
description: #(Tag:bound)(Tag:gun)(Tag:spirit)(Tag:tech)(Tag:weapon)(Tech) Dubbed "Roman Artillery", Pumpkin is a large gun Teigu that fires energy-beam projectiles using your energy reserves in sniper, rifle, and machine-gun modes. Output amplifies with your danger and emotional state. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to use and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.

name: Shambala
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:bound)(Tag:movement)(Tag:space)Dubbed "Dimensional Formation", Shambala is a pendant Teigu that teleports you and others over short and long distances via set sigils, but heavily strains stamina and usually needs time between uses. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to use and can only be used by people who are compatible with it. (A/N: Anime Exclusive Trump Card is not included).

name: L'Arc Qui Ne Faut
description: #(Tag:bound)(Tag:bow)(Tag:weapon)L'Arc Qui Ne Faut is a bow-and-quiver Teigu that forces fired arrows to infinitely track a named target while they remain in effective range. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.

name: Cross Tail
description: #(Tag:bound)(Tag:flexible)(Tag:weapon)Dubbed "Infinite Uses", Cross Tail is a glove-and-thread Teigu whose very durable flexible strings you manipulate with great precision, generating more thread from the spool with energy. Masters unlock Realm-Cutting Threads, nigh-unbreakable strings. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.

name: Erastone
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:bound)Dubbed "Absolute Limitation", Erastone is a crown Teigu whose jewel shines light that shatters all of the target's equipment and items weaker than Legendary rank. The jewel shatters after use and regenerates after a week-long cooldown. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.

name: Yatsufusa
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:bound)(Tag:necro)(Tag:summon)(Tag:weapon)Dubbed "March of the Dead", Yatsufusa is an incredibly durable sharp katana Teigu that raises up to 8 corpses as puppets retaining their skills, abilities, and habits, but unable to grow stronger or learn. Each corpse drains part of your strength, returned when buried. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master, can only be used by compatible people, and Yatsufusa demands a macabre mindset.

name: Spectator
description: #(Tag:bound)(Tag:illusion)(Tag:implant)(Tag:perception+)Dubbed "Almighty Five Sights", Spectator is a bonding mechanical third-eye Teigu that massively boosts vision to read minute muscle movements, see through objects, and project sight like a camera to predict opponents. Its trump card makes a target perceive you as a loved one. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.

name: Absordex
description: #(Tag:bound)(Tag:energy-recovery)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:implant)(Tag:life)(Tag:weapon)Dubbed "Blood Collection", Absordex is a fang Teigu that drains living beings' blood by biting to restore your energy and temporarily boost physical abilities. Returns scale with blood quality and quantity. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.

name: Grand Chariot
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:bound)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:movement)Dubbed "Absolute Carnage", Grand Chariot is a short-sword Teigu that, when activated, dons you in incredibly resilient full armor boosting physical prowess and granting free flight, plus a built-in spear. It rapidly drains stamina and energy. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.

name: Incursio
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:bound)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:growing)(Tag:polearm)(Tag:stealth)(Tag:weapon)Dubbed "Demon Armor", Incursio is a shortsword "Key" Teigu that forms incredibly durable armor massively enhancing physical abilities, with camouflage invisibility and semi-living adaptation that evolves with user compatibility at massive stamina cost. A highly compatible user can further evolve and fuse with it into its original beast's full dragon form. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master, can only be used by compatible people, and may kill an incompatible activator outright.

name: Demon's Extract
description: #(Tag:bound)(Tag:consumable)(Tag:ice)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:meta)Dubbed "Demon God Manifestation", Demon's Extract is a chalice Teigu of super-class Danger Beast lifeblood granting those who fully drink and survive it telekinetic ice creation and freezing, including independent ice soldiers and functional ice arms. Surviving the drink requires inhuman willpower and a monstrous mindset. (A/N: No time stop trump card).

name: Perfector
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:bound)(Tag:dexterity+)Dubbed "Glorious Hands of God", Perfector is a glove Teigu that, when donned, grants finger dexterity and precision beyond any machine or tool. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.

name: Shitoukazer
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:bound)(Tag:vehicle)(Tag:weapon)Dubbed "National Defense Machine God", Shitoukazer is a massive pilotable mech Teigu entered via its chest core, with insane durability, physical strength, mortar barrages, homing missiles, and giant laser cannons. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it. (A/N: No Purge Mode).

name: Heavy Pressure
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:bound)(Tag:sound+)(Tag:tool)(Tag:weapon)Dubbed "Great Tremor", Heavy Pressure is a microphone Teigu turning your voice into stone-shattering shockwaves and amplifying sound-based abilities. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by compatible people, usually cheerful young women for some reason.

name: Scream
description: #(Tag:bound)(Tag:mental)(Tag:tool)Dubbed "Military Music Dream", Scream is a flute-like Teigu whose songs manipulate listeners' emotions toward anger, calm, courage, joy, or sorrow. Effects are resisted by strong willpower or dispelled by pain. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by compatible people with sufficient musical talent.

name: Shamshir
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:bound)(Tag:weapon)Dubbed "Moonlight Sword Dance", Shamshir is a durable sharp curved-sword Teigu firing flying slashes with your energy. Its power increases depending on the night's moon phase. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.

name: Murasame
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:bound)(Tag:curse)(Tag:poison)(Tag:weapon)Dubbed "One-Cut Killer", Murasame is a durable sharp sword Teigu that kills any living being with even a shallow cut via a heart-seeking poisonous curse, though stronger targets resist slightly. Experiencing great loss unlocks its trump card, briefly massively boosting speed and strength. As this item is a Teigu, it can only be used by compatible true killers who find it beautiful.

name: Balzac
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:bound)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:mind+)Dubbed "Power Surging", Balzac is a strange-mask Teigu that, while fully worn, unleashes your full mental and physical potential past all limits while heavily straining mind and body. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.
