name: Gaea Foundation
description: #(Tag:bound)(Tag:tool)(Tag:transformation)Dubbed "Phantasmagoria", Gaea Foundation is a large makeup-kit Teigu letting you disguise as any living being you have seen, with stamina drain rising as the form diverges from your body. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.

name: Rongo Rongo
description: #(Tag:bound)(Tag:divination)(Tag:earth)(Tag:tool)Dubbed "Complete Book of the World", Rongo Rongo is a book Teigu containing a detailed map and encyclopedia of your entire world with locations plus future natural disasters like earthquakes, tsunamis, storms, and rains. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.

name: Mastema
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:bound)(Tag:movement)(Tag:weapon)Dubbed "Thousand Mile Flight", Mastema is a disk Teigu forming wings for flight and volleys of sharp durable feather projectiles. Skilled users unlock the "Gods Wings" trump card, turning wings ethereal to reflect projectiles at large stamina cost. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.

name: Adramelech
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:bound)(Tag:electric)(Tag:electric+)(Tag:fist)(Tag:weapon)Dubbed "Thunder God's Rage", Adramelech is a gauntlet Teigu conjuring and sky-summoning electricity like lightning orbs, beams, and direct strikes by expending energy. Power scales with energy expended. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.

name: Extase
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:bound)(Tag:weapon)Dubbed "Cutter of Creation", Extase is a large-scissor Teigu with incredibly durable sharp blades that cut metal like ribbon. Its Trump Card emits blinding light from the blade. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.

name: Belvaac
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:bound)(Tag:weapon)Aptly dubbed "Double Bladed Axe", Belvaac is a dense short double-bladed axe Teigu landing devastating blows. It can split in two and be thrown to track opponents staying in range. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master, can only be used by compatible people, and prefers the very strong.

name: Black Marlin
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:bound)(Tag:water)(Tag:weapon)Dubbed "Water Dragon Possession", Black Marlin is an ornate ring Teigu letting the wearer telekinetically control nearby water and water-based liquids with energy and stamina. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.

name: Big Leaguer
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:bound)(Tag:electric)(Tag:fire)(Tag:ice)(Tag:necro)(Tag:tool)(Tag:weapon)Dubbed "Chaos Throw", Big Leaguer is a Teigu of 6 throwable elemental orbs: Storm for whirlwinds, Explosion for blasts, Fire for searing flames, Ice for freezing, Lightning for electric bolts, and Rot for eroding mist. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.

name: Lionel
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:bound)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:perception+)(Tag:transformation)Dubbed "King of Beasts Transformation", Lionel is a belt Teigu transforming you into a half-beast lion with increased physical abilities and sharp senses. It grants exceptional vitality and regeneration, regrowing eyes and reattaching limbs while you have stamina. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master, can only be used by compatible people, and Lionel prefers free-spirited busty women.

name: Hekatonkheires
description: #(Tag:bound)(Tag:summon)Dubbed "Magical Beast Transformation", Hekatonkheires is an ugly unlikeable dog-like Teigu that transforms into a larger form with great strength, blade-like teeth, and limb-regrowing regeneration unless its core breaks. Berserker mode further boosts it but leaves the Teigu unusable for a few days. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by compatible people; this overgrown rat has terrible taste. (A/N: Stylish modifications not included).

name: Horse Electrolytes
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:electric)A full container of powdered horse electrolytes. Drink it. Restock Timer: 1 hour.

name: Apple
description: #(Tag:consumable)A regular juicy shiny red apple that repels registered practicing doctors within 25 meters while you eat it. Restock Timer: 24 hours.

name: Blood Vial
description: #(Tag:blood)(Tag:consumable)(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:life)A Healing Church Blood Vial of diluted Blood Saint blood curing many ailments. Used moderately it considerably heals wounds and disease, but it is addictive and abuse can turn the susceptible into beasts.

name: Saint Blood Vial
description: #(Tag:blood)(Tag:consumable)(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:life)A Healing Church vial of pure Blood Saint blood with potent Old One traces, powerfully healing even severe injuries and illnesses. Yharnam blood is addictive, and overuse can turn the susceptible into beasts.

name: Surströmming
description: #(Tag:consumable)A can of fermented Baltic Sea Herring that smells and tastes foul. Only a disturbed mind enjoys it. Restock Timer: 30 minutes.

name: Magician's Hat
description: #(Tag:summon)(Tag:tool)A classic showman magician's hat that produces a rabbit or dove whenever you reach inside. Only one at a time, and you must reach in.

name: Artoria Fumo
description: #(Tag:fumo)(Tag:space)A Fumo of Britain's true king that, when shaken violently, temporarily enacts Avalon as a nigh-absolute barrier on the shaker. You cannot move or use abilities while it is active.

name: "Alice" Fumo
description: #(Tag:fumo)(Tag:meta)A Fumo of the Dear Girl that, when shaken violently, rerolls your most recently rolled ticket. Cooldown: 336 hours.

name: Node Fumo
description: #(Tag:fumo)(Tag:meta)A Fumo of the White Queen, Node, that makes all cooldowns and restock timers pass 5x faster while you sleep in the same building or room as it.

name: Mabel Fumo
description: #(Tag:fumo)(Tag:meta)A Fumo of a certain Girl of Nihility that produces a Random Gold Ticket it can be found holding every 168 hours.

name: Mary Sue Fumo
description: #(Tag:fumo)(Tag:meta)A Fumo of a certain Annoying Fairy that lets you change the type of any one ticket you hold by slamming or punching it against a wall. Cooldown: 168 hours.

name: Reimu Fumo
description: #(Tag:anti-dark)(Tag:anti-infernal)(Tag:fumo)A Fumo of a certain destitute Shrine Maiden that, when shaken violently, erects a spiritual barrier against Unholy/Dark beings around a location. Only one barrier at a time.

name: Cirno Fumo
description: #(Tag:fumo)(Tag:ice)A Fumo of a certain Genius Ice Fairy that freezes a target when smacked with it while imbued with your energy. Potency scales with energy expended and impact force.

name: Remilia Fumo
description: #(Tag:fumo)(Tag:luck+)A Fumo of the Scarlet Devil Mansion's mistress that, when shaken violently, grants you [Rabbit's Foot (Rare Trait)] luck for 24 hours, or inflicts [Jinx (Rare Ability)] for 24 hours when smacked on a target. Cooldown: 72 hours.

name: Flandre Fumo
description: #(Tag:anti-barrier)(Tag:anti-resistance)(Tag:fumo)A Fumo of a certain Destructive Vampire that, while held, lets you bypass all of a target's immunities and resistances like barriers, elemental immunity, magic resistance, and scrying resistance. (Does not bypass regular durability or magical toughness, etc.).

name: Patchouli Fumo
description: #(Tag:fumo)(Tag:growth+)(Tag:magic)A Fumo of a certain lazy magician that boosts all comprehension and learning speed for everyone in the same room, especially magic study in libraries.

name: Eirin Fumo
description: #(Tag:fumo)(Tag:recovery+)(Tag:skill+)A Fumo of a certain pharmacist granting temporary Adept Medicine skill and increased Healing ability and spell potency while held or worn on the head.

name: Suika Fumo
description: #(Tag:bludgeon)(Tag:fumo)(Tag:weapon)A Fumo of a certain drunk Oni that is exceptionally durable and can absorb your energy to temporarily increase density, making a fearsome bludgeon.

name: Youmu Fumo
description: #(Tag:fumo)(Tag:spirit)A Fumo of a certain half-phantom sword master that, when vigorously rubbed on a sword, temporarily blesses it with greater sharpness and the power to hit spiritual entities.

name: Ran Fumo
description: #(Tag:fumo)A Fumo of a certain fox shikigami possessing Master level Mathematics that will tackle any posed question if given a way to write calculations. Shaking speeds the process.

name: Suwako Fumo
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:fumo)(Tag:nature)A Fumo of a certain Mountain God letting you terraform surroundings with energy by diverting rivers, raising mountains, moving forests, creating caves, and more. Cannot be used for combat.

name: Koishi Fumo
description: #(Tag:fumo)(Tag:stealth)A Fumo of a certain easily overlooked yokai that boosts Stranger abilities and Traits while held or worn on the head. Left in a building or area, it makes that place easier to overlook and harder to perceive for newcomers.

name: Kaguya Fumo
description: #(Tag:fumo)A Fumo of a certain Lunar Princess that is eternal, returning to perfect condition almost instantly no matter the damage, tearing, smacking, milk-soaking, or wall-throwing.

name: Yuyuko Fumo
description: #(Tag:fumo)(Tag:necro)(Tag:social)(Tag:spirit)A Fumo of a certain Ghost Princess that passively attracts and pacifies departed souls. Affected ghosts and dead instinctively protect it and are far more agreeable to its holder.

name: Yuugi Fumo
description: #(Tag:fumo)(Tag:strength+)A Fumo of the Strongest Oni granting the holder passive [Strength (Rare)] without using an ability slot while held or worn on the head.

name: Utsuho Fumo
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:fumo)A Fumo of a certain Nuclear Bird that, when shaken vigorously or bonked on the head, starts a 10-second countdown to a 50-megaton nuclear explosion it ignores. Cooldown: 240 hours.

name: Kanako Fumo
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:fumo)(Tag:nature)A Fumo of a certain Sky God letting you alter surrounding weather and climate with energy like seasons, rain, and clouds. Cannot be used to hurt others or for combat.

name: Mokou Fumo
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:fumo)A Fumo of a certain Burning Immortal Girl that is immortal, returning to perfect condition almost instantly no matter the tearing, smacking, milk-soaking, or wall-throwing. Any surface rubbed with it spontaneously catches fire.

name: Junko Fumo
description: #(Tag:ailment-recovery)(Tag:fumo)(Tag:holy)A Fumo of a certain Grieving Woman that slowly purifies what it touches or maintains contact with, restoring rusted metal, curing disease, and clearing polluted rivers. Stronger Impurity or Corruption takes longer.

name: Tewi Fumo
description: #(Tag:fumo)(Tag:luck+)A Fumo of a certain Rabbit Yokai granting temporary [Rabbit's Foot (Rare Trait)] good luck while held or worn on the head.

name: Meiling Fumo
description: #(Tag:fumo)(Tag:growth+)A Fumo of a certain Lazy Gatekeeper that accelerates physical and martial development when training in the same room. Sleeping while hugging it greatly accelerates physical recovery.

name: Utsuho Deka Fumo
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:fumo)A Deka Fumo of a certain Nuclear Bird that passively produces up to 100 Terawatts of energy per second when hooked to something needing or transferring energy. While held, imbuing energy fires 50-megaton nuclear beams from its eyes.

name: Reimu Deka Fumo
description: #(Tag:anti-dark)(Tag:anti-infernal)(Tag:fumo)A Deka Fumo of a certain Floating Shrine Maiden that, where placed, erects a Holy Spiritual Barrier sanctifying the area. All Unholy/Dark beings below Elite rank are repelled, and breach survivors are weakened.

name: The Table
description: #(Tag:mundane)A large, sturdy, high-quality oak table stolen from Ashford High School after Nina Einstein violated it.

name: The Chair
description: #(Tag:mundane)Vergil Sparda's iconic cheap plastic chair, rumored to greatly increase the motivation of anyone sitting in it.

name: The Master Sword
description: #(Tag:anti-dark)(Tag:anti-infernal)(Tag:blade)(Tag:holy)(Tag:light)(Tag:weapon)The Master Sword, Blade that Vanquishes Evil and former sword of Goddess Hylia bathed in Sacred Flames, is nigh unbreakable. It deals extreme damage ignoring resistances to ALL Unholy and Darkness targets, fires light slashes when imbued, and grows permanently stronger by absorbing Holy energy while housing blessings. Only a worthy Hero of proven Pure Heart, Courage, Wisdom, and Power can wield it.

name: Hylian Shield
description: #(Tag:dark-resistance+)(Tag:infernal-resistance+)(Tag:magic-resistance+)(Tag:shield)The Legendary Hero of Hyrule's shield, tempered many times for the Knights of Hyrule. Besides absurd durability, it has great magic resistance and extreme resiliency to all Unholy or Darkness attacks.

name: Mirror Shield
description: #(Tag:anti-magic)(Tag:shield)An exceptional magical mirror-surfaced shield, only decent against physical attacks. It reflects all Light-based and Magical attacks hitting its mirror surface.

name: Bottle of Milk
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:health-recovery)A bottle of incredibly high-quality milk from Malon that restores some vitality and vigor when drunk. Restock Timer: 12 hours.

name: Earth Key
description: #(Tag:dimension)(Tag:earth)An ornate key that, turned in a sufficiently large space, opens a portal to a 20,000 km x 20,000 km x 20,000 km pocket dimension containing planet Earth. It holds a human-free version of Earth as untamed wilds. The exit gate stays open and leads to where the entrance was last opened.

name: Bathhouse Key
description: #(Tag:tool)An ornate key that, turned in a sufficiently large space, opens a portal to a 250x250x250m pocket dimension holding a luxurious opulent bathhouse. Homunculi attendants staff, maintain, and serve entrants, and its water excellently restores Health and Energy. The exit gate stays open and leads to where the entrance was last opened.

name: A chocolate chip cookie but with the chips picked off for some reason
description: #(Tag:infernal)(Tag:mundane)The saddest cookie you have ever seen. Giving it a restock timer would be an insult.

name: A handful of chocolate chips
description: #(Tag:mundane)Recently plucked off a cookie, still slightly warm with crumbs attached.

name: Space Stone
description: #(Tag:reality-manipulation)(Tag:space)(Tag:tool)One of the Infinity Stones with power to change the universe, letting the user manipulate space, open portals, siphon energy from space, and more. A strong user is needed to unleash it without devastating consequences.

name: Dojo Key
description: #(Tag:dimension)An ornate key that, turned in a sufficiently large space, opens a portal to a 1 km x 1 km x 1 km pocket dimension containing a large dojo with a moderate garden. It holds training dummies, sparring weapons, running water, uniforms, towels, and more, all restocked and repaired within 24 hours with debris removed. Nothing originating from the dojo can be taken out. The exit gate stays open and leads to where the entrance was last opened.

name: Flynn's Ring
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:strength+)Flynn's ring of the fabled thief slightly increases the wearer's physical strength the less they carry.

name: Witch Ring
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:fire+)Rings bestowed by the Witch of Izalith and her daughter on pyromancy successors, thrumming with strange warmth. When equipped, they increase fire ability and spell potency while reducing costs.

name: Father Garcia's Trenchcoat
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:curse-resistance+)(Tag:infernal-resistance+)"True faith looks forward, not back." Father Garcia's iconic fairly durable black trench coat that wards curses and negative energy from the wearer.

name: Father Garcia's Shotgun
description: #(Tag:gun)(Tag:holy)(Tag:weapon)"You shall drink the wrath of the Almighty." Father Garcia's shotgun for fighting demons and evil spirits, whose bullets hit intangible entities and are more effective against Unholy beings.

name: Big Hat Logan's Big Hat
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:magic)(Tag:skill+)Big Hat Logan's titular uncomfortably large hat of the legendary sorcerer that makes studying magic slightly easier when worn.

name: Bold & Brash
description: #(Tag:mundane)Squidward Quincy Tentacles's Bikini Bottom masterpiece that refreshes to perfect condition every 24 hours to protect the canvas.

name: Monster Fucker Permit
description: #(Tag:social)(Tag:tool)(Tag:transformation)(Noncon) "Officially Sanctioned by the Goat herself." Pointed at a monster or creature, this permit turns them into a more humanoid attractive member of your attracted gender and grants baseline intelligence if lacking. Authority figures accept it as legitimate proof you are qualified for monster-girl cases.

name: Berserker Armor
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:defence+)(Tag:strength+)A Dwarven Blacksmith's exceptionally durable magical armor that fits the wearer perfectly. It boosts performance by suppressing pain and mental limiters, impales you to pin your body together when damaged, and self-repairs over time. It amplifies negative emotions, requiring careful moderation.

name: The Cursed Ticket
description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:ticket)(Gacha) "Fancy your chances?" A ticket that, when torn, spins the Curse Roulette for the user and automatically applies the result and earned ticket to the recipient.

name: Metal Gear
description: #(Tag:mundane)A rather ordinary, if extraordinarily solid, iron gear.

name: Taimanin Changing Booth
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:production)A changing booth giving anyone a tailored Taimanin Suit for their abilities. Always skintight yet lightweight, mobile, bulletproof, exceptionally durable, and receptive to reinforcement abilities and spells. Only one outfit per person; re-entering repairs it.

name: Claidheamh Mor
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:energy-recovery)(Tag:weapon)"Don't even try to pronounce it" A very durable sharp zweihander that steals a portion of a beheaded victim's energy to refuel your own.

name: One Thousand Bottles of Baby Oil
description: #(Tag:mundane)Confiscated from a certain mansion. One thousand unbranded bottles of standard baby oil.

name: Soylent Green
description: #(Tag:resource)A tin of Soylent Green that is unappetizing but nutritious enough to prevent starvation, with taste varying by person. Restock Timer: 1 hour.

name: Prismatic Cloak
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:light-resistance+)(Tag:stealth)A white cloak that turns the user invisible by bending light when exposed to natural sunlight. It also reflects all light-based attacks below Epic rank.

name: Truants Stopwatch
description: #(Tag:mental)(Tag:tool)A silver stopwatch that, when started, speeds up the starter's perception. The longer it stays active, the more its energy drain grows exponentially.

name: Heavenly Tribulation Ticket
description: #(Tag:electric)(Tag:holy)(Tag:ticket)"Pissing off the Heavens has never been easier." When ripped, it summons a Heavenly Tribulation of sky-aimed energized lightning equal to an Epic rank attack meant to kill you. Withstanding and tempering with it considerably improves physical abilities.

name: Gravitational Beam Emitter
description: #(Tag:gravity)(Tag:gun)(Tag:tech)(Tag:weapon)(Tech) A super high-tech pistol-shaped device firing Condensed Graviton Energy Beams that rip through anything, with outputs from anti-personnel to anti-spacecraft. It draws energy from the user instead of ammo. Beware intense recoil.

name: The City
description: #(Tag:barracks)(Tag:growing)(Tag:machine)(Tag:production)(Tag:summon)(Tag:tech)(Tech) The City is a Dyson-sphere-origin megastructure of hyper-compressed defensive and computational layers, factories, cities, and terminals holding millions of impossibly advanced technologies and blueprints. Your key opens portals to any part and gives absolute command authority. For size it lives in a pocket universe but can open portals into your reality.

name: Erdtree Seed
description: #(Tag:curse-resistance+)(Tag:health-recovery)(Tag:nature)(Tag:poison-resistance+)A seed that sprouts a small ineffectual Erdtree, grown larger by supplying energy or ritually burying corpses beneath it. When strong enough it blesses those under its light, warding disease and curses, nourishing land, and boosting recovery and healing.

name: Undo Stone
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:meta)(Tree)(Meta:lock-refund) Single use. Crush the stone to lock one of your unlocked nodes and refund its core and points.

name: Tree Graft
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:implant)(Tag:meta)(Tag:nature)(Tree)(Meta:add-link:3) Three uses. Add a connection between two close, unconnected nodes.

name: Chaos Die
description: #(Tag:card)(Tag:meta)(Tree)(Meta:gacha:5) Single use. Roll to unlock a random locked node with rarity 5 or below for free.

name: Greater Wild Roll
description: #(Tag:meta)(Tree)(Meta:gacha:5-7) Single use. Roll to unlock a random locked node with rarity between 5 and 7 for free.

name: Duplicate
description: #(Tag:meta)(Tree)(Meta:duplicate:5) Single use. Unlock a random locked node that shares a source with one of your unlocked nodes (source not Generic), with rarity 5 or below.

name: Lifeline
description: #(Tag:meta)(Tree)(Meta:lifeline) Single use. Unlock any node adjacent to an unlocked node for free.

name: Recall
description: #(Tag:meta)(Tree)(Meta:recall) Single use. Undo your most recent unlock: the node is locked again and its core and points refunded.

name: Shuffle
description: #(Tag:meta)(Tree)(Meta:shuffle) Single use. Exchange the location and connections of a visible locked node with a random not-visible locked node of similar rarity (±0.2). If no not-visible candidate exists, a visible one is chosen.

name: Node Swap
description: #(Tag:meta)(Tree)(Meta:swap) Single use. Exchange the location and connections of two visible locked nodes of your choice.

name: Reshuffle
description: #(Tag:meta)(Tree)(Meta:reshuffle) Unlimited use. Like Shuffle, but costs a quarter of the chosen node's points cost each time.

name: Pal Sphere
description: #The basic catching sphere: weaken a creature, throw, three shakes and a click. Holds weak catches, Pals or otherwise; anything sturdy breaks out. Consumed on throw, hit or miss; a replacement condenses every 24 hours.

name: Mega Sphere
description: #Improved catching sphere for tougher catches past the early game, Pals or otherwise. Three shakes and a click, with far fewer breakouts. Consumed on throw, hit or miss; a replacement condenses every 24 hours.

name: Giga Sphere
description: #High-grade catching sphere that holds even sturdy catches that would shred lesser spheres. Consumed on throw, hit or miss; a replacement condenses every 24 hours.

name: Hyper Sphere
description: #Advanced catching sphere for powerful catches; rarely fails on anything short of a boss. Consumed on throw, hit or miss; a replacement condenses every 24 hours.

name: Ultra Sphere
description: #Near-top-tier catching sphere with a catch rate worthy of endgame hunts, Pals or otherwise. Consumed on throw, hit or miss; a replacement condenses every 24 hours.

name: Legendary Sphere
description: #The ultimate catching sphere, forged for Legends; even a Jetragon, or anything on its level from elsewhere, can end up inside. Consumed on throw, hit or miss; a replacement condenses every 24 hours.

name: Portable Miner
description: #Plop it on any resource node and it mines hands-free into its own little inventory.

name: Chainsaw
description: #(Tag:flexible)Clears whole forests in seconds and mulches wood and leaves into biomass.

name: Xeno-Zapper
description: #Standard-issue electric prod; stings alien wildlife and gets stingers moving.

name: Rebar Gun
description: #(Tag:gun)(Tag:weapon)Fires sharpened rebar spikes; silent, cheap, and surprisingly lethal.

name: Nobelisk Detonator
description: #(Tag:kinetic)Remote-detonated explosive charges for clearing rock, trees, and hogs.

name: Object Scanner
description: #(Tag:tool)Pings the direction of selected resources, crash sites, and power slugs.

name: Blade Runners
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:weapon)Exoskeleton legs that boost sprint speed and let you powerslide under everything.

name: Jetpack
description: #Packaged-fuel flight with a satisfying roar; keep an eye on the fuel gauge.

name: Gas Mask
description: #(Tag:accessory)Breathe easy in poison-pillared zones while the filter holds out.

name: Mercer Sphere
description: #A humming alien artifact. Research it in the MAM to unlock alien technology, starting with extra personal inventory slots.

name: Somersloop
description: #An impossible looping doodad; slot it into a machine to double that machine's output.

name: Analysis Visor
description: #(Tag:accessory)Tag flora, fauna, and minerals through your visor; uploads pay out in Nanites.

name: Terrain Manipulator
description: #(Tag:earth)Reshape whole landscapes, mine underfoot, and flatten base sites with multitool modes.

name: Boltcaster
description: #The trusty starting multitool weapon; rapid plasma bolts with endless upgrades.

name: Blaze Javelin
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:weapon)A charged railbeam that pierces rock and sentinels alike.

name: Hyperdrive
description: #(Tag:teleport)Fold space between stars on warp cells; the whole galaxy opens up.

name: Minotaur Exocraft
description: #A piloted mech suit with mining laser, stomp jets, and a cockpit with a view.

name: Living Ship
description: #(Tag:vehicle)A grown void-egg starship that is alive: it gestates its own upgrades, bleeds, and sings in transit.

name: Foundation
description: #Pave any terrain flat for building; the entire factory stands on these.

name: Solar Sail
description: #(Tag:fire)Paper-thin orbital mirrors, launched by the thousand to begin the swarm.

name: Proliferator
description: #A spray that overclocks production lines and multiplies their output.

name: Strange Matter
description: #(Tag:alter)Exotic late-game material for the strangest recipes in the tech tree. A lump the size of a coin weighs as much as an anvil, holds staggering energy, and forges components no mundane material can match, if you have the tools and knowledge to work it safely.

name: Antimatter Fuel Rod
description: #(Tag:catalyst)(Tag:resource)Dense annihilation fuel that keeps Icarus flying between stars.

name: EM Rail Ejector
description: #A mass driver that hurls solar sails and small carriers into orbit.

name: Gravity Gloves
description: #(Tag:fist)(Tag:gravity)(Tag:mundane)Flick your wrists to snatch distant objects and ammo straight into your hands. Everyone calls them the Russells.

name: Combine Pistol
description: #(Tag:gun)(Tag:weapon)Standard Combine sidearm with reflex sight and resin upgrades.

name: Combine Shotgun
description: #(Tag:gun)Double-barrel burst cannon that deletes headcrabs up close.

name: Combine SMG
description: #(Tag:gun)Rapid-fire Combine automatic with an energy-ball secondary fire.

name: Xen Grenade
description: #(Tag:consumable)Volatile Xen flora that detonates seconds after you grab it. Throw fast.

name: Climbing Axe
description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:weapon)Lara's iconic axe: climbs ice walls, pries doors, and ends fights.

name: Recurve Bow
description: #(Tag:bow)(Tag:weapon)Silent with retrievable arrows; rope, fire, and poison upgrades with tinkering.

name: Heavy Pistol
description: #(Tag:gravity)(Tag:gun)(Tag:weapon)Hard-hitting sidearm for when stealth stops being an option.

name: Rope Ascender
description: #(Tag:flexible)(Tag:tool)Motorized ascender that zips you up ropes and rappels you down cliffs.

name: Seaglide
description: #Handheld underwater scooter with light and sonar map; every diver's first love.

name: Seamoth
description: #(Tag:insectoid)Nippy one-person sub with crush-depth upgrades and a perimeter defense zapper.

name: Prawn Suit
description: #(Tag:armor)Powered exosuit with drill and grapple arms, for punching leviathans in the face.

name: Cyclops
description: #A full submarine base with silent running, decoys, and room for a Seamoth in the belly.

name: Habitat Builder
description: #(Tag:building)Prints seabase modules from titanium anywhere with a flat-ish seabed.

name: Stasis Rifle
description: #(Tag:ice)(Tag:time)Freezes anything in a time bubble, up to and including Reapers. Briefly.

name: Thermoblade
description: #Superheated survival knife that cooks fish as it cuts them.

name: Ultra Glide Fins
description: #Slick fins that make you properly fast underwater.

name: Focus
description: #(Tag:catalyst)Ear-mounted AR that scans machines, tags weak points, and replays echoes of the past.

name: Shield-Weaver
description: #(Tag:shield)Ancient power armor projecting a rechargeable energy shield around its wearer.

name: Ropecaster
description: #Pins machines down with tethers; enough ropes will tie down a Thunderjaw.

name: Tripcaster
description: #Lays shock, fire, and explosive tripwires for the ambush engineer.

name: Blast Sling
description: #(Tag:bow)(Tag:kinetic)Lobs proximity bombs in a satisfying arc with a bigger boom. Carries six bombs; ammunition restocks every 24 hours.

name: Tearblaster
description: #Close-range cannon blast that rips armor plates and components clean off.

name: Black Lotus
description: #Sacrifice it for three mana of any color. The most famous cardboard on Earth.

name: Mox Pearl
description: #Zero-mana artifact that taps for white. Power Nine fast mana.

name: Mox Ruby
description: #Zero-mana artifact that taps for red. Power Nine fast mana.

name: Mox Sapphire
description: #Zero-mana artifact that taps for blue; the priciest of the five Moxen.

name: Mox Jet
description: #(Tag:vehicle)Zero-mana artifact that taps for black. Power Nine fast mana.

name: Mox Emerald
description: #Zero-mana artifact that taps for green. Power Nine fast mana.

name: Charge Rifle
description: #(Tag:gun)(Tag:movement)(Tag:weapon)Spacer-tech pulse rifle that outshoots anything short of a charge lance.

name: Charge Lance
description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:polearm)(Tag:weapon)Long-range armor-melting spacer rifle; one shot can delete a torso.

name: Healer Mech Serum
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:elixir)(Tag:tech)(Tag:vehicle)Glitterworld nanomachines that regenerate scars, missing organs, and chronic ills.

name: Resurrector Mech Serum
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:elixir)(Tag:life)(Tag:tech)(Tag:vehicle)Brings back the recently dead, full resurrection psychosis side effects included.

name: Tranquilizer Rifle
description: #(Tag:gun)(Tag:weapon)Long-range nonlethal takedowns; one dart naps a guard for minutes.

name: Zenith 10mm Pistol
description: #(Tag:gun)(Tag:weapon)Custom compact pistol, whisper-quiet with a suppressor and laser sight.

name: Nanoceramic Blade
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:material)(Tag:weapon)Monomolecular sword that cuts through armor, bots, and bad decisions.

name: Service Weapon
description: #The Director's shapeshifting gun: Spin, Grip, Shatter, Pierce, and Charge forms in one impossible object.

name: Hotline
description: #A red Bakelite phone that calls the Board directly, geometry optional. The Board answers in cryptic instructions, sideways comments, and fragments of backstory that turn out to matter later.

name: Hedron Resonance Amplifier
description: #(Tag:sound)Wearable Hedron tech that shields the mind from Hiss resonance.

name: Vacpack
description: #Vacuum, shoot, and store slimes, food, and plorts with four color-coded tanks.

name: Slime Key
description: #(Tag:amorphous)A statue-shaped key that opens Slime Gates into new ranch zones.

name: CCCC Ion Laser
description: #(Tag:light)(Tag:tech)A handheld weapon that looks and feels like part of a microbe. Instead of ammunition, it recharges from your bio-energy, and it tends to overheat when overused. A piercing hitscan laser with near-perfect accuracy and extreme range: devastating pinpoint damage with a slow fire rate.

name: AAAA Minigun
description: #(Tag:gun)A handheld weapon that looks and feels like part of a microbe. Instead of ammunition, it recharges from your bio-energy, and it tends to overheat when overused. Spews a torrent of miniscule projectiles, taking 3 seconds to spool up, with decent DPS within a cone.

name: GGG Wavequake
description: #(Tag:earth)A handheld weapon that looks and feels like part of a microbe. Instead of ammunition, it recharges from your bio-energy, and it tends to overheat when overused. Slowly fires a full circle of slow-moving midrange waves carrying a strong punch of knockback along with decent damage.

name: Idol of Rebirth
description: #(Tag:life)A full idol that automatically resurrects its bearer once, then crumbles.

name: Resurrection Scroll
description: #(Tag:grimoire)(Tag:life)Bring an ally back mid-fight; every tactician carries a stack.

name: Q-Up Coin
description: #(Tag:resource)The perfectly fair coin at the heart of the coin-flipping esport. Fifty-fifty, totally fair, and immune to all luck, fate, and probability manipulation, so its verdict settles any dispute beyond argument.

name: Identity Disc
description: #A glowing identity disc worn on the back: memory, weapon, and backup in one. Grants disc abilities, a returning energy throw, plus disc subroutines like Seeker or Firewall, and stores a backup that can restore you if you're derezzed. It doesn't make you a program, and the backup restores you rather than cloning an independent copy.

name: Impossible Shard
description: #(Tag:resource)A shard of Impossible rarity; slotting it multiplies everything your build does.

name: Passenger Blimp
description: #A lumbering passenger blimp that ferries you and up to a dozen passengers or a hold of cargo through the skies in style, slow, comfortable, and landing anywhere flat, needing only time and clear weather.

name: Space Elevator
description: #(Tag:space)A unique-building space elevator you can raise wherever you settle: a tethered beanstalk that lifts you and freight straight into orbit and back, cheaply and endlessly, once anchored, it cannot be moved.

name: Instant Camera
description: #(Tag:time)An instant camera for capturing the moments that matter, before you rewind them.

name: Planetary Shield
description: #(Tag:dimension)(Tag:shield)(Tag:vehicle)A planet-wide shield generator that shrugs off anything short of a star going out.

name: Vertical Launching Silo
description: #A silo that launches rockets, warpers, and sphere components straight into orbit.

name: Power Armor
description: #(Tag:armor)Modular power armor with room for exoskeletons, shields, batteries, and a personal fusion reactor.

name: Personal Roboport
description: #A wearable roboport that deploys your own construction robots wherever you stand.

name: Blueprint Book
description: #(Tag:grimoire)A book of stamped-down factory blueprints recorded by scanning layouts you have built. Stamp ghost-images of entire production blocks, walls, or furnace rows at once; construction robots, yours or borrowed, then build them for real, consuming materials from your stock, as the book conjures no matter itself. Synergises with any Tinker, construction, or automation abilities, which can feed it new designs and supply the builders and belts to realise them.

name: Scout Launcher
description: #(Tag:gun)A wrist-mounted launcher firing a reusable camera probe that photographs the unknown.

name: Signalscope
description: #(Tag:tech)A zoomable signal-finder that tunes into quantum fluctuations, distress calls, and music.

name: Ash Twin Project
description: #(Tag:time)The Nomai station at the heart of the 22-minute loop. You hold its secrets: you can detect time loops and anomalies, navigate them safely, and, most precious of all, retain your memories across resets while others forget.

name: The Generator
description: #(Tag:machine)(Tag:production)A towering coal-fired Generator you can raise at any settlement: it burns coal, or wood, oil, and worse in a pinch, to radiate life-saving warmth across whole districts through even supernatural frost. The city lives or dies with it, so you must feed it fuel and hands around the clock.

name: Steam Hub
description: #(Tag:water)A portable steam hub extending the Generator's warmth to distant districts.

name: Atmo Suit
description: #(Tag:armor)A sealed suit with its own oxygen supply for space, magma, and chlorine zones alike.

name: Super Computer
description: #(Tag:machine)(Tag:tech)A humming research station that turns raw data and power into steady research progress.

name: Drakkar
description: #(Tag:movement)(Tag:vehicle)A clinker-built Viking longship that outruns sea serpents with the wind behind it.

name: Megingjord
description: #Thor's strength belt, granting the bearer the carrying might of a giant.

name: Wishbone
description: #A dowsing wishbone that tugs toward buried silver and hidden treasure.

name: Pickaxe
description: #(Tag:tool)A tempered pickaxe for rock, dirt, and the occasional glyphid skull.

name: Flare Gun
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:gun)(Tag:weapon)Fires a burning flare that sticks where it lands and lights up the whole cave.

name: Terrain Tool
description: #(Tag:earth)A deformable-terrain multitool for digging, flattening, and analyzing alien soil.

name: Shuttle
description: #(Tag:vehicle)A single-seat interplanetary shuttle; pack solid fuel and pick a landing zone.

name: RTG
description: #A radioisotope thermoelectric generator delivering endless quiet power.

name: Spiked Baseball Bat
description: #A Louisville classic wrapped in nails; quiet, reliable, and permanently bloody.

name: Sledgehammer
description: #(Tag:bludgeon)Destroys walls, doors, and skulls with equal enthusiasm. Heavy, though.

name: Generator
description: #(Tag:ice)A portable gas generator that keeps the lights and freezers on after the grid dies.

name: Galaxy Sword
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:weapon)A sword forged from a galaxy soul; the finest blade the Adventurer's Guild has ever seen. It never dulls or breaks, and cuts clean through armor, monsters, and magic-resistant hides far beyond mundane steel, though it grants no magic of its own.

name: Junimo Hut
description: #A hut housing Junimos who emerge each morning to harvest your crops for you.

name: SHIELD Flying Car
description: #(Tag:shield)(Tag:vehicle)Coulson's cherry-red 1962 Corvette convertible with VTOL flight, machine guns, and flamethrowers. She has a name, and it is Lola.

name: Darkhold
description: #The Book of the Damned, transcribed from Wundagore's dark dimension; every spell in it corrupts its reader.

name: Book of Vishanti
description: #(Tag:grimoire)The collected white magic counterweight to the Darkhold; its defensive spells answer nearly anything.

name: Ten Rings
description: #(Tag:accessory)Ten bracelets of alien origin granting longevity, concussive blasts, and a small army's obedience.

name: Loki's Sceptre
description: #The Chitauri sceptre housing the Mind Stone, bending minds and firing energy alike.

name: Staff of the Living Tribunal
description: #(Tag:catalyst)A mystic staff that cracks the ground with golden force and pries open sealed things.

name: TemPad
description: #A TVA time-pad that opens Time Doors to anywhen; pruning charges not included.

name: Time Stick
description: #(Tag:time)A TVA Time Stick that alters a target's flow of time, or disintegrates organic and inorganic targets alike, sending them to the Void. Touch range only.

name: Reset Charge
description: #(Tag:movement)A timeline-nuking charge that prunes a whole branched reality back to the Sacred Timeline.

name: Yaka Arrow
description: #(Tag:weapon)A whistle-guided Yaka arrow that carves through targets and curves back to hand.

name: Yondu's Fin
description: #The head-mounted Centaurian fin that conducts the Yaka arrow by whistle alone.

name: Photostatic Veil
description: #A Black Widow mesh mask that wears anyone's face well enough to fool scanners.

name: CPH4
description: #(Tag:mental)A packet of synthetic blue crystals that unlocks escalating brain capacity: perfect recall, telepathy, then matter and time itself. Unstable, leaks, and past a point there is no coming back.

name: Time Loop Cave
description: #(Tag:time)A desert cave that traps whoever enters during a tremor in a repeating day. Rehearse anything forever; rumor says one explosion inside, mid-quake, gets you out.

name: Electric Locomotive
description: #(Tag:electric)A multi-wagon electric freight locomotive that hauls entire factories' output on your rail lines.

name: Freight Wagon
description: #A cavernous freight car that follows your locomotive anywhere rails go.

name: Locomotive
description: #A diesel workhorse locomotive for a fully automated rail network; schedule not included.

name: Cargo Wagon
description: #A steel cargo wagon that loads and unloads itself at smart stations.

name: Rail Car
description: #(Tag:vehicle)A click-together rail car for the railway you really should have built sooner.

name: Mugen Train
description: #(Tag:vehicle)An eight-car demon fused with its own train, bound to your service as transport; its sleeping passengers never wake unless you allow it.

name: Puffing Tom
description: #The Sea Train that runs on water rails between Water 7 and its neighbors, rocketing through Aqua Laguna.

name: Minecart Shotgun
description: #(Tag:gun)A shotgun rigged to a high-speed minecart loop; anything in the corridor ceases to be a problem.

name: Ishimura Tram
description: #A complete tram network in a box: track, cars, and stations that unfold wherever you lay them. Ship and necromorphs not included.

name: Ecliptic Express
description: #A Umbrella luxury train, delivered fumigated and horror-free, ready to run wherever you lay track.

name: Powered Rail
description: #Golden rails that boost any passing minecart, with or without redstone attached.

name: Spirit Train
description: #(Tag:spirit)(Tag:vehicle)The sacred Spirit Tracks engine, blessed rails and all; evil cannot board without an invitation.

name: Passing Train
description: #(Tag:vehicle)On certain days a freight train rumbles through the valley, shaking loose coal, wood, and geodes.

name: Molentary Express
description: #A luxury puzzle-box express where every passenger is lying and the dining car hides a secret.

name: Galaxy Express 999
description: #A spacefaring steam locomotive bonded to you as its passenger of record, running its Andromeda circuit wherever you ask. You never pay the fare.

name: Kotetsujo
description: #An armored steam fortress-train with a very good crane and a worse kabane problem.

name: Snowpiercer
description: #A thousand-and-one-car perpetual-motion train, yours to command, laying its own track wherever you point it. Frozen apocalypse and class uprising not included.

name: The Engine
description: #(Tag:machine)(Tag:tech)Wilford's sacred Engine, yours to install: eternal heat and power for a settlement, a ship, or a very warm room.

name: Polar Express
description: #A Christmas Eve steam train to the North Pole for children who still believe loudly enough.

name: Orient Express
description: #The Simplon-Orient luxury express, first class only, murderer probably included.

name: Source Code
description: #(Tag:tech)A program that drops your mind into a doomed train passenger's final eight minutes, looping with memories intact until you find the bomb. Your body waits safely outside.

name: Jules Verne Time Train
description: #(Tag:time)Doc's flying steam-locomotive time machine, running on steam and pure showmanship.

name: Spatchcock
description: #A patchwork sky-locomotive held together by rivets, prayer, and Roger's excellent tea service.

name: War Rig
description: #The armored tanker rig: guzzoline, mothers' milk, and one very shiny steering wheel.

name: Armored Train
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:vehicle)A behemoth armored battle train bristling with cannons; the track is more of a suggestion.

name: Aurora
description: #A working steam locomotive hauling the last livable train yards east through the radiation.

name: Sea Railway
description: #(Tag:water)A one-way spectral rail line gliding over open ocean to Swamp Bottom, departing every dawn whether or not you are aboard. Fare is a single vivid memory paid at the gate; the train carries you and whatever you can hold, never deviates, never stops between stations, and cannot be ridden twice in the same direction.

name: LLM Workstation Laptop
description: #(Tag:mundane)A top-spec laptop with an absurd amount of VRAM that runs a genuinely helpful AI assistant entirely offline. Battery life: optimistic.

name: Shake the Tree
description: #(Tag:meta)(Tag:nature)(Tree)(Meta:shake) Single use. Shuffle which entry sits on every locked node. Positions and connections don't move, and every node keeps a similar rarity.

name: ChaosQuake
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:meta)(Tree)(Meta:chaosquake) Single use. Shuffle which entry sits on every node, locked or unlocked alike. Your unlocked nodes keep their places but not their faces; rarities stay similar.

name: Gambler's Bronze Die
description: #(Tag:card)(Tag:material)(Tag:meta)(Tree)(Meta:gamble:2) Unlocking this die lets you gamble 2 awarded tickets: roll a d20 for each (20: tier up, 17-19: twin second core, 13-16: new ticket kind, 8-12: nothing, 2-7: tier down, 1: destroyed, no core and half points).

name: Gambler's Silver Die
description: #(Tag:card)(Tag:earth)(Tag:meta)(Tree)(Meta:gamble:4) Unlocking this die lets you gamble 4 awarded tickets: roll a d20 for each (20: tier up, 17-19: twin second core, 13-16: new ticket kind, 8-12: nothing, 2-7: tier down, 1: destroyed, no core and half points).

name: Gambler's Gold Die
description: #(Tag:card)(Tag:earth)(Tag:meta)(Tree)(Meta:gamble:6) Unlocking this die lets you gamble 6 awarded tickets: roll a d20 for each (20: tier up, 17-19: twin second core, 13-16: new ticket kind, 8-12: nothing, 2-7: tier down, 1: destroyed, no core and half points).

name: Gambler's Platinum Die
description: #(Tag:card)(Tag:meta)(Tree)(Meta:gamble:10) Unlocking this die lets you gamble 10 awarded tickets: roll a d20 for each (20: tier up, 17-19: twin second core, 13-16: new ticket kind, 8-12: nothing, 2-7: tier down, 1: destroyed, no core and half points).

name: Gambler's Diamond Die
description: #(Tag:card)(Tag:meta)(Tree)(Meta:gamble:10)(Meta:gamble-reroll:1) Unlocking this die lets you gamble 10 awarded tickets, and all your die rolls reroll natural 1s. Each gamble rolls a d20 (20: tier up, 17-19: twin second core, 13-16: new ticket kind, 8-12: nothing, 2-7: tier down, 1: destroyed, no core and half points).

name: Gambler's Legendary Die
description: #(Tag:card)(Tag:meta)(Tree)(Meta:gamble:12)(Meta:gamble-reroll:5) Unlocking this die lets you gamble 12 awarded tickets, and all your die rolls reroll 5s and below. Each gamble rolls a d20 (20: tier up, 17-19: twin second core, 13-16: new ticket kind, 8-12: nothing, 2-7: tier down, 1: destroyed, no core and half points).

name: Gambler's Mythical Die
description: #(Tag:card)(Tag:meta)(Tree)(Meta:gamble:12)(Meta:gamble-reroll:7) Unlocking this die lets you gamble 12 awarded tickets, and all your die rolls reroll 7s and below. Each gamble rolls a d20 (20: tier up, 17-19: twin second core, 13-16: new ticket kind, 8-12: nothing, 2-7: tier down, 1: destroyed, no core and half points).

name: Gambler's Divine Die
description: #(Tag:card)(Tag:divine)(Tag:holy)(Tag:meta)(Tree)(Meta:gamble:12)(Meta:gamble-reroll:9) Unlocking this die lets you gamble 12 awarded tickets, and all your die rolls reroll 9s and below. Each gamble rolls a d20 (20: tier up, 17-19: twin second core, 13-16: new ticket kind, 8-12: nothing, 2-7: tier down, 1: destroyed, no core and half points).

name: Gambler's Transcendent Die
description: #(Tag:card)(Tag:meta)(Tree)(Meta:gamble:16)(Meta:gamble-twice) Unlocking this die lets you gamble 16 awarded tickets, and every gamble gets a second d20 roll whenever the first roll isn't a natural 20. Each roll uses the same table (20: tier up, 17-19: twin second core, 13-16: new ticket kind, 8-12: nothing, 2-7: tier down, 1: destroyed, no core and half points).

name: Morph Ball
description: #(Tag:transformation)(Tech) Compress into an armored rolling sphere a third of your height, fast and nearly silent. Lay energy bombs, three active at a time, and boost-charge for a destructive burst of speed.

name: Varia Suit
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tech) Powered exosuit with major damage reduction, full heat and cold immunity, and an arm cannon firing charged plasma bolts. Heavy, obvious, and hungry for energy cells.

name: Gravity Suit
description: #(Tag:armor)(Tag:gravity)(Tech) Upgraded powered exosuit that moves through liquid, lava, and crushing gravity as though they were air, with greater defense than lesser suits. Same appetite for energy cells.

name: Birthing Pod
description: #Feed this biomechanical pod a living creature or minion to dissolve it and birth a slightly stronger creature of a related kind. One hatching at a time; the pod hungers again within a day.

name: Mimic Vat
description: #Imprint the recently fallen into this vat to produce temporary token copies of them, loyal to you, each lasting a single battle. One imprint stored at a time.

name: The Ozolith
description: #A floating crystal that drinks in the counters of your fallen minions and lets you redistribute them onto your survivors. Counters left unassigned past a day decay away.

name: Pithing Needle
description: #Name one ability, item power, or spell; its owner cannot activate it while you hold this needle and picture them clearly. One name at a time; renaming takes an hour of focus.

name: Panharmonicon
description: #A humming engine that doubles the triggered effects of things you control: arrivals, deaths, thresholds, all of it firing twice. Costs are not copied, and upkeep still ticks once.

name: Mirror of Night
description: #A mirror of stolen darkness with a talent tree you allocate at will: stubborn defiance, death resistance, energy reserves, casting strength, and more. Refund and reallocate freely between battles.

name: Lucky Tooth
description: #A Cerberus fang that takes a killing blow for you instead, leaving you barely standing. Reforms by the next dawn, and only while you carry no other death-cheating trinket.

name: Stygius
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:weapon)The prince's underworld sword with shifting aspects: swift slashes, a lunging special, and a nova that spends your casting stone for ruinous damage. It never dulls and never leaves your hand unasked.

name: Pierced Butterfly
description: #A keepsake butterfly that drinks in flawless victories: each battle you end untouched sharpens all your attacks noticeably, stacking until something finally lands a hit and resets it.

name: Fishing Rod
description: #(Tag:catalyst)A simple rod that catches something worthwhile in any liquid, including lava, chaos, and the Styx: mostly fish, occasionally riches, rarely something that bites back. One notable catch per day; endless minnows.

name: Arcana Deck
description: #(Tag:card)A deck of major arcana you activate within your grasp: the Sorceress quickens casts, the Titan hardens skin, the Huntress sharpens strikes, and more. Deeper grasp holds more cards.

name: Ghost Onion
description: #(Tag:spirit)A spectral onion that revives you once per battle at half strength with full energy, then needs a full rest to regrow. Smells faintly of the surface.

name: Descura
description: #(Tag:catalyst)(Tag:magic)The witch's staff: forceful bolts, a charged omega blast that consumes magick, and a special that lobs your casting stone and recalls it. Never runs dry, only runs hot.

name: Arachne's Cocoon
description: #A spool of Arachne's silk that wraps you in ablative armor cocoons, each absorbing a full hit before bursting. Three cocoons per rest; the silk itches terribly.

name: Old Spiked Collar
description: #A spiked collar granting a reserve of bonus health that absorbs harm first. The reserve refills between battles; Cerberus has never noticed it missing.

name: Pom Blossom
description: #(Tag:nature)A divine flower that grows a random power a full rank after every major battle. Minor scuffles don't interest it.

name: Skull Earring
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:necro)An earring that makes your attacks hit notably harder while you are badly hurt. Stopping to heal wastes its attention.

name: White Antler
description: #An antler charm making critical strikes far more likely; clean hits find weak points on their own.

name: Lambent Plume
description: #A feather that stacks dodge chance the longer you keep moving without stopping. Standing still resets it.

name: Harpy Feather Duster
description: #(Tag:avian)A duster that makes breakables and containers hide more valuables. Dust first, loot second.

name: Cosmic Egg
description: #(Tag:growing)A cosmic egg that thins local reality: chaotic phenomena and strangers seek you out, and offerings made to Chaos, such as Chaos Gate sacrifices, run stronger.

name: Luckier Tooth
description: #A luckier tooth that cheats death once per venture at partial strength. Skelly swears this one works better than the last one.

name: Knuckle Bones
description: #(Tag:bio)(Tag:fist)(Tag:material)(Tag:necro)Knucklebones that make your guardians and companions hit harder and endure longer. They rattle approvingly at good plans.

name: Left Sock
description: #A single left sock. Its partner is never found, in any world.

name: Dead Battery
description: #(Tag:resource)A battery that is mysteriously always dead. Devices reject it on sight.

name: Allen Key
description: #(Tag:tool)A very specific size that fits nothing you own. Indestructible by neglect.

name: Fortune Cookie (blank)
description: #(Tag:consumable)(Tag:divination)The fortune slip is blank. The cookie is stale. Interpret freely.

name: Hotel Pen
description: #(Tag:mundane)Writes for exactly one signature, then gives up. Stolen legally.

name: Traffic Cone (mini)
description: #A miniature traffic cone. Directs nothing; respected by no one.

name: Single Chopstick
description: #One chopstick. Pairs with nothing. Stabs adequately.

name: Deflated Balloon
description: #A balloon with no air and no squeak left. Pops only emotionally.

name: USB Cable (wrong end)
description: #Both ends are the wrong end. Data transfer is theoretical.

name: Takeout Menu (closed)
description: #Menu for a restaurant that closed years ago. The pictures still look good.

name: Empty Missile Tank
description: #(Tag:vehicle)An empty missile expansion tank. Holds sandwiches now.

name: Oxygen Candle (half)
description: #Half a chemical oxygen candle. Burns fifteen minutes of thin, tinny air.

name: Unobtanium Pebble
description: #A pebble of unobtanium too small to interest anyone. Worth: one (1) pebble.

name: Stillsuit Patch Kit
description: #(Tag:tool)Patches stillsuit leaks adequately. Does not patch the wearer's complaining.

name: Mud (thermal)
description: #(Tag:earth)Special mud that hides body heat from thermal vision while wet. Dries fast; reapply under fire.

name: Endoskeleton Finger
description: #One hyperalloy finger. Points accusingly. Cannot be bent, broken, or returned.

name: Sonic Screwdriver (dead)
description: #(Tag:sound)(Tag:tool)Does everything except work: the battery is dead and replacements don't exist. Still excellent for pointing.

name: Talkie Toaster
description: #(Tag:mundane)A toaster obsessed with toast. Asks about toast. Toasts adequately.

name: Towel
description: #(Tag:mundane)A large, mostly clean towel. Hugely useful in ways that only become clear during emergencies.

name: Lawgiver (empty)
description: #A voice-activated sidearm with no ammunition and no voice authorization. Makes a convincing paperweight.

name: MALP (stuck)
description: #A probe stuck in a ditch just past the event horizon. Telemetry works; retrieval does not.

name: Cylon Toaster (quiet)
description: #(Tag:mundane)Makes toast and says nothing. The silence is the point. Probably.

name: Encyclopedia Galactica (abridged)
description: #Abridged to one volume. Covers everything briefly and nothing usefully.

name: Knife Missile (blunt)
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:weapon)A formerly godlike smart munition, now blunt and docile. Follows you like a duckling.

name: DRD (lost)
description: #A small repair bot, lost. Fixes tiny things nearby while looking for its Pilot.

name: Cardboard Box (soggy)
description: #(Tag:storage)Stealth camouflage, waterlogged. Fools no one but smells like rain.

name: Companion Cube (inert)
description: #An inert weighted companion cube. Will never threaten to stab you and, in fact, cannot.

name: Joja Cola
description: #Corporate cola. Restores a sip of energy and a pang of guilt.

name: Bonesaw
description: #(Tag:bio)A bone saw granting +1/+0. Rusty, loud, and eager.

name: Shiv (dull)
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:dagger)A dull shiv. Shanks poorly. Intimidates only the already intimidated.

name: Lethe Water (sip)
description: #(Tag:water)One sip erases roughly the last minute. Single use; the flask stays empty as a lesson.

name: Zat'nik'tel
description: #Goa'uld sidearm with three settings per target: first shot stuns, second kills, third disintegrates. Resets are per target, so count your shots.

name: Sarcophagus
description: #Goa'uld healing sarcophagus that restores any wound, illness, or age on a long rest inside. Each use costs a sliver of soul and feeds a quiet hunger for more.

name: Puddle Jumper
description: #A cloaking puddle jumper seating four: flies, swims, squeezes through gates, and hides from nearly everything. Needs drone weapons separately; they are never included.

name: Viper Mk II
description: #A Colonial Viper interceptor: brutally fast, manually flown, no networked systems to subvert. Lands like a brick and turns like a rumour.

name: Witcher Medallion
description: #(Tag:magic)A wolf's-head medallion vibrating near magic, monsters, and curses, stronger for closer and fouler. Useless as jewelry; wolves approve.

name: Hearthstone
description: #Bind to an inn and return to it from anywhere after a short channel, once per day. Binds to inns only; dungeons, war zones, and other people's houses do not count.

name: Mimic Beacon
description: #(Tag:tool)A thrown hologram projector impersonating a soldier badly enough to draw all enemy fire. Lasts until destroyed or disbelieved, whichever comes first.

name: Combat Stim
description: #(Tag:consumable)Military-grade combat stims: greatly quickened strikes and dulled pain for a few minutes, at the cost of a chunk of health. Side effects include confidence.

name: Plant in a Boot
description: #(Tag:nature)A living plant growing in an old boot: proof that life finds a way. Tends to inspire hope, directives, and mutiny in roughly that order.

name: Nano Boost
description: #(Tag:tech)An injection granting one ally massive damage and resistance for a short push. Recipient hears heroic music; enemies hear footsteps. One dose; a new dose brews per week.

name: Battle-Car
description: #(Tag:vehicle)A supersonic acrobatic rocket car with flip, boost, and demolition manners. Ball not included; walls are load-bearing suggestions. Boost refills from pads and pickups; without it, just a fast car.

name: Facts Given
description: #A misprinted card: rip it to roll four gold tickets, keep two, and your nemesis receives the other two.

name: Gift and Fiction
description: #A misprinted card: rip it to gain five silver coupons; your nemesis divides them into two groups, you keep one group and they take the other.

name: Cat Costume
description: #The lowest-effort cat costume: fuzzy pink cat ears with bells, pink bow collar with a bell, white fluffy tail. Supply your own gloves, boots, and underwear.

name: Purrpetual Petz
description: #An animatronic pet that never needs feeding and judges you silently. Batteries included; affection sold separately.

name: Head Key
description: #(Tag:tool)A whispering iron key that unlocks the inside of a willing or restrained head, letting you walk around their memories and rearrange the furniture. What you break in there stays broken.

name: Anywhere Key
description: #(Tag:tool)A pale key that opens any door onto anywhere you have seen, one trip per turn. Doors remember being used; some start locking themselves.

name: Echo Key
description: #(Tag:sound)(Tag:tool)A key that summons an echo of a dead person: speak their name while turning it in any lock and they appear, knowing full well they are dead and mostly resenting it. They persist only while the key stays turned; remove it and they are gone.

name: Hextech Gauntlets
description: #(Tag:earth)Enormous hextech brawling gauntlets: seismic punches, shockwave claps, and a shield mode that mostly protects other people from you. Fittings run large.

name: Shimmer
description: #A vial of violet Shimmer granting monstrous strength and speed while it lasts, at the usual price: addiction, mutation, and purple eyes that never quite fade.

name: Jinx's Pow-Pow
description: #(Tag:curse)A custom minigun with separation anxiety: devastating suppressive fire that jams if ignored, sulks if cleaned by anyone else, and works best while being sung to.

name: Hexcore
description: #An unstable arcane gem that powers hextech evolution and whispers equations no one taught it. Grants insights freely; mutates the bearer slowly and without asking.

name: Ambessa's Charm
description: #(Tag:accessory)(Tag:mental)A Noxian war-charm that drinks hostile magic aimed at the bearer, up to a measure, then must be emptied by force of will. Smells faintly of war paint and disapproval.

name: Chaos's Shoe
description: #(Gacha) A nice black leather left shoe that fits you. Drop it after a gacha roll to change the result to randomly the next or previous item on the wheel.

name: Chaos's Other Shoe
description: #(Gacha) A nice black leather right shoe that fits you. When rolled, it lands on your head: lose your previous roll to reroll the ticket that gave you the shoe. You get to keep the shoe.

name: Scent Hound Whistle
description: #(Tag:meta)(Tree)(Meta:trace-name-use) A carved wooden hound whistle. One blow summons a tireless phantom scent hound that traces the route to the closest node matching a name, then fades; the whistle cracks after a single use.

name: Second Breakfast Box
description: #(Tag:storage)A lunchbox that produces any mundane meal or tool under 5 kg on demand, endlessly; items taken more than a mile away fade after 24 hours.

name: Wardrobe of Elsewhere
description: #Walk through it to exit from any door you have previously touched, anywhere; a round trip collapses the wardrobe for a week.

name: Penny of the Ferryman
description: #(Tag:magic)(Tag:necro)Pay it to cross any one boundary: locked doors, wards below Divine rank, even death itself (survive one killing blow, the penny spent). Single use; a replacement condenses every year.

name: The Unfinished Map
description: #A map that fills in wherever you haven't been, including secret doors, traps, and treasures within a mile; it never shows people. Its inks run dry for 30 days after mapping a Divine-tier secret.

name: Gavel of Adjournment
description: #Strike it to adjourn any conflict within earshot: all combatants must stop fighting for 10 minutes (Divine and below cannot resist; stronger can). Once per day.

name: Cradle of Embers
description: #(Tag:fire)A brazier holding the last fire of a dead universe; it never goes out, kindles any flame into sun-hot forge fire, and once per year can reignite a dead star, or a dead heart, if it consents.

name: Seed of Yggdrasil
description: #(Tag:nature)Plant it in any soil and it grows a world-tree anchor within days: a personal pocket realm that grows with age, perfect health within its roots, and one resurrection at its base per year. Fell the tree and all of it is undone.

name: The Honest Die
description: #(Tag:card)A d20 that lands on exactly what the roller most needs (never what they want) in any game of chance they play for real stakes, dice, cards, coins, wagers, trials by lot. Staged or stakeless flips do nothing, and it reaches no further than the game: no meta-luck, no gacha pulls. Each roll also speaks one truth the roller most needs to hear, aloud, where everyone present can hear it.

name: The Triforce
description: #Three relics granting absolute expression of their bearer's dominant virtue: Power, Courage, Wisdom. United, one wish within the world's bounds. It arrives split across the world, you hold only what you can keep.

name: Command Block
description: #(Tag:command)Executes one written sentence on the world per redstone pulse, parsed with total literality. Needs power; needs precision; typos are cataclysms.

name: Zenith Blade
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:weapon)The culmination of swords: every swing launches a cascade of flying sword-images striking everything in a wide arc. Lesser blades shatter in its presence.

name: Hogyoku
description: #Manifests the desires of those around it at godlike speed: wounds close, limits break, evolutions trigger. It serves the strongest will present, not necessarily yours.

name: Mother Flame
description: #(Tag:fire)A miniature sun in a flask: endless clean power for any machine or city, or one dawn-bright detonation if shattered.

name: Type-40 TARDIS
description: #(Tag:space)(Tag:storage)(Tag:time)(Tag:vehicle)Bigger inside, traveling all of time and space; telepathic, temperamental, constantly breaking down. It refuses paradoxes at fixed points and likes you more than it admits.

name: Eye of the Universe
description: #You know where it is and how to reach it. Enter, and seed the next universe with laws of your choosing. Single use; everything ends first.

name: The Moment
description: #The Time Lord weapon with a conscience: it can unmake anything short of a fixed point, but it judges the wielder first and shows them the cost in full. Fail its judgment and it drops you home, disarmed.

name: Genesis Device
description: #(Tag:bio)Terraform a dead world to lush life in hours, or unmake a living one just as fast. Protomatter instability means inhabited targets may come out wrong; Starfleet will have questions either way.

name: DeLorean Time Machine
description: #(Tag:time)Eighty-eight mph time travel for you and your passengers; riders keep their memories across edits, but history pushes back, change too much and you start fading from the photograph. You provide the plutonium (or fusion upgrade), the maintenance, and roads.

name: Elder Scroll
description: #(Tag:grimoire)Read a prophecy of anything, past or future. The Scroll bills in sight: temporary blindness for small questions, permanent for large ones. Knowledge first; eyesight negotiable.

name: Gravitational Beam Emitter
description: #(Tag:gravity)(Tag:gun)(Tag:tech)(Tag:weapon)A sidearm firing gravitational-collapse beams that pierce planets end to end. Recoil and charge time scale with output, and silence is mandatory: everything hears a GBE shot.

name: Berserker Body
description: #An ancient URM nanotech combat body, offered as a full replacement: superhuman strength, speed, and durability, plasma discharge, and self-repair that knits wounds mid-fight. Attunement is agonizing and demands a compatible nervous system; overuse runs the furnace into berserk overload.

name: Damascus Blade
description: #(Tag:blade)(Tag:weapon)A bracelet unfolding into a blade that cuts armor, cyborgs, and monsters like paper and never dulls. It has no guard and no mercy: in unskilled hands it endangers the wielder as much as the foe (Panzer Kunst training recommended).

name: Monsterbane Blade
description: #(Tag:anti-monster)(Tag:blade)(Tag:martial)(Tag:weapon)A hunter's greatsword etched with a hundred monster names. It bites deep into anything bestial, monstrous, or unnatural, through claw, fang, and hide tougher than plate, and takes a trickle of the kill to keep its edge. People die to it like any sword; monsters die to it quickly.

name: Wyvernheart Bowgun
description: #(Tag:anti-dragon)(Tag:gun)(Tag:tech)(Tag:weapon)A hunting bowgun fed by a revolving magazine of wyvern rounds. Its shot tears through scaled hide and wing membrane, and its burst mode empties the cylinder in a heartbeat for the moment a dragon is brought to ground. Slower and lighter than siege guns, and far quicker on the turn.

name: Profaned Greatsword
description: #(Tag:anti-holy)(Tag:blade)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:weapon)A colossal blade quenched in profane flame, so heavy it has to be dragged into its own swing. Its fire burns angels, paladins, and anything sanctified as readily as flesh, snuffs out holy wards on contact, and leaves wounds that do not close.

name: Replicating Nanobot
description: #(Tag:growing)(Tag:resource)(Tag:tech)A palm-sized swarm of self-copying nanobots. Once a day you give each bot one of two orders: split in two, or mint a single gold coin. Splitting doubles the swarm, so a batch told to replicate gives up today's income for a much larger one later, and the same swarm told to mint produces coins in proportion to its size. They never wear out and never stop following orders.

name: Water Stream Crushing Rock
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:unarmed)(Tag:unique)(Tag:water)You are an apprentice in the legendary martial art created by S-Rank Hero Silverfang. You flow like water to defend and redirect enemy attacks, then strike like a raging river, and with enough training you counter an enemy's blow with double their power.

name: Intermediate Cooking
description: #(Tag:craft)You are as skilled as a seasoned chef. You make complex dishes with little trouble, and most of your food tastes pretty good.

name: Iaijutsu
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:weapon)You practice a refined blade art that turns drawing the blade into blitzing fast, precise slashes. With experience, you imbue your scabbard with energy to propel your sword even faster and increase your attacks' potency.

name: Intermediate Acting
description: #(Tag:social)You are a skilled actor. You portray yourself as you want to be seen and conceal your real emotions, but people familiar with you or with good intuition like detectives can probably see through your acting.

name: Intermediate Shooting
description: #(Tag:ranged)You are a pretty decent shot. You handle most firearms and projectiles with familiarity, but you do not land headshot after headshot.

name: Intermediate Hand-to-Hand Combat
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:unarmed)You are a seasoned fighter who knows how to move your body to hurt people. You pick up most martial arts far faster than others and completely thrash the average man in a fight.

name: Intermediate Programming
description: #(Tag:science)(Tag:tech)You are an experienced programmer in all languages. You code considerably faster than the average programmer in any programming language you encounter.

name: Intermediate Mechanics
description: #(Tag:craft)(Tag:tech)You are a decent mechanic. With the right tools, you fix most mundane appliances, and you know how most machines work and how to build basic machines.

name: Intermediate Biology
description: #(Tag:science)You are learned enough in Biology to be a professor. You know how most organs and organisms function, how most things interact with biology, and how to affect biology yourself.

name: Intermediate Physics
description: #(Tag:science)You are learned enough in Physics to be a professor. You know how physics works and interacts with objects, and you spot and understand how most phenomena interact with the laws of the universe.

name: Intermediate Chemistry
description: #(Tag:science)You are learned enough in Chemistry to be a professor. You understand how most common compounds form and remember chemical and reaction interactions well.

name: Intermediate Math
description: #(Tag:science)You are very good at math, enough to be considered somewhat of a savant. You rapidly and accurately calculate numbers in your head faster than most people and keep track of numbers and variables especially well.

name: Intermediate Blacksmithing
description: #(Tag:craft)You are experienced enough in blacksmithing to be called a real blacksmith. You forge decent-quality weapons, armour, and various tools that a warrior uses without apprehension.

name: Intermediate Teaching
description: #(Tag:social)You are a good teacher. You effectively impart your knowledge and skills to people and get them to take your lessons to heart most of the time.

name: Intermediate Blade Weapon Mastery
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:weapon)You are fairly skilled with bladed instruments and weapons such as swords and daggers. You effectively move your body and weapon to match most practitioners in skill and finesse.

name: Intermediate Blunt Weapon Mastery
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:weapon)You are fairly skilled with blunt instruments and weapons such as hammers, mauls and clubs. You effectively move your body and weapon to match most practitioners in skill and finesse.

name: Intermediate Polearm Mastery
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:weapon)You are fairly skilled with bladed instruments and weapons such as spears, halberds and sickles. You effectively move your body and weapon to match most practitioners in skill and finesse.

name: Intermediate Item Construction
description: #(Tag:craft)(Tag:magic)You know how to make decent magical and enchanted items. If you know fire magic, you turn a regular sword into a sword that lights itself on fire on command, and if you have the ability Invisibility, you probably make a cloak that suppresses your presence.

name: Polar Channel Flow - Cellular Overdrive
description: #(Tag:technique)You have mastered the Pugilist skill of pushing every cell in your body to its absolute limits. You draw up every ounce of their energy to augment all your stats to their limits, but this places immense strain on your body and repeated use may cause permanent damage.

name: All Life Eradication Fist
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:unarmed)(Tag:unique)You know the pinnacle of all martial arts, fusing mastery of dozens of supernatural martial arts with knowledge granted by god. You manipulate the flow of cosmic and all forms of energy with your martial arts to replicate almost any known phenomenon, but you must be sufficiently physically strong to utilize this skill in any meaningful capacity.

name: Spear of Untraceable Trajectory
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:unique)(Tag:weapon)Your spear mastery reaches such a degree that you disobey even physics. When you attack with the spear, you hit multiple locations at once with the number rising with your mastery, similar to Tsubame Gaeshi from Fate.

name: Nanaya Assassination Arts
description: #(Tag:stealth)(Tag:technique)You are trained in the unique assassination arts of the Nanaya Family, a clan of selectively bred demon hunters. You focus on extremely quick movements and mobility rather than stealth, moving unpredictably and using ceilings and walls as footholds, and you are especially strong against non-humans.

name: Whirlwind Iron Cutting Fist
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:unarmed)(Tag:unique)You are an apprentice in the supernatural martial art developed by the legendary martial artist Bomb after decades of self-training. Your style resembles kung fu, and you move your body to produce razor-sharp currents of wind that you send like whirlwinds to decimate any target.

name: Backflipping
description: #(Tag:movement)You know how to perform a gnarly backflip, though frontflips may be a bit challenging.

name: Water Breathing
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:unique)(Tag:water)(Tag:weapon)You practice Water Breathing, a specialized swordsmanship style and breathing technique that mimics water's flow, flexibility, and adaptability through your movements, techniques, and abilities. Most, if not all, known techniques bend your body, arm, and weapon in fluid motion to match rushing or flowing water, and with magical power you manifest water to further augment the style.

name: Fire Breathing
description: #(Tag:fire)(Tag:martial)(Tag:unique)(Tag:weapon)You practice Fire Breathing, a specialized swordsmanship style and breathing technique that mimics flames through your movements, techniques, and abilities. Most, if not all, known techniques and forms are extremely powerful singular strikes that 'burn' opponents from a high stance, and with magical power you manifest fire to further augment the style.

name: Wind Breathing
description: #(Tag:air)(Tag:martial)(Tag:unique)(Tag:weapon)You practice Wind Breathing, a specialized swordsmanship style and breathing technique that mimics wind, specifically powerful torrents of air and whirlwinds, through your movements, techniques, and abilities. Most, if not all, known techniques and forms are purely offensive attacks using fast rotating movements to generate swift whirlwind-like slashes that greatly increase your striking range, as well as using the surrounding air to deliver sharp sickle-shaped flying slash attacks and gale force winds.

name: Thunder Breathing
description: #(Tag:electric)(Tag:martial)(Tag:movement)(Tag:unique)(Tag:weapon)You practice Thunder Breathing, a specialized swordsmanship style and breathing technique that mimics lightning, specifically swift strikes and movements akin to lightning ripping through the sky, through your movements, techniques, and abilities. Most, if not all, known techniques and forms use blinding speeds and immensely fast attacks to overwhelm the enemy in an instant, and with magical power you manifest thunder to further augment the style.

name: Sun Breathing
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:unique)(Tag:weapon)You practice Sun Breathing, the specialized swordsmanship style and breathing technique created by legendary swordsman Yoriichi Tsugikuni that mimics the sun through your movements, techniques, and abilities. All techniques and forms are extremely varied with no set pattern, making them the most versatile and effective against enemies, and with magical power you manifest solar flames effective against the unholy.

name: Intermediate Kama Sutra
description: #(Tag:nsfw)(Nsfw) You are experienced in the sexual arts. You skillfully pleasure your partner, are a pleasant recipient, and know how to spot arousal and what your partner responds to.

name: Intermediate Taming
description: #(Tag:social)You are good at taming and training wild creatures. You make them submit and become obedient, submissive, and loyal to you, learn how to tame specific creatures, and apply this to people to an extent.

name: Intermediate Pressure Points
description: #(Tag:medical)You are experienced at spotting and using pressure points on human or animal bodies. You press them to paralyse people or cause pleasure and more, and though not easy, you use this in combat.

name: Intermediate Massage
description: #(Tag:medical)You are as skilled as an experienced masseuse. You relieve pressure, cause pleasure, and relax the muscles of people you massage.

name: Divine Gaming
description: #(Tag:tech)You are godlike at all kinds of games, including chess, video games, gambling, bottle toss, and anything of the sort. You are nigh unbeatable at any game unless against another godlike being of a similar domain.

name: Intermediate Driving
description: #(Tag:motor)(Tag:movement)You are a seasoned driver. You handle a variety of vehicles ranging from bikes and cars to aircraft with familiarity.

name: Intermediate Leadership
