description: #(Tag:social)You are an effective leader. You motivate, take charge of, and lead people with decent effectiveness, instilling confidence in them and making them do what you want.

name: Intermediate Charisma
description: #(Tag:social)You have an aura of charisma around you, less a skill than something just around you. People of note feel more attracted to your presence, paying more attention to you, taking you more seriously, and similar subtle effects.

name: Throwing
description: #(Tag:ranged)You are fairly skilled at throwing various objects with speed and accuracy. You land a stone on a target's head from across the street without trouble.

name: Intermediate Medicine
description: #(Tag:medical)You are as skilled as a doctor. You possess varied medical knowledge for treating injuries, illnesses, and problems, plus familiarity with the body, medicine, and its applications.

name: Kung Fu
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:unarmed)You are an apprentice in Kung Fu, a Chinese martial art that refines the body through discipline, efficiency, and adaptability. You use strikes, guards, footwork, and grappling, and with sufficient mastery you enhance your strikes with your internal energy.

name: Bajiquan
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:unarmed)You are an apprentice in Bajiquan, a Chinese martial art specializing in explosive short-range attacks and aggressive forward momentum to break through enemy defences. With sufficient mastery, you enhance your strikes with your internal energy.

name: Taekwondo
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:unarmed)You are an apprentice in Taekwondo, a dynamic Korean martial art specializing in speed, agility, and powerful kicking techniques. You combine high, spinning, and jumping kicks with fast footwork and precise strikes to deliver devastating blows, and with sufficient mastery you enhance your strikes with your internal energy.

name: Renewal Taekwondo
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:unarmed)(Tag:unique)You practice a specialized form of Taekwondo specializing in strong linear kicks like regular Taekwondo. It initially resembles simply a more refined and powerful Taekwondo style, but its true power emerges when you achieve Recoilless by mastering it, letting you focus all your energy into perfected strikes to unleash devastating effects.

name: Karate
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:unarmed)You are an apprentice in Karate, a Japanese martial art specializing in powerful strikes, strong stances, and precise technique. You use direct, forceful punches, kicks, knee strikes, and blocks for maximum impact to develop explosive power, speed, and efficiency for well-rounded offence and defence, and with sufficient mastery you enhance your strikes with your internal energy.

name: Suppression
description: #(Tag:stealth)You are a master of suppressing yourself. You erase your presence down to an ordinary one or fully conceal all your energy, turning a presence that shakes gods into one that does not seem out of place with foliage.

name: Krav Maga
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:unarmed)You are an apprentice of Krav Maga, a brutally efficient martial art made for military use that emphasizes instinctive movements, rapid strikes, and efficient takedowns to neutralize threats as quickly as possible. It incorporates techniques from boxing, wrestling, judo, and street fighting, and with sufficient mastery you enhance your strikes with your internal energy.

name: Muay Thai
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:unarmed)You are an apprentice of Muay Thai, a powerful Thai martial art known as the "Art of Eight Limbs" that uses punches, kicks, elbows, and knee strikes for devastating close and mid-range combat. You emphasize powerful strikes, clinch fighting, and relentless conditioning to build endurance and toughness, and with sufficient mastery you enhance your strikes with your internal energy.

name: Intimidation
description: #(Tag:social)You are skilled at intimidating people. You make them feel fear and shake in their boots with your mere presence, instinctively presenting yourself in ways that invoke terror.

name: Novice Cooking
description: #(Tag:craft)You are a novice in the culinary arts. You cook most basic meals to taste good but cannot get a job as a chef, though you improve much faster than others if you train yourself.

name: Wilderness Survival
description: #(Tag:expertise)You are very skilled at surviving in the wilderness. You make temporary shelter from found materials, identify safe food sources, track animals, secure your belongings, and handle everything else needed to survive effectively.

name: Novice Acting
description: #(Tag:social)You are a novice actor. You portray yourself as you want to be seen and hide your real emotions, but experienced people easily see through your acting, though you improve much faster than others if you train yourself.

name: Novice Shooting
description: #(Tag:ranged)You know how to handle firearms. You are no marksman but aim and shoot projectiles as well as the average soldier, though you improve much faster than others if you train yourself.

name: Novice Hand-to-Hand Combat
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:unarmed)You are reasonably talented in hand-to-hand combat. You know how and where to punch, enough for most people, and while you do not beat professionals, you confidently beat the average person and improve much faster than others if you train yourself.

name: Novice Programming
description: #(Tag:science)(Tag:tech)You know how to code at a novice level. You create simple programs and read, understand, and spot mistakes in code in every single coding language you have encountered.

name: Novice Mechanics
description: #(Tag:craft)(Tag:tech)You are as skilled as a mechanic apprentice. With the right tools, you fix basic appliances and maybe even a car, though you improve much faster than others if you train yourself.

name: Novice Biology
description: #(Tag:science)You have the skills and knowledge of a Biology Major. You hold a decent repertoire of knowledge regarding biology, bodies and organs, and how things interact with biology.

name: Novice Physics
description: #(Tag:science)You have the skills and knowledge of a Physics Major. You hold a decent repertoire of knowledge regarding physics and the laws of the universe, including why and how things fall, why magnets repel each other, and how to build a nuclear bomb.

name: Novice Chemistry
description: #(Tag:science)You have the skills and knowledge of a Chemistry Major. You hold a decent repertoire of knowledge regarding chemistry and compounds, know how to make most regular chemicals, and know not to drink bleach.

name: Novice Math
description: #(Tag:science)You are good at calculating things in your head and on the spot. You easily solve in your head most math problems you can solve, like a human calculator without writing things down.

name: Novice Blacksmithing
description: #(Tag:craft)You are about as skilled as a Blacksmith's apprentice. You make basic weapons and tools without guaranteeing their quality, but you accurately gauge the quality of metalwork you are given.

name: Novice Teaching
description: #(Tag:social)You are as skilled as a fresh teacher. You impart your knowledge and skills to people well enough but cannot guarantee they listen or take your lesson to heart.

name: Novice Blade Weapon Mastery
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:weapon)You are reasonably talented with bladed weapons such as swords and knives. You hold the sword with its sharp point toward the enemy, align the edge of your cuts, and poke the stabby end into people.

name: Novice Blunt Weapon Mastery
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:weapon)You are reasonably talented with blunt weapons such as hammers or clubs. You move your body to deal damage with your held instrument, but there is only so much finesse to handling a large stick.

name: Novice Polearm Mastery
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:weapon)You are reasonably talented with polearms such as spears, halberds or scythes. You smack with the long stick, cut with its end blade, and stab people with its pointy end, and that is enough for most people.

name: Novice Item Construction
description: #(Tag:craft)(Tag:magic)You know how to create minor enchanted and special items. You cannot make anything called a proper item, but things like a self-heating plate or an air-purifying mask are possible as long as you have the proper knowledge base.

name: Novice Kama Sutra
description: #(Tag:nsfw)(Nsfw) You are reasonably talented in the carnal arts. You know what goes where, how to pleasure your partner, and what not to do during coitus.

name: Novice Taming
description: #(Tag:social)You know how to tame wild creatures, but not very precisely. With trial and error you probably tame a creature, though it is not easy, while you easily tame and train mundane animals.

name: Novice Massage
description: #(Tag:craft)You are as skilled as an apprentice masseuse. You give massages that feel good and relieve pressure but not much beyond that.

name: Novice Driving
description: #(Tag:motor)(Tag:movement)You know how to drive most vehicles. You are no expert, but you do not fall off your bike or drive into pedestrians.

name: Novice Leadership
description: #(Tag:social)You know a bit about leading and motivating people. You do not lead armies anytime soon, but your team probably finds you agreeable and you decently resolve member conflicts and motivate your team.

name: Novice Charisma
description: #(Tag:social)You have an aura of charisma around you, less a skill than a change in your demeanour and how you hold yourself. People of note feel more attracted to your presence, paying more attention to you and taking you more seriously, though at this level it is not too noticeable.

name: Novice Medicine
description: #(Tag:medical)You are about as skilled as a doctor in training. You perform first aid, apply medicine, know what most medicines do, and in a pinch improvise medical tools to perform basic surgery.

name: Adept Cooking
description: #(Tag:craft)You are great at cooking, at the level of a veteran chef. You cook most meals with great flavour that few find disappointing, and you easily get a job as a private chef.

name: Literacy
description: #(Tag:expertise)(Tag:social)You know how to read effectively. You know all common and mundane languages of the world you are in, and you read books and grimoires much faster while digesting their information better.

name: Adept Acting
description: #(Tag:social)You are as skilled as a veteran actor. You effectively present yourself as you want to be seen to invoke the emotions you want while hiding your real thoughts and feelings, and it takes a seasoned detective to suss you out.

name: Adept Shooting
description: #(Tag:ranged)You are a natural crack shot, wielding most projectile weaponry with great accuracy and rarely missing except against opponents of similar skill.

name: Adept Hand-to-Hand Combat
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:unarmed)You fight at the level of a veteran martial artist, moving your body to unleash powerful blows with arms and legs that are lethal weapons.

name: Adept Programming
description: #(Tag:tech)You are as skilled as a veteran programmer, writing and designing complex programs and algorithms, quickly spotting mistakes in your code, and writing far faster than you should without sacrificing quality.

name: Adept Mechanics
description: #(Tag:craft)(Tag:tech)You are as skilled as a veteran engineer, able to repair almost any mundane machine given the tools and to design and build a car from scratch. You tinker and design far faster than you should without sacrificing quality.

name: Adept Biology
description: #(Tag:science)You have the experience and knowledge of a Senior Scientist in Biology, deeply knowledgeable in the study of life, including how living organisms function, form, and what they are made of.

name: Adept Physics
description: #(Tag:science)You have the experience and knowledge of a Senior Scientist in Physics, deeply knowledgeable in the laws of the universe, including gravity, electromagnetism and its effects, and nuclear fission and fusion.

name: Adept Chemistry
description: #(Tag:science)You have the experience and knowledge of a Senior Scientist in Chemistry, deeply knowledgeable in the study of matter, including what most substances are formed of, how they interact, how to form chemical compounds, and how to influence matter as you want.

name: Adept Math
description: #(Tag:science)You are a mathematical savant who never needs a calculator, crunching calculations in your head faster than you could type them, though not yet competing with computers, and far faster than you should be.

name: Adept Blacksmithing
description: #(Tag:craft)You are as skilled as a veteran blacksmith, crafting fine weapons and armour without trouble, and with practice, sought-after rare weapons. Your understanding of metallurgy and forging is far beyond average.

name: Adept Teaching
description: #(Tag:social)You are a great teacher, skilled at imparting your knowledge and skills even to poor students. You can teach anyone any of your skills as long as they are physically capable and the skill is below rare rank. (Call yourself GTO if your name starts with O.)

name: Adept Blade Weapon Mastery
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:weapon)You wield bladed weapons at the level of a veteran swordsman, handling any bladed weapon such as swords and daggers with great efficiency and finesse.

name: Adept Blunt Weapon Mastery
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:weapon)You are very talented with blunt weapons such as hammers and clubs, exerting almost supernatural strength while wielding them.

name: Adept Polearm Mastery
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:weapon)You wield polearms at the level of a veteran spearman, handling any polearm such as spears, sickles, and halberds with great efficiency and finesse.

name: Adept Item Construction
description: #(Tag:craft)(Tag:magic)You can create enchanted and special items based on your capabilities. If you know fire magic, you could turn a regular ring into one that deploys a fire barrier in an emergency, or if you have teleportation, you could create a ring that teleports people to a set location.

name: Adept Kama Sutra
description: #(Tag:nsfw)(Nsfw) You are very talented in the carnal arts, able to spot signs of arousal and attraction, and you instinctively know how to pleasure your partner in bed while being a very pleasant recipient, enhancing pleasure for both of you.

name: Adept Taming
description: #(Tag:social)You are great at taming, making beings submit to your ownership or superiority, gaining the obedience and loyalty of eligible familiars and, to a lesser extent, people. You are also good at training them.

name: Adept Massage
description: #(Tag:craft)You are as skilled as a seasoned masseuse, giving massages that relieve exhaustion, recover stamina, revitalize body and mind, and even invoke sexual pleasure. Few would leave your massage bed unsatisfied.

name: Adept Driving
description: #(Tag:motor)(Tag:movement)You are as skilled as a veteran driver, handling any vehicle with ease. In a race, you would likely embarrass the competition.

name: Adept Leadership
description: #(Tag:social)You are a skilled leader of small teams or even companies, able to earn loyalty, boost morale, manage, and lead. If you led a military into war, you would be known as a great commander.

name: Adept Charisma
description: #(Tag:social)You have an aura of charisma that is less a skill and more something around you. People of note feel more attracted to your presence, and you are more intimidating when you want to be and more persuasive when you try to be.

name: Adept Medicine
description: #(Tag:medical)You are very skilled in all areas of medicine at a veteran level, able to perform surgery, diagnose conditions, and create medicine. Given ingredients, you can make your own medicines, even magical ones such as potions depending on the world you are in.

name: Expert Cooking
description: #(Tag:craft)You are an expert in the culinary arts, better than most chefs will ever be. Given ingredients, you can cook almost any meal to taste great, leaving no one at your table unsatisfied, though still just short of foodgasm levels.

name: Grooming
description: #(Tag:expertise)NOT THAT KIND - You are very skilled at grooming, caring for your hair, hygiene, and cleanliness, making yourself and others look presentable.

name: Expert Acting
description: #(Tag:social)You are an expert actor, skillfully portraying yourself as you want to be perceived to invoke or hide emotions at will. It would take a real expert to see through your mask.

name: Expert Shooting
description: #(Tag:ranged)You are an expert marksman, handling all firearms and projectiles with such skill and finesse that others might wonder if you have a special power. You can curve shots, utilize ricochets, and better predict the trajectory of enemy projectiles.

name: Expert Hand-to-Hand Combat
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:unarmed)You are an expert martial artist, moving your body like a lethal weapon and knowing where and how to strike. You learn and master other unarmed martial arts much faster.

name: Expert Programming
description: #(Tag:tech)You are an expert programmer with skill comparable to a low-level Tinker ability, crafting complex algorithms and programs with ease, including basic artificial intelligences.

name: Expert Mechanics
description: #(Tag:craft)(Tag:tech)You are an expert mechanic with skill comparable to a low-level Tinker ability, able to fix and build any mundane machine and design improved versions. With enough time and practice, you can even build low-level tinkertech.

name: Expert Biology
description: #(Tag:science)You are an expert in Biology, the study of life, intimately familiar with the biology of most organisms from mammals to cellular life. If given magic, you could probably figure out Biomancy rather quickly.

name: Expert Physics
description: #(Tag:science)You are an expert in Physics, the study of the laws of the universe, intimately familiar with how those laws interact with most objects and forces. If given magic, you could probably figure out Gravity and Electricity magic rather quickly.

name: Expert Chemistry
description: #(Tag:science)You are an expert in Chemistry, the study of matter, intimately familiar with how most compounds and materials form and how they react to each other and stimuli. If given magic, you could probably become an alchemist rather quickly.

name: Expert Math
description: #(Tag:science)You are a true mathematical savant, solving most number-related problems with ease and crunching numbers in your head far beyond most people.

name: Expert Blacksmithing
description: #(Tag:craft)You are an expert blacksmith of the hermit-in-the-mountains kind, visited by knights on dragon-slaying quests. You are intimately familiar with building all kinds of cold weapons of supernatural quality, able to forge an iron sword that cuts an iron block in half, and you can grant weapons special traits depending on your forging materials.

name: Expert Teaching
description: #(Tag:social)You are an expert teacher of the kind a protagonist meets mid-journey to learn an essential skill before moving on. You are incredibly skilled at imparting knowledge and skills, able to turn any old farmboy into a fine warrior.

name: Expert Blade Weapon Mastery
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:weapon)You are an expert in bladed weapons such as daggers and swords, not yet legendary, but in old ages songs would tell of you slaying 100 men with a single blade. Your expertise and finesse are the stuff of rumours.

name: Expert Blunt Weapon Mastery
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:weapon)You are an expert in blunt weapons like hammers and clubs, swinging with might that would brown the pants of any common man. In old ages, folklore would tell of you splattering a man across the battlefield with a simple mace.

name: Expert Polearm Mastery
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:weapon)You are an expert with polearms like spears, halberds, and scythes, not quite at the level of heroes like Cu Chulainn but ferocious in your own right, wielding the spear as an extension of your body.

name: Expert Item Construction
description: #(Tag:craft)(Tag:magic)You can create great enchanted and special items based on your capabilities. If you know fire magic, you could turn a regular ring into one that deploys fireballs and walls of fire while making the user resistant to fire, or if you have teleportation, you could create a ring that teleports people to a set location.

name: Expert Kama Sutra
description: #(Tag:nsfw)(Nsfw) You are an expert in the carnal arts, intimately familiar with reading signs of arousal and pleasuring partners in bed. Unless your partner is completely frigid, no one leaves your bed unsatisfied, and your skill is unmatched by most. If given magic, you could probably create Eromancy.

name: Expert Taming
description: #(Tag:social)You are an expert in taming and domestication, able to turn a ferocious beast into your best buddy and skillfully train creatures to gain their obedience and loyalty. This also applies to people to a lesser extent.

name: Expert Massage
description: #(Tag:craft)You are an expert masseuse on the level of a grandpa who spent his life refining his craft, giving massages that melt away exhaustion, revitalize the body, relieve tension, and give unmatched sexual pleasure.

name: Expert Driving
description: #(Tag:motor)(Tag:movement)You are an expert driver of all vehicles from scooters to spaceships, able to outrace a motorcycle while riding a tricycle. If it has steering controls, you can make it purr as others can only hope to imitate.

name: Expert Leadership
description: #(Tag:social)You are an expert leader on par with famous leaders like Iskandar or King Arthur, motivating, leading, and managing your people with finesse and efficiency. You could probably run your own country with some effort.

name: Expert Charisma
description: #(Tag:social)You have an aura of charisma that is less a skill and more something about your presence. People of note feel more attracted to your presence, and you are more intimidating when you want to be and more persuasive when you try to be.

name: Expert Medicine
description: #(Tag:medical)You are an expert in all fields of medicine seldom matched by regular humans, performing surgery, making your own supernatural medicine, and diagnosing ailments with ease and finesse.

name: Master Cooking
description: #(Tag:craft)You are a true master of cooking, able to cook almost any dish to incredible taste that may even gain supernatural traits depending on your ingredients. You can induce actual foodgasms.

name: Makeup
description: #(Tag:expertise)You are very skilled at applying makeup and enhancing natural beauty with products.

name: Master Acting
description: #(Tag:social)You are a master actor, perhaps no longer able to tell where the mask ends and you begin. You can present yourself any way you want and perfectly mask your emotions when needed. It would take nothing less than the eyes of a truth seer to see beyond your mask.

name: Master Shooting
description: #(Tag:ranged)You have marksmanship on the level of legends like Orion or Arash, or you could with enough training. Few mortals can dodge your projectiles, and in old times you would have been hailed as a legendary archer.

name: Master Hand-to-Hand Combat
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:unarmed)You have martial skill and talent on the level of legends, a true prodigy. You quickly master most martial arts, comprehend unarmed combat incredibly well, and your hands and feet are weapons that would not lose to swords and spears.

name: Master Programming
description: #(Tag:tech)You are a master programmer whose skills may as well be Tinker abilities, except this is all raw skill. You easily code complex algorithms and programs and create your own Artificial Intelligence. Sci-fi worlds fear you.

name: Master Mechanics
description: #(Tag:craft)(Tag:tech)You are a master mechanic whose skill at designing, fixing, and building machinery could be called a Tinker ability if it were not pure skill. You easily design, repair, build, and improve all mundane appliances, and with enough time and effort, you can create your own brand of Tinkertech.

name: Master Biology
description: #(Tag:science)You are a master in Biology, the study of life, perfectly familiar with the biology of most organisms from mammals to cellular life, able to guess the biology of completely unfamiliar creatures. Given time and effort, you can create godforsaken biological hybrids and homunculi and improve beings' physiology through surgery. You will need study to digest and use this knowledge due to its immense quantity.

name: Master Physics
description: #(Tag:science)You are a master in Physics, the study of the laws of the universe, knowing how those laws work and interact with the world. Given enough time and effort, you could probably invent anti-gravity, railgun tech, cold fusion, and more. You will need study to digest and use this knowledge due to its immense quantity.

name: Master Chemistry
description: #(Tag:science)You are a master in Chemistry, the study of matter, perfectly familiar with how most compounds and objects form and what reacts with what. At your mastery, you could probably make your own supersoldier serum given enough time. You will need study to digest and use this knowledge due to its immense quantity.

name: Master Math
description: #(Tag:science)You are beyond a basic savant, truly superhuman with numbers, mathematics, and calculations, to the point where others might wonder if you have a computer inside your head.

name: Master Blacksmithing
description: #(Tag:craft)You are a master blacksmith, not quite on the level of Muramasa, but your works are nothing less than art. You make weapons not for simple men but for mighty warriors and heroes of legend, and with time and effort, you can create weapons on the level of Noble Phantasms.

name: Master Teaching
description: #(Tag:social)You are a master teacher, able to masterfully impart knowledge and skills to your pupils. While not quite on the level of the Kingmaker Merlin, you can train heroes yourself, and in old times people from across the country would journey for your teachings.

name: Master Blade Weapon Mastery
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:weapon)You are a true master of blades spoken of only in legends, mentioned alongside King Arthur and Lancelot, on the cusp of the sword saint realm but not quite there yet.

name: Master Blunt Weapon Mastery
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:weapon)You are a true master of blunt weapons spoken of only in legends, one with your hammer, exerting far beyond your normal strength while wielding one. You can shatter castle walls with a tree branch.

name: Master Polearm Mastery
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:weapon)You are a true master of polearms spoken of only in legends, mentioned alongside Cu Chulainn and Lu Bu, handling all polearms such as spears, glaives, and scythes with mastery.

name: Master Item Construction
description: #(Tag:craft)(Tag:magic)You can create epic enchanted and special items based on your capabilities. If you know fire magic, you could turn a regular ring into one that lets the user use fire magic at a lower level, or if you have something like superhuman strength, you could create a ring that turns the average Joe into a super soldier. Stronger enchantments demand stronger base materials.

name: Master Kama Sutra
description: #(Tag:nsfw)(Nsfw) You are a true master of lovemaking and passion whom no mortal man can match, with your partners' bodies as putty in your hands. Even gods would be reduced to helpless messes by your skills.

name: Master Taming
description: #(Tag:social)You are a true master tamer, able to turn even the most ferocious, bloodthirsty, manic beast into a living room pet, and to masterfully train familiars for obedience and loyalty. This also applies to people to a lesser extent.

name: Master Massage
description: #(Tag:craft)(Tag:healing)You are a master masseuse beyond any mortal, whose massages can heal injuries and ailments, bringing therapy, immense pleasure, and comfort. Even the bodies of gods are like putty in your hands.

name: Master Driving
description: #(Tag:motor)(Tag:movement)You are a true master at driving any vehicle or mount with steering, riding it as an extension of your body, ranging from rollerblades to star-sized spacecraft.

name: Master Leadership
description: #(Tag:social)You are a master leader, excellent at managing, leading, motivating, and earning the loyalty of all under you. You could easily run your own country, and in old times you would be hailed as a legendary general.

name: Master Charisma
description: #(Tag:social)You have an aura of charisma that is less a skill and more something about your presence. People of note feel more attracted to your presence, your presence strikes fear when you want to intimidate, and your aura appears serene when you want to calm others.

name: Master Medicine
description: #(Tag:medical)You are a true master in all fields of medicine seldom matched by regular humans, performing surgery, making your own medicine, and diagnosing ailments with extreme efficiency and precision. You can create and design your own medicines, and with practice, even superhuman medicines.

name: Grandmaster Cooking
description: #(Tag:craft)You are a Grandmaster of Cooking, better than any mortal has any right to be, able to cook any meal from Elder Dragon steaks to Leviathan sushi. In addition to incredible taste, your foods gain special wondrous effects depending on what you cook.

name: Grandmaster Shooting
description: #(Tag:ranged)You are a Grandmaster Marksman, better than any mortal has any right to be, in the vein of Bullseye. Your accuracy with any ranged weapon and projectile is almost absolute, and their lethality in your hands is unmatched. You could kill a man two streets away by flicking a toothpick through his eyesocket into his brain.

name: Grandmaster Hand-to-Hand Combat
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:unarmed)You have reached the Saint level in martial arts. Even without abilities or energy, your arms and legs can strike the intangible, kicking so hard you shatter souls or slapping magic from hands.

name: Grandmaster Programming
description: #(Tag:tech)You are a Grandmaster Programmer, the scourge of advanced civilizations and artificial intelligences, casually coding incredibly complex programs and creating powerful intelligences. Given enough time, you could probably code your own Ultron.

name: Grandmaster Mechanics
description: #(Tag:craft)(Tag:tech)You are at Saint level in mechanics, able to create an automated factory even in the Stone Age. Your skill is on the level of a Tinker Ability, letting you easily build, design, fix, and innovate most technology, even beyond your world's level, including generalized Tinker Tech.

name: Grandmaster Biology
description: #(Tag:science)You have comprehension in Biology, the study of life, beyond what any mortal should have, instinctively understanding organisms' biology so that with a simple scan you can identify their genetic blueprint and alter biology, DNA, and genetics to your ends. You need time and study to digest this sheer amount of information, which at this level becomes comprehension and instinct toward the world rather than mere knowledge.

name: Grandmaster Physics
description: #(Tag:science)Your comprehension of Physics, the study of the laws of the universe, surpasses what any mortal should hold. You know how those laws work, interact with the world, and how to manipulate those forces to your ends. You need time and study to digest this knowledge; at this level it stops being knowledge and becomes comprehension and instinct toward the world around you.

name: Grandmaster Chemistry
description: #(Tag:science)Your comprehension of Chemistry, the study of matter, surpasses what any mortal should hold. You know how matter and materials form, combine, and interact, and you easily devise never-before-seen miracle alloys and materials. You need time and study to digest this knowledge; at this level it stops being knowledge and becomes comprehension and instinct toward the world around you.

name: Grandmaster Math
description: #(Tag:science)Your understanding of numbers, mathematics, and calculations is at a concerning level. You outcalculate NASA computers, crunching numbers faster than most computers can. If you forget your computer at home, your mind is the better alternative.

name: Grandmaster Blacksmithing
description: #(Tag:craft)You are a grandmaster blacksmith whom heroes and legends seek for legendary armaments. You give Muramasa a run for his money, and with enough resources you forge your own Durandal, Gram, Gae Bolg, etc.

name: Grandmaster Teaching
description: #(Tag:social)You are a grandmaster teacher on par with the Kingmaker Merlin, just without his decades of experience and repertoire of teachable skills. If you hold a skill yourself, you train a random country girl into a hero of legend.

name: Grandmaster Blade Weapon Mastery
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:weapon)You are a swordmaster on the level of a Saint, like Musashi and Sasaki Kojiro. Even without abilities or energy, you cut the intangible with any blade and your bare body, cutting souls, energy, and magic.

name: Grandmaster Blunt Weapon Mastery
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:weapon)You have reached Saint level with blunt weapons. You wield a club with such skill that you smash and shatter the intangible, shattering body, mind, and soul with a hit. You also bat away magic like a softball.

name: Grandmaster Polearm Mastery
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:weapon)You have reached Saint level with polearms. Without abilities or energy, you pierce and cut the intangible with your spear. You stab souls, cut abilities in half, and bat away magic with your shaft, etc.

name: Grandmaster Item Construction
description: #(Tag:craft)(Tag:magic)You know how to create legendary enchanted items depending on your knowledge, abilities, and skills. Your artefacts rank as national treasures and items of legend. You craft a ring granting teleportation or fire magic, or armor resisting the heat of the sun; the only limits are your abilities.

name: Grandmaster Leadership
description: #(Tag:social)Your leadership and ruling stand at the peak of what a person can achieve. You manage a kingdom and an army in your sleep as easily as playing a simulation game. People under your rule and command grow naturally more loyal and obedient, and they will not rebel unless you are just that bad.

name: Grandmaster Medicine
description: #(Tag:medical)You stand beyond human but not quite divine in all fields of medicine and healing. You perform surgery, modify bodies, create legendary medicines, and identify and cure almost all illnesses and ailments. In a cultivation world you are titled the Medicine King.

name: Divine Cooking
description: #(Tag:craft)Your cooking talent is on the level of the gods. Your food gives someone an epiphany and changes their life. Gods queue outside your restaurant to taste your cooking.

name: Divine Shooting
description: #(Tag:ranged)Your skill with bow and arrow is on the level of the gods. With training, you take Artemis, Apollo, and Arjuna's lunch money.

name: Divine Hand-to-Hand Combat
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:unarmed)Your martial arts talent is godly. You learn someone's martial art just by exchanging blows with them, and you invent new martial arts on the spot that would normally take masters tens of years to create.

name: Divine Programming
description: #(Tag:tech)Your programming is on the level of the gods. This is no longer just coding: you translate your code into actual magic formulas to execute in the world. You bring galactic empires to their knees, make any robot weep, and outcode Ultron.

name: Divine Mechanics
description: #(Tag:craft)(Tag:tech)Your ability to create, design, fix, and improve machinery is on the level of the gods. You outbuild Tony Stark, and with time you build a spaceship in the Stone Age regardless of world. You build practically any machine as long as you have the proper knowledge and abilities.

name: Principle of Life
description: #(Tag:magic)(Tag:science)You possess the creator's knowledge of Life and Biology. You know how to create, modify, and understand life. But this knowledge is too much for a mortal vessel, so it manifests as instinctive comprehension of all matters of life; the stronger you get, the more access you gain to the principle.

name: Principle of Law
description: #(Tag:magic)(Tag:science)You possess the creator's knowledge of the fundamental forces of the universe. You know perfectly how the world's laws work and how to manipulate them to your desires. But this knowledge is too much for a mortal vessel, so it manifests as instinctive comprehension of all matters of law; the stronger you get, the more access you gain to the principle.

name: Principle of Matter
description: #(Tag:magic)(Tag:science)You possess the creator's knowledge of matter and creation. You know how to construct, transmute, and understand matter, even creating matter that does not exist. But this knowledge is too much for a mortal vessel, so it manifests as instinctive comprehension of all matters of matter; the stronger you get, the more access you gain to the principle.

name: Divine Formula
description: #(Tag:science)Your internal calculator surpasses any calculator. You effortlessly solve all mathematical problems and calculate faster than the fastest supercomputers. You can probably replicate the Kankara formula from DxD. But if your vessel is too weak, do not use all your computational power or you will melt your brain.

name: Divine Blacksmithing
description: #(Tag:craft)Your blacksmithing skill is on the level of a god. With enough training you give Hephaestus a run for his money. With enough resources and time, you forge your own Excalibur, Gungnir, Longinus, Mjolnir, etc.

name: Divine Teaching
description: #(Tag:social)Your ability to impart skills and knowledge is divine. With enough effort, you train the average farmboy into a demigod. There is no one you cannot teach.

name: Divine Blade Weapon Mastery
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:weapon)Your mastery with swords is divine. With training, there is nothing you cannot cut: space, time, heat, mind, souls; the only limit is the effort you put in. If you are not strong enough, you need training to properly digest this skill.

name: Divine Polearm Mastery
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:weapon)Your mastery with polearms is divine. With training, there is nothing you cannot stab, cut, or strike: space, time, heat, mind, souls; the only limit is the effort you put in. If you are not strong enough, you need training to properly digest this skill.

name: Divine Blunt Weapon Mastery
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:weapon)Your mastery with blunt instruments is divine. With training, there is nothing you cannot crush and shatter: space, time, heat, mind, souls; the only limit is the effort you put in. If you are not strong enough, you need training to properly digest this skill.

name: Divine Item Construction
description: #(Tag:craft)(Tag:magic)Your knowledge of creating artefacts and wondrous items is on the level of the gods. Your creations rank as holy grails. If you have the skills, resources, time, and abilities, you make your own divine artefacts like a tesseract, a holy grail, or even a Longinus.

name: Divine Leadership
description: #(Tag:social)Your leadership and ruling skills are divine. You maintain a galaxy-spanning empire and handle all its bureaucracy yourself. Any army you lead fights with unstoppable morale and might, and any empire you lead prospers.

name: Divine Charisma
description: #(Tag:social)You carry the presence and aura of a god. Your sheer charisma brings people to their knees, draws people of note to you, calms a raging beast, and inspires awe in the masses. You are the most popular being alive.

name: Divine Medicine
description: #(Tag:medical)You are as skilled as a god of health and medicine. You modify and heal bodies to your liking as long as you have the tools, cure any ailment, and create divine medicines like panaceas and elixirs of immortality. But this knowledge is too much for a mortal vessel, so it manifests as instinctive comprehension of all matters of life; the stronger you get, the more access you gain to the divine knowledge.

name: Novice Interfacing
description: #(Tag:motor)You are nimble. You pick basic locks, pick pockets, find your way around mechanisms, and move with decent grace.

name: Intermediate Interfacing
description: #(Tag:motor)You are tricky. You pick locks, pick pockets, work out the kinks in mechanisms, and find your way around things. Your fingers grow a little restless.

name: Adept Interfacing
description: #(Tag:motor)You are dexterous with slippery fingers. You easily pick mundane locks, empty pockets unnoticed, perform stage magic tricks (performance, not actual magic), and work out the kinks in mechanisms. Few barriers keep you out, and few jails hold you.

name: Expert Interfacing
description: #(Tag:motor)Your interfacing skill defeats almost any lock or mechanism. You probably steal the clothes off someone's body without them noticing. You feel out and exploit weaknesses in locks, machines, terminals, etc. at an incredible level.

name: Master Interfacing
description: #(Tag:motor)You are a master of interfacing, and your fingers are so nimble that locks and barriers may as well not exist. You pick your way into Area 51 with a single hairpin, steal someone's underwear off their body unnoticed, and interface with and exploit any lock or mechanism like your own body.

name: Novice Savoir Faire
description: #(Tag:motor)You move with grace and finesse. You are light on your feet, you dance and place your feet so you do not trip and fall, and even when you fall you do so with grace.

name: Intermediate Savoir Faire
description: #(Tag:motor)You move with grace and finesse. You are light on your feet, tear up the dance floor, rarely lose your balance, and perform parkour, flips, and manoeuvres with decent grace.

name: Adept Savoir Faire
description: #(Tag:motor)You are smooth. Grace and finesse come naturally to you, and you move with flair and smoothness. You are skilled at acrobatics, dancing, parkour, and anything requiring finesse or agility.

name: Expert Savoir Faire
description: #(Tag:motor)You are stylish and cool with unmatched finesse. You perform acrobatics, dancing, parkour, and anything requiring finesse or agility at expert level. You move like wind and water.

name: Master Savoir Faire
description: #(Tag:motor)You are the master of grace, coolness, and finesse. You perform baffling feats of acrobatics, dancing, parkour, and nimbleness as naturally as breathing. Even as a baseline human, you dance around bullets.

name: Novice Stealth
description: #(Tag:motor)(Tag:stealth)You are a novice in stealth. You mask your footsteps, sneak up on people, check for traps, and gather information more effectively. But anyone actually working in the field is better than you.

name: Intermediate Stealth
description: #(Tag:motor)(Tag:stealth)You are experienced in stealth. You move silently, sneak up on people, check for traps, and gather information more effectively. You qualify as a ninja grunt.

name: Adept Stealth
description: #(Tag:motor)(Tag:stealth)You are skilled in stealth. You move silently, sneak up on people, check for traps, and blend into your surroundings, even sneaking up on people who know you are coming. You make Solid Snake proud.

name: Expert Stealth
description: #(Tag:motor)(Tag:stealth)You are an expert in stealth. You move like a ghost, blend into your surroundings, and swim with the shadows. You infiltrate a military base unseen and stalk an owl through a forest in a high-visibility jacket. You rank with the greatest assassins.

name: Master Stealth
description: #(Tag:motor)(Tag:stealth)You have mastered stealth. You blend with shadows, move without sound, and suppress your presence so fully that even someone looking directly at you struggles to distinguish you from the world around you. You rank with the greatest of the Hassassin.

name: Jack of All Trades
description: #(Tag:craft)(Tag:medical)(Tag:motor)You hold novice-level expertise in all basic trades (Novice Blacksmithing, Medicine, Mechanics, Cooking, Interfacing) with apprentice competence. It does not extend to combat skills.

name: Queen of All Trades
description: #(Tag:craft)(Tag:medical)(Tag:motor)You hold intermediate-level expertise in all basic trades (Intermediate Blacksmithing, Medicine, Mechanics, Cooking, Interfacing) with competence comparable to actual trade performers.

name: King of All Trades
description: #(Tag:craft)(Tag:medical)(Tag:motor)You hold Adept-level expertise in all basic trades (Adept Blacksmithing, Medicine, Mechanics, Cooking, Interfacing) with competence comparable to a veteran of the trade.

name: Ace of All Trades
description: #(Tag:craft)(Tag:medical)(Tag:motor)You hold Expert-level expertise in all basic trade skills (Expert Blacksmithing, Medicine, Mechanics, Cooking, Interfacing), comparable to true trade masters. If you train further, you advance far more quickly in any trade field.

name: Calligraphy
description: #(Tag:expertise)You have excellent handwriting, letting you write extremely fast while keeping it appealing.

name: Meditation
description: #(Tag:expertise)You are well-versed in meditation, calming down and clearing your mind of distractions. While meditative, your energy recovers slightly faster.

name: Etiquette
description: #(Tag:expertise)(Tag:social)You have excellent etiquette. You present yourself with regal bearing, keep high society's rules, and maintain decorum and politeness.

name: Swimming
description: #(Tag:expertise)(Tag:motor)You swim very well, on par with an Olympian swimmer. If dunked in water, you likely will not drown.

name: Novice Performance
description: #(Tag:social)You know how to put on a performance. You play all musical instruments well enough for basic songs, sing decently, and dance without tripping. You fit right in with a high school band.

name: Intermediate Performance
description: #(Tag:social)You are a qualified performer. You play all basic instruments well enough for most songs, sing well enough that people may like it, and dance without being an eyesore. You assemble your own semi-successful band.

name: Adept Performance
description: #(Tag:social)You are a great performer. You play all instruments well enough to impress most people and sing well enough to capture attention with flair for crowds. You know how to put on a show and sustain a very successful entertainment career.

name: Expert Performance
description: #(Tag:social)You have expert performer skills. You play any instrument as well as anyone can and sing with a voice that impresses almost anyone. You captivate large crowds, imbue emotion into your songs, and sway crowds like an expert. You rank among the classics and greats.

name: Master Performance
description: #(Tag:social)You have mastered performance. You play any instrument well enough to impress the world, and your singing voice is captivating. You sway entire crowds, make them weep or cheer, and capture and sway them instinctively. You rank among the greatest artists and idols of all time.

name: Novice Management
description: #(Tag:mental)You are a novice at managing. You schedule your day, distribute tasks, and allocate attention to spend time better. You make a decent secretary.

name: Intermediate Management
description: #(Tag:mental)You are fairly skilled at management. You split attention between tasks, distribute tasks, structure things, and manage groups. You make a fine secretary or small business owner.

name: Adept Management
description: #(Tag:mental)You are skilled at management. You distribute tasks, handle them and employees or minions efficiently, multitask efficiently, and resolve financial problems efficiently. You run your own company or serve as an excellent financial advisor.

name: Expert Management
description: #(Tag:mental)You are an expert in management. Whether managing finances, people, assets, tasks, or your own attention and problems, you do so with brutal efficiency and expertise. You run a multinational company or a nation.

name: Master Management
description: #(Tag:mental)You are a master of management. You manage tasks, people, assets, finances, task distribution, and anything needed to run a large group like a company or country. You split attention seamlessly like parallel processing. You increase your mastery further through training and experience.

name: Novice Discipline
description: #(Tag:mental)You have basic discipline. You endure slight hardship, force yourself to eat what you dislike and study when unwilling, but your discipline is not much greater than average.

name: Intermediate Discipline
description: #(Tag:mental)Your discipline is remarkable. You endure hardship like discomfort and pain without audible complaint, force yourself to train when unwilling, leave a comfortable bed, and maintain focus. People credit you with excellent work ethic.

name: Adept Discipline
description: #(Tag:mental)Your dedication and focus are admirable. You focus without falling to distractions and grit your teeth to finish, pushing through discomfort, annoyance, and pain. Mental abilities struggle to affect you.

name: Expert Discipline
description: #(Tag:mental)Your mind is iron and your focus is sharp as a blade. If you refuse interruption, you are not interrupted; if you must continue, you do. You endure the toughest training even as your body breaks down, forcing it onward longer. You strongly resist mental influences and effects.

name: Master Discipline
description: #(Tag:mental)You are master of your own mind and captain of your own ship. Pain does not impair your abilities, and you endure the toughest punishments even when you think you cannot. Your focus and discipline cannot be shaken. Your mind cannot be shaken by those weaker than you, and even stronger foes struggle. You are as disciplined as Batman himself.

name: Rokushiki
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:technique)(Tag:unique)You train in Rokushiki, the superhuman martial art for only the most expert Marines and Cipher Pol agents. It holds 6 special superhuman techniques plus a secret 7th once you master the others. You start knowing all techniques but must train to use them.

name: Caryll Runecraft
description: #(Tag:magic)(Tag:unique)The Outer Ones beyond the stars whisper to you, letting you glimpse their knowledge as runes. You memorize the Outer Gods' runes to gain boons, but you must study to memorize the runes given to you. You can only hold three runes active at a time. List of Runes: https://bloodborne.wiki.fextralife.com/Caryll+Runes

name: Novice Conceptualization
description: #(Tag:mental)Conceptualization is your ability to grasp what should not be: the mystical, magical, and eldritch. You comprehend, understand, and learn mystical and exotic effects more easily, but only slightly above average.

name: Intermediate Conceptualization
description: #(Tag:mental)Conceptualization is your ability to grasp what lies beyond the mundane. At intermediate level, you comprehend the mystical and esoteric, learn and master magic faster, and better understand the composition of abilities and esoteric effects.

name: Adept Conceptualization
description: #(Tag:mental)Conceptualization is your ability to grasp the mundane-defying and inexplicable. At this level, hearing the old ones whisper will probably not shatter your mind. Magic and the esoteric make more sense when you see them; you understand, learn, and develop magic more easily and grasp reality's mystical side better.

name: Expert Conceptualization
description: #(Tag:mental)Conceptualization is your ability to grasp beyond mundane reality into esoterica and the mystical. Your mind more easily comprehends arcane mysteries and esoterics, letting you learn and develop things like magic far more easily with great intuition for reality's esoteric side.

name: Master Conceptualization
description: #(Tag:mental)Conceptualization is your ability to grasp what hides behind base reality's veil. You comprehend arcane mysteries and Outer concepts like second nature, understanding, dissecting, learning, and developing magic and mystery far beyond most mages. You converse with the old ones and, with training, translate their words into runes or use them to break minds.

name: Divine Conceptualization
description: #(Tag:mental)You have achieved true conceptualization; your mind is wired unlike mortals and immortals. Grasping magic and mystery is no harder than basic math or reading words on paper. You instinctively use magic, and through natural understanding of the stars you call on the Outer Gods' powers and bend reality with their words given enough practice. You may rightly be considered an infant Outer God.

name: Soma's Winemaking
description: #(Tag:craft)(Tag:unique)You make wine and other alcohol as well as the god Soma. You still need to experiment to learn what you can make with available resources, and you do not succeed every time.

name: Quickening
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:motor)(Tag:unique)You have mastered the Old Hunters' Quickening Technique. You briefly dash forward at incredible speed while shrouding your form in arcane fog to obscure your movements. It heavily strains your stamina and energy.

name: Edna Mode
description: #(Tag:craft)You are THE fashionista, a master designer of clothes and costumes. Your costume creation rivals a Tinker.

name: Salt Distillation
description: #(Tag:craft)You can skillfully extract salt from water sources or tears.

name: Prana Bindu
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:motor)You have learned Prana Bindu. You train bodily control beyond human levels, from individual muscles to individual strands, and eventually, with enough training, your nerves and bioelectrical signals.

name: Novice Communication
description: #(Tag:social)You are slightly better than average at understanding others and conveying your thoughts clearly. You know how to properly communicate with people.

name: Intermediate Communication
description: #(Tag:social)You are skilled at understanding others and conveying your intent through words and actions. You discern the emotions behind their words and make yourself understood even by people who struggle to understand others.

name: Adept Communication
description: #(Tag:social)You are greatly skilled at communicating, understanding others, and conveying your intentions. You make yourself understood to basically anyone, even using only body language. You easily read intent and emotion from body language, tone of voice, and small tells. Only someone like a trained spy can easily hide their intentions from you.

name: Expert Communication
description: #(Tag:social)You are an expert in communication. You always convey what you mean to anyone, from the dullest human to the lowliest beast, even through gestures alone without being misunderstood. You cold read people to detect lies and understand what they want and feel without them speaking.

name: Master Communication
description: #(Tag:social)You are an absolute master of communication bordering on magic. Even without understanding their language, you read intent and emotion from a glance, almost like mind-reading. You always convey exactly what you mean: a hundred words with a single nod, speech animals understand, or exactly how badly you will hurt or love someone.

name: Novice Persuasion
description: #(Tag:social)You are slightly better than average at persuasion, pleading your case and convincing people with words.

name: Intermediate Persuasion
description: #(Tag:social)You are skilled at convincing people with words or actions, like a used car salesman or lawyer. You have a decent feel for what words resonate with each type of person.

name: Adept Persuasion
description: #(Tag:social)You are a skilled talker, well-trained at convincing people with words and actions. You present yourself to be easily believed and know how to make people trust what you say. You would make a damn fine politician.

name: Expert Persuasion
description: #(Tag:social)You are an expert in persuasion. You know what words and actions sway each type of person, and can persuade people to do things they would otherwise refuse.

name: Master Persuasion
description: #(Tag:social)You have mastered persuasion. You are among history's best talkers, with almost supernatural awareness of what words and actions work on each person. Still, some people simply cannot be made to listen.

name: Novice Ninjutsu
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:stealth)(Tag:weapon)You have passed very basic ninja training, though you are no true ninja. You handle most knives and swords without cutting yourself, and have basic acrobatics, sneaking, and combat tool use.

name: Intermediate Ninjutsu
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:stealth)(Tag:weapon)You are a ninja grunt. You handle throwing weapons, knives, and swords with relative skill, and are decent at sneaking, acrobatics, espionage, and using tools in combat with finesse.

name: Adept Ninjutsu
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:stealth)(Tag:weapon)You are a fully fledged ninja, not just a footman. You skillfully handle thrown weapons, bladed weapons, and hand-to-hand combat. You are a skilled acrobat, can mask your sounds and presence fairly effectively, and use tools proficiently in combat. You are no match for another Adept in any single field, but together your skills make you formidable.

name: Expert Ninjutsu
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:stealth)(Tag:weapon)You are a true Expert Ninja with honed skills. You handle thrown weapons, bladed weapons, and unarmed combat with great efficiency, favoring quick, brutal decisive strikes, and excel at supplementing your style with tools. Your agility and acrobatics are incredible: you can aim-dodge bullets even with base human stats and parkour as naturally as walking. Your stealth makes you a shadow in the night; suppressing your presence, blending into the background, and leaving no tracks is second nature to you, and most would struggle to spot you. You are no match for another Expert in any single field, but together your skills make you formidable. You may need time and training to digest this influx of skills.

name: Master Ninjutsu
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:stealth)(Tag:weapon)You are a Master Ninja with mastery over several crafts. You expertly use thrown weapons, tools, bladed weapons, and unarmed combat in a lethal style only other masters can match. You are an expert at acrobatics and stealth, hiding your presence from all but the most vigilant eyes, blending into your environment, and moving with utmost efficiency and grace. You are no match for another Master in any single field, but together your skills make you formidable. You may need time and training to digest this influx of skills.

name: Mixology
description: #(Tag:expertise)You are a well-trained mixologist and bartender. You mix most drinks, invent great-tasting alcohol combinations, manage a bar, and handle drunk people.

name: Begging
description: #(Tag:expertise)(Tag:social)You are very skilled at throwing away your dignity to beg for things. On all fours crying, you seem pitiful enough that most people grant your request. People are more receptive to your begging, making requests easier to accept. Warning: effects depend heavily on the individual, and work especially well on soft-hearted people.

name: Architecture
description: #(Tag:expertise)You are very skilled at architecture, designing buildings and structures that look good and hold up well. You could design entire cities, minus the infrastructure, and easily work as an architect.

name: Litigation
description: #(Tag:expertise)You have the skills of an experienced lawyer. You grasp the laws of your world, country, and city well enough to easily defend yourself or a client in local court.

name: Gooning
description: #(Tag:expertise)(Tag:martial)(Tag:ranged)(Tag:social)(Tag:weapon)You are skilled at gooning, serving as a low-rank thug for a boss. You shake people down for money, intimidate them for their wallets, and fight with novice-level knives, pistols, and unarmed combat. You can use a Brooklyn accent at will, and could easily land a low-ranking job in any organised crime organisation.

name: Cosplayer
description: #(Tag:expertise)You are very skilled at cosplaying and dressing up. You sew well enough to make convincing outfits, especially clothes you have seen before. If you cosplay a real person, people may mistake you for them.

name: Servitude
description: #(Tag:expertise)You are one hell of a maid/butler, skilled in housekeeping, manners, and servitude. You clean, track schedules, remember preferences, and present yourself professionally yet approachably.

name: Aura Farming
description: #(Tag:expertise)You are skilled at presenting yourself as cool and badass. You spot the perfect moments to farm aura: interjecting on cue, making dramatic entrances, or posing caped on a ledge. You avoid seeming uncool by not tripping or stuttering, and recover well from mistakes to keep your aura.

name: Fishman Karate
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:unarmed)(Tag:unique)You know Fishman Karate, the Fishmen's martial art for manipulating water offensively. You use existing water to strengthen your blows, disrupt fluids inside opponents with your hits, or transmit your fists' power through airborne moisture. You start as a white belt and can train to higher mastery.

name: Clowning Around
description: #(Tag:expertise)You are a Clown College graduate. You tell lame jokes, entertain kids, make balloon animals, fit in comically small cars, apply humorous makeup, and perform other professional clown skills.

name: Novice Spycraft
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:ranged)(Tag:social)(Tag:stealth)(Tag:weapon)You have basic spy training, though not enough to be a proper spy. You are better at eavesdropping, masking your feelings, deceiving people, using disguises, deducing thoughts, and wielding guns and knives without killing yourself. You are no match for anyone properly trained in those fields, but you are better than the average person.

name: Intermediate Spycraft
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:ranged)(Tag:social)(Tag:stealth)(Tag:weapon)You are a fully fledged but unremarkable spy. You eavesdrop, snoop for information, interrogate, deceive, use disguises, and fight with knives and guns when needed. You are no match for a fellow intermediate in any single skill, but together they make you a decent spy.

name: Adept Spycraft
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:ranged)(Tag:social)(Tag:stealth)(Tag:weapon)You are a real spy who would make James Bond proud. You are skilled at gathering information, infiltrating places, acting, masking your emotions, using disguises effectively, reading people, and handling yourself in combat with knives, guns, and hand-to-hand. You are no match for a fellow adept in any single skill, but together they make you effective.

name: Expert Spycraft
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:ranged)(Tag:social)(Tag:stealth)(Tag:weapon)You are an Expert Spy who would make Loid Forger proud. You are greatly skilled at gathering information, infiltration, acting, staying calm under stress, disguising, cold reading people, and fighting with unarmed, knives, and guns when needed. You are no match for a fellow expert in any single skill, but together they make you great.

name: Master Spycraft
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:ranged)(Tag:social)(Tag:stealth)(Tag:weapon)You are a Master Spy, among the best there is. You are an expert at gathering information, infiltration, deception, acting, keeping your cool, disguising, cold reading people, and fighting with unarmed, knives, and guns when needed. You are no match for a fellow master in any single skill, but together they make you a master spy.

name: Stylist
description: #(Tag:expertise)You are a hair stylist employable by celebrities and nobles. You style hair well, like second nature.

name: Cheer
description: #(Tag:expertise)(Tag:social)You have a natural knack for motivating and cheering people up. You know what words and actions they need to escape a slump. You would make one hell of a cheerleader.

name: Novice Fine Arts
description: #(Tag:craft)You are a novice artist with beginner skill in most fine arts such as painting, engraving, sketching, and sculpting, and some skill at making things more aesthetically pleasing. You are no real artist yet.

name: Intermediate Fine Arts
description: #(Tag:craft)You have the skills of a professional fine artist, with good skill in drawing, painting, sketching, sculpting, engraving, and making things more aesthetically pleasing. You could easily work as a painter, illustrator, or sculptor, but you would not stand out.

name: Adept Fine Arts
description: #(Tag:craft)You have the skills of an experienced senior artist, with great skill in drawing, painting, sketching, sculpting, engraving, and making things more aesthetically pleasing. You could easily work in the arts; in medieval times, most nobles would hire you.

name: Expert Fine Arts
description: #(Tag:craft)You have the skills of an expert renowned artist, with impressive skill in drawing, painting, sketching, sculpting, engraving, and making things more aesthetically pleasing. Your works could hang in museums and sell for fortunes at auction; your paintings evoke great emotion and your sculptures look almost alive. In medieval times, nobles would line up for you and your name would go down in history.

name: Master Fine Arts
description: #(Tag:craft)You have the skills of a true master artist, with incredible, almost supernatural skill in drawing, painting, sketching, sculpting, engraving, and making things more aesthetically pleasing. With time and inspiration, you produce masterpieces; you instinctively know what aesthetics appeal to whom, how to pour your thoughts and emotions into your works, and create art that shakes even the sternest critics. You would rank among the greatest in art history, the kind legends speak of when gods curse mortals for beating them in skill.

name: Farming
description: #(Tag:expertise)You have extensive farming knowledge rivaling the most experienced farmers, including maintaining a farm, caring for livestock, maintaining soil, and more.

name: Sign Language
description: #(Tag:expertise)(Tag:social)You use this world's basic sign language as fluently as your native language.

name: Mental Image Blocking
description: #(Tag:mental)(Tag:technique)You learned from the elusive Tibetan Monks to block mind readers and telepaths by masking your thoughts with conjured mental images.

name: Mind Control Resistance
description: #(Tag:mental)(Tag:technique)Thanks to the Tibetan Monks' teachings, you resist mind control and mind reading. Your resistance scales with your mental strength and overall power level.

name: Army Breaker
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:unarmed)Rikudou: Army Breaker is a specialized martial art based in Karate movements. You emphasize arm weight, shifting balance, and relaxation to strike fast as whips yet heavy as hammers; skilled enough, you cut to bone in one blow. With enough practice, you control your joints to elongate your arms and empower the attacks called Dawn.

name: Kaiwan Style
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:unarmed)You are an apprentice in the Kaiwan Style, an assassination art rooted in multiple arts, mainly Karate. It requires knowledge of the nervous system, pressure points, and Qigong. Outwardly simplistic, it focuses on perfectly timed direct strikes and great bodily control. Its main move is Devil Lance, a spear-like strike of great power that demands superhuman conditioning. Skilled users can use Motionless to predict opponents' next moves and strike their openings.

name: The Niko Style
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:unarmed)(Tag:unique)You are an apprentice in the Niko Style, a compilation of Katas demanding great bodily control, skill, and practice. The Adamantine Kata tightens and braces muscles to deliver powerful blows and withstand attacks. The Flame Kata focuses on dodging, footwork, and agility. The Redirection Kata shifts and parries opponents' blows. The Water Kata focuses on binds and holds. You combine all four into Demonsbane, a devastating strike demanding immense skill. Its secret Possessing Spirit speeds your heartbeat to extremes to boost performance, while Fallen Demon forcibly slows your time perception, but both can damage you.

name: Possessing Spirit
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:mental)(Tag:technique)(Tag:unarmed)(Tag:unique)Otherwise called Advance, you speed up your heartbeat and blood flow to massively boost performance, but it can make your bloodlust harder to control, which you can train. First Gear boosts performance and makes self-control harder. Second Gear further boosts performance but induces bloodlust and lowers self-control. Third Gear raises heartbeat and blood flow to inhuman levels, making you seem demon-possessed, massively amplifying performance and bloodlust while suppressing pain, but likely causing permanent damage without intervention. It can damage your heart, veins, and organs from immense strain and inhuman blood flow.

name: Kaolan Style
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:unarmed)You are an apprentice in the Kaolan Style, an all-rounder combining Muay Thai and Boxing, invented by genius boxer Kaolan Wongsavat. It focuses on adaptability, power, and speed to overwhelm opponents with quick strikes while answering most moves. Its standout Flash throws a hail of flicker jabs at great speed in a single breath. Its strongest God Blow is an incredibly fast straight punch that can injure your arm if thrown improperly.

name: Lingshu Chin Na
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:medical)(Tag:unarmed)You practice Lingshu Chin Na, a Chinese art striking opponents' acupoints to debilitate without needing greater strength. Using bodily knowledge, you land quick, precise finger jabs to acupoints, debilitating with each strike when used properly. The further a target's biology deviates from human, the harder you will find it to use without study.

name: Kujin Style
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:unarmed)The Kujin Style is a Japanese art made to counter heavily armored or large, lumbering opponents. You rely on throws, sweeps, and trips to ground opponents, then finish them with powerful blows while they are down. But you may struggle against more traditional martial arts.

name: Martial Foresight
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:technique)(Tag:unique)Foresight is a technique of skilled fighters. You predict targets' moves to dodge and counter them through quick analysis and instinct. Your Foresight is basic, and will require real fights to train and develop.

name: Novice Arms Mastery
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:weapon)You handle all conventional weapons, from knives to swords to axes to polearms to guns to bows to chained weapons and clubs, with basic proficiency, enough for familiarity and knowing how they are used.

name: Intermediate Arms Mastery
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:weapon)You handle all conventional weapons, from knives to swords to axes to polearms to guns to bows to chained weapons and clubs, with notable proficiency, enough to match a general practitioner and wield them effectively.

name: Adept Arms Mastery
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:weapon)You handle all conventional weapons, from knives to swords to axes to polearms to guns to bows to chained weapons and clubs, with great skill, enough to match most dedicated practitioners.

name: Expert Arms Mastery
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:weapon)You handle all conventional weapons, from knives to swords to axes to polearms to guns to bows to chained weapons and clubs, with incredible skill, enough to match real experts specialized in those weapons.

name: Master Arms Mastery
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:weapon)You have mastery over all conventional and non-conventional weapons, from knives, billhooks, boomerangs, swords, whips, and more. Any weapon you hold, you use as if you have wielded it all your life, and you easily recognize and dissect other Weapon Arts you witness. Your general Weapon mastery grants incredible martial prowess.

name: Novice Total Concentration Breathing
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:technique)(Tag:unique)You are a novice of Total Concentration Breathing, a breathing technique that raises blood oxygen and better activates your muscles, granting a superhuman physique while maintained. As a novice, you know only the very basics, but you can improve with practice.

name: Intermediate Total Concentration Breathing
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:technique)(Tag:unique)You are learned in Total Concentration Breathing, a breathing technique that raises blood oxygen and better activates your muscles, granting a superhuman physique while maintained. As an intermediate, you actively maintain it in combat, but you can improve with practice.

name: Adept Total Concentration Breathing
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:technique)(Tag:unique)You are an adept in Total Concentration Breathing, a breathing technique that raises blood oxygen and better activates your muscles, granting a superhuman physique while maintained. As an adept, you easily maintain it in a fight without added strain, and in daily life unless exhausted or excessively distracted. You also use it to stop your own bleeding and speed recovery.

name: Expert Total Concentration Breathing
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:technique)(Tag:unique)You are an expert in Total Concentration Breathing on par with a Hashira, a breathing technique that raises blood oxygen and better activates your muscles for superhuman performance. You have achieved Total Concentration Breathing Constant, maintaining it even while sleeping. You also forcefully close wounds, expel poison, and speed recovery.

name: Pre-Initiative
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:technique)(Tag:unique)Pre-Initiative is an advanced form of a fighter's foresight; you know an enemy's move before they use it and counter before they throw it. It comes from extensive martial arts familiarity and analyzing opponents' styles. It demands much training, sparring, and familiarity with many styles, but a master seems almost omniscient against a lesser opponent after only a few exchanged moves.

name: Reduced Earth
description: #(Tag:earth)(Tag:martial)(Tag:unique)Reduced earth is a movement technique for covering a short distance in a single extremely fast movement through practiced breathing, footwork, and exertion. But it is quite exhausting to use.

name: Ryu's Shotokan
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:unique)You practice Ryu's Shotokan, a special Karate school created by Ryu. It focuses on direct, powerful strikes with kicks and punches, mixing aggression and defense. With enough practice, you tap into the Kyoi no Hado and harness Ki to empower your blows, perform special techniques, and use the Hadoken.

name: Akuma's Shotokan
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:unarmed)(Tag:unique)You practice Akuma's Shotokan, a special Karate school created by Akuma. It focuses on direct, powerful strikes with kicks and punches, emphasizing brutal aggression and offense. With enough practice, you tap into the Satsui no Hado and harness raw killing intent as Ki to enhance your body, imbue your strikes, turn your inner energy into dark flame-like Ki, use the Gohadoken, and take a more demonic form to further boost power, but overuse without control can make you lose yourself and turn into a demon. You need great skill and control to avoid losing yourself and master it.

name: The Shotokan
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:unarmed)(Tag:unique)You practice Goutetsu's Shotokan, a special Karate school. It focuses on direct, powerful strikes with kicks and punches, but its heart is the Satsui and Kyoi no Hado, Dark and Light. As you practice, you may awaken and train in one Hado to tap its full power, reinforcing your strikes with Ki and releasing energy waves to supplement your style.

name: Master Total Concentration Breathing
description: #(Tag:martial)(Tag:unique)You have fully mastered Total Concentration Breathing, a breathing technique that raises blood oxygen and better activates your muscles, granting exceptional performance and letting you use your body to its utmost potential. You maintain it as easily as regular breathing. While maintained, your recovery speeds are sped up.

name: Dapping
description: #(Tag:expertise)You are a master at dapping people up effectively, judging dap distance and producing a satisfying crispy dap regardless of the other party's skill or constitution.

name: Boggart's Boiling Brilliance
description: #(Tag:craft)You have learned to boil crab, prawn, and crustaceans in general with great skill, on the level of the great Big Boggart. Even if your crab is the magical kind from the Lands Between, it will taste spectacular.

name: Hacking
description: #(Tag:tech)You are skilled at leveraging your skills to breach networks and bypass digital and cyber defenses.

name: Crying
description: #(Tag:expertise)You cry at will, and very convincingly.

name: Judging
description: #(Tag:expertise)(Tag:social)You are very skilled at judging and discerning the morality of people you meet, as well as spotting ill intent.

name: Commerce
description: #(Tag:expertise)(Tag:social)You are very skilled at haggling, assessing monetary value, and securing a good price for everything.

name: Tax Evasion
description: #(Tag:expertise)You are a master of tax evasion. If you wish, the government sees no more of your money than you allow. You know the ins and outs of money laundering, obfuscating, and more.

name: Kidnapping
description: #(Tag:expertise)You are very skilled at kidnapping targets, planning such operations with great skill and finesse and executing them with practiced moves.

name: Factory Planning
description: #(Tag:craft)Lay out production lines, manifolds, and bus feeds that scale up without dissolving into spaghetti.

name: Machine Override
description: #(Tag:tech)Hack overridden machines to fight for you or serve as mounts.

name: Bushcraft
description: #Forage, hunt, craft, and read the land in any hostile wild.

name: Colony Medicine
description: #(Tag:healing)Triage, surgery, and glitterworld care with whatever counts as a hospital.

name: Colony Construction
description: #(Tag:craft)Raise bases fast and sturdy, from wooden shacks to plasteel fortresses.

name: Deep Space Survey
description: #(Tag:science)Chart stars, anomalies, and habitable worlds with professional thoroughness.

name: Galactic Diplomacy
description: #(Tag:social)Federations, vassals, and first contact without starting an extermination war. Usually.

name: Sneaking
description: #(Tag:stealth)Move unseen, pick pockets, and backstab with professional discretion.

name: Persuasion
description: #(Tag:social)Talk down fights, talk up prices, and talk your way into restricted areas.

name: Masonry
description: #(Tag:craft)Cut stone blocks and raise fortresses that outlast civilizations.

name: Brewing
